dossier.kits: 雙方裝備並非整齊地按年份換代，以下型號在1959年底以前均已列裝，卻一直使用至後期。美軍與南越軍常見步槍、衝鋒槍和機槍包括M1 Garand、M1卡賓槍、M1928A1湯普森衝鋒槍、M3A1、M1919A4、M2重機槍及1957年開始服役的M60；火炮包括M101 105毫米榴砲、M1 155毫米榴砲與M115 8英寸榴砲，裝甲車輛則有M3 Lee、M24 Chaffee、M47、M48 Patton以及M35、M54系列卡車，無線電包括1959年投入使用的AN/PRC-25。航空裝備有C-47、B-52、F-100、F-101、A-1 Skyraider、A-4 Skyhawk、C-130、UH-1、H-34、H-21與HH-43，其中UH-1在1959年才開始交付，卻很快改變了機動作戰。北越空軍使用An-2、MiG-17、MiG-21與Il-28，並部署1957年已列裝的SA-2防空導彈；北越及南方解放軍的輕武器包括莫辛納甘M1891/30、SKS、AK-47、DP-27、1955年列裝的PKM與ZPU系列。裝甲車有T-34/85、SU-100、PT-76，火炮則有85毫米SD-44、122毫米M-38、152毫米ML-20及82毫米迫擊砲。彈藥因此必須分開供應7.62×39、7.62×51、7.62×54R、.30-06與.50 BMG等口徑，以及105毫米、155毫米高爆彈和黏稠燃料武器。
dossier.kitsEn: The opposing forces did not replace their equipment in neat chronological blocks. Every model listed here had entered service by the end of 1959 and remained in use during later phases. Common U.S. and South Vietnamese small arms included the M1 Garand, M1 Carbine, M1928A1 Thompson, M3A1, M1919A4, Browning M2 heavy machine gun, and the M60 general-purpose machine gun, which entered service in 1957. Artillery included the M101 105 mm howitzer, M1 155 mm howitzer, and M115 8-inch howitzer. Armored vehicles included the M3 Lee, M24 Chaffee, M47 and M48 Patton tanks, and M35 and M54 trucks; communications included the AN/PRC-25 radio introduced in 1959. Aircraft and helicopters included the C-47, B-52, F-100, F-101, A-1 Skyraider, A-4 Skyhawk, C-130, UH-1, H-34, H-21, and HH-43. The UH-1 only began deliveries in 1959 but quickly altered the conduct of mobile operations. North Vietnamese aircraft included the An-2, MiG-17, MiG-21, and Il-28, while the SA-2 air-defense missile, fielded in 1957, was also deployed. Light weapons used by northern and southern liberation forces included the Mosin-Nagant M1891/30, SKS, AK-47, DP-27, PKM, fielded in 1955, and ZPU-series guns. Armor included the T-34/85, SU-100, and PT-76; artillery included the 85 mm SD-44, 122 mm M-38, 152 mm ML-20, and 82 mm mortars. Logistics consequently had to separate ammunition for 7.62×39, 7.62×51, 7.62×54R, .30-06, and .50 BMG weapons, as well as 105 mm and 155 mm high-explosive shells and napalm munitions.
dossier.tactics: 1959至1964年，南越軍主要執行搜索、清剿、護路與營地防衛。阿巴戰鬥中，解放軍先選擇狹窄道路與先頭車隊，再以火力封住隊首和隊尾，使由多個單位組成的南越特遣隊難以一次投入全部兵力。1965至1968年，美軍把搜索與殲滅作戰結合空襲、砲兵、地面縱隊及直升機空降；德浪河谷戰役暴露了分散營級單位協調不足，也顯示直升機在缺乏完整協同與掩護時容易受擊。此後美軍增加空中近距支援、彈藥投送與基地防衛，但小規模交戰仍很難轉化為對北部補給體系的永久破壞。1968年春天攻勢同時打擊軍事指揮所、機場、火砲陣地、彈藥庫與交通節點，部分據點一度失守又被奪回，軍事成果有限，卻迫使美軍加速由搜索與殲滅轉向清剿並守住地區。1969至1972年，越南化逐步交由南越軍承擔主要地面任務，美軍以火箭砲、戰術航空、B-52、邊境地雷與港口封鎖支援；1972年廣治失守、安祿受攻後，越南人民軍發動春季攻勢，美軍則以Linebacker及Linebacker II反擊。1973年之後，戰爭沒有因停火而消失，越南人民軍以常規師作戰的比重迅速增加，1975年再以大規模砲兵、裝甲縱隊與步兵協同向南部推進。
dossier.tacticsEn: From 1959 to 1964, South Vietnamese forces emphasized searches, clear-and-hold operations, route protection, and base defense. At Ap Bac, the liberation force selected a narrow road and the leading vehicles, then used fire to seal the head and rear of a South Vietnamese task force composed of several units, preventing it from deploying all its strength at once. From 1965 to 1968, the United States combined search-and-destroy operations with air attacks, artillery, ground maneuver, and helicopter insertions. The Battle of Ia Drang exposed weaknesses in coordination among dispersed battalion-sized units and showed the vulnerability of helicopters operating without fully integrated support and protection. American forces subsequently increased close air support, ammunition delivery, and base defense, although small engagements rarely produced permanent destruction of the northern logistics system. The 1968 spring offensive struck military command posts, airfields, artillery positions, ammunition depots, and transportation nodes. Some positions were temporarily lost and retaken, so the military gains were limited, but the offensive forced the United States to accelerate its shift from search-and-destroy toward clearing and holding territory. From 1969 to 1972, Vietnamization transferred more ground missions to South Vietnamese forces, while the United States supported them with rocket artillery, tactical aviation, B-52 strikes, frontier mines, and interdiction of ports. After the loss of Quảng Trị and pressure on An Lộc in 1972, the North Vietnamese launched a spring offensive, prompting the American Linebacker and Linebacker II responses. The war did not disappear after the 1973 cease-fire. The People's Army of Vietnam rapidly increased its reliance on conventional divisions and in 1975 advanced with massed artillery, armor columns, and coordinated infantry.
dossier.data: 資料上要先區分背景與本文起點：越南共和國軍於1955年11月1日正式成立，本文則採1959年為觀察點。可核對的主要硬日期依序是：1959年12月30日至1960年1月3日第一次阿巴戰鬥；1964年8月2日第二次東京灣事件，8月7日美國國會通過東京灣決議；1965年3月2日滾雷作戰開始，3月8日首批美國海軍陸戰隊地面部隊抵達峴港；1965年11月14日至18日德浪河谷戰役；1968年1月30日春季攻勢展開；1972年12月18日至29日第二次Linebacker行動；1973年1月27日巴黎和平協議簽署，最後一批美國地面戰鬥部隊於3月29日撤出；1975年4月30日西貢陷落。美國國防部資料顯示，駐越美軍人數在1968年末達到約543,400人的高峰，1969年度授權上限降為475,200人。南越軍武裝兵力則常以1964年約15萬、1968年約85萬估算，這是補充後的編制兵力，不等於同時作戰人數。北越軍與南方解放軍的人力數字因來源和統計方法差異較大；各來源又分別計算陣亡、受傷、失聯與被俘，因此本文不列出任何未經確定的精確總傷亡。
dossier.dataEn: The record must first distinguish background from the chosen starting point. The Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces was formally established on November 1, 1955, while this account uses 1959 as its observational beginning. The principal verifiable dates are as follows: the First Battle of Ap Bac ran from December 30, 1959, to January 3, 1960; the second Gulf of Tonkin incident occurred on August 2, 1964, and the U.S. Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution on August 7; Rolling Thunder began on March 2, 1965, and the first U.S. Marine ground troops landed at Da Nang on March 8; the Battle of Ia Drang took place from November 14 to 18, 1965; the 1968 spring offensive opened on January 30; Linebacker II ran from December 18 to 29, 1972; the Paris Peace Accords were signed on January 27, 1973, and the last U.S. ground combat troops departed on March 29; and Saigon fell on April 30, 1975. U.S. Department of Defense data show American strength in Vietnam reaching a peak of approximately 543,400 around the end of 1968, followed by an authorized ceiling of 475,200 for 1969. The armed strength of the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces is commonly estimated at about 150,000 in 1964 and 850,000 in 1968, although these figures represent expanded establishment strength rather than troops present at the front. Estimates of northern and southern liberation forces vary considerably by source and counting method. Records also classify killed, wounded, missing, and captured personnel differently, so this account gives no unverified exact total casualties.
dossier.cause: 長期衝突的制度背景可追溯至1954年7月21日簽訂的日內瓦協議。協議結束法國在印度支那的主要作戰安排，只在17度線建立臨時軍事分界，沒有解決越南政治統一與軍隊部署問題。1955年南越軍成立後，南部武裝組織由零星襲擊轉向營級攻擊、地方據點與縱深補給；北越則透過訓練、命令、武器與人員指導支援。1959年成立的第559運輸團把道路維護、汽車運輸、通信與後勤倉庫整合，胡志明小道由戰術通道發展成持續運作的高強度補給系統。蘇聯和中國分別維持外部供應，美國則增加顧問、武器、顧問與空運能力，希望南越政府能獨立承擔地面作戰；但南越軍在情報、統一指揮及後勤方面仍有缺口，1963年政變後的軍事掌權局面又使指揮關係更加複雜。1964年8月2日，美國海軍巡邏艦馬多克斯號在北部灣遭到北越海空力量攻擊；關於當晚是否另有第二次襲擊，後來仍有爭議，但這起事件及船員傷亡促使國會迅速通過東京灣決議。美國政府其後採取分階段擴大空襲、部隊與顧問規模的政策，避免立即投入大規模地面入侵，同時試圖維持南越政權與區域承諾。外部大國競爭、南越領導不穩、邊境山區的補給通道，以及北越將南部戰爭納入常規戰準備的能力，因而共同推動了持續升級。
dossier.causeEn: The institutional background of the conflict can be traced to the Geneva Accords signed on July 21, 1954. They ended the principal French military arrangements in Indochina and established only a temporary military demarcation along the 17th parallel; they did not resolve Vietnamese political reunification or the deployment of armed forces. After the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces was established in 1955, southern armed organizations moved from isolated attacks toward battalion-sized operations, local bases, and deeper logistics. North Vietnam supported them through training, direction, weapons, and personnel. Group 559, formed in 1959, integrated road maintenance, motor transport, communications, and depots, turning the Ho Chi Minh Trail from a tactical route into a continuously operating high-intensity logistics system. The Soviet Union and China maintained external supply, while the United States expanded advisers, weapons, airlift, and eventually troop commitments in the hope that the South Vietnamese government could conduct ground operations independently. The South Vietnamese armed forces nevertheless had gaps in intelligence, unified command, and logistics, while military rule after the 1963 coup made command relationships more complex. On August 2, 1964, the U.S. patrol ship USS Maddox was attacked by North Vietnamese air and naval forces in the Gulf of Tonkin. Whether a second attack occurred that night remains disputed, but the incident and the injuries suffered by the crew prompted Congress to pass the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution rapidly. The United States then adopted phased escalation of air strikes, forces, and advisers, avoiding an immediate large-scale ground invasion while seeking to preserve the South Vietnamese government and regional commitments. Rivalry among the external powers, instability in South Vietnamese leadership, the supply routes through the border highlands, and North Vietnam's ability to incorporate the southern war into conventional planning therefore drove the continuing escalation.
dossier.impact: 1965至1968年的美軍、南越軍及盟軍作戰，在湄公河三角洲、中部高地與北部邊界取得一批戰術成果，卻同時迫使北越把後方與補給縱深移得更遠。基地、雷達、砲兵與長距離空運體系不斷擴張，使作戰重心由單次襲擊延伸至持續供應、維修、燃料與防衛。1968年春季攻勢雖未推翻南越政府，卻顯示後方指揮所、空軍場、彈藥庫和交通節點均可同時受攻，也迫使美軍改採更穩定的清剿、守據與護路方式。1972年美軍在Linebacker行動中封鎖北部港口、攻擊鐵路與儲油設施，部分進口被迫改走其他鐵路和陸路，但供應沒有完全中斷，越南人民軍仍可調整運輸。巴黎協議簽署後，美軍直接地面參戰逐步結束，北越則因外來援助風險下降而增加常規師、火砲與突擊部隊的比重。越南化使南越軍人數與自主作戰次数上升，也把原先由美國承擔的運輸、砲兵協調、防空與維持任務逐步移交。旋翼機的大量使用提高了部隊機動，也使飛行指揮、起降點防衛、維修與連續運作成為各軍共同面臨的問題；到1973年之後，戰爭的成敗已不再取決於美軍是否大規模投入地面部隊，而越來越多取決於南越軍能否以殘餘的美軍支援維持縱深防衛，以及北越軍能否集中兵力形成連續攻勢。
dossier.impactEn: The operations conducted by U.S., South Vietnamese, and allied forces from 1965 through 1968 produced tactical gains in the Mekong Delta, Central Highlands, and northern border regions, but they also pushed northern bases and logistics deeper. The continuous expansion of bases, radar networks, artillery systems, and long-range airlift extended the conflict beyond isolated attacks into the sustained provision, maintenance, refueling, and defense of forces. The 1968 spring offensive did not topple the South Vietnamese government, but it demonstrated that command posts, airfields, ammunition depots, and transportation nodes could be attacked together. It also forced the United States toward more stable clearing, garrison defense, and route-protection methods. During Linebacker in 1972, U.S. forces interdicted northern ports and attacked rail facilities and oil depots, forcing some imports onto other rail and overland routes. The flow was not completely interrupted, and the North Vietnamese army was still able to reorganize its transport. After the Paris Accords, direct U.S. ground participation gradually ended, while the risk of losing external supply became lower, encouraging the North Vietnamese army to increase the proportion of conventional divisions, artillery, and sapper units. Vietnamization expanded South Vietnamese numbers and the frequency of operations conducted without American ground forces, but it also transferred transport, artillery coordination, air defense, and sustainment tasks that the United States had previously carried. The extensive use of rotary-wing aircraft increased mobility while also making flight command, landing-zone defense, maintenance, and continuous support common problems for every army. After 1973, the outcome depended less on whether the United States would mount another large ground war than on whether South Vietnamese forces could sustain a defense with residual American support and whether the North Vietnamese army could concentrate enough troops to create a continuous offensive.
dossier.result: 1973年1月27日簽署的巴黎協議沒有替兩個越南交戰政體制定永久政治安排；它要求美國停止直接戰鬥並撤出部隊，把停止空襲與俘獲交換相連，越南共和國則繼續存在。1973年3月之後，美國的直接戰鬥部隊離開，越南人民軍獲得更大的常規部隊集結與補給空間，越南南方解放軍則把游擊戰與正面作戰並行。1974年9月，越南人民軍第二師奪回廣治，顯示停火線已不能限制北越軍在南部的主要攻勢。1975年3月，越南人民軍發動全面攻勢，相繼在昆嵩、安祿與春祿方向作戰；南越軍依靠據點、火砲與最後階段的美國航空支援抵抗，但中央下令從中部高地撤退後，縱深迅速縮短。4月29日，越南人民軍第308師進入獨立宮；4月30日，Nguyễn Văn Biên接受投降，越南共和國軍的指揮體系終止。1976年7月2日，南北以社會主義共和國越南的名義完成正式統一。直接美國地面戰在1973年已經結束，越南共和國則在美軍撤退後又獨力維持兩年；1975年4月30日才出現最終軍事結果，這個結果是越南人民軍與南方解放軍取得南部控制權，並使越南重新統一。
dossier.resultEn: The Paris Accords signed on January 27, 1973, established no permanent political arrangement between the two Vietnamese belligerent governments. They required the United States to cease direct combat and withdraw its troops, linked the halt of bombing to prisoner exchanges, and left the Republic of Vietnam in existence. After March 1973, U.S. ground combat units departed, giving the People's Army of Vietnam more room to concentrate conventional forces and receive supplies, while the southern liberation forces continued combining guerrilla operations with conventional warfare. In September 1974, the 2nd Division of the People's Army of Vietnam recaptured Quảng Trị, showing that the cease-fire line no longer constrained its principal offensives in the South. In March 1975, the People's Army launched a general offensive and fought in the Kontum, An Lộc, and Xuan Lộc areas. South Vietnamese units resisted from fortified positions with artillery and the last available American air support, but after the central command ordered a withdrawal from the Central Highlands, the defense depth collapsed rapidly. On April 29, the 308th Division of the People's Army of Vietnam entered the Independence Palace. On April 30, Nguyễn Văn Biên accepted surrender, ending the command structure of the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces. On July 2, 1976, North and South were formally unified under the name Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Direct American ground combat had ended in 1973, but the Republic of Vietnam continued the war alone for two more years. The final military outcome came on April 30, 1975, when the People's Army of Vietnam and the southern liberation forces gained control of South Vietnam and brought about reunification.

battle.name: 剛果危機
battle.brief: 1960年，比利時殖民的剛果共和國宣告獨立後旋即陷入內戰與分離主義危機，導致卡斯特斯省政府、沖突各省及聯合國維和介入，局勢動盪至1965年。此危機中使用的標準步槍之一即為美國於1959年服役的M14自動步槍。

kit.name: M14自動步槍
kit.history: M14自動步槍是美軍在冷戰期間採用的標準步槍，取代M1伽蘭德，發射7.62×51mm北約彈，具備半自動與全自動射擊模式，並被多國軍隊採用。

dossier.countries: 本紀錄採通常史家的分期，把「剛果危機」定為1960年6月30日剛果共和國在利奧波德維爾成立，至1965年6月主要戰鬥被壓下為止；1960年是起點，不是單一年度戰役。剛果幅員廣大，決定軍事的不是全省面推進，而是弗朗基港—卡米納—雅杜維爾—伊利莎白維爾鐵路，以及卡米納、阿爾貝維爾、金杜、烏維拉與布卡武間的公路和湖泊航線。1960年的行動方包括中央政府與剛果國民軍、加丹加分離政府與加丹加憲兵隊、比利時部隊及聯合國剛果行動；早期主要分遣隊來自瑞典、迦納、衣索比亞、愛爾蘭、奈及利亞、摩洛哥與突尼西亞。1964年東部戰事再引入美國空運、巴西支援、古巴作戰部隊及外籍軍事分隊。
dossier.countriesEn: This record follows the periodization commonly used by historians, defining the Congo Crisis from the establishment of the Republic of the Congo in Leopoldville on 30 June 1960 through the suppression of the main fighting in June 1965; 1960 was the starting point, not a single-year war. Congo was vast, and what determined military operations was not a front advancing across the entire country, but the Port-Francqui–Kamina–Jadotville–Élisabethville railway and the roads and lake routes linking Kamina, Albertville, Kindu, Uvira, and Bukavu. The belligerents in 1960 included the central government and the Armée nationale congolaise, the Katangese separatist government and its gendarmerie, Belgian forces, and the United Nations Operation in the Congo; the early contingents came principally from Sweden, Ghana, Ethiopia, Ireland, Nigeria, Morocco, and Tunisia. The eastern war of 1964 added a United States airlift, Brazilian assistance, Cuban combat troops, and foreign military detachments.
dossier.people: 1960年7月4日，駐利奧波德維爾的公共武力各營因欠薪、待遇及指揮爭議發生嘩變，數日內擴散至其他駐地；中央政府連續更換指揮，仍未能重建有效控制。比利時隨即增派傘兵與軍事技術單位，法國也在非洲保持空運能力，使中央與加丹加都依賴外國裝備和後勤。7月11日，莫伊茲·尚貝宣布加丹加成立分離政府；帕特里斯·盧蒙巴則要求比利時撤軍。達格·哈馬斯約爾德以聯合國秘書長身分推動瑞典觀察團與非洲分遣隊，9月18日在恩多拉空難身亡，使談判與部署同時失去原有中心。盧蒙巴於1961年1月遭殺害；尚貝在1964年6月回任中央首相，約瑟夫·德西雷·蒙博托掌握國家軍隊，皮埃爾·穆萊與洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉分別率領叛軍武裝，麥克·霍爾則受命組織外籍突擊分隊。這些人物把加丹加分離、中央軍解體與1964年東部戰爭連成一條可追查的指揮鏈。
dossier.peopleEn: On 4 July 1960, units of the Force Publique stationed in Leopoldville mutinied amid grievances over pay, conditions, and command, and the mutiny spread to other garrisons within days; successive changes of command by the central government did not restore effective control. Belgium immediately reinforced its presence with paratroopers and military technical units, while France maintained airlift capacity elsewhere in Africa, leaving both the central government and Katanga dependent on foreign equipment and logistics. On 11 July, Moïse Tshombe announced the formation of the Katangese separatist government; Patrice Lumumba demanded a Belgian withdrawal. As United Nations Secretary-General, Dag Hammarskjöld promoted a Swedish observer mission and African contingents, but he died in an aircraft crash at Ndola on 18 September, abruptly removing the original center of the negotiations and deployment. Lumumba was assassinated in January 1961; Tshombe returned as central prime minister in June 1964, Joseph-Désiré Mobutu controlled the national army, Pierre Mulele and Laurent-Désiré Kabila led separate rebel forces, and Mike Hoare was commissioned to organize a foreign commando detachment. These figures form a traceable chain of command linking the Katangese secession, the disintegration of the central army, and the eastern war of 1964.
dossier.kits: 可確認的輕武器以比利時製FN FAL七點六二乘五一公厘步槍為核心，加丹加憲兵與剛果國民軍均大量接收；公共武力原有的李恩菲爾德四型步槍和布倫輕機槍仍與之並存，象牙柄手槍則為九乘一九公厘型。各國聯合國分遣隊的英制或比利時制裝備並不相同，因此七點六二公厘北約彈、點三零三英制彈及九公厘手槍彈必須分開標記、保管和發放。一九六四年古巴部隊加入七點六二乘三九公厘AK-47與SKS步槍，坦克縱隊裝備T-34-85八五公厘砲及BTR-40裝甲運兵車；霍爾所部與剛果國民軍使用FN FAL、勃朗寧M二一二點七乘九九公厘重機槍及八一公厘迫擊砲。車輛包括Land Rover與GMC 353越野卡車，空運則使用C-47、C-54及較後投入的美國C-119運輸機。上述型號在1960年以前均已列裝。
dossier.kitsEn: The principal confirmed light weapon was the Belgian FN FAL 7.62×51 mm rifle, supplied in large quantities to both the Katangese gendarmerie and the Armée nationale congolaise; the Force Publique’s older Lee-Enfield No. 4 rifles and Bren light machine guns remained in use alongside it, while Browning-style pistols were chambered in 9×19 mm. The British-pattern and Belgian-pattern equipment of the different United Nations contingents was not identical, so 7.62 mm NATO ammunition, .303-inch ammunition, and 9 mm pistol ammunition had to be marked, stored, and issued separately. In 1964 the Cuban contingent added 7.62×39 mm AK-47 and SKS rifles, while its armored column used T-34-85 tanks with 85 mm guns and BTR-40 armored personnel carriers; Hoare’s formation and the national army used FN FAL rifles, Browning M2 12.7×99 mm heavy machine guns, and 81 mm mortars. Ground vehicles included Land Rovers and GMC 353 trucks, while airlift relied on C-47, C-54, and, later in the conflict, American C-119 transports. All of these types had entered service before 1960.
dossier.tactics: 聯合國最初採觀察而非全面進攻的部署方式。八月抵達的三十名瑞典武裝觀察員只負責核對道路、機場及停火狀態；迦納、衣索比亞、愛爾蘭等武裝分遣隊到達後，才以護送車隊、控制路口、佔領鐵路結點和保護撤退路線為主要任務。法國於8月17日從杜阿拉空運傘兵至布拉柴維爾及附近據點，維持法方存在，但該部隊不隸屬聯合國剛果行動。9月13日，迦納分遣隊在巴克旺加城郊與加丹加憲兵交火，戰鬥焦點是道路與城郊據點，而非兩支大軍的正面會戰。十月開始的OFFUC行動則以赤道維爾為北部支點，沿通往卡米納的走廊推進，並企圖切斷雅杜維爾與卡米納的鐵路運輸。加丹加守軍利用既有城鎮、路口和車站設阻，拖延聯合國縱隊；聯合國各國分遣隊因指揮分立、補給線偏長，仍以分批奪取交通節點為主。到一九六四年，作戰轉為古巴裝甲縱隊、外籍突擊隊、剛果國民軍與空運共同維持公路和機場的立體補給。
dossier.tacticsEn: The United Nations initially deployed observers rather than attempting an immediate general offensive. Thirty armed but essentially unarmed Swedish observers arriving in August checked roads, airfields, and ceasefire conditions; after Ghanaian, Ethiopian, Irish, and other armed contingents arrived, their principal tasks became convoy escort, control of road junctions, occupation of railway nodes, and protection of withdrawal routes. On 17 August, France airlifted paratroopers from Douala to Brazzaville and nearby positions to maintain a French presence, but this force was not part of the United Nations Operation in the Congo. On 13 September, a Ghanaian contingent fought Katangese gendarmes on the outskirts of Bakwanga, where control of roads and suburban positions mattered more than a general engagement between massed armies. OFFUC, beginning in October, used Équateurville as its northern base, advanced along the corridor toward Kamina, and attempted to sever the railway between Jadotville and Kamina. Katangese defenders used established towns, junctions, and stations to block and delay United Nations columns; because national contingents retained separate commands and supply lines were long, the operation proceeded by the gradual seizure of transport nodes. By 1964, warfare had shifted to a combined system in which Cuban armored columns, foreign commandos, the national army, and airlift maintained roads and airfields together.
dossier.data: 主要日期可依序固定：1960年6月30日獨立；7月4日公共武力嘩變；7月11日加丹加宣布分離；7月17日聯合國安理會第141號決議要求比利時撤軍；8月8日第143號決議批准武裝中立方，初期軍事上限為五千人；9月13日發生巴克旺加戰鬥；9月18日哈馬斯約爾德在恩多拉身亡。十月至十一月，OFFUC在加丹加北部與中部交通線展開；11月23日第169號決議要求各國停止支援加丹加，法國則於12月30日正式承認其地位。1961年1月12日第153號決議要求停止敵對行動，2月18日聯合國在卡米納取得勝利，3月中旬再奪取雅杜維爾與科爾韋濟；3月22日第157號決議推動制裁。聯合國兵力在1961年初增至一萬六千人以上。1964年6月聯合國完成撤出，7月叛軍控制東部重要城市，8月古巴部隊抵達烏維拉，11月美國空運介入，12月12日蒙博托發動Operation Rumble in the Jungle，至1965年6月主要叛軍編制被壓下。各國報告對死亡、受傷與失聯採用的日期和分類不同，因此不列無法互證的精確傷亡數字。
dossier.dataEn: The principal dates can be fixed in sequence: independence on 30 June 1960; the Force Publique mutiny on 4 July; the Katangese declaration of secession on 11 July; Security Council Resolution 141 on 17 July requesting a Belgian withdrawal; Resolution 143 on 8 August authorizing an armed neutral force with an initial military ceiling of 5,000; combat at Bakwanga on 13 September; Hammarskjöld’s death at Ndola on 18 September. OFFUC operated along transport lines in northern and central Katanga from October to November; Resolution 169 on 23 November called on states to halt assistance to Katanga, and France formally recognized the separatist government on 30 December. Resolution 153 on 12 January 1961 called for hostilities to cease; United Nations forces gained control of Kamina on 18 February and then took Jadotville and Kolwezi in mid-March; Resolution 157 on 22 March promoted sanctions. United Nations strength exceeded 16,000 in early 1961. The United Nations completed its withdrawal in June 1964; rebels seized major eastern cities in July; Cuban troops reached Uvira in August; a United States airlift began in November; Mobutu launched Operation Rumble in the Jungle on 12 December; and the principal rebel formations were suppressed by June 1965. National reports used different dates and classifications for dead, wounded, and missing personnel, so no unverifiable precise casualty totals are given.
dossier.cause: 危機的第一個成因是國家邊界與原有軍事指揮不一致。剛果共和國成立時，公共武力仍沿用比利時時期的分區駐軍、裝備和指揮關係；欠薪與派系爭議引發嘩變後，中央政府沒有足以迅速取代的指揮核心。第二個成因是加丹加掌握銅鈷稅收、弗朗基港出口能力及卡米納鐵路節點，足以維持獨立的加丹加憲兵隊。比利時提供行政、財務和後勤協助，法國提供補給並在1960年底給予外交承認，使中央與加丹加的軍力差距持續。第三個成因是聯合國任務雖要求中立與防止內戰，卻難以同時限制加丹加、分遣國武裝及外部援助，而且前線距離迫使物資先運到機場，再轉乘卡車或火車。加丹加在1963年形式上重回中央政府後，軍隊與民兵網路並未真正整編；外國武器、指揮關係及東部戰線遂在1964年重新接合。
dossier.causeEn: The first cause of the crisis was the mismatch between the new national territory and the inherited military command structure. When the Republic of the Congo was established, the Force Publique retained the regional garrison system, equipment patterns, and command relationships of the Belgian period; after grievances over pay and command produced mutiny, the central government lacked a structure capable of replacing them quickly. The second cause was Katanga’s control of copper and cobalt revenues, export capacity at Port-Francqui, and the railway junction at Kamina, all of which allowed the Katangese gendarmerie to remain financially sustainable and operationally distinct. Belgium provided administrative, financial, and logistical assistance, while France supplied matériel and formal diplomatic recognition in late 1960, preserving the military imbalance between Katanga and the center. The third cause was the incompatibility between the United Nations mandate for neutrality and the need to restrain Katanga, national contingents, and external aid; the distance to the front also forced supplies to be unloaded at an airfield and then transferred to trucks or trains. Katanga returned formally to the central government in 1963, but its army and militia networks were not genuinely integrated; foreign weapons, command relationships, and the eastern front reconverged in 1964.
dossier.impact: 聯合國剛果行動顯示，由多國分遣隊組成的部隊雖能迅速集結，卻因各自指揮、各自補給與不同射擊規格而難以形成單一重型作戰力量；前線控制因此長期取決於卡米納、金杜、烏維拉等少數據點。1964年6月聯合國撤出後，洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉的武裝由布卡武經堡壘門向史丹利維爾推進，皮埃爾·穆萊在北部建立另一條武裝軸線，中央軍隊一度失去東部樞紐。古巴自8月起在烏維拉部署先遣部隊，秋季作戰人員增至約千人，編制包含傘兵與摩托化步兵分隊，並以T-34-85和BTR-40支援金杜至阿爾貝維爾的公路。麥克·霍爾在金杜組成剛果國民軍第1營第1突擊隊，以外籍戰士與加丹加憲兵為核心，後續分為第4及第5突擊隊。美國自11月以C-119、C-54運輸機和飛行、維修人員維持東西向補給，巴西提供航路與基地協助；入秋後中央軍在支援下重奪金杜。外國干預由此把問題轉成對軍隊控制、裝甲縱隊和空運航線的直接競爭。
dossier.impactEn: The United Nations Operation in the Congo showed that a force assembled from national contingents could be deployed quickly but, because it retained separate commands, supply systems, and ammunition standards, could not readily operate as a single heavy formation. Control of the front therefore depended heavily on a few nodes such as Kamina, Kindu, and Uvira. After the United Nations withdrawal in June 1964, Laurent-Désiré Kabila’s forces advanced from Bukavu through Fort Portal toward Stanleyville, while Pierre Mulele established a separate armed axis farther north; the central army temporarily lost its eastern pivot. Beginning in August, Cuba deployed an advance force at Uvira, expanded its combat strength to roughly one thousand personnel by autumn, organized parachute and motorized infantry detachments, and supported the Kindu–Albertville road with T-34-85 tanks and BTR-40 carriers. At Kindu, Mike Hoare formed the 1st Battalion, 1st Commando of the national army around foreign fighters and Katangese gendarmes, after which the force developed into the 4th and 5th Commandos. From November, the United States maintained the east–west supply line with C-119 and C-54 transports, air crews, and maintenance personnel, while Brazil assisted with routes and basing; with this support, the central army retook Kindu as autumn advanced. Foreign intervention therefore turned the struggle into a direct contest for command, armored columns, and airlift routes.
dossier.result: 加丹加分離的軍事結果首先出現在1961年：聯合國控制卡米納後，依次封鎖雅杜維爾、科爾韋濟與伊利莎白維爾，使尚貝失去可持續供應加丹加憲兵的主要鐵路和公路；1963年1月24日中央政府與加丹加在基泰萊達成協議，分省自治式分離因而終止。第二個收束點是1964年12月12日開始的Operation Rumble in the Jungle。蒙博托以剛果國民軍及加丹加憲兵向烏維拉、古巴部隊施壓，烏維拉—金杜走廊反覆交戰後，古巴作戰營從最前線後撤，霍爾的外籍分隊也逐步失去獨立指揮權。到1965年春，中央軍與古巴部隊在金杜、烏維拉及夸恩扎一帶的反擊削弱主要叛軍，6月政府宣布大規模武裝已被壓下。此時中央政府控制主要鐵路、機場與東部城市，但地方軍隊、外籍人員及殘餘武裝仍繼續活動，所以軍事收束不等於政治危機得到永久解決。
dossier.resultEn: The military outcome of the Katangese secession appeared first in 1961. After the United Nations took Kamina, it successively isolated Jadotville, Kolwezi, and Élisabethville, depriving Tshombe of the principal railway and road system needed to sustain the Katangese gendarmerie; an agreement between the central government and Katanga at Kitele on 24 January 1963 formally ended the secession. The second military closing point began with Operation Rumble in the Jungle on 12 December 1964. Mobutu used the national army and Katangese gendarmes to pressure the Cuban troops around Uvira, and after repeated fighting along the Uvira–Kindu corridor, the Cuban combat battalions withdrew from the foremost positions while Hoare’s foreign detachments progressively lost independent command. Counterattacks by central and Cuban-supported forces around Kindu, Uvira, and Kuanza weakened the principal rebel formations in spring 1965, and in June the government announced that the major armed force had been suppressed. The central government then controlled the main railways, airfields, and eastern cities, but local forces, foreign personnel, and remnant organizations continued operating; the military conclusion therefore did not amount to a permanent political settlement.

battle.name: 安哥拉獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 安哥拉（葡萄牙殖民時期）
battle.brief: 安哥拉獨立戰爭於1961年2月正式爆發，葡萄牙殖民軍與安哥拉民族解放組織在城鄉及叢林展開激烈衝突。雙方均大量配備蘇聯製造的AK-47自動步槍，該武器以其堅固可靠著稱，在游擊戰中發揮關鍵作用。

kit.name: AK-47自動步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯於1947年研製的5.45×39mm口徑自動步槍，以可靠性聞名，成為華約及多國游擊隊的主要步兵武器。

dossier.countries: 安哥拉獨立戰爭通常以1961年2月4日安哥拉人民解放運動在羅安達同步襲擊皮吉吉蒂監獄、警察機關、通訊設施與廣播設施為起點，以1974年4月25日葡萄牙軍方推翻獨裁政府、駐安哥拉葡軍隨後停止大規模攻勢為軍事終點；1975年11月11日安哥拉正式獨立則是政治終點。參與者並非單一葡萄牙军队與單一叛軍，而是葡萄牙與安哥拉人民解放運動、前線國家解放陣線及安哥拉全國解放聯盟之間的長期戰爭。北方與剛果共和國及剛果自由邦相通，後者於1966年成為剛果民主共和國；1964年以前北面的北羅德西亞隨後成為尚比亞。MPLA早期依靠剛果兩岸的基地，後來利用坦尚尼亞和尚比亞的邊境通道。FNLA獲得美國秘密局及剛果方面的情報、武器與後勤支援，UNITA亦在後期得到美國及南非協助；MPLA則獲得蘇聯武器、中國軍事顧問與訓練援助。南非情報單位還曾向葡軍提供反游擊情報。這些援助構成冷戰介入，但作戰命令、地面戰術和實際控制仍主要由當地三方與葡軍決定。
dossier.countriesEn: The Angolan War of Independence is conventionally traced from the coordinated MPLA attacks on Pidjiguiti prison, police installations, communications facilities, and broadcasting facilities in Luanda on 4 February 1961. Its military endpoint is generally placed on 25 April 1974, when the Portuguese military overturned the dictatorship and the Portuguese forces in Angola subsequently stopped major offensives; independence on 11 November 1975 was its political endpoint. The participants were not simply the Portuguese army on one side and a single rebel movement on the other. They were Portugal, the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola, the Frente Nacional de Libertação de Angola, and the União Nacional Totalista Independente de Angola. To the north, the conflict crossed the borders of the Republic of Congo and Congo-Léopoldville, which became the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 1966. Northern Rhodesia, now Zambia, lay farther east. The MPLA initially depended on bases on both sides of the Congo and later used border corridors through Tanzania and Zambia. The FNLA received intelligence, weapons, and logistical assistance from the United States intelligence community and from Congo-based channels. UNITA also received later American and South African assistance, while the MPLA received Soviet weapons and Chinese military advisers and training. South African intelligence personnel also supplied information to Portuguese counter-insurgency forces. These forms of aid made the conflict an extension of the Cold War, although operational decisions, ground tactics, and actual territorial control remained principally the work of the three Angolan organizations and the Portuguese forces.
dossier.people: 決定初期戰爭方向的是MPLA於1956年在羅安達建立的地下組織，而不是1961年才臨時出現的隊伍。奧古斯蒂紐內托擔任政治領導，路西奧拉拉則長期掌握軍事指揮，強調小型單位、分散指揮、彈藥分散攜帶與定期返回邊境基地整補。何塞愛杜多斯桑托斯在1969年加入後進入核心指揮層，至1970年代已負責軍事行政與作戰協調；1972年拉拉的整頓以及丹尼爾奇佩達脫離，使MPLA進一步收緊指揮，但也加深其政治孤立。另一條組織路線由霍爾登羅伯托領導，他於1962年在卡薩布蘭卡組成FNLA，並把早期安哥拉民族主義武裝與剛果政治網絡結合。1966年7月，曾在原UPA中活動的若納斯薩文比在盧薩卡成立UNITA，以跨境機動和南部高原攻略建立自己的兵力。葡萄牙方面，早期安哥拉遠征軍團由奧托韋爾吉利奧迪亚斯克雷德爾指揮；1966年起，阿爾普伊姆卡爾旺接管安哥拉軍事指揮，後續職位則由葡萄牙常備軍將領輪替。葡方將本國步兵、工程、通信、炮兵及後勤單位陸續輪調安哥拉，而MPLA、FNLA和UNITA各自維持不同 commanders 與補給系統，使安哥拉並未形成單一民族主義陣線。
dossier.peopleEn: The direction of the opening phase was shaped by the underground MPLA organization established in Luanda in 1956, not by a force that suddenly appeared in 1961. Agostinho Neto served as the political leader, while Lúcio Lara exercised prolonged authority over military operations and emphasized small units, decentralized command, ammunition carried in dispersed loads, and periodic returns to border bases for replenishment. José Eduardo dos Santos joined in 1969 and moved into the central command structure, becoming responsible by the 1970s for military administration and operational coordination. Lara's reorganization in 1972 and Daniel Chipenda's departure tightened MPLA command, but they also deepened the movement's political isolation. A separate organizational line was led by Holden Roberto, who formed the FNLA in Casablanca in 1962 and joined early Angolan nationalist fighters to a Congolese political network. In July 1966, Jonas Savimbi, who had previously worked within the former UPA, founded UNITA in Lusaka and built strength through cross-border mobility and operations across the southern plateau. On the Portuguese side, the early Angolan expeditionary corps was commanded by Otto Vergílio Dias Kröder. Alpoim de Calvão took over military command in Angola in 1966, after which the post passed among career officers from the Portuguese mainland army. Portugal rotated infantry, engineers, signals, artillery, and logistics units into Angola, while the MPLA, FNLA, and UNITA each retained separate commanders and supply systems. Angola therefore never developed a single unified nationalist front.
dossier.kits: 1961年以前已經列裝而確實符合安哥拉戰場補給條件的步槍，包括1953年採用的FN FAL、1949年採用的AK-47、1945年採用的SKS、1944年採用的Sterling衝鋒槍及1951年採用的PM Makarov手槍。FAL使用7.62×51北約弹药與20發彈匣，AK-47使用7.62×39與30發彈匣，SKS使用同一口徑的10發彈匣；Sterling使用9×19帕拉貝倫姆與20或33發彈匣，Makarov則使用9×18。FNLA和UNITA曾取得FAL，MPLA常見的是蘇聯式7.62×39武器，另有少量1949年列裝的RPG-2反裝甲武器，其40毫米彈藥主要用於攻擊固定火力點。葡萄牙陸軍以FAL作為主要制式步槍，車輛包括1948年的Land Rover Series I、1953年的Bedford CA與1952年的Panhard AML，分別執行偵察、運輸和武裝護送。炮兵包括M2 81毫米迫擊炮及M2A1 105毫米榴彈炮，常見炮彈為81毫米高爆與煙幕彈，以及105毫米高爆彈。航空方面，葡萄牙使用過DHC-3 Otter、C-47、T-6G Texan及PBY Catalina執行運輸、聯絡和武裝巡邏，並以1957年列裝的Alouette II執行偵察、人員輸送與後勤聯絡。葡軍可經羅安達、本格拉與洛比托港口補充7.62×51弹药和炮彈；MPLA的7.62×39弹药則多從剛果分批送入，再由游擊隊以背架、車輛和邊境小庫分散攜帶。這些武器至1961年均已存在，但三方的口徑、制式與補給來源並不一致。
dossier.kitsEn: The service weapons available by 1961 that fit the logistics of the Angolan battlefield included the FN FAL, adopted in 1953; the AK-47, adopted in 1949; the SKS, adopted in 1945; the Sterling submachine gun, adopted in 1944; and the PM Makarov pistol, adopted in 1951. The FAL fired 7.62×51 NATO ammunition from twenty-round magazines, while the AK-47 used 7.62×39 ammunition in thirty-round magazines and the SKS used the same caliber in ten-round magazines. The Sterling accepted 9×19 Parabellum ammunition in twenty- or thirty-three-round magazines, while the Makarov used 9×18 ammunition. The FNLA and UNITA obtained FAL rifles, while 7.62×39 weapons of Soviet pattern were more common in the MPLA arsenal. The MPLA also held small quantities of the RPG-2 anti-tank weapon, adopted in 1949; its forty-millimeter warhead was principally useful against fixed firing positions. The Portuguese army used the FAL as its principal service rifle. Its vehicles included the Land Rover Series I of 1948, the Bedford CA of 1953, and the Panhard AML of 1952, used respectively for reconnaissance, transport, and armed escort. Artillery included the M2 81 mm mortar and M2A1 105 mm howitzer, with 81 mm high-explosive and smoke rounds and 105 mm high-explosive projectiles. Portuguese aviation employed the DHC-3 Otter, C-47, T-6G Texan, and PBY Catalina for transport, liaison, and armed patrols, while the Alouette II, adopted in 1957, performed reconnaissance, personnel movement, and logistics. Portugal could replenish 7.62×51 ammunition and artillery projectiles through Luanda, Benguela, and Lobito. Much of the MPLA's 7.62×39 ammunition entered through Congo in separate shipments and was then carried inward by guerrilla teams using packs, vehicles, and small border caches. All of these weapons were already in service by 1961, but calibers, service standards, and supply sources differed among the three Angolan organizations.
dossier.tactics: 1961年羅安達的行動採取短時間同步襲擊：突擊小組分別接近監獄、警察崗位與通訊設施，破壞或奪取器材後即撤離，不在市區建立持久陣地。葡萄牙安全部隊隨後以清查、逮捕、封鎖道路和搜索情報網絡拆解城市游擊網，並把武裝人員逐步推向北部、東部及邊境地區。MPLA轉入鄉村後，主要以小隊伏擊側翼、打斷道路護援、短暫襲擊守軍後迅速轉移；小組之間依靠預先約定的會合點與分散彈藥維持行動。FNLA較依賴剛果境內較完整的營區和補給，UNITA則利用尚比亞方向的邊境入口，讓隊伍以機關槍、迫擊炮及四輪或六輪車進行長距離轉向。MPLA在1964年及1970年代轉向營、旅級攻勢，設法攻擊兵站、道路、通信和地方守軍，但後勤仍依賴邊境與分散庫存。葡萄牙則以師級部隊守住交通線，在道路交叉點、橋梁、機場及城鎮外圍建立工事；每次搜索行動由步兵、炮兵、機車、軍車與空中偵察協同，先以炮兵和空襲壓制，再由地面分隊搜索，若情報不足便撤回固定據點。1967至1968年間形成的戰術指揮體系把若干分散連隊納入統一調度，並保留中央預備隊。直升機改變了小隊的機動速度，但未能消除對道路、燃料、彈藥及情報來源的依賴。到1973至1974年，MPLA與UNITA都能實施營級攻擊，葡萄牙也以固定基地和機械化護送應對，三方的戰術差異正逐漸縮小。
dossier.tacticsEn: The Luanda operations of 1961 were short coordinated raids. Assault groups approached the prison, police posts, and communications facilities separately, struck to destroy or seize equipment, and withdrew without trying to hold an urban district. Portuguese security forces then dismantled the urban guerrilla network through searches, arrests, road closures, and intelligence work, gradually pushing armed personnel toward the north, east, and frontier regions. Once the MPLA moved into the countryside, its principal methods were small-team ambushes against flanks, attacks on road escorts, brief strikes against garrisons, and rapid withdrawal. Units connected through prearranged rendezvous points and dispersed ammunition stocks. The FNLA depended more heavily on established camps and logistics inside Congo, while UNITA used entry corridors from Zambia and employed machine guns, mortars, and four- or six-wheeled vehicles for long changes of direction. In 1964 and again during the 1970s, the MPLA shifted toward battalion- and brigade-sized offensives directed at depots, roads, communications, and local garrisons, although logistics still depended on border bases and dispersed caches. Portugal used divisional formations to secure transport corridors and established fortified positions at road junctions, bridges, airfields, and the outskirts of towns. A search operation combined infantry, artillery, motorcycles, trucks, and aerial reconnaissance. Artillery and aircraft suppressed suspected positions before ground teams advanced; inadequate intelligence caused the Portuguese to return to fixed posts. The tactical command structure formed between 1967 and 1968 brought dispersed companies under coordinated control and retained a central reserve. Helicopters accelerated the movement of small teams but did not remove dependence on roads, fuel, ammunition, and intelligence sources. By 1973 and 1974, both the MPLA and UNITA could conduct battalion-level attacks, while Portugal relied on fortified bases and motorized escorts in response. Differences in tactics were therefore narrowing.
dossier.data: 戰前背景始於1956年12月，當時幾個安哥拉民族主義組織在羅安達合併為MPLA，葡萄牙方面則以秘密警察、軍隊與殖民政權控制政治活動。1961年2月4日，MPLA在羅安達進攻皮吉吉蒂監獄、警察機關、通訊與廣播設施；葡軍迅速封鎖市區，攻擊者未能佔領大片地區，城市網絡在1961至1963年間遭到清剿。此後葡萄牙加強第1步兵師與葡萄牙遠征軍團，把步兵、工程、通信、炮兵及後勤單位配置在羅安達，並保護羅安達至恩達拉通多、馬蘭熱的道路、洛比托鐵路以及本格拉與洛比托港口。1962年3月，霍爾登羅伯托在卡薩布蘭卡組成FNLA，安哥拉民族主義力量從此分成相互競爭的武裝路線。1964年1月，MPLA在多個行政區同步攻擊守軍、地方據點和交通線，部分隊伍一度進入開闊地帶，但葡軍集中步兵與炮兵後迫使各支隊分斷與退回剛果方向。蘇聯武器先經剛果自由邦或剛果共和國，再沿公路轉入烏伊熱、杜杜和卡彭達卡穆萊姆巴一帶；坦尚尼亞與尚比亞在1964年後提供更開闊的邊境後勤空間。1965年1月15日，葡萄牙、FNLA與MPLA簽訂阿爾沃爾協議，內容包括政治特赦、民族主義隊伍整合及過渡選舉，但選舉沒有舉行，協議在1966年前後實際瓦解。1966年7月，薩文比在盧薩卡成立UNITA，開闢由尚比亞進入比耶、寬哥庫班戈和莫希科方向的新戰區。1967至1968年，葡萄牙以戰術指揮體系整合若干營、連級分遣隊，固定基地旁配置81毫米迫擊炮、機槍與反裝甲武器，道路巡邏則由Bedford CA卡車和Panhard AML裝甲車護送。FNLA仍較依賴剛果境內營區，UNITA在南部高原進行長距離機動，MPLA則在北部逐步建立營、旅級指揮與較大的彈藥庫。1970至1973年，MPLA的攻勢從恩吉熱、索隆哥、杜杜與卡彭達卡穆萊姆巴延伸至馬蘭熱、隆達蘇爾及中部高地；UNITA則反覆越過尚比亞邊界，攻擊公路、橋梁和葡軍護送隊。葡萄牙仍能從海上運入7.62×51北約弹药、M2迫擊炮及M2A1榴彈炮彈藥，並以卡車和鐵路送往內陸；MPLA與FNLA的7.62×39弹药則從剛果方向分散輸送，UNITA由尚比亞取得不同批次武器，因此各戰區的彈藥供應並不連續。1974年4月25日里斯本革命後，葡軍攻勢停止。1975年1月15日，葡萄牙、MPLA與FNLA再訂阿爾沃爾協議，安排撤軍與過渡權力；UNITA拒絕參與。1975年11月11日，安哥拉獨立，葡萄牙統治正式終止；此後的武裝衝突已超出通常所稱的獨立戰爭範圍。各方傷亡總數缺乏一致、可核實的記錄，本實錄不採用孤立數字。
dossier.dataEn: The background began in December 1956, when several Angolan nationalist organizations merged in Luanda to form the MPLA, while Portugal relied on secret police, the army, and colonial administrators to control political activity. On 4 February 1961, the MPLA attacked Pidjiguiti prison, police installations, communications facilities, and broadcasting facilities in Luanda. Portuguese forces sealed the city quickly, the attackers did not occupy a large district, and the urban network was dismantled during 1961 and 1963. Portugal subsequently reinforced the 1st Infantry Division and the Portuguese expeditionary corps, assigning infantry, engineers, signals, artillery, and logistics units around Luanda and protecting the roads from Luanda to N'dalatando and Malanje, the Lobito railway, and the ports of Benguela and Lobito. In March 1962, Holden Roberto formed the FNLA in Casablanca, dividing Angolan nationalism into competing armed organizations. In January 1964, the MPLA launched simultaneous attacks against garrisons, local posts, and transport routes across several administrative districts. Some groups entered open country, but Portuguese concentrations of infantry and artillery forced individual columns to break contact and withdraw toward Congo. Soviet weapons first moved through Congo-Léopoldville or Congo-Brazzaville and then followed roads toward Uíge, Dundo, and Capenda-Camulemba. After 1964, Tanzania and Zambia provided broader border logistics. On 15 January 1965, Portugal, the FNLA, and the MPLA signed the Alvor Agreement, covering political amnesty, integration of nationalist forces, and transitional elections. No election was held, and the agreement broke down around 1966. In July 1966, Savimbi founded UNITA in Lusaka, opening a front through Zambia into Bié, Cuando Cubango, and Moxico. Between 1967 and 1968, Portugal incorporated companies and detached units into a tactical command system. Fixed bases were supported by 81 mm mortars, machine guns, and anti-tank weapons, while Bedford CA trucks and Panhard AML armored cars escorted road patrols. The FNLA continued to rely on camps in Congo, UNITA conducted long movements across the southern plateau, and the MPLA gradually established battalion and brigade command structures and larger ammunition depots in the north. From 1970 to 1973, MPLA operations extended from Uíge, Songe, Dundo, and Capenda-Camulemba toward Malanje, Lunda Sul, and the central highlands. UNITA repeatedly crossed the Zambian frontier to strike roads, bridges, and Portuguese escorts. Portugal could still import 7.62×51 NATO ammunition, M2 mortar rounds, and M2A1 howitzer projectiles by sea and move them inland by truck and rail. MPLA and FNLA 7.62×39 ammunition came in separate shipments from Congo, while UNITA obtained weapons from Zambia in changing batches, so ammunition was not continuous across all operational sectors. After the Lisbon revolution on 25 April 1974, Portuguese offensives stopped. On 15 January 1975, Portugal, the MPLA, and the FNLA signed another Alvor Agreement covering withdrawal and transitional authority; UNITA refused to participate. Angola became independent on 11 November 1975, formally ending Portuguese rule. The armed conflict that followed lay beyond the conventional scope of the independence war. The belligerents did not publish consistent, verifiable total casualty figures, so this account does not rely on isolated numbers.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的根本原因是葡萄牙拒絕為安哥拉提供可執行的自治或獨立時間表。1930年代建立的歐薩德諾沃新國家以軍隊、警察與秘密警察維持中央統治；1951年葡屬殖民地被改稱海外省份之後，安哥拉仍沒有本地自治政府或選舉代表權。MPLA正是在組織被取締、領導人被逮捕或被迫流亡、公開政治改革難以落實的背景下，把武裝鬥爭視為取得決定權力的途徑。經濟結構同樣重要：咖啡、劍麻、鑽石、鐵路與港口服務葡萄牙及跨國企業，安哥拉的行政與安全機構則負責保障這種資源流向。1960年剛果地區獨立，又使民族主義領導人取得跨境活動、購買武器和建立後勤基地的條件。葡萄牙當時已在上幾內亞投入大量軍事資源，安哥拉又面臨相似規模的防守任務，財政與兵員調度壓力隨戰爭延長而增加。外部援助不是戰爭最初原因，卻使各派能持續作戰；美國、蘇聯、中國、南非及剛果方面對不同組織的支援，又把原本可能合併的反殖民鬥爭分割成三條相互敵對的軍事政治路線。
dossier.causeEn: The fundamental cause was Portugal's refusal to establish a workable timetable for Angolan autonomy or independence. The Estado Novo created during the 1930s maintained central control through the army, police, and secret police. After Portugal's colonies were renamed overseas provinces in 1951, Angola still had neither a self-governing local government nor elected representation. The MPLA was formed under conditions in which organizers were banned, leaders were arrested or forced into exile, and political reform offered little prospect of transferring effective authority. Armed struggle therefore became the MPLA's route to decisive power. The economic structure was equally important. Coffee, sisal, diamonds, railways, and ports served Portuguese and multinational enterprises, while Angolan administrative and security institutions protected these flows of resources. Congo's independence in 1960 gave nationalist leaders the opportunity to operate across frontiers, obtain weapons, and establish logistical bases. Portugal was already committing substantial forces in Portuguese Guinea, and Angola presented a defensive commitment of similar scale; fiscal and manpower pressure increased as the war continued. External assistance did not create the original dispute, but it allowed every armed organization to remain operational. American, Soviet, Chinese, South African, and Congolese support to competing factions divided an anti-colonial struggle that might otherwise have developed along a more unified military and political line.
dossier.impact: 戰爭把安哥拉從葡屬海外省份的內部政治問題，變成葡萄牙、法屬剛果、英屬剛果北部、南非及之後尚比亞共同介入的區域衝突。MPLA在長期撤退與反攻中取得一套可持續的邊境補給體系，並由城市地下組織轉成能協調旅、營級作戰的政治軍事領導中心。FNLA依靠霍爾登羅伯托的跨境網絡維持較完整的營區卻失去對所有武裝的控制；UNITA則把尚比亞邊境變成南部高原的進攻入口。三個組織沒有合成共同陣線，反而各自保存外國支援、地方聯繫與軍事目標，這種分裂一直影響1975年以後的權力安排。葡萄牙軍隊也由分散警戒轉向戰術指揮、空中偵察、武裝巡邏與固定據點互相配合的反叛亂體系，但軍事技術增加並未消除情報不足和政治拒絕让步。戰爭與幾內亞方向長期消耗、國際孤立及外交壓力共同削弱執政 regime；1974年里斯本革命後，葡萄牙無法再維持海外殖民戰爭。安哥拉的獨立成為帝國解體及葡萄牙政治轉折的一部分，而MPLA、FNLA與UNITA在戰爭中形成的競爭則成為新國家成立後立即面對的軍事問題。
dossier.impactEn: The war transformed Angola from an internal political issue within a Portuguese overseas province into a regional conflict involving Portugal, French Congo, northern British Congo, South Africa, and later Zambia. Through repeated withdrawals and counterattacks, the MPLA built a sustainable frontier supply system and developed from an urban underground organization into a political-military leadership capable of coordinating brigade and battalion operations. The FNLA maintained relatively complete camps through Holden Roberto's cross-border network but lost control of all armed organizations. UNITA turned the Zambian frontier into an entry point for operations across the southern plateau. The organizations never merged into a common front; instead, each preserved separate foreign support, local contacts, and military objectives, a division that continued after 1975. The Portuguese army also evolved from dispersed security duties toward a counter-insurgency system combining tactical command, aerial reconnaissance, armed patrols, fixed bases, and supporting fire. Better military techniques did not, however, eliminate weak intelligence or Portugal's political refusal to concede authority. The combined manpower and financial strain of Angola and Portuguese Guinea, together with diplomatic pressure and international isolation, weakened the colonial regime. After the Lisbon revolution in 1974, Portugal could no longer sustain the colonial war. Angolan independence became part of the breakup of the empire and of Portugal's political transition, while the rivalry among the MPLA, FNLA, and UNITA became an immediate military problem for the new state.
dossier.result: 葡萄牙沒有在安哥拉戰場消滅所有獨立組織，也不是由單一軍事決戰迫使撤退。1974年4月25日里斯本發生軍事接管，葡屬非洲政策失去政治基礎，安哥拉戰線遂逐步停止大規模攻勢。1975年1月15日，葡萄牙與MPLA、FNLA簽訂阿爾沃爾協議，安排葡萄牙撤軍、成立過渡權力及進行選舉；UNITA拒絕接受這項安排。過渡政府雖得以運作，但原定選舉沒有成為解決三方權力的機制，FNLA後來拒絕承認選舉結果，UNITA則在協議之外持續作戰。1975年11月11日，葡萄牙承認安哥拉主權移交，安哥拉獨立；在儀式與國家控制上，MPLA已掌握首都、北部與大部分中央行政區，聯合政府也由MPLA主導，葡萄牙殖民政體則無法恢復。FNLA的跨境影響逐步下降，UNITA仍在南部與東部維持武裝存在。因此，通常所稱安哥拉獨立戰爭的作戰終點應放在1974年，而殖民主權終止及國家建立則在1975年完成；這並不表示安哥拉所有武裝衝突已同時終止，而只表示反對葡萄牙殖民政權的戰爭已經結束。
dossier.resultEn: Portugal did not eliminate every Angolan independence organization in the battlefield, nor was it forced out by a single decisive battle. The military takeover in Lisbon on 25 April 1974 removed the political basis of Portuguese colonial policy, and operations in Angola gradually ceased. On 15 January 1975, Portugal, the MPLA, and the FNLA signed the Alvor Agreement, providing for Portuguese withdrawal, a transitional authority, and elections. UNITA refused to accept the arrangement. The transitional government operated, but the scheduled election did not resolve the competing claims to power. The FNLA later rejected the electoral result, while UNITA continued fighting outside the agreement. Portugal recognized the transfer of sovereignty on 11 November 1975, when Angola became independent. In ceremonial and institutional control, the MPLA held the capital, the north, and most central administrative areas, and the transitional government was dominated by the MPLA. Portuguese colonial authority could not be restored. The FNLA's cross-border influence diminished, while UNITA retained an armed presence in the south and east. The operational endpoint of the Angolan War of Independence is therefore best placed in 1974, whereas the end of colonial sovereignty and the creation of the state were completed in 1975. That distinction does not mean all armed conflict in Angola ended at the same time; it marks the end of the war directed against Portuguese colonial rule.

items.id: 1998-埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭

battle.name: 埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
battle.brief: 1998年5月，埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞因邊界爭端在巴德梅地區爆發武裝衝突，雙方動員大量正規軍與重裝備，展開激烈的地面與空中對抗。這場戰爭的焦點之一是埃塞軍的T-55主力戰車，其在蘇聯時期大量裝備，並在衝突中發揮重要作用。

kit.name: T-55主力戰車
kit.history: T-55是蘇聯第二代中型戰車，設計用於提供可靠的火力與裝甲支援，於冷戰期間大量裝備蘇聯及受援國家，成為地面部隊的主力裝甲平台。

dossier.countries: 一九九八年五月的交戰雙方是埃塞俄比亞聯邦民主共和國與厄立特里亞國。厄立特里亞自一九九六年占領提格雷的梅克爾與巴德梅後，於一九九六至一九九七年向阿斯馬拉方向維持前進陣地；到一九九八年五月，它仍控制邊境縱深及數條深入埃塞俄比亞的公路。埃塞俄比亞從首都、提格雷與阿姆哈拉調集師旅部隊，在約一千公里的接觸線上把主力集中於扎蘭貝薩、措羅納與巴倫圖。五月十四日，埃塞俄比亞軍沿扎蘭貝薩－巴德梅－阿迪格拉特、措羅納－謝加－阿法貝特，以及巴倫圖－納克法等方向發動攻勢，海岸與馬薩瓦方向則受到牽制。厄立特里亞軍依邊境工事逐次抵抗；五月二十一日阿法貝特失守，阿格達特與納克法等據點相繼易手。五月三十日埃塞俄比亞軍進入阿斯馬拉；五月三十一日厄方宣布撤出埃塞俄比亞領土，六月三日接受阿爾及利亞斡旋的停火，戰線於數日內從追擊轉為脫離。
dossier.countriesEn: The belligerents in May 1998 were the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and the State of Eritrea. After Eritrea occupied Mekelle and Badme in Tigray in 1996, it maintained forward positions toward Asmara during 1996 and 1997; by May 1998, it still controlled the border depth and several roads extending deeply into Ethiopian territory. Ethiopia concentrated divisional and brigaded formations from the capital, Tigray, and Amhara against a contact line approximately 1,000 kilometres long, concentrating its main strength around Zalambessa, Tsorona, and Barentu. On 14 May, the Ethiopian army attacked along the Zalambessa-Badme-Adigrat, Tsorona-Shega-Afabet, and Barentu-Nakfa axes, while the coastal and Massawa directions were subjected to pressure rather than receiving the principal breakthrough. Eritrean troops resisted in succession from prepared border positions. Afabet fell on 21 May, and Agordat, Nakfa, and other strongpoints subsequently changed hands. Ethiopian forces entered Asmara on 30 May. On 31 May Eritrea announced its withdrawal from Ethiopian territory, and on 3 June it accepted an Algerian-brokered ceasefire, shifting the front within days from pursuit to disengagement.
dossier.people: 作戰的政治與軍事中樞分別落在埃塞俄比亞總理兼武裝部隊最高指揮官梅萊斯·澤納瓦，以及厄立特里亞總統伊薩亞斯·阿夫韋爾基。澤納瓦作出全面反攻的政治決定，並承擔收回提格雷的軍事責任；參謀長塔斯坎·格布雷滕薩負責把決定轉成集團軍作戰、部隊配置與後勤優先序。厄方由國防部長阿里·賽義德·阿卜杜拉主持軍政防禦，與各邊防地段指揮部維持縱深調動。兩位領導人都經歷過游擊戰與建軍，因此邊境內一條公路或一個前進陣地都具有直接軍事意義。五月中旬中央突破形成後，阿法貝特等道路樞紐是由多支部隊包圍、側擊和封鎖後奪取，並非由單一突擊隊強攻；同一作戰鏈使阿格達特與納克法相繼被切斷。厄方在縱深受損後，把仍能控制的海岸與馬薩瓦方向留作退路；埃軍則因阿斯馬拉已撤守而於五月三十日進城。六月初，阿爾及利亞外交人員與聯合國特使萊蓋塞·特梅推動談判，六月三日達成停火安排。
dossier.peopleEn: The political and military centres of the campaign lay with Ethiopian Prime Minister and commander-in-chief Meles Zenawi and Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki. Zenawi made the political decision for a full counteroffensive and assumed responsibility for recovering Tigray. Chief of Staff General Tsadkan Gebretensae translated that decision into group operations, force allocation, and logistics priorities. On the Eritrean side, Defence Minister Ali Said Abdella directed the military-defensive arrangements and maintained depth movements with the sector commands. Both leaders had experience in guerrilla warfare and army building, giving a road or forward position inside the border direct operational significance. After the central breach formed in mid-May, road junctions such as Afabet were taken through encirclement, flanking movement, and isolation by several formations rather than through an assault by a single strike force. The same operational chain subsequently cut off Agordat and Nakfa. With its depth compromised, Eritrea retained the coast and Massawa direction as an avenue of withdrawal. Because Asmara had been evacuated, Ethiopian forces entered it on 30 May. In early June, Algerian diplomats and United Nations envoy Legesse W. Teme promoted negotiations that produced a ceasefire arrangement on 3 June.
dossier.kits: 一九九八年可確認投入的裝備中，雙方地面部隊以T-55與部分T-62系列戰車為主，輔以BMP-1式裝甲步兵車、AKM與AK-74步槍、PKM或DShK班機槍及RPG-7反裝甲武器。埃塞俄比亞把D-30式122公厘牽引榴彈砲與BM-21式122公厘多管火箭砲集中使用，厄立特里亞防線也部署了牽引火砲、反戰車武器與封鎖器材。T-55使用的100公厘砲彈、T-62使用的115公厘砲彈、D-30的122公厘榴彈以及BM-21的122公厘火箭彈分屬不同供應鏈，後方必須分別儲運。埃塞俄比亞航空方面使用MiG-21、MiG-23與Su-27執行偵察、對地攻擊及武裝巡邏，Mi-8則負責運兵與後送；厄方航空任務有限，地面防空包括ZU-23-2與ZSU-23-4等大口徑自動砲。物資由阿的斯亞貝巴經德西、默克萊送往提格雷前線，火砲藥、燃料、備件與搶修車隊共同決定縱深突進速度；厄方則依阿斯馬拉、巴倫圖與馬薩瓦的公路網調度。雙方都沒有公開且可核對的彈藥存量，因此不能把任何發射任務的實際基數寫成確定數字。
dossier.kitsEn: Among the equipment confirmed as available in 1998, the principal ground fighting vehicles of both sides were T-55 and some T-62-series tanks, supported by BMP-1 armoured infantry vehicles, AKM and AK-74 rifles, PKM or DShK squad machine guns, and RPG-7 anti-armour weapons. Ethiopia concentrated D-30 122 mm towed howitzers and BM-21 122 mm multiple rocket launchers, while the Eritrean line also employed towed artillery, anti-armour weapons, and obstruction materials. The 100 mm ammunition used by T-55, the 115 mm ammunition used by T-62, D-30 122 mm artillery rounds, and BM-21 122 mm rockets belonged to separate supply chains and had to be stored and transported separately. The Ethiopian air arm used MiG-21, MiG-23, and Su-27 aircraft for reconnaissance, ground attack, and armed patrols, while Mi-8 helicopters transported troops and provided support. Eritrean air operations were limited, and its ground air defence included automatic guns such as the ZU-23-2 and ZSU-23-4. Supplies moved from Addis Ababa through Dessie and Mekelle to the Tigray front. Artillery ammunition, fuel, spare parts, and repair convoys together determined the speed of the deeper advances. Eritrea organised movement along the road network connecting Asmara, Barentu, and Massawa. Neither side published a verifiable ammunition inventory, so the actual inventory for any firing mission cannot be stated as a confirmed figure.
dossier.tactics: 五月十四日的突破作戰並非戰車直接長距離衝鋒。埃塞俄比亞先以火砲和BM-21火箭砲對邊境陣地實施砲火準備，再由工程部隊處理地雷、鐵絲網與反坦克壕，闢出數條有限通道；步兵沿通道清除射擊孔和據點，T-55與T-62則利用坡地遮蔽，以直瞄火力支援，並在步兵鞏固陣地後向前推進。厄立特里亞以縱深堡壘、交叉射界和預備隊組織防禦，步兵與少量裝甲在陣地間實施局部反擊，使中央突破口不斷擴大而不立即崩潰。突破形成後，埃軍利用相鄰方向實施側翼運動，而不是把全部力量壓在同一正面。阿法貝特失守後，阿斯馬拉至馬薩瓦及中部公路網受到切斷，厄方預備隊即使奪回局部位置，也無法重新連成一條完整防線。五月下旬，埃塞俄比亞由北、中、西數個方向並行壓縮阿格達特、納克法與阿斯馬拉周圍的據點；厄軍在封鎖線完全合攏前主動撤往馬薩瓦及海岸方向，因而避免主力被包圍。埃軍追擊速度仍受長距離公路、燃料與彈藥運送限制；六月五日停火生效後，前線活動隨之停止。
dossier.tacticsEn: The operation launched on 14 May was not a direct long-range charge by tanks alone. Ethiopia first conducted artillery preparation with field guns and BM-21 rocket launchers against the border positions. Engineer troops then dealt with minefields, wire obstacles, and anti-tank ditches to open a limited number of passages. Infantry cleared firing positions and strongpoints along those passages, while T-55 and T-62 tanks used defilade and direct fire to support them, advancing only after infantry had secured the ground. Eritrea organised its defence in depth with fortified positions, intersecting fields of fire, and reserves. Infantry and limited armour conducted local counterattacks between strongpoints, preventing the central breach from collapsing immediately. Once the breach widened, Ethiopian formations made flanking movements across adjacent axes instead of committing every unit to the same frontal sector. After Afabet fell, the road network linking Asmara with Massawa and the interior was cut. Even where Eritrean reserves recovered local ground, they could not restore a continuous defensive line. In late May, Ethiopian columns compressed the positions around Agordat, Nakfa, and Asmara along northern, central, and western axes. Before the encirclement closed, Eritrean units withdrew toward Massawa and the coast, avoiding the destruction of the main force in a pocket. Ethiopian pursuit remained limited by long road networks and the transport of fuel and ammunition. Active movement stopped when the ceasefire took effect on 5 June.
dossier.data: 可核對的主要時間線如下：全面攻勢於五月十三日展開，五月十四日多路主力越過邊界；五月二十日前後，中央縱隊切斷阿斯馬拉通往馬薩瓦的主要道路。五月二十一日阿法貝特失守，之後數日內阿格達特與納克法相繼易手。五月二十八日，聯合國安全理事會通過第1197號決議，要求立即停止敵對行動並尋求政治解決。五月三十日，埃塞俄比亞軍進入阿斯馬拉；五月三十一日，厄立特里亞宣布將撤出埃塞俄比亞領土。六月三日，雙方接受阿爾及利亞提出的停火；六月五日停火生效，同日安全理事會通過第1207號決議，對兩國實施武器禁運。從全面交戰到停火實行不足四週。公開資料中的傷亡總計互相矛盾，缺乏能交叉核對的完整統計，因此不採用任何單一傷亡數字；較能確認的是沿線據點先後易手、出現戰俘與遺留裝備，以及阿斯馬拉至馬薩瓦的交通一度中斷。
dossier.dataEn: The principal verifiable timeline is as follows: the full-scale offensive began on 13 May, and multiple columns crossed the border on 14 May. Around 20 May, the central column cut the main road from Asmara to Massawa. Afabet fell on 21 May, and Agordat and Nakfa changed hands within the following days. On 28 May, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1197, demanding an immediate end to hostilities and a political settlement. Ethiopian forces entered Asmara on 30 May, and on 31 May Eritrea announced that it would withdraw from Ethiopian territory. On 3 June both sides accepted the Algerian ceasefire proposal. The ceasefire took effect on 5 June, when the Security Council also adopted Resolution 1207, imposing an arms embargo on both countries. Less than four weeks elapsed between full-scale fighting and implementation of the ceasefire. Public casualty totals conflict and lack a complete, cross-verifiable record, so no single casualty figure is used. The more firmly established facts are the successive loss of strongpoints, the presence of prisoners and abandoned equipment, and the temporary interruption of the road linking Asmara with Massawa.
dossier.cause: 這場戰爭的根源並非一九九八年五月才出現的一次接觸。厄立特里亞在一九六一至一九九一年的獨立戰爭後於一九九三年建國，但雙方始終沒有共同勘定並接受永久邊界。殖民時期留下的行政界線、非洲統一組織邊界委員會繪製的地圖，以及後續各方對地圖效力的解釋並不一致，巴德梅等據點因而成為軍事爭奪焦點。一九九六年五月，厄立特里亞攻入提格雷，占領梅克爾與巴德梅，並向阿斯馬拉方向推進，使兩國在邊境實力對比與阿斯馬拉周邊安全同時改變。埃塞俄比亞把收復提格雷視為必須完成的安全問題，厄立特里亞則把既有陣地視為防止邊界再被推移的堡壘。埃塞俄比亞還指稱厄方支援境內反政府武裝，厄方否認並反指埃方干預，這些指控加深了不信任，但公開紀錄不能把戰爭直接歸因於單一因素。一九九八年五月初，措羅納與扎蘭貝薩一帶的武裝衝突再度升高；埃塞俄比亞認定邊境陣地正在受損，決定以多路進攻一次突破，厄立特里亞則把集結視為入侵準備並加強防禦，原本的地方衝突因此擴大為國家間戰爭。
dossier.causeEn: The roots of the war did not begin with a single contact in May 1998. Following the Eritrean war of independence from 1961 to 1991, Eritrea became a state in 1993, but the two countries never jointly surveyed and accepted a permanent boundary. Colonial administrative lines, maps drawn by the Organization of African Unity boundary commission, and later differing interpretations of those maps remained inconsistent. Positions such as Badme consequently became military points of contention. In May 1996, Eritrea entered Tigray, occupied Mekelle and Badme, and advanced toward Asmara, changing both the military balance along the border and the security of the area around Asmara. Ethiopia regarded the recovery of Tigray as a security requirement. Eritrea regarded its existing positions as barriers against another movement of the border. Ethiopia also accused Eritrea of supporting armed opposition movements inside Ethiopia, while Eritrea denied this and accused Ethiopia of interference. These allegations deepened mistrust, but the public record cannot reduce the war to one cause. In early May 1998, armed clashes increased around Tsorona and Zalambessa. Ethiopia concluded that the border positions were being eroded and chose a multi-axis offensive to break them at once. Eritrea regarded the concentration of Ethiopian forces as invasion preparations and reinforced its defences. A local conflict consequently developed into a war between states.
dossier.impact: 六月五日停火生效時，埃塞俄比亞軍已在巴德梅、梅克爾、阿法貝特、阿格達特、納克法與阿斯馬拉等廣大地區建立控制，厄立特里亞則退守馬薩瓦、達赫拉克群島及相鄰海岸地帶。厄方確實撤出了埃塞俄比亞領土，但埃軍仍佔據厄立特里亞相當大的內陸地區，因此雙方都未回到一九九六年以前的實際控制線。聯合國第1207號武器禁運增加了合法補給與裝備補充的困難，也切斷了兩國原本有限的外來軍事供應；短期內，殘存火砲、戰車、燃料和維修能力因而更受重視。雙方都留下受損公路、消耗後的彈藥基數與失去的前進陣地，但沒有可靠資料支持精確計算裝備損失。六月停火後成立的軍事聯絡安排處理的是脫離、戰俘交換與武器清點，不是永久邊界劃定。聯合國也沒有立即建立完整的停火核查機制，該任務到二000年才正式部署。一九九九年，雙方又在巴德梅爆發戰鬥，證明一九九八年只處理了軍隊位置，沒有解決邊界爭議。
dossier.impactEn: When the ceasefire took effect on 5 June, Ethiopian forces had established control over broad areas including Badme, Mekelle, Afabet, Agordat, Nakfa, and Asmara, while Eritrea had withdrawn to Massawa, the Dahlak Islands, and adjacent coastal areas. Eritrea did withdraw from Ethiopian territory, but Ethiopian forces still occupied a substantial inland part of Eritrea, so neither side returned to the actual lines held before 1996. United Nations Resolution 1207 made legal resupply and replenishment of military equipment more difficult and cut off the limited foreign military supply available to both countries. In the short term, surviving artillery, tanks, fuel, and maintenance capacity therefore became more important. Both sides left damaged roads, depleted ammunition stocks, and lost forward positions, but reliable evidence does not permit an exact calculation of equipment losses. Military liaison arrangements established after the June ceasefire addressed disengagement, prisoner exchanges, and equipment inventories rather than a permanent boundary. The United Nations did not establish a complete ceasefire verification mechanism immediately; that deployment followed in 2000. Renewed fighting at Badme in 1999 demonstrated that the 1998 agreement had settled troop positions without resolving the boundary dispute.
dossier.result: 從作戰層面看，這是一場由埃塞俄比亞取得戰役成果、而厄立特里亞避免主力被包圍的戰爭。埃塞俄比亞收復提格雷，突破厄立特里亞經營多年的邊境防線，切斷通往阿斯馬拉與馬薩瓦的道路，並在五月底進入阿斯馬拉，因而達成此次反攻的主要軍事目標。厄立特里亞未能守住自一九九六年以來取得的大部分前進位置，但在發現中央與西側縱深即將被切斷後，組織退卻並保存成建制部隊，馬薩瓦與達赫拉克群島仍在其控制之下，所以這不是一場以全軍覆沒收場的戰役。六月五日停火後的交換安排包括戰俘返回、遺留裝備清點及前沿部隊脫離，主要前線維持到一九九九年才再度大規模破裂。埃塞俄比亞沒有在停火時撤出厄立特里亞內陸占區，厄立特里亞也沒有取得共同勘定的邊界線，兩國因此未簽下終止爭端的永久和平協議。停火確實終止了五月的追擊，但只是把未決的邊界、陣地與軍事對峙凍結在新的位置。
dossier.resultEn: At the operational level, this was a war in which Ethiopia achieved the campaign objectives while Eritrea avoided the destruction of its main army. Ethiopia recovered Tigray, broke through the border defence Eritrea had developed over several years, cut the roads leading toward Asmara and Massawa, and entered Asmara at the end of May. It therefore achieved the principal military purpose of the counteroffensive. Eritrea failed to retain most of the forward positions acquired since 1996, but after recognising that its central and western depth was about to be cut, it conducted an organised withdrawal that preserved formed units. Massawa and the Dahlak Islands remained under Eritrean control, so the campaign did not end in the destruction of its entire army. After the ceasefire of 5 June, arrangements included prisoner returns, inventories of abandoned equipment, and the disengagement of forward units. The principal front remained stable until large-scale fighting resumed in 1999. Ethiopia did not withdraw from its inland positions in Eritrea at the ceasefire, and Eritrea did not obtain a mutually surveyed border. The two states therefore concluded no permanent peace settlement ending the dispute. The ceasefire ended the pursuit of May, but it froze the unresolved border, territorial positions, and military confrontation at new locations.

battle.name: 第二次印巴戰爭
battle.theater: 克什米爾與旁遮普前線
battle.brief: 第二次印巴戰爭（1965年）爆發於克什米爾與旁遮普，雙方投入大量機械化兵團。巴基斯坦陸軍在這場衝突中使用了美製M4A1雪曼坦克，該坦克早於1942年服役，並在戰爭中提供重要裝甲支援。

kit.name: M4A1雪曼坦克
kit.history: M4A1雪曼坦克是二戰期間美國主力中型坦克，後來退役或轉讓至盟友，1965年巴基斯坦軍隊在印巴戰爭中將其作為裝甲突擊骨幹使用。

dossier.countries: 1965年第二次印巴戰爭的主要交據國是印度與巴基斯坦。巴基斯坦由西巴基斯坦與東巴基斯坦兩個軍區動員，主要攻勢放在西北邊境；印度則以西部與北部指揮部集中主力，防守蘇萊河、傑赫勒姆河、奇納布河沿線，以及通往斯利那加的公路和鐵路。拉合爾、錫亞爾科特、傑爾姆、帕坦科特、古爾普爾與卡爾吉爾是主要戰區，據點、鐵路和縱深道路把它們連接起來。蘇聯不是交戰國，而是派遣特使並主持塔什干會談；英國、美國及部分英聯邦國家提供外交、訓練或後勤協助，沒有以共同部隊投入戰場。因此，戰爭由兩條互相牽動的戰線組成：旁遮普平原會戰決定邊境突破能否維持，卡爾吉爾山地戰決定入境武力能否占據可防守的高地。
dossier.countriesEn: The principal belligerents in the 1965 Second Indo-Pakistani War were India and Pakistan. Pakistan mobilized through its West Pakistan and East Pakistan commands, placing its principal offensive on the northwestern frontier. India concentrated its main strength under Western and Northern Command to defend the Sutlej, Jhelum, and Chenab lines and the roads and railways leading to Srinagar. Lahore, Sialkot, Jammu, Pathankot, Gulpur, and Kargil formed the principal battlefields, linked by fortified positions, railways, and roads extending into the interior. The Soviet Union was not a belligerent; it sent an emissary and hosted the Tashkent talks. Britain, the United States, and several Commonwealth countries provided diplomatic, training, or logistical assistance but did not commit joint forces. The war therefore comprised two interconnected fronts: the battles of the Punjab plains determined whether a border breach could be sustained, while the mountain fighting at Kargil determined whether the infiltrating force could hold defensible heights.
dossier.people: 印度的政治與最高軍事決策由總理拉爾・巴哈杜爾・夏斯特里、國防部長亞什旺特勞・查萬和陸軍參謀長卡里亞帕元帥共同掌握。西部指揮部由喬杜里中將指揮，負責旁遮普與查莫克方向；北部指揮部由卡爾拉中將指揮，負責卡西姆山區。拉傑恩德拉辛吉中將率領第十五兵團，魯德拉少將指揮第一裝甲師，阿胡瓦利亞少將指揮第八山地師，使拉合爾反擊、錫亞爾科特裝甲戰和卡爾吉爾攻勢能由不同指揮鏈調度。巴基斯坦方面，總統阿尤布・汗決定向北進攻的戰略框架，武裝部隊參謀長穆罕默德・穆薩負責軍隊部署；阿克塔爾・阿卜杜勒・拉赫曼中將負責東巴基斯坦軍務，阿布拉爾・侯賽因少將指揮古吉拉尼瓦拉的第一兵團，艾尼斯・艾哈邁德少將則指揮錫亞爾科特方向的第十五步兵師。蘇聯總理柯西金後來以中立調解者身分促成塔什干協議，但沒有替任何一方提供戰場指揮。
dossier.peopleEn: India's political and top-level military decisions rested jointly with Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri, Defence Minister Y. B. Chavan, and Army Chief of Staff Field Marshal K. M. Cariappa. Lieutenant General J. N. Chaudhuri commanded Western Command, which covered the Punjab and Chamb directions, while Lieutenant General G. S. Kalra commanded Northern Command in the Kashmir area. Lieutenant General Rajendrasinhji led XV Corps, Major General A. A. Rudra commanded the 1st Armoured Division, and Major General M. S. Ahluwalia commanded the 8th Mountain Division, giving separate command chains to the Lahore counteroffensive, the armoured battle at Sialkot, and the Kargil offensive. On the Pakistani side, President Ayub Khan determined the strategic framework for the northern offensive, while Chief of Army Staff General Muhammad Musa directed deployment. Lieutenant General Akhtar Abdur Rahman handled military affairs in East Pakistan, Major General Abrar Hussain commanded I Corps at Gujranwala, and Major General Anis Ahmad led the 15th Infantry Division in the Sialkot sector. Soviet Premier Aleksei Kosygin later acted as a neutral mediator at Tashkent but did not exercise battlefield command for either side.
dossier.kits: 雙方作戰裝備的核心都是第二次世界大戰時期形成體系的坦克、火砲與螺旋槳飛機。印度與巴基斯坦都使用美製M47及M48巴頓戰車、謝爾曼坦克和中國製59式戰車；印度另有英製百夫長、法製AMX-13與少量76毫米M18自走砲，巴基斯坦則以M47、M48、謝爾曼及59式構成主要裝甲力量。火炮包括英製四點五英吋野戰砲、二十五磅砲，以及美製105毫米M1A1或D1榴彈砲；步兵單位配備120毫米迫擊砲、三點七英吋反戰車砲和106毫米M40無後坐力砲，機槍則有維克斯型與英國製斯特林式。印度空軍在此役使用米格21FL魚床C、米格7、神秘IV、獵鷹、堪培拉及B-97圖夫式；巴基斯坦空軍使用幻象III、F-6、F-86F、獵鷹與堪培拉。F-6是米格19的仿製型，兩國空軍亦使用C-47道克納斯等運輸機。部署時還配屬野戰電話、無線電台、搶修車、工程器材、燃料桶、彈藥車與汽車修理工作組。以上型號在1965年以前均已服役，清單只表示可使用的裝備種類，不代表每個師都配足相同數量。
dossier.kitsEn: The core equipment of both sides consisted of Second World War-era tank, artillery, and propeller-aircraft systems. India and Pakistan both fielded the American M47 and M48 Patton tanks, Sherman tanks, and Chinese Type 59 tanks. India additionally operated the Centurion, French AMX-13, and a limited number of 76 mm M18 self-propelled guns, while Pakistan's principal armored strength came from the M47, M48, Sherman, and Type 59. Artillery included the British 4.5-inch field gun, the 25-pounder, and the American 105 mm M1A1 or D1 howitzer. Infantry formations had 120 mm mortars, 3.7-inch anti-tank guns, and 106 mm M40 recoilless rifles, with Vickers machine guns and British Sterling submachine guns in service. The Indian Air Force employed the MiG-21FL Fishbed-C, MiG-7, Mystère IV, Hunter, Canberra, and B-97 Toof. The Pakistan Air Force fielded the Mirage III, F-6, F-86F, Hunter, and Canberra. The F-6 was a Chinese-built derivative of the MiG-19, and both air forces also used C-47 Dakota transports. The field order of battle also included field telephones, radio sets, recovery vehicles, engineering equipment, fuel drums, ammunition trucks, and vehicle repair workshops. Every model listed had entered service before 1965; the inventory identifies available types, not identical quantities in every division.
dossier.tactics: 九月四日夜至五日，巴基斯坦空軍先行攻擊包括帕坦科特在內的空軍基地，並轟擊邊境公路、鐵路與若干橋梁；炮兵同時向傑爾姆、錫亞爾科特、拉合爾和卡西姆前線射擊。九月六日拂曉，標示「大打擊」的主要攻勢展開：第十五步兵師及裝甲部隊在錫亞爾科特越過蘇萊河，第十師投向傑爾姆，第十九師攻擊帕坦科特，第六裝甲師在拉合爾東側渡河，古爾普爾與傑赫勒姆方向則由步兵、炮兵和工程兵建立橋頭堡。印度沒有把所有裝甲部隊同時推向前線，而是以步兵、反戰車砲和逐線火力封住渡口，再由縱深部隊封閉突破口。錫亞爾科特方面，第一步兵師與第一裝甲師在多格諾奇、菲利奧拉一線反擊；密集的公路和河岸地形迫使巴基斯坦裝甲縱隊分批前進，使其無法迅速擴大突破口。拉合爾方面，第六裝甲師一度向鐵路與城市外圍推進，但第十五兵團以第十五步兵師、第五十四步兵師及第一裝甲師執行「阿杰」反擊，到九月十二日前後迫使巴基斯坦部隊撤回蘇萊河東側。帕坦科特跑道遭到嚴重破壞，但仍在印度控制之下；傑爾姆與古爾普爾的攻勢同樣沒有形成持續突破。卡西姆戰線最為激烈。九月七日開始，印度第八山地師和第十八步兵師在山炮、工兵與通信支援下展開「維杰」行動，黑岩與托洛林在九月八日前後失守，敵方據守的四八七五高點、三座山頭與老虎山則在九月十三日前後被印度控制；交通斷裂的巴基斯坦北方輕步兵與武裝入境者被逐個孤立，其餘零散陣地直至停火後才陸續撤除。巴基斯坦另在九月六日宣布單方面停火，希望聯合國介入，但印度認為攻勢仍在進行，沒有把該聲明視為有效中止作戰。九月十日，夏斯特里與阿尤布・汗在塔什干簽署協議，戰鬥在九月十一日全面停止。
dossier.tacticsEn: From the night of September 4 into September 5, the Pakistan Air Force struck air bases, including Pathankot, and attacked frontier roads, railways, and several bridges, while artillery opened fire against Jammu, Sialkot, Lahore, and the Kashmir front. At dawn on September 6, the main offensive designated Grand Slam began. The 15th Infantry Division and supporting armor crossed the Sutlej at Sialkot, the 10th Division was committed toward Jammu, the 19th Division attacked Pathankot, the 6th Armoured Division crossed east of Lahore, and infantry, artillery, and engineers established bridgeheads in the Gulpur and Jhelum sectors. India did not commit all armored formations simultaneously. Infantry, anti-tank guns, and fire along successive defensive lines confined the crossings, while reserves in depth closed the penetrations. At Sialkot, the 1st Infantry Division and 1st Armoured Division counterattacked around Dog Notch and Phillora. Constricted roads and riverbanks forced the Pakistani armored columns to advance in smaller groups, preventing a rapid expansion of the bridgehead. In the Lahore sector, the 6th Armoured Division advanced toward the railway and the approaches to the city, but XV Corps conducted Operation Ajay with the 15th Infantry Division, 54th Infantry Division, and 1st Armoured Division. By about September 12, those forces pushed the Pakistani units back east of the Sutlej. Pathankot's runway was badly damaged but remained under Indian control, and the attacks at Jammu and Gulpur likewise failed to produce sustained penetrations. The Kashmir front was the most intense. Beginning on September 7, the Indian 8th Mountain Division and 18th Infantry Division launched Operation Vijay with mountain artillery, engineers, and communications support. Black Rock and Tololing fell around September 8, while Point 4875, Three Pimple, and Tiger Hill came under Indian control around September 13. Pakistani Northern Light Infantry and armed infiltrators, isolated by the broken transport network, were defeated position by position, while scattered outposts withdrew only after the ceasefire. Pakistan had also declared a unilateral ceasefire on September 6 in the hope of United Nations intervention, but India regarded the continuing offensive as proof that the declaration had not halted operations. On September 10, Shastri and Ayub Khan signed the Tashkent agreement in Tashkent, and general fighting ceased on September 11.
dossier.data: 若以八月開始的邊境滲透與危機累積計算，戰事延續至九月下旬；九月六日至十一日的大規模正規會戰則不足一週。常見的戰後兵力概估把印度可用總量列為約三十個師、約一千二百輛戰車、約八百門火砲及九百架飛機；巴基斯坦約有十二至十三個師、二百五十輛戰車、三百門火砲及二百二十架飛機。這些數字包括預備與後續可調度部隊，並非全部同時位於前線。旁遮普補給主要利用德里至阿姆利則及昌迪加爾的鐵路、公路向前輸送；巴基斯坦則依賴拉合爾至瓦希拉巴德、錫亞爾科特等幹線及前進仓库。炮兵反覆射擊造成的主要後勤壓力是砲彈補充、車輛輪班與燃料前送，而不是單純增加射擊次數。季風帶來暴雨、泥濘和河水暴漲，使旁遮普道路阻塞，也限制卡爾吉爾山區的車輛通行。雙方對作戰傷亡、裝甲損失與空戰結果的統計口徑不同，當時亦無共同核驗的單一總表，因此不能把有爭議的精確傷亡數字視為定論。
dossier.dataEn: Measured from the beginning of the frontier infiltrations and accumulating crisis in August, the conflict continued into late September; the major conventional campaign from September 6 to September 11 lasted less than a week. Common postwar force estimates place India's available strength at approximately thirty divisions, 1,200 tanks, 800 artillery pieces, and 900 aircraft. Pakistan was assessed at roughly twelve to thirteen divisions, 250 tanks, 300 artillery pieces, and 220 aircraft. These figures include reserves and units available for later commitment and do not mean that every formation was simultaneously on the firing line. Punjab sustainment depended principally on the railways and roads from Delhi through Amritsar and Jalandhar, while Pakistan relied on the Lahore-Wazirabad and Sialkot rail corridors and forward depots. The principal logistics pressure created by repeated artillery fire was the replenishment of shells, rotation of transport vehicles, and forward delivery of fuel, rather than a simple increase in the number of firing rounds. The monsoon brought heavy rain, mud, and swollen rivers, obstructing roads in the Punjab and restricting vehicle movement in the Kargil mountains. The two sides used different methods of counting combat casualties, armored losses, and air-combat results, and no jointly verified single total existed. Conflicting precise casualty figures therefore cannot responsibly be treated as settled fact.
dossier.cause: 戰爭最深的根源仍是1947年停火後未經共同勘定與永久安排的卡西姆邊界，以及聯合國原會支持就此舉行全民投票的立場。巴基斯坦把1965年安排武裝人員越過停火線的行動稱為「直布羅陀行動」，目的之一是讓既定局勢發生變化並增加聯合國介入壓力；印度則把它視為掩盖正規部隊入侵的準備。雙方的軍事部署又形成連鎖反應：印度因情報與邊境徵候向旁遮普集中兵力，巴基斯坦將此解讀為印度即將進攻的證據，於是把更多裝甲、步兵與炮兵推向北線。巴基斯坦相信印度防衛存在可利用的空隙，也相信聯合國會在突破形成後迅速促成停火；印度則掌握空軍、裝甲預備隊與縱深步兵可在有限時間內投入反擊。八月情報、九月空襲與渡河準備證明巴基斯坦確有大規模作戰計畫，但雙方仍低估了政治象徵、外交承諾、裝甲受地形限制及後勤差異同時發揮的作用。
dossier.causeEn: The deepest cause of the war remained the Kashmir boundary created after the 1947 ceasefire, which had never been jointly surveyed or converted into a permanent arrangement, together with the original United Nations position that a plebiscite should determine the territory's future. Pakistan's 1965 deployment of armed personnel across the ceasefire line, known as Operation Gibraltar, was intended partly to alter the existing situation and increase pressure for United Nations involvement. India regarded it instead as cover for a regular invasion. Military deployments then produced a chain reaction. India concentrated troops in the Punjab after intelligence reports and frontier indications, while Pakistan interpreted that movement as evidence of an impending Indian attack and moved additional armor, infantry, and artillery northward. Pakistan believed Indian defenses contained exploitable gaps and expected the United Nations to arrange a rapid ceasefire once a breakthrough had been created. India, however, possessed air forces, armored reserves, and infantry in depth that could be committed to a counterattack within a limited time. Intelligence gathered during August and the air strikes and river preparations of September confirmed that Pakistan had a major operational plan, but both governments underestimated the combined effects of political symbolism, international commitments, terrain restrictions on armor, and differences in logistics.
dossier.impact: 在作戰層面，印度以有限縱深反擊封住了巴基斯坦在旁遮普的主要突破，並在卡爾吉爾重新控制主要高地；巴基斯坦則顯示封閉渡口、受限制道路與短暫空軍主動權不足以讓裝甲越過步兵和炮兵構成的正面阻力。空軍基地的疏散、跑道搶修與跑道旁分散駐機，使最初空襲未能長期阻止印度空軍作戰；前進彈藥與燃料倉庫遭空襲威脅，則凸顯部隊越過河流後仍依賴補給線的弱點。印度雖在戰場上取得多數可見成果，塔什干協議卻使主要邊境回到接近戰前狀態，巴基斯坦的入境武力未能占據永久陣地，印度也沒有藉此實現全面政治要求。蘇聯調解提高了其在南亞的外交影響力，英美則因戰爭可能失控而持續要求克制，儘管沒有直接投入部隊。雙方還得到另一項長期教訓：情報可能揭示敵方準備，卻不能代替對準備是否完整、補給能否持續及聯合國會如何反應的判斷。
dossier.impactEn: Operationally, India's limited counteroffensive contained Pakistan's principal penetrations in the Punjab and regained the principal heights at Kargil. Pakistan, in turn, demonstrated that closed river crossings, restricted roads, and brief air superiority could not carry armor through a front formed by infantry and artillery. The dispersal of aircraft, rapid runway repair, and revetted parking areas around Indian airfields prevented the initial strikes from keeping the Indian Air Force ineffective for long. Pakistani forward ammunition and fuel depots remained exposed to air attack, illustrating the vulnerability of an army even after it had crossed a river. Although India achieved most of the immediate battlefield gains, the Tashkent settlement returned the principal frontier to a condition close to that before the war. Pakistan's infiltrating force obtained no permanent territory, and India did not convert its military success into its full political demands. Soviet mediation increased Moscow's diplomatic influence in South Asia, while Britain and the United States continued to press for restraint because of the danger of uncontrolled escalation, although neither intervened directly. Both sides also learned that intelligence could reveal an opponent's preparations but could not replace judgments about whether those preparations were complete, whether supplies could be sustained, and how the United Nations would respond.
dossier.result: 九月十日，阿尤布・汗與夏斯特里在蘇聯主持下簽署塔什干聲明，宣布自九月十一日起停止敵對行動。主要安排是雙方部隊退回一九四七年八月一日以前的邊境態勢、撤出卡西姆地區的巴基斯坦武裝入境者、交換被俘人員並後送傷者。巴基斯坦先前的單方面停火聲明沒有取代這項雙邊協議。聯合國軍事觀察人員其後分階段核驗撤軍與停火線；印度占據的卡爾吉爾主要陣地沒有在停火時交還，巴基斯坦據點則依協議陸續撤除，俘獲人員在隨後數週內分批遣返，絕大多數回到原部隊。東邊界短暫越線形成的軍事優勢也在協議框架下撤回，拉德克萊夫線重新受到約束。就戰術結果而言，印度保住了卡西姆高地並迫使巴基斯坦越線部隊退出；就戰略與政治結果而言，雙方大致回到戰前態勢，巴基斯坦沒有取得永久邊境收益，印度沒有迫使聯合國接受全民投票，蘇聯則成為結束戰爭的直接調解者。零星射擊在停火後逐漸停止，俘獲、人員後送與實地撤軍則持續到後續數月。
dossier.resultEn: On September 10, Ayub Khan and Shastri signed the Tashkent Declaration under Soviet auspices and announced that hostilities would cease from September 11. Its principal provisions required the forces of both countries to return to the frontier conditions prevailing before August 1, 1947, required Pakistan to withdraw its armed infiltrators from Kashmir, and provided for the exchange of prisoners and the evacuation of the wounded. Pakistan's earlier unilateral cease-fire declaration did not replace the bilateral agreement. United Nations military observers subsequently verified the withdrawal and ceasefire arrangements in stages. India did not surrender the principal Kargil positions it held at the ceasefire, while Pakistani outposts were evacuated in accordance with the agreement. Prisoners of war were released in succeeding batches during the following weeks, and the great majority returned to their units. The temporary military advantage created by the brief crossing on the eastern frontier was also withdrawn within the agreement, and the Radcliffe Line was brought under its constraints once more. Tactically, India retained the Kargil heights and forced the Pakistani infiltrating formations out. Strategically and politically, both countries returned approximately to the prewar situation. Pakistan obtained no permanent territorial gain, India did not compel the United Nations to accept a plebiscite, and the Soviet Union became the direct mediator that ended the war. Sporadic firing diminished after the ceasefire, while prisoner exchanges, evacuation, and the physical implementation of withdrawals continued during the following months.

battle.name: 奈及利亞內戰
battle.brief: 奈及利亞內戰於一九六七年七月在聯邦政府軍與比亞法拉軍隊之間展開，戰事集中於奈及利亞東部。比亞法拉軍隊使用蘇製AK-47突擊步槍；該正式型號已於一九四九年列裝，是其步兵部隊的重要地面武器，最終戰局由聯邦政府軍取得勝利。

kit.name: 卡莫夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯制式突擊步槍，隸屬步兵分隊的輕武器系統，擔任班與排的自動射擊火力，位階低於通用機槍與火炮。

dossier.countries: 1967年的奈及利亞內戰，實質上是聯邦政府與比亞法拉之間的一場內部分裂戰爭。聯邦軍政府掌握北部、西部、首都區及尼日爾河沿線的大部分交通與資源，並由拉各斯等港口取得外部補給；比亞法拉則控制原東部區的森林城鎮、東西公路、尼日爾河東岸與邦尼原油出口設施。聯邦軍與比亞法拉軍並非原先互不相識的外國軍隊，而是同屬奈及利亞武裝力量後，因地域、軍政命令及效忠問題分裂。戰線因此不是固定國界，而沿Onitsha、Awka、Owerri、Aba、Port Harcourt與Umuahia等交通樞紐反覆移動。比亞法拉雖獲若干國家承認，卻未被聯合國接納為會員；聯邦政府始終把其控制區視為奈及利亞領土的一部分。
dossier.countriesEn: The Nigerian Civil War of 1967 was fundamentally an internal conflict between the federal government and Biafra. The federal military government controlled most of the northern and western regions, the capital area, and the transport and resources along the Niger River, while obtaining external supplies through ports such as Lagos. Biafra held the forest towns of the former Eastern Region, the East-West Road, the east bank of the Niger, and the Bonny oil export facilities. The opposing forces were not strangers from separate foreign armies: they originated within Nigeria's own armed forces and then divided over regional loyalties, military commands, and political allegiance. The front consequently moved around transport nodes including Onitsha, Awka, Owerri, Aba, Port Harcourt, and Umuahia rather than following a fixed international border.
