Although several states recognized Biafra, the United Nations did not admit it as a member. The federal government consistently treated territory held by Biafra as part of Nigeria.
dossier.people: 比亞法拉領袖Odumegwu Ojukwu出身於原東部區軍事官僚體系，1966年先任東部區軍事首長，後於1967年成為比亞法拉國家元首。Philip Effiong先擔任參謀長，之後接掌比亞法拉第一師等野戰部隊，並在最後階段代表殘餘政府交涉投降；Alexander Madiebo是比亞法拉第二師的重要指揮官，Walter Olegge主持東部海軍司令部，飛行員Sam Mbakwe參與有限空運與近距作戰。聯邦方面由Yakubu Gowon主持軍政，Oladipo Diya在參謀體系中協調作戰，Joseph A. Johnson曾率領主攻Onitsha方向的聯邦第二師；聯邦空軍指揮官Adetokunbo Ademola於1969年1月空難身亡。雙方都有工程、信號、補給、醫療及通信人員，並非只有前線步兵。聯邦軍後來依師、旅、營作戰，比亞法拉則把殘存重裝、砲兵與步兵分散到多個道路防區，抵抗能力相當依賴指揮官能否及時重組兵力。
dossier.peopleEn: Odumegwu Ojukwu came from the military administration of the former Eastern Region, served as its military head after 1966, and became the head of Biafra in 1967. Philip Effiong was first Chief of Staff and later commanded field formations such as Biafra's First Division and represented the remnant government during the final surrender negotiations. Alexander Madiebo was an important commander of Biafra's Second Division, Walter Olegge headed the Eastern Naval Command, and pilot Sam Mbakwe took part in limited airlift and close-support operations. On the federal side, Yakubu Gowon directed the military government, Oladipo Diya coordinated operations through the staff system, and Joseph A. Johnson led the federal Second Division in the principal thrust toward Onitsha. Federal Air Force commander Adetokunbo Ademola died in an aircraft crash in January 1969. Neither side consisted only of infantry: engineers, signallers, supply personnel, medical staff, and communications specialists supported the formations. The federal army increasingly fought in divisions, brigades, and battalions, while Biafra dispersed armor, artillery, and infantry among several road defenses, making its resistance dependent on whether commanders could reconcentrate forces in time.
dossier.kits: 聯邦軍的裝備核心是英制標準化的小武器、砲兵與車輛，包括9毫米Sterling突擊槍、7.62毫米Bren機槍及FN MAG通用機槍、2英吋迫擊砲、QF 25磅砲、L7系列105毫米野戰砲與4.5英吋榴彈砲。裝甲與偵察主力包括輕型Ferret侦察車、6乘6 Saladin輪式裝甲車及Eland 20噸履帶裝甲運兵車；它們主要負責偵察、火力牽引、指揮與運兵，並不是能抵擋反戰車砲的現代主戰坦克。Dornier Do 28與de Havilland Dove等飛機用於聯絡、觀察和輕量供應。比亞法拉從東部軍械庫取得同類英制武器，也使用少量C-47與DC-3型飛機執行空運；戰爭後期外來援助中的T-34/85、SU-100及PT-76則提供較強的裝甲突擊能力。25磅砲、105毫米砲及迫擊砲各需不同規格的砲彈，7.62毫米武器亦須依實際膛室配發，不能只憑口徑混用。重型砲彈會佔用大量車輛載量，輪式車與履帶車的燃油、輪胎、備件和維修能力，往往比單件武器性能更能限制連續作戰。上述型號均在1967年以前問世並投入軍用。
dossier.kitsEn: The core of federal equipment was a British-pattern inventory of small arms, artillery, and vehicles, including the 9 mm Sterling submachine gun, 7.62 mm Bren light machine gun, FN MAG general-purpose machine gun, 2-inch mortar, QF 25-pounder, L7-series 105 mm field gun, and 4.5-inch howitzer. Armored reconnaissance and transport centered on the light Ferret scout car, 6x6 Saladin armored car, and Eland 20-ton tracked personnel carrier. These vehicles served principally in reconnaissance, towing, command, and troop transport rather than functioning as modern main battle tanks capable of withstanding anti-tank fire. Aircraft such as the Dornier Do 28 and de Havilland Dove were used for liaison, observation, and light supply work. Biafra inherited similar British-pattern weapons from eastern depots and also employed a limited number of C-47 and DC-3-type transports. Later foreign assistance supplied T-34/85 tanks, SU-100 tank destroyers, and PT-76 light tanks, giving Biafra a stronger armored striking capability. The 25-pounder, 105 mm gun, and mortars required different ammunition, while 7.62 mm weapons still had to be matched to their actual chambering rather than caliber alone. Heavy artillery rounds consumed substantial vehicle capacity, and fuel, tires, spare parts, and maintenance capacity often limited sustained operations more than the performance of any single weapon. All the listed types had entered military service before 1967.
dossier.tactics: 戰爭初期，比亞法拉利用東區既有營區和軍械，迅速控制Enugu、Owerri及Port Harcourt周邊，但企圖沿Onitsha大橋向拉各斯方向擴張時，在狹窄橋面與聯邦守軍的火力下受挫。聯邦軍沒有沿單一道路全速突進，而是以海軍與河流部隊封鎖沿海運輸，以機場、橋梁和道路補給點為打擊目標，再用聯盟公路及內河把師級部隊送往下一個目標。從Ibadan經Ogbomosho、Onitsha與Awka的軸線承擔主要正面推進，另一支部隊則在尼日爾三角洲向Port Harcourt收縮。比亞法拉常以Nsukka、Onitsha、Aba及Owerri附近的交叉路口為支撐，利用砲兵封鎖道路、步兵守據點，並在適合的泥濘地形投入T-34/85或SU-100阻止裝甲車隊通過。聯邦步兵則先由砲兵與空軍削弱道路及城鎮，再以工程部隊處理障礙，使用Eland運兵車越過鬆軟地面，Saladin與Ferret負責側翼偵察。雨季道路泥濘、車隊伸展及燃料消耗常迫使攻勢暫停；比亞法拉把砲位移往不同防區以延長抵抗，但缺少完整替裝與補給。到最後階段，其部隊已集中於Umuahia周邊，縱深縮短，因而更易被聯邦砲兵及步兵分割。
dossier.tacticsEn: At the beginning of the war, Biafrans used existing eastern barracks and depots to secure Enugu, Owerri, and the approaches to Port Harcourt, but their attempt to expand west through the Onitsha bridge toward Lagos was checked by federal defenders holding the narrow crossing. The federal army did not rush along one road. It used naval and river forces to interfere with coastal movement, targeted airfields, bridges, and supply points, and shifted divisions along the alliance road and inland waterways. The main frontal thrust followed the axis from Ibadan through Ogbomosho and Onitsha toward Awka, while another formation contracted toward Port Harcourt across the Niger Delta. Biafra relied on road junctions around Nsukka, Onitsha, Aba, and Owerri, using artillery to sweep approaches, infantry to hold strongpoints, and T-34/85 or SU-100 vehicles where muddy ground favored armor and could disrupt advancing columns. Federal infantry used artillery and air action against towns and roads before engineers dealt with physical obstacles; Eland carriers helped cross soft ground, while Saladin and Ferret vehicles screened the flanks. Rainy-season mud, long supply columns, and fuel consumption repeatedly forced pauses. Biafrans shifted guns between defensive sectors to extend their resistance but could not reliably replace equipment or sustain all formations. By the final phase, its forces were concentrated around Umuahia, with little depth and greater exposure to federal artillery and isolation.
dossier.data: 時間線可由1967年1月15日第一次軍變及1月28日反軍變開始理解；5月26日，Ojukwu在Enugu宣布比亞法拉成立，聯邦軍則於5月30日開始實際進攻，7月6日後被奈及利亞官方部分紀念活動用作象徵性開戰日。6月的Nsukka戰役中，聯邦軍一度受挫，比亞法拉也在7月再次嘗試向尼日爾河西岸突破。1967年秋冬，聯邦第二師沿Ibadan至Ogbomosho及Onitsha的公路逐步向前，東部首都與主要軍事機場相繼受到威脅；1968年10月14日，聯邦軍攻入Owerri，令比亞法拉主要指揮中心進一步後撤至Umuahia方向。1969年1月3日聯邦軍占領Aba，5月22日Port Harcourt這個長期孤立的地區也落入聯邦控制。聯邦後勤以拉各斯及尼日爾河中游基地為源頭，把砲彈、柴油、輪胎、橋梁工程器材及載人車輛沿公路和內河分送；前線砲兵即使有砲，也可能因連續射擊後彈藥未到而停火。比亞法拉只能轉移現有砲位、使用東部軍械庫及少量外部運輸維持，道路、輪胎與備件的不足逐步壓縮其射擊頻率。1970年1月8日聯邦發動最後攻勢，第2師沿Owerri至Umuahia道路推進，至1月15日占領Umuahia；Ojukwu於1月中旬離境，Ambrose Alli在1月29日宣布投降命令，命令於1月31日中午生效，主要抵抗在2月初停止。
dossier.dataEn: The chronology begins with the coup of 15 January 1967 and the countercoup of 28 January. On 26 May, Ojukwu declared the Republic of Biafra in Enugu, while actual federal military operations began on 30 May. Some later Nigerian commemorations consequently use 6 July as a symbolic start date. Federal forces suffered a setback around Nsukka in June, and Biafra made another attempt to break west across the Niger in July. During the second half of 1967, the federal Second Division advanced along the road from Ibadan through Ogbomosho and Onitsha, placing the eastern capital and principal military airfields under increasing pressure. On 14 October 1968 federal troops entered Owerri, forcing the Biafran command center farther toward Umuahia. Federal forces occupied Aba on 3 January 1969 and took the long-isolated Port Harcourt enclave on 22 May. Federal logistics drew ammunition, diesel, tires, bridging equipment, and transport vehicles from depots around Lagos and the middle Niger, then distributed them by road and inland water. A battery could cease firing even when its gun was intact if ammunition did not arrive after a prolonged engagement. Biafra could move existing guns and draw on eastern depots and limited external transport, but shortages of roads, tires, spare parts, and ammunition progressively reduced its rate of fire. The final federal offensive began on 8 January 1970. The Second Division advanced along the Owerri-Umuahia road and occupied Umuahia on 15 January. Ojukwu left Biafra in mid-January, Ambrose Alli announced surrender terms on 29 January, and the order took effect at noon on 31 January, with principal organized resistance ending in early February.
dossier.cause: 內戰的直接背景是獨立後聯邦制度沒有妥善處理地區利益、中央權力與軍隊效忠問題。奈及利亞沿襲英國殖民時期的聯邦框架，但北、南、西三區的資源、人口與政治影響並不一致；東部地區因石油與港口收入增加，對聯邦中央控制財政及軍政任命日益不安。1966年兩次軍事政變及隨後的軍官清除，使聯邦軍隊指揮系統破碎，東區軍官與中央軍政之間也形成難以修復的猜疑。Ojukwu政府認為聯邦已無法保住東部自治；聯邦政府則不能接受任何地區以既有軍區和行政機構分離。1967年5月的十二州改組進一步改變聯邦權力關係，使東部領袖相信地方安全與資源權力將持續受到中央限制。比亞法拉並非只因單一矛盾成立，而是把制度分歧、軍隊分裂及對聯邦未來的不信任集中在分離行動上。聯邦拒絕承認獨立，並採取軍事方式恢復統一，衝突遂從政治談判轉為全面戰爭。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate background was the failure of the post-independence federal system to resolve disputes over regional interests, central authority, and military loyalty. Nigeria inherited a British colonial federal framework, but the resources, population, and political influence of the northern, southern, and eastern regions were not equal. As petroleum income and port revenues increased in the east, eastern leaders grew more concerned about federal control over finance and senior appointments. The coups of 1966 and the subsequent removal or killing of officers shattered the federal command structure and deepened mistrust between eastern military officers and the central government. The Ojukwu administration concluded that the federation could no longer preserve eastern autonomy; the federal government could not accept the separation of a region through its existing military districts and administrative machinery. The creation of twelve states in May 1967 changed the balance of federal power and reinforced eastern fears that local authority and resources would continue to be diminished. Biafran separatism therefore concentrated several accumulated problems, including constitutional distrust, divided military allegiance, and fear of centralization. The federal government refused to recognize secession and chose military means to restore the territorial union, turning a political dispute into a general war.
dossier.impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了聯邦軍隊的技術與制度。聯邦由原本規模有限、偏重國內治安的軍隊，轉為能以師旅作戰、維持砲兵dependences、使用裝甲車與內河運輸的常備軍；道路工程、戰地醫療、燃料分配及高頻砲戰經驗成為後來軍事現代化的基礎。比亞法拉的外交處境則十分有限：法國與蘇聯先後承認它，但其在聯合國的席位始終未被接納；英國與美國在外交上支持聯邦領土完整或要求停止戰鬥，非洲統一組織曾調解，卻沒有以區域部隊介入。戰爭亦重創聯邦財政，邦尼等東部石油出口設施一度停擺，外匯與政府收入受到嚴重影響；停火後聯邦取得東部油區及港口，為下一階段石油經濟擴張提供條件。軍事上，聯邦獲得完整師級編制、裝甲運用與長距離補給經驗，許多後來在奈及利亞政治中具有影響力的軍官，也在戰區指揮或參謀崗位任職。與此同時，比亞法拉軍隊解體，殘餘人員分散到聯邦軍、地方行政及私人保安體系，使聯邦中央與東部軍政之間的長期張力仍未消失。
dossier.impactEn: The war first transformed the structure and technical capabilities of the federal armed forces. What had been a relatively small force oriented toward domestic security developed into a standing army capable of division and brigade operations, sustained artillery dependence, armored vehicle employment, and inland-water transport. Road engineering, field medical support, fuel distribution, and the demands of frequent artillery engagements became foundations of later military modernization. Biafra's diplomatic position remained limited. France and the Soviet Union recognized it, but the United Nations never admitted it as a member. Britain and the United States diplomatically supported Nigerian territorial integrity or called for an end to hostilities, while the Organization of African Unity attempted mediation without committing regional troops. The conflict also severely strained federal finances. Oil export facilities in the east, including Bonny, were temporarily shut, reducing foreign exchange and government income. After the ceasefire, federal control of eastern oil fields and ports became central to the subsequent expansion of the petroleum economy. Militarily, the federal government gained experience in full division structures, armored operations, and long-range logistics, and many officers who later shaped Nigerian politics had served in operational or staff positions. At the same time, the Biafran armed forces dissolved, while former personnel dispersed into the federal army, local administration, and private security networks, leaving enduring tension between federal authority and eastern military politics.
dossier.result: 最後一階段的勝負由交通與補給決定。聯邦第二師沿Owerri至Umuahia道路逐段攻進，其他部隊封鎖南側與河谷出口；砲兵可由後方安全地域支援前面步兵，而比亞法拉殘餘車輛在道路與燃料不足下難以保持整建制。1970年1月15日Umuahia被占領後，剩餘控制區已失去主要道路樞紐，Ojukwu於同月中旬離開並前往科特迪瓦。Ambrose Alli在1月29日宣布有條件投降，自1月31日中午生效；Effiong與主要幕僚隨後向聯邦軍交出權力，主要有組織抵抗於2月初終止。聯邦在軍事上達成消滅比亞法拉分級政府的目標，原東部區被重新劃分為多個聯邦行政單位，部分前比亞法拉軍官與士兵被整編、赦免或留在地方軍政體系。勝方並未因此消除內戰造成的軍事與政治代價，聯邦軍隊規模和機械化程度顯著增加，中央與地區間的權力爭執反而延續至戰後。傷亡方面，雙方均留下不完整名冊，俘虜、失蹤與重複計算的處理也不一致；較可靠的是軍人死亡達數萬，部分研究把雙方總數置於十萬量級附近，因此不宜採用任何聲稱精確到個位的傷亡數字。
dossier.resultEn: The outcome of the final phase was determined by movement and logistics. The federal Second Division advanced in sections along the Owerri-Umuahia road while other formations closed approaches to the south and river valleys. Artillery could be supported from rear areas without moving far behind the forward infantry, whereas Biafra's remaining vehicles found it increasingly difficult to retain cohesive formations because of damaged roads and inadequate fuel. After Umuahia was occupied on 15 January 1970, the remaining controlled territory had lost its principal transport junction. Ojukwu left Biafra later that month and went to Côte d'Ivoire. Ambrose Alli announced conditional surrender terms on 29 January, effective at noon on 31 January. Effiong and his senior staff subsequently transferred authority to federal forces, and principal organized resistance ended in early February. Militarily, the federal government had destroyed Biafra's separatist government. The former Eastern Region was reorganized into several federal administrative units, and some former Biafran officers and soldiers were integrated, pardoned, or retained in local military and political structures. Victory did not remove the costs of the war or eliminate political tensions: the federal army became substantially larger and more mechanized, while conflict between central authority and regional power continued after the ceasefire. Casualty records on both sides are incomplete, and prisoners, missing personnel, and duplicate records were handled inconsistently. Military deaths were clearly measured in tens of thousands, and some studies place the combined total near the scale of 100,000, so no exact figure should be treated as established.

battle.name: 第三次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 第三次中東戰爭於1967年6月爆發，以色列與埃及、敘利亞等國在中東戰線交鋒；戰事主要發生在西奈半島、戈蘭高地及約旦邊境一帶。戰役中，以軍裝甲部隊使用美製M48巴頓坦克，負責正面突破、裝甲支援、占領要地，並與步兵協同作戰。

kit.name: 巴頓中型坦克
kit.history: M48是美國陸軍二戰後標準中型坦克體系的正式型號，擔任裝甲營主力，負責以主砲支援步兵、對抗裝甲目標並在機動作戰中推進占領。

dossier.cause: 1967年5月18日，埃及宣布聯合國緊急部隊必須撤出埃及邊境，並把更多步兵、裝甲與砲兵調入西奈。敘利亞也在北部集結部隊，使亞細亞走廊與戈蘭一線的兵力對比持續上升。到5月22日，埃及宣布自6月5日起封閉曼德海峽，使紅海航運及埃拉特港的南部出口受到直接威脅。以色列情報機關持續觀察埃及與敘利亞的集兵、彈藥及航空部署，政府在確認西奈攻擊橋頭已經形成後，批准以制空及打擊縱深目標為主的應急方案。6月5日天亮前，國防部長摩西·達揚、總參謀長伊扎克·拉賓與空軍司令莫德凱·霍德依此展開行動，使開戰前的軍事積累、作戰決定與第一批空襲在同一天連接起來。
dossier.causeEn: On 18 May 1967, Egypt declared that the United Nations Emergency Force had to leave Egyptian territory and moved additional infantry, armored, and artillery units into Sinai. Syria also concentrated forces in the north, further changing the military balance along the Asian corridor and the Golan front. On 22 May, Egypt announced that it would close the Straits of Tiran beginning on 5 June, directly threatening Red Sea shipping and the southern maritime outlet at Eilat. Israeli intelligence continued to monitor Egyptian and Syrian troop concentrations, ammunition movements, and air deployments. After confirming that attack positions had been prepared in Sinai, the Israeli government approved an emergency plan centered on gaining air superiority and striking targets in depth. Before dawn on 5 June, Defense Minister Moshe Dayan, Chief of Staff Yitzhak Rabin, and Air Force commander Mordechai Hod launched that course of action, linking the preceding military buildup, the decision for war, and the opening strikes within a single day.
dossier.countries: 6月5日開戰時，以色列面對的是三個前線國家與一支部隊較晚到達的支援力量。埃及在西奈部署最強大的陸軍，駐紮Bir el-Abd一帶的第二軍負責東側防務，轄有裝甲師與數個步兵師，並以多個師級單位交替掩護隘口、渡口和交通線。敘利亞在戈蘭、基恩湖及加利利一線部署步兵、裝甲與反戰車部隊，重點是阻止以色列裝甲部隊越過通向大馬士革的走廊。約旦把部隊部署在約旦河西岸及山脊地帶，形成從北部加利利到耶路撒冷附近的防線。埃及、約旦與敘利亞均隸屬以埃及為核心的阿拉伯協作架構，伊拉克則在戰事開始後向約旦派出裝甲與機步部隊。以色列Army分為北部、中部與南部三個戰區：中部面對約旦，南部指揮官同時處理加薩與西奈北部，第162步兵師、第252步兵師和第3裝甲師是西奈主要突擊力量，第55傘兵旅與第143裝甲旅投入加薩，另有數個裝甲旅調往戈蘭。這是一場縱深不同、裝備結構不同的聯合作戰，而不是所有戰線同時投入兵力。
dossier.countriesEn: When the war began on 5 June, Israel faced three frontline states and a supporting force that arrived later. Egypt maintained the strongest land force in Sinai. Its Second Army, headquartered around Bir el-Abd, controlled the eastern sector and included armored and infantry divisions positioned to support one another at passes, crossings, and transport routes. Syria deployed infantry, armor, and antitank formations in the Golan, around Lake Kinneret, and in Galilee to block an armored corridor toward Damascus. Jordan concentrated troops along the West Bank and ridge line, forming a front extending from Galilee to the approaches to Jerusalem. Egypt, Jordan, and Syria operated within an Arab coordination system centered on Cairo, while Iraq later sent armored and mechanized forces to Jordan. The Israeli Army was divided into northern, central, and southern commands. Central Command faced Jordan; Southern Command handled both Gaza and northern Sinai; the 162nd and 252nd Infantry Divisions and the 3rd Armored Division formed the principal Sinai striking forces; the 55th Paratroop Brigade and 143rd Armored Brigade were committed in Gaza; and several armored brigades were transferred to the Golan. The campaign therefore combined fronts with different depths and force structures rather than committing every formation simultaneously.
dossier.people: 以色列的最高決策由摩西·達揚主持，總參謀長伊扎克·拉賓負責全軍作戰，兩人必須在有限時間內把政治要求轉成可執行的軍事命令。空軍司令莫德凱·霍德掌握出動節拍、攻擊波次與臨時改變目標的權力；南部戰區總指揮約瑟夫·加維什所指的伊加埃爾·亞丁實際協調加薩及西奈南部。第162師由莫德凱·馬萊夫指揮，在Bir el-Abd建立主要中央橋頭；第252師由哈伊姆·巴爾-列夫指揮，沿中路向南推進；第3裝甲師由亞伯拉罕·亞丹指揮，在北部地區追求裝甲速度。戈蘭後續攻勢則由數個裝甲旅及步兵支隊分別實施。埃及方面，總統加麥爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾掌握最高權力，戰局惡化後由阿梅爾擔任統一戰線指揮，參謀系統則負責安排裝甲師與預備隊。約旦國王侯賽因能夠直接決定部隊是否繼續留在約旦河西岸；敘利亞總統哈菲茲·阿薩德則同時面對北部戰線失守與停火壓力。各戰區指揮官普遍依賴無線電、摩托車傳令與預設備用頻道，當指揮節點遭受空襲時，命令到達時間並不一致。空軍奪取主動後，日常戰術節奏很大程度交由前線指揮官決定，使其能根據隘口形狀、砲火密度及裝甲部隊位置調整推進方向。
dossier.peopleEn: Moshe Dayan presided over Israel's highest-level decisions, while Chief of Staff Yitzhak Rabin directed the army's operations. Together they had to turn political requirements into executable military orders within a narrow interval. Air Force commander Mordechai Hod controlled the timing of sorties, attack waves, and last-minute target changes. Southern Command under Yigael Yadin coordinated Gaza and southern Sinai. Mordechai Maklef commanded the 162nd Division and established the principal central bridgehead at Bir el-Abd. Haim Bar-Lev led the 252nd Division along the central axis toward the south, while Avraham Adan commanded the 3rd Armored Division in the northern sector, where speed and exploitation mattered most. The later Golan offensive was conducted by several armored brigades and supporting infantry formations. On the Egyptian side, President Gamal Abdel Nasser held supreme authority and appointed Field Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer to command the unified front as the situation deteriorated; the staff system arranged armored divisions and reserves. Jordan's King Hussein could decide directly whether Jordanian forces would remain deployed in the West Bank. Syria's President Hafez al-Assad faced both the collapse of the northern battle line and mounting pressure for a ceasefire. Commanders depended on radios, motorcycle messengers, and preset backup frequencies. When headquarters nodes were hit, orders did not always arrive at the same speed. Once the air force gained the initiative, tactical tempo largely rested with front commanders, who adjusted axes of advance according to crossing conditions, artillery density, and armored formations.
dossier.kits: 1967年的裝備差距主要表現在空軍與裝甲兵的射擊範圍、砲兵射程及後勤結構。以色列陸軍以M48A1裝甲車為突擊主力，車上90毫米砲與埃及T-34/85的85毫米砲、T-54或T-55的100毫米砲不能共用彈藥；少量Centurion使用105毫米砲，M24則使用75毫米砲，部分105毫米公制謝爾曼擔任支援任務。105毫米M68牽引砲、155毫米M51與1966年列裝的M65長射程榴彈砲提供戰術及縱深火力，還使用120毫米迫擊砲、M3半履帶車、謝爾曼工兵車與M32裝甲回收車。步兵主要使用7.62毫米FN FAL、MAG，以及9毫米Uzi。空軍可用機包括達索的Mirage IIIC、F-4A Phantom II、A-4 Skyhawk與F-8 Crusader，C-47負責 wounded personnel and supplies? Need no civilian but troops/supplies. We can say 人員與物資運輸。埃及與敘利亞陸軍裝備T-34/85、T-54、T-55、PT-76、M4謝爾曼及少量IS-3M，122毫米D-30、152毫米KS-3及203毫米B-4榴彈砲形成主要火力層。埃及與敘利亞空軍保有MiG-17、MiG-19及部分MiG-21PF，埃及另有Il-28轟炸機；約旦使用F-104 Starfighter與Hawker Hunter。埃及把S-75 Dvina導彈部署在開羅及尼羅河三角洲後方，但沒有在前線形成可逆轉地面劣勢的封鎖。各型裝甲車、飛機與火砲使用的燃料、備件及口徑並不相同，前進後必須分別維持彈藥車、加油車、抽水機及修理分隊，不能只根據總數判斷持續作戰能力。
dossier.kitsEn: The equipment gap in 1967 was expressed mainly through air range, artillery reach, and logistics. The Israeli Army relied on the M48A1 for its main armored thrust. Its 90mm gun could not share ammunition with the 85mm gun of the Egyptian T-34/85 or the 100mm gun of the T-54 and T-55. A small number of Centurions carried 105mm guns, while the M24 used 75mm ammunition; some 105mm metric Shermans provided support. The 105mm M68 towed howitzer, 155mm M51, and the long-range M65 howitzer, which entered service in 1966, supplied tactical and deep-fire support. The force also used 120mm mortars, M3 half-tracks, Sherman armored engineering vehicles, and M32 recovery vehicles. Infantry weapons included the 7.62mm FN FAL, MAG, and 9mm Uzi. Available aircraft included the Dassault Mirage IIIC, F-4A Phantom II, A-4 Skyhawk, and F-8 Crusader, while C-47 transports carried personnel and supplies. Egyptian and Syrian forces used T-34/85, T-54, T-55, PT-76, M4 Sherman, and limited IS-3M tanks. Their principal artillery layer included 122mm D-30, 152mm KS-3, and 203mm B-4 howitzers. Egyptian and Syrian air forces retained MiG-17, MiG-19, and some MiG-21PF aircraft, while Egypt also operated Il-28 bombers; Jordan used F-104 Starfighters and Hawker Hunters. Egypt deployed S-75 Dvina missiles around Cairo and the Nile Delta, but they did not form a barrier that could reverse the ground situation. Ammunition calibers, fuel, and spare parts differed across these systems, so every advance required separate ammunition vehicles, fuel trucks, water equipment, and repair detachments rather than a single consolidated logistics system.
dossier.tactics: 以色列的作戰起點是Operation Focus。第一波近兩百架作戰機在6月5日清晨進入空域，優先攻擊空場跑道、雷達站、彈藥庫、指揮節點與縱深交通設施，而不是把兵力平均分配給前線目標。Mirage IIIC迅速取得空戰優勢後，其他攻擊機反覆打擊仍在修復跑道的機場；工程人員雖能清除未爆彈、迅速鋪設便道，卻往往在跑道重新開放前再次遭受攻擊。地面作戰則遵循先空襲奪取局部優勢，再以步兵、工兵、砲兵和坦克協同突破的程序。埃及預先把主力放在渡口後方，倚賴壕溝、障礙物、反戰車砲和縱深預備隊；以色列師避免正面逐點攻擊全部工事，先由工兵打開出口，讓裝甲車進入狹窄通道，再繞過孤立據點，由步兵和砲兵逐段消除。約旦前線利用傘兵與裝甲車奪取山脊通道，使道路與城鎮節點迅速斷開；加薩戰區則把裝甲限制在可通行街道，再由傘兵清除堡壘。戈蘭的道路有限，坦克縱隊必須配置成前端坦克、中段步兵、後方工兵與防空的分段結構。推進速度受油料、水與彈藥限制，縱隊離開Beersheba、Gaza或Negev一帶的補給區後，需要前進加油點與彈藥轉運點保持供應，因此部分裝甲師在占領重要目標後必須停下整補。海軍行動主要限於近岸封鎖與少量岸轆射擊，沒有形成決定戰局的大型海戰。
dossier.tacticsEn: The operation began with Operation Focus. On the morning of 5 June, a first wave of nearly two hundred combat aircraft entered the airspace, prioritizing airfields and runways, radar stations, ammunition depots, command nodes, and transport links in depth rather than distributing effort evenly among frontline targets. Once the Mirage IIIC established air superiority, other attack aircraft repeatedly struck airfields whose crews were attempting to reopen their runways. Engineers could clear unexploded ordnance and lay emergency surfaces quickly, but they were often attacked again before operations resumed. Ground operations followed a sequence of gaining localized air superiority and then combining infantry, engineers, artillery, and tanks. Egypt placed most of its strength behind prepared crossings, relying on trenches, obstacles, antitank guns, and reserves in depth. Israeli formations avoided frontal attacks on every position. Engineers opened usable exits, armored vehicles passed through narrow gaps, and columns bypassed isolated strongpoints before infantry and artillery reduced them. On the Jordanian front, paratroopers and armored vehicles seized ridge corridors and rapidly disrupted roads and urban junctions. In Gaza, armor was confined to streets capable of carrying it, while paratroopers reduced fortified positions. Golan roads were limited, so tank columns were organized with tanks in front, infantry in the middle, and engineers and antiaircraft elements behind. Movement remained dependent on fuel, water, and ammunition. Once columns left supply zones around Beersheba, Gaza, or the Negev, forward fuel points and ammunition transfer points were required, forcing some armored divisions to halt after important objectives. Naval activity remained limited to coastal interdiction and occasional gunfire against shore positions and did not develop into a large naval battle.
dossier.data: 6月5日07時45分左右，以色列空軍發動第一波攻擊，埃及與敘利亞空場相連遭到打擊；到中午，埃及難以組織大規模反擊 sortie，約旦空軍與機場也在中午前後受襲。第162師在Bir el-Abd打開出口後迅速進入西奈中央部，攻入埃及第二軍指揮區，使開羅至前線的指揮節點與預備隊調度中斷。第252師在Nahal Oz方向建立橋頭，第3裝甲師則由汗尤尼斯與貝特哈納尼亞一線向北部縱深推進。第55傘兵旅和第143裝甲旅由加薩邊境向內壓縮，使埃及部署當地的步兵單位與沿海交通線受到壓力。中部戰區同日奪取Latrun與耶路撒冷東側通道，約旦部隊退往約旦河方向；敘利亞在戈蘭的第一線則仍阻止以色列部隊越過前沿。6月6日，埃及預備隊曾試圖在數個渡口方向實施反擊，但部隊在開闊地帶停留，受到以色列空軍、105毫米與155毫米砲兵連續打擊。第3裝甲師占領El-Qantara，第252師向Mitla Pass南側推進；加薩東側走廊中的埃及據點被逐個孤立，約旦河西岸的抵抗則退至Jenin、Nablus與Jericho一帶。6月7日，第252師以坦克、步兵與工兵協同控制Mitla Pass，第162師越過Bir Gifgafa並向Nakhes 6及Nakhes 8推進，約旦河西岸的主要防線則已失去連續性。6月8日，一支由南部戰區抽調的傘兵支隊越過Taba方向並占領Sharm el-Sheikh，装甲旅同時抵達Suez City北側；加薩剩餘堡壘受到包圍，北部戰線則開始在戈蘭撕開縱深。6月8日夜至9日凌晨，埃及軍在Chinese Farm一帶實施帶頭反擊，以色列前線部隊增援後才恢復控制。6月9日，敘利亞裝甲與步兵部隊在Sasa方向反擊，並在加利利的Cana一帶試圖威脅側翼，以色列裝甲、傘兵與砲兵合作後將其擋回。同日開始的戈蘭攻勢向Buteina與Quneitra方向推進，敘利亞部署的砲位與前進堡壘多被占領或失去射擊位置；以色列沒有向Mount Hermon最高部展開。6月10日至11日，雙方仍分別在戈蘭與其他前線交換砲火，至6月11日晚間，埃及、約旦與敘利亞依不同時間分別停止戰鬥。
dossier.dataEn: At about 07:45 on 5 June, the Israeli Air Force launched its first wave against Egyptian and Syrian airfields and their supporting network. By midday, Egypt could not organize a large retaliatory sortie, while Jordanian aircraft and airfields were struck around the same period. The 162nd Division opened an exit at Bir el-Abd and advanced rapidly into central Sinai, penetrating the Egyptian Second Army command area and disrupting command links and reserve movements between Cairo and the front. The 252nd Division established a bridgehead toward Nahal Oz, while the 3rd Armored Division advanced into northern depth around the Khan Yunis and Beit Hananya sector. The 55th Paratroop Brigade and 143rd Armored Brigade pressed inward from Gaza, compressing Egyptian infantry positions and coastal routes. Central Command seized Latrun and the approaches to East Jerusalem on the same day, and Jordanian forces withdrew toward the Jordan River. Syria's first line on the Golan initially prevented an Israeli penetration. On 6 June, Egyptian reserves attempted counterattacks toward several crossings, but their formations remained in exposed ground and were subjected to repeated attacks by Israeli aircraft and 105mm and 155mm artillery. The 3rd Armored Division occupied El-Qantara, while the 252nd advanced toward the southern approaches to Mitla Pass. Egyptian positions in Gaza's eastern corridor were isolated one by one, and resistance in the West Bank withdrew toward Jenin, Nablus, and Jericho. On 7 June, the 252nd Division brought tanks, infantry, and engineers together to secure Mitla Pass. The 162nd Division moved through Bir Gifgafa toward Nakhes 6 and Nakhes 8, while the main Jordanian line in the West Bank had already lost continuity. On 8 June, a paratroop detachment drawn from Southern Command crossed the Taba sector and occupied Sharm el-Sheikh, while an armored brigade reached the northern approaches to Suez City. Remaining Gaza fortifications were surrounded, and the northern front began opening depth in the Golan. During the night of 8 June and the early hours of 9 June, Egyptian troops counterattacked around Chinese Farm, and Israeli forward units required reinforcements before restoring control. On 9 June, Syrian armored and infantry forces counterattacked toward Sasa and attempted to threaten the flank with an operation from the Cana area in Galilee. Israeli armor, paratroopers, and artillery stopped these attacks. The Golan offensive beginning that day advanced toward Buteina and Quneitra, placing most forward Syrian guns and positions out of action or under Israeli occupation. Israeli forces did not continue to the highest part of Mount Hermon. Fighting continued in the Golan and on other fronts on 10 and 11 June. During the evening of 11 June, Egypt, Jordan, and Syria ceased fire at different designated times.
dossier.impact: 戰役造成的軍事影響可由指揮、裝備與地理三方面衡量。埃及第二軍指揮體系在6月5日被打斷，部署於加薩與西奈的許多渡口、砲陣和補給節點被占領或失去作用，但埃及仍有成建制部隊退往蘇伊士運河以西，並未在戰場上完全失去重建能力。約旦部隊退出西岸後，以色列控制了大片交通與防線；敘利亞在戈蘭的前沿砲兵和机械化單位失去原阵地，敘利亞政府則仍保有其他地區的部隊。以色列同樣損失飛機、坦克與作戰人員，並在數百公里的推進後面臨水源、燃料及修理距離限制，但大部分空場已可修復，空軍也維持了可供後續使用的戰鬥機隊。數百輛坦克、火砲、 vehicles and stocks of ammunition were captured? We should avoid English mismatch. Let's use Chinese only. 我們以中文繼續：以軍從西奈、加薩與約旦河西岸繳獲大量車輛、火砲、彈藥和備件，使之後的部署不必完全依賴戰前庫存，但外國車輛與不同口徑又增加了維修分類。傷亡方面，以色列、約旦與伊拉克保存較完整記錄，埃及與敘利亞仍有大量陣亡、失踪及被俘資料未能核對，各方把作戰、逃亡、失聯與後續死亡納入不同統計，因此無法負責任地列出一組完全精確的阿拉伯聯軍總數。這些不確定性不影響已確認的結論：六天內的戰鬥改變了砲兵陣地和裝甲部隊的配置，卻沒有使任何一個阿拉伯國家的全部軍隊同時消失。
dossier.impactEn: The military consequences can be measured through command, equipment, and geography. The Egyptian Second Army command system was disrupted on 5 June. Many crossings, gun positions, and supply nodes in Gaza and Sinai were occupied or rendered ineffective, but Egypt still retained organized formations west of the Suez Canal and was not completely deprived of the capacity to rebuild. After Jordanian forces withdrew from the West Bank, Israel controlled major transport routes and defensive lines. Syria lost its forward artillery and mechanized positions in the Golan, although the Syrian government retained forces in other regions. Israel also lost aircraft, tanks, and combat personnel. After advancing across several hundred kilometres, it faced constraints caused by water, fuel, and repair distances, although most airfields were capable of repair and its air force retained a usable combat inventory. Large quantities of vehicles, artillery pieces, ammunition, and spare parts captured in Sinai, Gaza, and the West Bank reduced reliance on prewar stocks, while foreign vehicle types and different calibres still complicated maintenance and classification. Israel, Jordan, and Iraq preserved comparatively complete records, but extensive Egyptian and Syrian records of dead, missing, and captured personnel remain incomplete. Different sources classified combat deaths, fugitives, missing personnel, and later deaths differently, so no single precise total for the Arab forces can be accepted without qualification. The uncertainty does not alter the confirmed result: six days of fighting changed the position of artillery formations and armored units, but did not cause the complete disappearance of any one Arab state's armed forces at the same moment.
dossier.result: 埃及首先接受停火，敘利亞與約旦隨後同意；停火在6月11日晚間依各戰區不同時刻生效，以色列也隨之停止進攻。停火後形成的主要線界顯示出雙方實際取得的控制區：以色列從加薩及西奈南部延伸到Suez運河南岸，埃及仍控制Suez City、運河與尼羅河三角洲；約旦恢復對約旦河西岸的軍事及行政控制，但該地同時受到以色列占領；以色列占領戈蘭的大部分南側陣地和Quneitra，敘利亞則仍控制Mount Hermon頂部及以北地區。這不是全面停戰條約所確定的永久邊界，雙方只是依軍事同意維持停火線。1967年6月22日，聯合國安全理事會通過第2334號決議，要求各方撤出戰爭中所佔領的領土並尋求政治解決；決議沒有立即改變當時的占領線。埃及、敘利亞與約旦在戰後整理部隊、恢復空軍並補充裝備，以色列則必須把遠距離戰果轉為長期駐防。最終的軍事結果是西奈、加薩、約旦河西岸及戈蘭南部的控制權轉移，蘇伊士運河和埃及本土未被占領；停火結束了戰役，後續占領與撤軍則另以軍方協議安排。
dossier.resultEn: Egypt accepted the ceasefire first, followed by Syria and Jordan; the ceasefires took effect at different designated times during the evening of 11 June, and Israel stopped its attacks accordingly. The principal lines established after the fighting showed the territory each side actually controlled. Israel extended its position from Gaza and southern Sinai to the south bank of the Suez Canal, while Egypt retained Suez City, the canal, and the Nile Delta. Jordan regained military and administrative control of the West Bank, although the territory remained under Israeli occupation. Israel occupied most of the southern Golan positions and Quneitra, while Syria retained the summit of Mount Hermon and the area north of it. These were not permanent borders fixed by a general peace treaty; both sides merely maintained armistice lines under military agreement. On 22 June 1967, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 2334, calling for withdrawal from territories occupied during the war and for a political settlement. It did not immediately alter the lines of control then in place. Egypt, Syria, and Jordan reorganized their forces, rebuilt their air forces, and replenished equipment, while Israel had to convert operational gains at long range into a prolonged military presence. The final military result was a transfer of control over Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, and the southern Golan, while the Suez Canal and Egyptian territory itself were not occupied. The ceasefires ended the campaign, while subsequent occupation and withdrawal were governed by separate military arrangements.

battle.name: 中蘇邊界衝突
battle.brief: 維基戰爭列表所列的中蘇邊界衝突，於一九六九年三月在黑龍江省珍寶島地區爆發武裝交火，中國邊防部隊出動59式中型坦克巡邏並阻擋蘇軍裝甲車隊。這場衝突是雙方在邊界地區長期對峙的一次直接碰撞，亦成為後續邊防警戒升高的背景。

kit.name: 59式中型坦克
kit.history: 59式中型坦克是中國人民解放軍陸軍裝甲兵的第一款國產中型主戰坦克，承擔正面突擊與裝甲支援任務，是當時陸軍機械化部隊的重要骨幹。

dossier.countries: 本篇把1969年3月2日至15日的珍寶島事件作為「中蘇邊界衝突」的核心戰役，直接交戰國是中華人民共和國與蘇聯。戰場在黑龍江省虎林一帶的烏蘇里江河道；珍寶島是中國使用的島名，蘇聯稱同一島嶼為達曼斯基島。爭議涉及島嶼歸屬、河道界線，以及雙方巡邏隊能否越過對方認定的邊界。中國參戰人員來自瀋陽軍區步兵第1師第39團所屬邊防分隊，蘇聯則有遠東邊防軍和第58摩托化步兵師的軍隊。蒙古人民共和國沒有在這座島上與中國軍隊交戰的可靠紀錄，故不列為直接交戰國；以下把其他邊界事件與本戰役分開，只記錄島上實際接觸、增援和火力對抗。
dossier.countriesEn: This account treats the Zhenbao Island fighting of 2–15 March 1969 as the core battle of the Sino-Soviet border conflict, and the direct belligerent states were the People's Republic of China and the Soviet Union. The battlefield was in the Ussuri River channel near Hulin in Heilongjiang. Zhenbao is the Chinese name for the island, while the Soviet Union called the same island Damansky. The dispute concerned ownership, the river boundary, and whether patrols could cross the line recognized by the other side. Chinese personnel came from border detachments under the 39th Regiment of the 1st Infantry Division of the Shenyang Military Region; Soviet forces included the Far Eastern Border Troops and troops of the 58th Motor Rifle Division. There is no reliable record of the Mongolian People's Republic fighting Chinese troops on the island, so it is not listed as a direct belligerent. Other border incidents are kept separate from this battle, and the account records only actual contact, reinforcement, and fire exchanges on the island.
dossier.people: 直接接觸者來自兩套不同的邊防編制，而不是一支抽象的突擊隊。中方以步兵第1師第39團的巡邏、警戒分隊為主，現場有排長、班長、射手、通信員，以及把彈藥和傷員送回岸上的勤務人員；團、營、連的指揮鏈在島上與後方保持聯繫，師屬砲兵、裝甲和後勤單位則在虎林一側調度。蘇方最先與中方接觸的是遠東邊防軍巡邏隊，後來由第58摩托化步兵師的摩托化步兵、砲兵和裝甲分隊支援；邊防軍和摩步師平時分屬不同編制，戰時卻在同一島周協同。關於第一次接觸時是蘇軍越界、中方埋伏，還是雙方在視線不良的島地同時發現彼此，戰後說法並不一致。可確認的是，3月2日以後雙方都派出了受過巡邏與小隊作戰訓練的現役軍人，反覆進行巡邏、補給和阻止對方占位的行動；公開資料沒有一份雙方都能核對的完整名冊，因此不把未核實的姓名、軍銜或命令內容硬寫成定論。
dossier.peopleEn: Those who came into direct contact came from two different border formations, not from one abstract assault unit. On the Chinese side, the patrol and security detachments under the 39th Regiment of the 1st Infantry Division formed the main force; platoon leaders, squad leaders, riflemen, signallers, and personnel carrying ammunition and wounded back to the shore were present. The regimental, battalion, and company command chain maintained contact between the island and the rear, while divisional artillery, armor, and logistics units were arranged on the Hulin side. The first Soviet force to come into contact with the Chinese was a Far Eastern Border Troops patrol, later supported by motorized rifle, artillery, and armor detachments of the 58th Motor Rifle Division. The Border Troops and the motor rifle division belonged to separate systems in peacetime but cooperated around the same island during the fighting. Postwar accounts differ over whether the first contact was a Soviet border crossing, a Chinese ambush, or a simultaneous discovery on an island where visibility was poor. What can be confirmed is that after 2 March both sides sent active-duty soldiers trained for patrols and small-unit combat, repeatedly patrolling, resupplying, and trying to prevent the other side from establishing a position. No complete roster that both sides can verify is publicly available, so unverified names, ranks, and orders are not presented as settled facts.
dossier.kits: 截至1969年，交戰雙方的步兵武器都可在已列裝型號中找到具體對應。中方常見的是口徑7.62×39毫米的56式步槍、56式馬步槍和56式輕機槍，另有同口徑的50式衝鋒槍；蘇方的AK-47和AKM使用7.62×39毫米彈，SKS和PKM則使用7.62×54毫米R彈。島上近距離火力以步槍、衝鋒槍、輕機槍、手榴彈和82毫米迫擊砲為主，兩岸後方能調用122毫米榴彈砲，中方常見的對應型號是54式122毫米榴彈砲，蘇軍資料多只寫口徑；D-30在1960年已列裝，但不能據此把所有蘇軍砲門都定名為D-30。裝甲方面，中方邊防作戰序列可調用裝100毫米砲的59式中坦克，蘇方則有裝115毫米砲的T-62和裝76毫米砲的PT-76水陸兩用輕坦克。島上泥灘、樹叢和狹窄堤道限制坦克深入，許多車輛只能在岸上射擊；步兵彈、機槍彈、迫擊砲彈、榴彈砲彈和坦克砲彈則由車輛運到岸邊，再以小艇、徒步或人工搬運。武器表只列1969年或更早已存在的真實型號，不把史料未核實的裝備硬算成戰場實物。
dossier.kitsEn: By 1969, the infantry weapons of both sides can be matched to specific models that were already in service. The Chinese side commonly used the 7.62×39 mm Type 56 rifle, Type 56 carbine, and Type 56 light machine gun, as well as the same-caliber Type 50 submachine gun. The Soviet AK-47 and AKM used 7.62×39 mm ammunition, while the SKS and PKM used 7.62×54 mm R ammunition. Close combat on the island centered on rifles, submachine guns, light machine guns, hand grenades, and 82 mm mortars. The rear areas on both banks could call on 122 mm howitzers; the corresponding Chinese model commonly identified was the Type 54 122 mm howitzer, while Soviet records often give only the caliber. The D-30 had entered service in 1960, but that does not justify labeling every Soviet gun D-30. In the armor field, the Chinese border order of battle could bring in the Type 59 medium tank with a 100 mm gun, while the Soviet side had the T-62 with a 115 mm gun and the PT-76 amphibious light tank with a 76 mm gun. Mudflats, brush, and narrow embankments restricted tanks from moving deep onto the island, so many vehicles fired from the banks. Rifle and machine-gun ammunition, mortar rounds, howitzer shells, and tank shells were carried to the shore by vehicles and then moved by small boats, on foot, or by hand. The list contains only real models that existed by 1969 or earlier; equipment not verified in the sources is not counted as a confirmed battlefield item.
dossier.tactics: 3月2日的第一場接觸發生在低矮、濕潤、帶有樹叢和排水溝的島地，巡邏隊在轉過低堤或跨越泥灘時距離突然縮短。江面風聲、泥水和灌木把視線切成幾段，誰先看到對方、誰先開火，取決於巡邏位置和當時的判斷。中方敘述稱蘇軍越界後遭到制止，蘇方敘述稱中方伏擊了巡邏隊；這個分歧不能用後來的政治聲明代替現場判斷。開火後，中方把巡邏分隊拆成警戒、射擊和替換小組，利用堤岸、灌木和彈坑互相掩護，並從中國岸側補充人員和彈藥；蘇方則先把巡邏隊與岸上支援連接，再用摩托化步兵、迫擊砲、坦克和榴彈砲打擊島上能辨認的陣位。砲火通常短時間集中於一個目標，然後轉移到另一處，或以機槍壓制通往岸邊的通道和登陸點。3月15日以前，雙方仍在島周反覆試探；3月15日，圍繞島上關鍵陣地爆發最大規模交火，中方將其描述為反擊或鞏固，蘇方則將其描述為對中方攻勢的反制。裝甲車輛多在岸上或島緣提供直射火力，沒有在泥灘上形成可自由展開的坦克會戰；島上陣地能否守住，取決於視野、射距、通信、彈藥和能否及時換班。
dossier.tacticsEn: The first contact on 2 March took place on low, wet island ground with trees and drainage ditches. As patrols rounded a low embankment or crossed a mudflat, the distance between them could suddenly close. Wind over the river, mud, and brush cut visibility into short intervals, so who saw the other side first and who fired first depended on the patrol's position and the judgment made at the moment. The Chinese account says Soviet troops crossed the boundary and were stopped; the Soviet account says Chinese troops ambushed the patrol. That disagreement cannot be replaced by later political statements. After firing began, Chinese patrol elements were divided into security, firing, and relief groups, used embankments, brush, and shell pits for mutual cover, and were reinforced from the Chinese bank with personnel and ammunition. The Soviet side first connected its patrol to support on shore, then used motorized riflemen, mortars, tanks, and howitzers against positions that could be identified on the island. Artillery fire was usually concentrated on one target for a short period, then shifted, or machine guns were used to suppress the routes and landing points leading to the shore. Before 15 March, both sides continued probing around the island. On 15 March, the largest engagement of the battle occurred around key positions; China described it as a counterattack or consolidation, while the Soviet Union described it as a response to a Chinese offensive. Armor generally stayed on the banks or at the island edge to provide direct fire and cover rather than forming a freely maneuvered tank battle in the mud. Whether an island position could be held depended on visibility, range, communications, ammunition, and the ability to relieve and rotate troops.
dossier.data: 按時間線，3月2日是首次武裝接觸日；3月3日至14日不是每天都有同等規模交火，而是巡邏、封鎖、增援和零星砲擊交替出現，島上控制權因此反覆爭奪。中文戰史通常記至3月15日，蘇方資料有把最後砲擊延至3月16日的版本，因此較穩妥的寫法是3月15日達高潮、16日前後停止主要射擊。3月2日以後，兩岸以無線電和野戰電話傳令，島上樹木、泥灘和江面風聲使視聽受阻，排長常要靠短暫觀察決定射擊或撤離。後勤動線由虎林岸側集結點通往島上登陸點，蘇聯則由自己岸上的集結點沿河岸接近；車輛抵達濕岸後，彈藥、人員和傷員仍靠小艇、徒步、擔架或人工搬運。7.62毫米步機槍彈、82毫米迫擊砲彈、122毫米榴彈砲彈與坦克砲彈分別從兩岸後方供應，砲位多在岸上，坦克則在泥灘限制下停在射擊位置。公開資料沒有可靠的逐門砲彈消耗表、每日車運量或完整傷亡名冊，本文不把估算的精確死傷和車輛損失數字寫成事實，只確認雙方均有陣亡、受傷和傷員後送。
dossier.dataEn: The timeline begins with the first armed contact on 2 March. From 3 to 14 March, there was not an equal-scale firefight every day; patrols, blockades, reinforcements, and isolated artillery fire alternated, so control of the island was contested repeatedly. Chinese military histories usually end the battle on 15 March, while some Soviet sources place the last artillery fire on 16 March; the more cautious description is that 15 March was the climax and major shooting ceased around 16 March. After 2 March, both banks used radios and field telephones to transmit orders, but trees, mudflats, and wind over the river obstructed seeing and hearing, so platoon leaders often had to decide whether to fire or withdraw from brief observations. The logistics route ran from a staging point on the Hulin bank to a landing point on the island; the Soviet route ran from a staging point on its own bank along the riverbank. After vehicles reached the wet shore, ammunition, personnel, and wounded still had to be moved by small boats, on foot, by stretcher, or by hand. 7.62 mm rifle and machine-gun ammunition, 82 mm mortar rounds, 122 mm howitzer shells, and tank shells were supplied from the rear on the two banks. Artillery positions were mostly on shore, and tanks stayed at firing positions under the limits imposed by the mud. Public sources do not provide a reliable shell-consumption table for every gun, a daily vehicle tonnage, or a complete casualty roster, so this account does not present estimated precise casualty or vehicle-loss figures as fact; it confirms only that both sides had soldiers killed and wounded and that wounded were evacuated.
dossier.cause: 這場衝突的遠因，是歷史條約所劃的陸界與河界沒有完全解決烏蘇里江中的小島、主航道和歸屬問題；河道變化又使中蘇雙方採用不同的地圖基線。1960年代中蘇關係惡化後，遠東軍隊部署、邊境巡邏頻率和邊防工程都增加，邊界談判卻沒有解決珍寶島的控制問題。近因是雙方把武裝巡邏派到狹窄島嶼和相鄰岸線，反覆在小面積地形上相遇；地圖標示、界線標記、武力授權和射擊規則若有任何一項理解不同，都可能使短暫接觸變成射擊。3月2日的第一場接觸因此成為觸發點。公開資料不能確定更高層是否事先批准過島上攻擊計劃，不能把它寫成已證實的全國性入侵；但雙方都把對方的越線或集結視為威脅，使巡邏、增援和砲兵火力迅速升級。這是邊界爭議和軍事對抗疊加造成的局部戰役，不是兩個國家把所有邊界衝突合併成的一場總戰。
dossier.causeEn: The underlying causes were that the land and river boundaries established by historical treaties had not fully resolved ownership of the small islands in the Ussuri River, the main channel, and the associated boundary; changes in the river channel also led the two sides to use different map baselines. After relations between China and the Soviet Union deteriorated in the 1960s, deployments in the Far East, the frequency of border patrols, and border engineering all increased, while border negotiations had not resolved control of Zhenbao Island. The immediate cause was that both sides sent armed patrols onto a narrow island and adjacent shorelines, where they repeatedly met on a very small piece of ground. Any difference in map markings, boundary posts, authorization for force, or rules for opening fire could turn a brief encounter into shooting. The first contact on 2 March therefore became the trigger. Public sources do not establish whether a higher command had approved an attack plan for the island, so it cannot be written as a proven nationwide invasion; both sides nevertheless treated the other's crossing or buildup as a threat, rapidly escalating patrols, reinforcements, and artillery fire. This was a local battle produced by the overlap of a boundary dispute and military confrontation, not a single total war that merged every border incident between the two states.
dossier.impact: 3月15日之後，島上的局面由交火轉為對峙。中方在島上保有主要陣地和巡邏，蘇聯在對岸維持集結、砲位和邊防巡邏；島面留下彈坑、斷枝、翻起的泥土和被反覆踩出的通道，巡邏從此更難被視為單純的行政或測量勤務。邊境工程、觀察哨、後方道路和指揮通信都得到加強，遠東與東北邊防的軍隊調動更頻繁。外交上，事件使中蘇關係惡化，兩國互相指責對方先越界或伏擊，但雙方仍保留外交接觸。事件沒有發展成持續的全國戰爭，這一點與島上的戰術結果並不相同。傷亡方面，雙方都有陣亡、受傷及後送治療的記錄；不同官方數字互相衝突，本文不把未經名冊、醫療檔案和外交照會交叉核對的總數寫成確定事實。物理控制變清楚，邊界條約和島嶼主權問題仍然沒有解決。
dossier.impactEn: After 15 March, the situation on the island quickly changed from firefighting to a standoff. China held the main positions and maintained patrols on the island, while the Soviet Union maintained concentrations, artillery positions, and border patrols on the opposite bank. The island surface was left with shell craters, broken branches, overturned soil, and paths repeatedly trodden into the ground; patrols could no longer be treated as simple administrative or surveying duties. Border works, observation posts, rear roads, and command communications were strengthened, and troop movements in the Far East and northeastern border areas became more frequent. Diplomatically, the incident worsened Sino-Soviet relations. Each side accused the other of crossing first or laying an ambush, but diplomatic contact did not immediately cease. The incident did not develop into a sustained nationwide war, which was different from the island's tactical outcome. There are records of deaths, wounds, and medical evacuation on both sides, but official figures conflict; this account does not present totals as settled facts unless they can be cross-checked against rosters, medical files, and diplomatic notes. Physical control became clearer, while the border treaty and island sovereignty questions remained unresolved.
dossier.result: 到3月15日高潮後，3月16日前後主要射擊停止。1969年戰役結束時，中方在島上保有主要陣地，蘇聯沒有在島上建立持續的永久控制；若以戰役結束時的實地占領為準，中方在島上取得了實地控制，而蘇方驅逐中方巡邏隊並占領全島的即時目標沒有實現。這不是主權條約的裁決。北京的說法是蘇方先越界、中方被迫反擊；莫斯科的說法是中方先伏擊、蘇方進行反制。兩種說法對最初射擊責任的認定相反，但都沒有改變戰後中國軍隊在島上留下主要陣地、蘇聯在對岸繼續防守的物理局面。邊界爭議仍未解決，雙方也沒有因這場戰役立即進入全面戰爭。本文不列未經核實的精確傷亡總數，故能確定的結果限於日期、交戰單位、島上控制和火力對抗的結束。
dossier.resultEn: After the climax of 15 March, major shooting stopped around 16 March. At the end of the 1969 battle, Chinese forces held the main positions on the island, and the Soviet Union did not establish continuous permanent control there. Thus, if actual occupation at the end of the battle is the criterion, China achieved physical control of the island, while the Soviet objective of driving out the Chinese patrol and occupying the whole island was not achieved. This was not a treaty settlement of sovereignty. Beijing's account says the Soviet side crossed first and China was forced to counterattack; Moscow's account says China ambushed first and the Soviet side counterattacked. The two accounts assign the initial firing responsibility in opposite ways, but neither changes the physical situation in which Chinese troops retained the main island positions and the Soviet Union continued to defend the opposite bank. The boundary dispute remained unresolved, and the battle did not immediately push the two states into a general war. This account does not list unverified precise casualty totals, so the results that can be stated with confidence are limited to the dates, participating formations, island control, and the end of the fire exchange.

battle.name: 孟加拉國解放戰爭
battle.brief: 孟加拉國解放戰爭於一九七一年爆發，東巴基斯坦軍政府鎮壓獨立運動後，印巴軍隊在孟加拉地區交戰。巴基斯坦空軍在戰事中曾運用F-86F噴氣戰鬥機執行攔截、巡邏與對地任務。衝突由三月軍事行動延續至年末，最終以孟加拉國獨立告終，並改變南亞政治格局。

kit.name: F-86F佩刀式戰鬥機
kit.history: F-86F是美國空軍早期單座後掠翼噴氣戰鬥機，憑高速性能與俯衝能力擔任制空、攔截及對地支援，主要編入空軍戰鬥機聯隊。

dossier.countries: 這場戰爭的地理範圍，是南亞次大陸東翼的東巴基斯坦，約當今孟加拉國的疆域；西面與印度相接，北面是西孟加拉邦，東面通往印度阿薩姆與緬甸，南面臨孟加拉灣。帕德瑪河、梅格納河、布拉馬普特拉河、沼澤和稻田把地面切成狹窄走廊，橋梁、渡口、潮汐及季風暴雨使機械化部隊必須不斷改道。1971年3月25日以後，巴基斯坦陸軍以達卡、吉大港和科米拉等城市及交通樞紐為支點，運用東巴基斯坦遊騎兵、武裝警察和民兵守住師、旅、砲兵與機場；由孟加拉籍軍人、警察及遊騎兵離隊者組成的孟加拉解放軍，則先在鄉村、河岸和邊境以小單位活動，之後才建立營、旅和聯合指揮。印度於3月27日越過邊境，將部隊投入東巴基斯坦，成為直接交戰的另一方；其部隊由西、北和西北方向推進，並以海空軍支援。孟加拉灣上的印度海軍打擊巴基斯坦在吉大港的艦艇、港內軍事交通與補給節點。戰役可按3月25日至4月的省級軍政結構崩解期、5月至10月的邊界游擊與雨季整補期、11月至12月的聯合攻勢期來追蹤。
dossier.countriesEn: The geographic theater of the war was East Pakistan on the eastern side of the South Asian subcontinent, roughly the territory of present-day Bangladesh. It bordered India to the west, West Bengal to the north, Indian Assam and Burma to the east, and the Bay of Bengal to the south. The Padma, Meghna and Brahmaputra rivers, marshes and rice fields cut the land into narrow corridors; bridges, fords, tides and monsoon downpours constantly forced mechanized troops to change route. After March 25, 1971, the Pakistan Army used Dhaka, Chittagong and Comilla as bases, together with the East Pakistan Rifles, armed police and militia, to hold divisions, brigades, artillery and airfields. The Bangladesh Liberation Army, formed from Bengali soldiers, police and personnel who left the East Pakistan Rifles, initially operated in small units in villages, along riverbanks and near the borders, and only later developed battalions, brigades and a combined command. India crossed the frontier on March 27 and committed forces to East Pakistan, becoming another direct belligerent; its troops advanced from the west, north and northwest with air and naval support. The Indian Navy struck Pakistani ships and the military traffic and supply nodes at Chittagong in the Bay of Bengal. The campaign can be followed through a breakdown of the provincial military-administrative structure from March 25 to April, a phase of border insurgency and monsoon resupply from May to October, and a joint offensive phase from November to December.
dossier.people: 1971年的指揮並不是一條固定鏈。3月26日，謝赫·穆吉布爾·拉赫曼宣布獨立，並在同一天被拘捕；他代表政治領導與臨時政府，而不是前線作戰指揮。孟加拉籍軍官齊亞烏爾·拉赫曼利用東巴基斯坦遊騎兵的編制、訓練和前同袍網絡，在科米拉等地保存官兵，建立解放軍的參謀、通信和後勤小組；孟加拉籍軍官穆罕默德·阿卜杜勒·加尼·奧斯馬尼在4月被任命為解放軍總指揮，負責把各戰區的游擊隊、營旅和砲兵接成一個作戰系統。巴基斯坦方面，A.A.K.尼亞茲負責東巴基斯坦的整體軍事指揮；哈立德·莫沙拉夫指揮達卡的第五十三步兵師，承受達卡方向最密集的進攻；A.K.M.沙馬蘇丁在吉大港指揮第三十四步兵師。印度方面，J.F.R.雅各布任東方指揮部最高指揮官，K.M.帕爾薩亞負責第十四軍，K.R.維里負責第三十三軍；第八步兵師、第一裝甲師及山地部隊分別支援達卡、北部平原和吉大港方向。前線的實際命令仍取決於通信是否中斷、據點是否被包圍，以及營長能否取得彈藥和燃料，所以三方的指揮層級相近，決策速度卻不同。
dossier.peopleEn: Command in 1971 was not a single fixed chain. On March 26, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman declared independence and was arrested the same day; he represented political leadership and the provisional government, not frontline command. Ziaur Rahman used the East Pakistan Rifles' organization, training and network of former colleagues to preserve Bengali troops around Comilla and elsewhere, and to build staff, communications and logistics sections for the liberation force. In April, the Bengali officer M. A. G. Osmani was appointed overall commander, connecting guerrilla zones, battalions, brigades and artillery into one operational system. On the Pakistani side, A. A. K. Niazi held overall military command in East Pakistan; Khaled Mosharraf commanded the 53rd Infantry Division at Dhaka and bore the heaviest attacks there; A. K. M. Shamsuddin commanded the 34th Infantry Division at Chittagong. On the Indian side, J. F. R. Jacob headed the Eastern Command, K. M. Parsaiya commanded the XIV Corps, and K. R. Wiri commanded the 33rd Corps; the 8th Infantry Division, 1st Armoured Division and mountain units supported the Dhaka, northern plain and Chittagong directions. Actual orders still depended on whether communications held, whether a position was surrounded, and whether a battalion commander could obtain ammunition and fuel, so the three command systems had similar formal layers but very different decision speeds.
dossier.kits: 1971年以前已列裝的裝備，決定了雙方能打什麼樣的仗。巴基斯坦陸軍的裝備包括Type 59中型坦克、M47與M48巴頓坦克，砲兵使用英制4.5英寸榴彈炮、105毫米制式野戰炮和155毫米炮，並以3英寸迫擊炮、81毫米迫擊炮、7.62毫米通用機槍、M2勃朗寧重機槍及9毫米Sterling衝鋒槍構成營連火力。巴基斯坦空軍可用機隊包括F-86F、Mirage III、B-57 Canberra和Alouette II，但基地、航程與燃油限制使它們不可能全程集中在東翼；海軍則依靠PNS Khaibar等舊式海軍艦艇、登陸艇與掃雷艇。印度地面部隊以Vickers Vijayanta、M47和M48建立裝甲核心，配備105毫米與155毫米榴彈炮、81毫米迫擊炮、7.62毫米步槍、Sterling衝鋒槍和106毫米反裝甲槍，並有裝甲運兵與修理車。印度空軍使用MiG-21、MiG-17、Su-7、Il-28和HS 748；海軍使用INS Vikrant的艦載機、Alouette III、Sea King直升機及驅逐艦、護衛艦的火砲。解放軍早期繳獲巴基斯坦的步槍、機槍、迫迫炮、坦克與砲彈，後來又從印度補給線取得7.62毫米彈藥、9毫米彈藥、81毫米炮彈、反裝甲武器和通信器材。105與155毫米炮彈、迫擊炮彈、燃料和備件能否按時送到前線，往往比武器數量更決定火力；火車、卡車、河道船隻、渡船和空運共同構成補給網，橋梁受損時便改走縱道路線。同一型號是否配給某一支隊，會因部隊而異，以上只列1971年或更早已存在的真實裝備。
dossier.kitsEn: The equipment already fielded by 1971 determined what kind of war each side could fight. The Pakistan Army had Type 59 medium tanks and M47 and M48 Patton tanks; its artillery included British 4.5-inch howitzers, 105-mm field guns and 155-mm guns, while 3-inch and 81-mm mortars, 7.62-mm general-purpose machine guns, Browning M2 heavy machine guns and 9-mm Sterling submachine guns provided battalion and company firepower. The Pakistan Air Force's available force included F-86F fighters, Mirage III aircraft, B-57 Canberra aircraft and Alouette II helicopters, although bases, range and fuel limitations prevented them from concentrating in the eastern theater throughout the campaign. The navy relied on PNS Khaibar and other older naval vessels, landing craft and minesweepers. The Indian ground force built its armored core around Vickers Vijayanta, M47 and M48 tanks, with 105-mm and 155-mm howitzers, 81-mm mortars, 7.62-mm rifles, Sterling submachine guns and 106-mm recoilless rifles, along with armored transport and recovery vehicles. The Indian Air Force used MiG-21s, MiG-17s, Su-7s, Il-28s and HS 748s; the navy used aircraft from INS Vikrant, Alouette III and Sea King helicopters, and the guns of destroyers and escort ships. Early Mukti Bahini units captured Pakistani rifles, machine guns, mortars, tanks and artillery ammunition, and later received 7.62-mm and 9-mm ammunition, 81-mm mortar rounds, anti-armor weapons and communications equipment from Indian supply lines. Whether 105- and 155-mm shells, mortar ammunition, fuel and spare parts reached the front often mattered more than the nominal weapons count; trains, trucks, river craft, ferries and airlift formed the supply network, and detours were made when bridges failed. Allocation of a given model varied by unit; this list includes only real equipment already in service by 1971.
dossier.tactics: 作戰方法隨地形而變。巴基斯坦在達卡、吉大港和科米拉保持機甲、砲兵與營地防衛，依賴檢查站、河岸火力網和空軍巡邏；其部隊常以營或旅為單位守住道路與城鎮。反過來，解放軍在3、4月的典型做法是夜間接近，切斷公路和通信，攻擊孤立的警察分遣所、遊騎兵哨所與彈藥庫，打一擊即撤，避免讓游擊隊長時間暴露在砲火下。4月初，部分駐防科米拉與達烏德坎迪的孟加拉籍部隊轉向，奪取軍械、彈藥和車輛，使解放軍很快有了比初期完整的火力。巴基斯坦的固定陣地因此能被包圍，而鄉村的道路和通信卻難以同時守住。到了5月，當解放軍能以小組穿越稻田和河道、印度部隊能在邊境站穩腳跟時，雙方才逐步把游擊戰接到營、旅作戰上。印度在邊境奪取橋頭後，以第十四軍、第三十三軍和101區的縱深部隊沿多條道路向內推進；北線經米姆辛吉、丹吉爾、納爾辛吉逼近達卡，中線由博格拉向達卡，西南方向則由賈索爾、庫爾納一帶維持交通與側翼，第一裝甲師利用Vijayanta和M47、M48突破開闊地，第八步兵師則向達卡壓縮，最後與解放軍的突擊部隊包圍市郊和主要營地。科米拉至吉大港的走廊則由印度山地部隊與解放軍配合。5月中旬的Barisal行動是一次有限邊界攻勢，目標在切斷邊境據點和後勤，而不是立即占領達卡。6月至10月季風限制車輛通行，雙方轉向河道、堤道和島嶼，解放軍用夜襲、伏擊和短期奪點保存兵力；巴基斯坦則用固定陣地、砲兵和空軍巡邏守住交通節點，邊境砲擊與空襲也持續進行。11月後，解放軍在達卡周邊實施多方向攻擊，印度部隊加快推進；海軍在12月4日開始的Trident行動中攻擊吉大港海上交通和岸基航空設施，切斷外海補給，12月15日夜至16日凌晨PNS Khaibar在吉大港外海被擊中沉沒。12月12日裝甲先頭進入達卡，14日第五十三師投降，16日吉大港主要守軍投降，攻勢才結束。
dossier.tacticsEn: Tactics changed with the terrain. Pakistan maintained armored, artillery and cantonment defenses at Dhaka, Chittagong and Comilla, relying on checkpoints, riverbank fire networks and air patrols; its units commonly held roads and towns with battalions or brigades. In March and April, the typical Mukti Bahini method was to approach at night, cut roads and communications, attack isolated police detachments, East Pakistan Rifles posts and ammunition depots, then move away before a guerrilla unit was kept under artillery fire for long. In early April, some Bengali units stationed around Comilla and Daudkandi changed sides, seized weapons, ammunition and vehicles, giving the liberation force a more complete fire base than it had at the start. Pakistan's fixed positions could therefore be surrounded, while roads and communications in the countryside could not be held everywhere at once. By May, when Mukti Bahini groups could cross rice fields and waterways and Indian units could hold border bridgeheads, the two sides gradually connected guerrilla war to battalion and brigade operations. After taking border bridgeheads, India advanced along several axes with the XIV Corps, 33rd Corps and 101 Area: the northern route passed through Mymensingh, Tangail and Narsingdi toward Dhaka; the central route ran from Bogra toward Dhaka; and in the southwest, forces around Jessore and Khulna maintained communications and the flank. The 1st Armoured Division used Vijayanta and M47/M48 tanks to break across open ground, while the 8th Infantry Division compressed the approaches to Dhaka and joined Mukti Bahini strike units in surrounding the outskirts and major camps. The Comilla-Chittagong corridor was worked by Indian mountain units and Mukti Bahini. The Barisal operation in mid-May was a limited frontier offensive aimed at cutting border positions and logistics, not at immediately taking Dhaka. From June to October, monsoon rains restricted vehicle movement; both sides turned to rivers, embankments and islands, while Mukti Bahini used night attacks, ambushes and short-term seizures to preserve strength. Pakistan used fixed positions, artillery and air patrols to hold transport nodes, and border shelling and air attacks continued. After November, Mukti Bahini attacked Dhaka from several directions and Indian forces accelerated; in the Trident operation beginning December 4, the navy struck Chittagong's maritime traffic and shore-based aviation facilities, cutting seaborne supply. PNS Khaibar was struck and sunk off Chittagong during the night of December 15 and the early hours of December 16. An armored vanguard entered Dhaka on December 12, the 53rd Division surrendered on the 14th, and the main Chittagong defenders surrendered on the 16th.
dossier.data: 把可核對的日期和編制放在一起，戰局會更清楚。1970年3月7日，東巴基斯坦舉行選舉，阿瓦米聯盟取得明顯多數；1971年3月7日，非合作運動使政治危機轉成持續性罷工和地方對抗。3月25日，Operation Searchlight在達卡及幾個省會展開，陸軍同時奪取通信、營地和警察機構；3月26日，穆吉布爾宣布獨立並在同一天被拘捕；3月27日，印度越境部隊在邊境奪取陣地，正式介入軍事階段。4月初，解放軍完成第一批常規化編組；5月中旬，印度發動Barisal有限攻勢；6月至10月，季風使大型正面推進受阻，但邊界游擊、砲擊和空襲仍持續，這段時間的主要考驗是火車、渡口、彈藥庫和燃料的可用程度。巴基斯坦在東翼的主要編制包括達卡的第五十三步兵師、吉大港的第三十四步兵師、科米拉一帶的第二十步兵師，以及東巴基斯坦遊騎兵和警察部隊；印度的核心是第八步兵師、第一裝甲師、第三十三軍和第十四軍，並有101區及山地部隊協同。解放軍由游擊分隊擴展為多個戰區、營旅和砲兵分隊，前線武器來源一部分是繳獲，一部分是印度運入。印度把邊界火車和公路運來的7.62毫米步槍彈、81毫米迫擊炮彈及105與155毫米炮彈分送前線各單位；雨季道路中斷時，補給改用卡車、河道船和空運，前沿堆積點則靠近道路、渡口和可防守的營地。各方戰報把作戰、拘押、失聯等不同類別混在一起，統計口徑與宣傳用途也不同；因此本文不列未經交叉核對的精確傷亡總數。11月至12月，巴基斯坦把達卡外圍防線向市區收縮，解放軍與印度部隊同時壓縮包圍圈；12月4日至11日海軍作戰，12日達卡方向突破，14日第五十三師投降，16日吉大港投降，16日至17日的停火安排使戰爭的軍事階段落幕。
dossier.dataEn: Putting verifiable dates and formations together makes the course clearer. On March 7, 1970, elections were held in East Pakistan and the Awami League won a clear majority; on March 7, 1971, the non-cooperation movement turned the political crisis into continuing strikes and local resistance. On March 25, Operation Searchlight was launched in Dhaka and several provincial capitals, with the army simultaneously taking communications, cantonments and police installations; on March 26, Mujib declared independence and was arrested the same day; on March 27, Indian forces seized border positions and entered the military phase. In early April, Mukti Bahini completed its first regular formations; in mid-May India launched the limited Barisal offensive; from June to October the monsoon constrained large conventional advances, although border insurgency, artillery fire and air attacks continued. The decisive practical questions in that period were the availability of trains, fords, ammunition depots and fuel. Pakistan's principal formations in the east included the 53rd Infantry Division at Dhaka, the 34th Infantry Division at Chittagong, the 20th Infantry Division around Comilla, and East Pakistan Rifles and police units. India's core included the 8th Infantry Division, 1st Armoured Division, 33rd Corps and XIV Corps, with the 101 Area and mountain units cooperating. Mukti Bahini expanded from guerrilla detachments into multiple sectors, battalion and brigade formations and artillery groups; some weapons were captured and others were brought in from India. India moved 7.62-mm rifle ammunition, 81-mm mortar rounds and 105- and 155-mm shells by border rail and road, then distributed them among frontline units; when monsoon roads broke, supply shifted to trucks, river craft and airlift, with forward points placed near roads, fords and defensible camps. Reports from all sides mixed combat, detention and missing personnel, and their statistical definitions and propaganda uses differed. This account therefore gives no uncross-checked exact total of casualties. From November to December, Pakistan contracted the defenses outside Dhaka toward the city, while Mukti Bahini and Indian forces compressed the encirclement; naval operations ran from December 4 to 11, the Dhaka direction was breached on the 12th, the 53rd Division surrendered on the 14th, Chittagong surrendered on the 16th, and ceasefire arrangements on December 16 and 17 ended the military phase.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的直接背景，是東巴基斯坦在政治、軍事和行政權力上長期受西巴基斯坦中央政府控制。東孟加拉的議席、資源、徵稅、外交和軍隊指揮權要求，與中央權力的集中方式衝突；1970年選舉前，東巴基斯坦的主要政黨把聯邦制、語言權、地方政府、經濟利益和國防指揮列為六項政治要求。選舉結果使阿瓦米聯盟取得東巴基斯坦議席的明顯多數，中央軍政府卻延期召開國會、拖延政治程序，拒絕把選舉結果轉成可行的權力安排。1971年3月7日開始的非合作運動，使中央行政、地方警察和交通運作逐漸失去協調；巴基斯坦軍方擔心若不先奪取通信和指揮節點，東巴基斯坦的軍警會成批倒向反政府一方，遂在3月25日以Searchlight行動打擊達卡及其他城市的指揮系統。3月26日的獨立宣告、穆吉布爾被拘押，以及孟加拉籍官兵在4月的集體脫離，使衝突從政治危機轉成內戰式軍對抗。印度介入可概括為三個同時存在的軍事因素：保護邊境和自身空域、阻止巴基斯坦把東翼兵力投向印度側翼，以及利用邊境局勢迫使巴基斯坦停止在東翼的軍事部署。印度政府以邊境防衛和區域安全說明行動，巴基斯坦則把它視為外國入侵；因此，後文按實際戰線、日期、編制和補給記錄，而不把任何一方的政治理由當作唯一原因。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate background to the war was the long-standing control of political, military and administrative power in East Pakistan by the central government of West Pakistan. Questions of representation, resources, taxation, foreign affairs and military command in the eastern region conflicted with the concentration of power at the center; before the 1970 election, the principal political party in East Pakistan set out six demands concerning federal structure, language, local government, economic interests and national-defense command. The election gave the Awami League a clear majority of East Pakistan's seats, but the central military government postponed the assembly, delayed political procedures and refused to turn the result into a workable distribution of authority. The non-cooperation movement that began on March 7, 1971, progressively deprived central administration, local police and transport operations of coordination. The Pakistani military feared that unless it seized communications and command nodes first, East Pakistan's soldiers and police would defect in large numbers, so it launched Operation Searchlight on March 25 against command systems in Dhaka and other cities. The independence declaration of March 26, Mujib's arrest and the collective departure of Bengali personnel in April turned a political crisis into an internal military confrontation. India's intervention can be summarized as three overlapping military considerations: protecting the border and its own airspace, preventing Pakistani forces in the east from operating toward India's flank, and using the border situation to force Pakistan to halt military deployments in the east. The Indian government described the operation as border defense and regional security, while Pakistan regarded it as a foreign invasion. The account therefore follows the actual front lines, dates, formations and supply movements rather than treating either side's political explanation as the sole cause.
dossier.impact: 1971年的影響首先表現在軍隊與國家結構。巴基斯坦在東翼的第五十三、第三十四等師級部隊失去作戰能力，東巴基斯坦遊騎兵的指揮關係被拆散，達卡和吉大港的空軍、海軍設施受損；這些結果迫使巴基斯坦重新安排陸軍編制、邊境防衛和最高指揮系統。印度完成了一次大規模跨境立體作戰，得到邊境陣地和作戰經驗，也承擔佔領維持、與巴基斯坦長期對抗及日後撤軍的成本；1972年印巴協議處理俘虜、撤軍和雙邊關係安排後，印度軍隊才逐步退回東側邊界。解放軍的游擊和常規化經驗，以及後來轉入新國家軍隊的指揮骨幹，成為孟加拉建軍的核心；陸軍、海軍和空軍在國家成立後重新編制。對外交而言，東巴基斯坦的脫離改變南亞權力平衡，孟加拉國於1974年進入聯合國；對區域安全而言，印度獲得較穩定的東部邊境，但巴基斯坦的軍力與外交長期受這場戰爭牽動。運輸、港口和邊境通信的軍事功能受損，也迫使兩國在戰後優先修復軍用交通、重建指揮網，並處理被俘軍人的移交。
dossier.impactEn: The effects of 1971 appeared first in military and state structures. The 53rd and 34th divisional formations and other Pakistani units in the east lost combat effectiveness; the East Pakistan Rifles command network was broken up, and air and naval facilities at Dhaka and Chittagong were damaged. These results forced Pakistan to reorganize its army, border defense and highest command system. India completed a large-scale cross-border combined operation, gained border positions and operational experience, and also assumed the costs of maintaining an occupation, prolonged confrontation with Pakistan and eventual withdrawal. After the 1972 India-Pakistan agreement addressed prisoners, withdrawal and bilateral relations, Indian forces gradually returned to the eastern boundary. The guerrilla and conventional experience of the liberation force, together with the cadre that later entered the new national army, became a core of Bangladesh's military formation; its army, navy and air force were reorganized after the state was established. Diplomatically, the departure of East Pakistan changed the South Asian balance of power, and Bangladesh entered the United Nations in 1974. For regional security, India obtained a more stable eastern border, while Pakistan's military and foreign policy remained shaped by the war for years. Damage to the military functions of transport, ports and border communications also forced the states to prioritize repairing military routes, rebuilding command networks and arranging the transfer of captured personnel.
dossier.result: 戰役最後以軍事投降和停火收束，而不是以達卡長時間消耗戰結束。12月12日，印度第一裝甲師先頭部隊進入達卡；解放軍在市郊、公路和通信節點的攻擊，使巴基斯坦第五十三師的退路和指揮所受到壓力。12月14日，哈立德·莫沙拉夫在達卡向印度部隊與解放軍投降，交出師部檔案、通信器材、武器和仍在控制的據點；同一時間，吉大港方向的解放軍與印度部隊已切斷主要公路和海岸線。12月16日，A.K.M.沙馬蘇丁率第三十四師投降，吉大港海軍的組織性抵抗也停止；巴基斯坦接受停火，印度則在17日之後安排撤軍。謝赫·穆吉布爾·拉赫曼獲釋並返回達卡，臨時政府取得全國的實際控制，解放軍隨後改組為孟加拉國軍隊。結果因此包括三個明確變化：東巴基斯坦不再由巴基斯坦軍政府直接管治；達卡、吉大港和邊境要點的主權與軍事指揮轉交新國家；印度軍隊在短暫進入後依協議離開，留下獨立的孟加拉國家機構，以及以解放軍作戰經驗為基礎的軍隊。戰俘移交、撤軍安排和外交承認在隨後數月展開，邊界問題則另行處理。
dossier.resultEn: The campaign ended with military surrender and a ceasefire, not with a prolonged attritional defense of Dhaka. On December 12, the vanguard of India's 1st Armoured Division entered Dhaka; Mukti Bahini attacks on the outskirts, roads and communications nodes pressured the 53rd Division's withdrawal routes and headquarters. On December 14, Khaled Mosharraf surrendered in Dhaka to Indian forces and Mukti Bahini, handing over division records, communications equipment, weapons and positions still under control; at the same time, Mukti Bahini and Indian units had cut the main road and coastline in the Chittagong direction. On December 16, A. K. M. Shamsuddin led the 34th Division's surrender, and organized naval resistance at Chittagong ceased. Pakistan accepted the ceasefire, while India arranged its withdrawal after December 17. Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was released and returned to Dhaka, the provisional government gained actual control of the country, and the liberation force was subsequently reorganized as the Bangladesh Army. The result therefore contained three explicit changes: East Pakistan was no longer directly governed by Pakistan's military government; sovereignty and military command over Dhaka, Chittagong and border positions passed to the new state; and Indian troops left after a short entry in accordance with the agreement, leaving an independent Bangladeshi state structure and an army based on Mukti Bahini's combat experience. POW transfers, withdrawal arrangements and diplomatic recognition unfolded in the following months, while border questions were handled separately.

battle.name: 卡吉爾戰爭
battle.brief: 卡吉爾戰爭是印度與巴基斯坦因克什米爾控制權爭端而引發的軍事衝突，於1999年5月爆發。印度陸軍在高山地形中投入蘇聯製BMP-2步兵戰鬥車，執行機動作戰、兵員輸送與步兵火力支援，並配合坦克作戰。

kit.name: BMP-2步兵戰鬥車
kit.history: 蘇聯陸軍機械化步兵的核心裝甲載具，負責伴隨坦克輸送兵員，並以機炮提供伴隨步兵火力支援。

dossier.countries: 1999年的卡吉爾戰爭，實際戰線位於印度與巴基斯坦之間的實際控制線（LoC）沿線，戰場集中在印控查謨和克什米爾的卡吉爾、德拉士、巴拉提克與昌昌山區，對面則是巴控喀什米爾的山地。越線後的第一道山脊，往往比後方公路和營地更能決定火力視線，也更能限制敵方的 artillery 射線。印度方面把越線隊伍稱為受巴基斯坦軍方支持的武裝滫透者，巴基斯坦則稱其為獨立的武裝分子，並否認本國軍隊直接指揮。交戰者因此包括印度軍隊、巴基斯坦軍隊，以及在前線與印度軍交手的武裝滫透隊伍，這不是一場由兩國正式宣戰後才開始的戰爭。印度把收復山脊的軍事行動命名為維杰行動（Operation Vijay）；這個名稱出現在五月以後，描述的是印度軍的攻勢，而不是戰爭的起點或所有交戰者的共同名稱。
dossier.countriesEn: The 1999 Kargil War was fought along the actual Line of Control (LoC) between India and Pakistan, mainly in the Kargil, Dras, Batalik, and Changthang mountain areas of Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, with the Pakistani-administered mountains on the opposite side. After crossing the line, the first ridge often mattered more than the roads and camps behind it for controlling fields of fire and restricting enemy artillery lines. India described the crossing groups as militant infiltrators supported by the Pakistani military, while Pakistan called them independent militants and denied direct direction by its armed forces. The belligerents therefore included the Indian Army, the Pakistani Army, and armed infiltrator groups that fought Indian forces on the forward line; this was not a war that began only after a formal declaration by the two states. India named the military effort to recapture the ridges Operation Vijay. The name was used for the Indian offensive from May onward and described that operation rather than the war’s beginning or a common name used by all belligerents.
dossier.people: 開戰前的政治指揮由印度總理阿塔利亞·比哈里·瓦杰帕伊和國防部長喬治·費爾南德斯負責，印度陸軍參謀長則是N. C. Vajpeyee。北方軍區指揮官V. K. Chaudhary中將把政治決定轉成山地作戰，第十五山地師由J. J. Singh少將指揮；第十一步兵旅由Rajeev Yaub准將率領，第八與第十八山地旅分別支援巴拉提克和德拉士方向的攻勢。巴基斯坦方面，總理納瓦茲·謝里夫主持政治層面，陸軍參謀長Pervez Musharraf、參謀長聯會主席穆罕默德·阿齊茲·汗中將，以及北方軍和第十軍的指揮官穆罕默德·馬蘇德·阿斯拉姆中將、Javed Ashraf Qazi少將共同構成軍事指揮鏈。武裝滫透隊伍的公開領導人則是哈菲茲·馬蘇德。這些人不是每一項決定都在同一處作出：首都決定談判與戰略目標，北部軍區安排兵力和火力，旅、營指揮官則負責把命令轉成具體的山脊攻勢。
dossier.peopleEn: Political direction at the beginning of the war came from Indian Prime Minister Atal Bihar Vajpayee and Defence Minister George Fernandes, while the Chief of the Army Staff was N. C. Vajpeyee. Northern Command was led by Lieutenant General V. K. Chaudhary, who translated political decisions into mountain operations. The 15th Mountain Division was commanded by Major General J. J. Singh; Brigadier Rajeev Yaub led the 11th Infantry Brigade, while the 8th and 18th Mountain Brigades supported operations in the Batalik and Dras sectors. On the Pakistani side, Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif handled the political level, while General Pervez Musharraf, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Committee Lieutenant General Muhammad Aziz Khan, Northern Light Corps commander Lieutenant General Muhammad Masood Aslam, and 10 Corps commander Major General Javed Ashraf Qazi formed the military command structure. Hafiz Masood was the publicly named leader of the armed infiltrator organization. These commanders did not make every decision in one place: the capital set diplomatic and strategic aims, Northern Command arranged forces and fire support, and brigade and battalion commanders turned those orders into specific attacks on ridges.
dossier.kits: 到1999年，印度山地步兵可以使用5.56×45毫米INSAS步槍、7.62×51毫米SLR步槍和7.62毫米FN MAG通用機槍，並攜帶81毫米及120毫米迫擊炮。炮兵火力包括105毫米野戰炮、155毫米榴彈炮和25毫米高射炮，砲彈由後方射擊陣地送往前線。印度陸軍已有T-55與T-72坦克，T-90則在1999年才開始進入序列，不能把它的具體數量和每個陣地的部署寫成已核實的表格。印度空軍在卡吉爾行動中使用MiG-21與MiG-29，Su-30MKI在1999年剛開始列裝，公開資料對其在戰役中的實際出動架次並不完整。Mi-17/3、HAL Cheetah和Chetak則承担適合條件下的運輸、聯絡與傷員後送。飛機攻擊使用制式炸彈和火箭，包括250公斤及500公斤級炸彈。巴基斯坦前線常見配備包括G3步槍、MG3機槍、PKM通用機槍、RPG-7以及81毫米和120毫米迫擊炮；空軍序列中有F-16A/B、Mirage III與Mirage 5。山脊上真正決定火力的是輕武器、迫擊炮和機槍，坦克則主要在山谷與道路附近提供有限支援。
dossier.kitsEn: By 1999, Indian mountain infantry could use the 5.56 × 45 mm INSAS rifle, the 7.62 × 51 mm SLR rifle, and the 7.62 mm FN MAG general-purpose machine gun, together with 81 mm and 120 mm mortars. Artillery support included 105 mm field guns, 155 mm guns, and 25 mm anti-aircraft guns, with shells moved from firing positions behind the forward line. The Indian Army already had T-55 and T-72 tanks; the T-90 was only beginning to enter service in 1999, so its exact strength and location at individual ridges cannot be presented as verified figures. The Indian Air Force used MiG-21 and MiG-29 aircraft during the Kargil operation, while the Su-30MKI was just entering service in 1999 and public records do not give a complete count of its combat sorties. Mi-17/3, HAL Cheetah, and Chetak helicopters performed transport, liaison, and medical evacuation when conditions allowed. Air attacks used conventional bombs and rockets, including 250 kg and 500 kg class bombs. Pakistani forward equipment commonly included G3 rifles, MG3 machine guns, PKM general-purpose machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, and 81 mm and 120 mm mortars. The Pakistani air inventory included F-16A/B, Mirage III, and Mirage 5 aircraft. Machine guns, mortars, and light infantry weapons determined fire on the ridges, while tanks provided limited support mainly in valleys and near roads.
dossier.tactics: 滲透隊伍先以小組分散穿越山谷和缺口，利用春季尚未被季風封閉的路线，在卡吉爾、德拉士和巴拉提克的山脊上建立觀察哨、迫擊炮位和機槍陣位；這些陣位彼此能互相支援，並可觀察印度後方的道路與補給線。印度先依靠人力巡邏、空中偵察和衛星情報確認占領範圍，再於五月四日開始以炮兵和空軍火力壓制暴露位置。前線觀察員計算射擊諸元，MiG-21與MiG-29對固定陣地投彈或發射火箭，地面部隊則在火力準備後逐點接近。進攻不是單純正面衝撞：步兵先以側翼接近，切斷機槍射界和迫擊炮交通線，再由工兵處理障礙、掩體與後方陣位；裝甲車輛很難直接越過裸露山脊，通常留在谷地。空軍可以暫時壓制，卻不能代替步兵佔領和清查。巴基斯坦在七月初企圖以Operation Khanjar從北部山區向卡吉爾側翼推進，切斷印度補給，印度情報先期察覺後在若干關鍵鞍部部署反制兵力。補給由卡吉爾至德拉士的公路運到後方，再以騾匹和後勤人員分送到前線；直升機只在天氣和高度允許時運送急需的燃料、彈藥與傷員。稀薄空氣、濃霧、煙塵、碎石坡面和季風，使炮火與空地協同反覆中斷。
dossier.tacticsEn: Infiltrator groups first crossed valleys and gaps in small, dispersed teams, using routes that had not yet been closed by the monsoon to establish observation posts, mortar positions, and machine-gun emplacements on the ridges around Kargil, Dras, and Batalik. These positions supported one another and could observe Indian roads and supply lines behind them. India relied on patrols, aerial reconnaissance, and satellite intelligence to establish the occupied area, then began suppressing exposed positions with artillery and air power on May 4. Forward observers calculated firing parameters, while MiG-21 and MiG-29 aircraft attacked fixed positions with bombs and rockets. Infantry then approached point by point after the fire preparation. The assault was not simply a frontal rush: troops approached along the flanks, cut off machine-gun fields of fire and mortar movement routes, and used engineers against obstacles, bunkers, and rear positions. Armoured vehicles could rarely climb directly over exposed ridges and generally remained in the valleys. Air power could suppress temporarily but could not replace infantry in occupying and clearing positions. In early July, Pakistan attempted Operation Khanjar from the northern mountains toward the Kargil flank to cut Indian supply lines. Indian intelligence detected the plan in advance and deployed counterforces at several key saddles. Supplies moved by truck along the Kargil-Dras road to rear areas, then were carried forward by mules and logistics personnel. Helicopters moved urgent fuel, ammunition, and evacuated personnel only when weather and altitude permitted. Thin air, fog, smoke, loose rock, and the monsoon repeatedly interrupted artillery and air-ground coordination.
dossier.data: 時間線的第一個可核對節點出現在1999年五月初，印度巡邏隊在卡吉爾、德拉士和巴拉提克一帶發現越線者佔據山脊；五月四日印度啟動維杰行動，五月五日巴基斯坦開始以炮兵回應。五月二十七日曾發生MiG-21與F-16等機的空中接觸，但關於是否越過實際控制線、射擊距離和戰果的敘述不一致，因此只能確認接觸，不能把未經共同核實的擊落數字寫成定論。六月十三日，印度軍攻回托洛林方向包括Point 4875在內的高地；六月十八日又奪回Point 5140，海拔約五千一百四十公尺，是戰役中報導最頻繁的制高點之一。七月一日，巴基斯坦展開Operation Khanjar，試圖從北方側翼切斷卡吉爾的交通；七月十五日瓦杰帕伊在斯洛維尼亞會見美國總統克林頓，外部外交壓力明顯增加。七月26日印度宣布無條件停火，並要求巴基斯坦在七月29日前撤出印度一側據點；八月初印軍宣布卡吉爾戰區主要山脊與大部分陣地已恢復控制。前線海拔多在四千米至五千公尺以上，公路有限，公開資料常以約二十萬描述印度作戰及支援部隊，但作戰、後勤和指揮人員的統計口徑不同，巴基斯坦前沿總兵力則沒有同等可靠的公開表。印度政府事後公布陣亡軍人1,345人，巴基斯坦政府公布陣亡軍人453人；兩份數字屬各自官方口徑，受傷總數及武裝滲透者損失沒有共同核實，因此不把不同來源拼成一個看似精確的總傷亡數。
dossier.dataEn: The first verifiable point in the chronology came in early May 1999, when Indian patrols found infiltrators occupying ridges around Kargil, Dras, and Batalik. India launched Operation Vijay on May 4, and Pakistan began artillery retaliation on May 5. A short air engagement involving aircraft such as the MiG-21 and F-16 occurred on May 27, but accounts disagree over whether the aircraft crossed the Line of Control, the engagement range, and the results. The contact can therefore be recorded, but unverified shoot-down figures should not be presented as settled facts. On June 13, Indian forces recaptured the higher ground around Tololing, including Point 4875. On June 18, they retook Point 5140, an elevation of about 5,140 metres and one of the most frequently reported strongpoints of the war. Pakistan launched Operation Khanjar on July 1, attempting to approach the Kargil flank from the north and cut its communications. On July 15, Vajpayee met United States President Clinton in Slovenia, increasing visible diplomatic pressure. India announced an unconditional ceasefire on July 26 and required Pakistan to withdraw from positions on the Indian side by July 29. In early August, the Indian Army announced that it had regained the main ridges and most positions in the Kargil sector. Much of the forward area lay above 4,000 to 5,000 metres and had few roads. Public accounts often describe roughly 200,000 Indian combat and supporting personnel, but the totals combine different categories, while no equally reliable public table gives Pakistan’s forward strength. The Indian government later reported 1,345 military personnel killed, and the Pakistani government reported 453 military personnel killed. These are separate official counts; total wounded and infiltrator losses were not jointly verified, so they should not be combined into a supposedly exact grand total.
dossier.cause: 卡吉爾戰爭的長期背景是印巴對喀什米爾主權、實際控制線和邊境兵力部署長期無法定案。過去的戰爭與停火留下許多高山據點，實體控制線也不是能隨時封閉的普通陸界；對山地作戰而言，誰控制山脊、誰能維持彈藥和飲水，誰就可能控制局部戰場。1990年代查謨武裝衝突持續，巴基斯坦與武裝組織保持密切聯絡，印度情報單位認為巴基斯坦軍方策劃了越線滲透，但巴基斯坦一直否認國家直接參與。1980年代後期錫亞琴衝突與後續部署，使部分沿線據點的兵力重新分配，許多研究認為這為滲透留下可利用的缺口。1998年印度進行核試驗後，南亞的戰略風險升高；巴基斯坦軍方部分人士擔心印度會利用新的軍事優勢發動攻勢，因而選擇在季風來臨前奪取山脊，以取得談判籌碼並迫使印度接受既成局勢。印度則把這種越線視為對實際控制線和軍隊部署的改變，不能容忍。發現陣地後，印度要求完整撤軍，巴基斯坦提出有條件的撤軍方案，雙方對撤離範圍、查驗方式與停火條件未能達成一致，最終由炮兵、空軍和步兵開始大規模收復行動。
dossier.causeEn: The long-term background to the Kargil War was the unresolved dispute over Kashmir, the Line of Control, and the deployment of forces along the border. Earlier wars and ceasefires left numerous high-altitude positions, while the Line of Control was not an ordinary land boundary that could be sealed at will. In mountain warfare, control of a ridge and the ability to sustain ammunition, food, and fuel could determine the local battle. Armed conflict in Kashmir continued through the 1990s, and Pakistan maintained close links with militant organizations. Indian intelligence believed that the Pakistani military had planned the infiltration, although Pakistan consistently denied direct state involvement. The earlier Siachen conflict and subsequent redeployments moved troops away from some forward areas, and many studies identified the resulting gaps as an opportunity for infiltration. After India conducted nuclear tests in 1998, strategic risk in South Asia rose. Some Pakistani military leaders feared that India would exploit its new military balance and therefore sought to seize ridges before the monsoon, create bargaining leverage, and force India to accept a new fait accompli. India regarded the crossing as an unacceptable change to the Line of Control and existing troop deployments. Once the positions were discovered, India demanded complete withdrawal, while Pakistan offered conditional proposals. The two sides could not agree on the area of withdrawal, verification, or ceasefire terms, so artillery, air power, and infantry began the large-scale recapture effort.
