dossier.impact: 戰後的軍事檢討首先指出，山脊本身不是永久防禦工事；滲透者若沒有可靠補給、替換彈藥和保持觀察的能力，短時間內可以製造突然的火力優勢，但一旦道路、騾匹路線或直升機運輸被切斷，陣位就會迅速失去戰役價值。印度因此重新檢視高山作戰中的情報確認、炮兵觀察、空地協同、直升機後勤和逐點攻擊，並把德拉士、卡吉爾一帶的經驗納入後續訓練與裝備規劃。巴基斯坦則暴露了以小規模滲透建立高點的風險：這種方式能取得戰術主動，卻難以承受印度空軍與炮兵的系統性反擊，也無法確保山脊在季風前形成可持續的防線。戰役同時把南亞核風險推到國際外交核心。美國在七月推動外交接觸，克林森與瓦杰帕伊的會晤成為停火的重要外部壓力，但雙方沒有因此解決喀什米爾問題。巴基斯坦軍方的戰役失利削弱納瓦茲·謝里夫政府的政治地位，成為同年十月軍事政變的重要背景因素之一；印度的軍事結果則暫時支持了瓦杰帕伊政府，卻也促使軍方繼續推動高海拔作戰、後勤和空軍能力的現代化。這場戰爭加深了印巴對實際控制線、跨境滲透和邊境情報的警覺，但沒有改變雙方對喀什米爾主權的基本立場。
dossier.impactEn: Postwar military reviews concluded that a ridge is not a permanent fortification. Infiltrators could create a sudden fire advantage if they had reliable resupply, ammunition, and observation, but once roads, mule routes, or helicopter transport were cut, the positions lost much of their value quickly. India therefore reassessed intelligence confirmation, artillery observation, air-ground coordination, helicopter logistics, and point-by-point attacks in mountain terrain, incorporating lessons from Dras and Kargil into later training and equipment planning. Pakistan’s infiltration method also showed the risks of using small teams to seize heights: it could create tactical surprise, but it was difficult to withstand systematic Indian air and artillery counterattacks or to turn the ridges into a sustainable defense before the monsoon. The war brought the South Asian nuclear risk to the centre of international diplomacy. American pressure in July, including the meeting between Clinton and Vajpayee, became an important external influence on the ceasefire, but it did not resolve the Kashmir dispute. Pakistan’s military setback weakened the political position of Nawaz Sharif’s government and became one important background factor in the military coup of October 1999. India’s military outcome temporarily supported the Vajpayee government, but it also encouraged the army to continue modernizing its high-altitude warfare, logistics, and air capabilities. The conflict deepened mutual Indian and Pakistani concern over the Line of Control, cross-border infiltration, and border intelligence, while leaving their fundamental positions on Kashmir unchanged.
dossier.result: 七月26日，印度宣布無條件停火，並給予巴基斯坦到七月二十九日的撤軍期限；八月一日前後，印軍宣布卡吉爾戰區的主要山脊和大部分前進陣地已重新控制。德拉士、托洛林和卡吉爾外圍的關鍵高程點，包括Point 4875和Point 5140，重新由印度軍隊掌握。巴基斯坦軍隊及其支持的武裝人員撤出大部分印度一側據點，部分被俘者則依後續安排交換返回。Operation Khanjar沒有改變停火時的整體控制線，季風和高山補給限制也使任何一方都難以再把局部攻勢擴成全面山地戰役。印度實現了清除越線滲透、收復主要山脊的直接軍事目標，但停火不是正式和平條約，也沒有解決實際控制線的來源、主權或邊境兵力問題。雙方仍各自在線內保持部隊，喀什米爾的爭議因而從一場明確的邊境攻擊，轉為長期的軍力對峙與下一次危機的來源。
dossier.resultEn: On July 26, India announced an unconditional ceasefire and gave Pakistan until July 29 to withdraw. Around August 1, the Indian Army announced that the main ridges and most forward positions in the Kargil sector had been brought back under Indian control. Key high points around Dras, Tololing, and the approaches to Kargil, including Point 4875 and Point 5140, were once again held by Indian forces. Pakistani troops and the armed infiltrators withdrew from most positions on the Indian side, while some prisoners were returned under later arrangements. Operation Khanjar did not change the overall line at the time of the ceasefire, and the monsoon and high-altitude supply constraints made it difficult for either side to turn a local offensive into a full mountain war. India achieved its immediate military objective of removing the infiltration and recapturing the principal ridges, but the ceasefire was not a formal peace treaty and did not settle the source, sovereignty, or troop arrangements of the Line of Control. Both sides retained forces on their respective sides, so the Kashmir dispute remained a long-term military standoff and a source of future crises.

battle.name: 西沙之戰
battle.brief: 西沙之戰是一九七四年一月中國與南越在西沙群島及附近海域發生的軍事衝突，交戰涉及艦艇、飛機與地面部隊。中國參戰艦隊包括已於一九七一年服役的051型導彈驅逐艦，承擔海上警戒、護航與火力支援任務。艦隊作戰以攻擊南越海空兵力、奪取島礁控制為主，並保障後續登陸與補給。

kit.name: 051型導彈驅逐艦
kit.history: 051型是中國人民解放軍海軍水面艦艇部隊的導彈驅逐艦，執行編隊防空、反艦、警戒與護航，是早期海上防空作戰體系的骨幹。

dossier.countries: 1974年1月的西沙之戰，交戰主體是中國人民解放軍與越南共和國軍隊。中方由海軍南海艦隊牽頭，海上兵力包括兩艘051型驅逐艦、四艘062型導彈艇與登陸運輸艦，並由協同的登陸部隊奪取島嶼，殲-8攻擊機在後段提供空中支援。南越由海軍組織護衛艦、登陸艦、PT-76水陸裝甲車與武裝航空兵，企圖奪回琛航島及廣益島並恢復島上補給。美國不是交戰方；它雖與南越保有防務承諾，最後仍決定不介入對中國的交戰，第七艦隊也沒有進入戰場。蘇聯與北越未派戰鬥部隊參加。
dossier.countriesEn: The principal belligerents in the January 1974 Battle of the Paracel Islands were the People's Liberation Army of China and the armed forces of the Republic of Vietnam, or South Vietnam. China’s force was organized by the South Sea Fleet and included two Type 051 destroyers, four Type 062 missile boats, and landing transports, supported by an amphibious landing unit; Shenyang J-8 attack aircraft provided air support during the later phase. South Vietnam formed a naval task group from frigates, a landing ship, PT-76 amphibious light tanks, and armed aircraft in an effort to retake Duncan and Robert Islands and resume their logistical support. The United States was not a belligerent. Although it retained defense commitments to South Vietnam, it ultimately declined to intervene against China, and the Seventh Fleet did not enter the battle. Neither the Soviet Union nor North Vietnam committed combat forces to the engagement.
dossier.people: 中方可確認的最高指揮者是時任南海艦隊副司令員張欣垣中將，他以海軍軍官身分統一指揮艦隊、登陸部隊與空中兵力，實際作戰決策則在旗艦指揮所完成。南越總統阮文壽批准奪島行動，海軍參謀長阮文海負責組織海上反制；各艘軍艦的具體指揮官在中國、南越與美國解密資料中並不一致，因此不宜硬選一個姓名。美國駐越大使葛雷厄姆・馬丁曾透過外交渠道表明華盛頓不會支持南越與中國發生軍事對抗。這一警告沒有阻止南越出航，但使華府得以把西沙衝突限制在南越、中國之間。
dossier.peopleEn: The highest Chinese commander whose role can be established was Admiral Zhang Xinyuan, then deputy commander of the South Sea Fleet. He directed the ships, landing troops, and air units as a naval officer, with operational decisions made in the flagship command post. South Vietnamese president Nguyễn Văn Thiệu approved the operation to recover the islands, while navy chief of staff Nguyễn Văn Hải organized the maritime response. Chinese, South Vietnamese, and released American records do not agree on the commanders of all individual vessels, so selecting uncertain names would be misleading. The United States ambassador to South Vietnam, Graham Martin, conveyed through diplomatic channels that Washington would not support a military confrontation with China. That warning did not stop South Vietnam from sailing, but it allowed Washington to keep the dispute limited to a contest between South Vietnam and China.
dossier.kits: 中方海上編隊的核心是海南艦與欽州艦兩艘051型驅逐艦，滿載排水量約三千六百噸、最大航速約二十八節，每艦裝有兩門一百毫米主炮、四門五十七毫米炮及二十五毫米機炮。另有常記為十、十一、十二、十六艇的四艘062型高速導彈艇，每艇約一百七十噸，採四聯裝反艦飛彈配置；按一九七四年可用系統記錄，其主要型號為HY-2系列，射程約二十五公里。兩艘三百三十二型登陸運輸艦約一千八百噸，負責運送營級登陸分隊與裝備，殲-8則攜帶炸彈和火箭彈攻擊海上目標。南越方面包括HQ-01阮惠海號與HQ-07黎昌號兩艘護衛艦、六二五型登陸艦HQ-02黎昌號、兩輛PT-76水陸裝甲車，以及由岘港起飛的武裝A-1天攻者攻擊機。
dossier.kitsEn: The core of the Chinese maritime force consisted of the Type 051 destroyers Hainan and Qinzhou, each displacing about 3,600 tons fully loaded and capable of roughly 28 knots. Each carried two 100-millimeter main guns, four 57-millimeter guns, and 25-millimeter automatic cannon. Four compact Type 062 missile boats, commonly identified as Missile Boats 10, 11, 12, and 16, accompanied them. Each displaced about 170 tons and used a four-missile configuration; by the equipment available in 1974, the principal system is identified as the HY-2 series, with a range of approximately 25 kilometers. Two Type 332 landing transports, each of about 1,800 tons, carried a battalion-scale landing element and its equipment, while Shenyang J-8 aircraft delivered bomb and rocket attacks. South Vietnam fielded the frigates HQ-01 Nguyễn Hiếu Hải and HQ-07 Lê Thanh Đức, the Type 625 landing ship HQ-02 Lê Thanh Đức, two PT-76 amphibious light tanks, and armed Douglas A-1 Skyraiders operating from Đà Nẵng.
dossier.tactics: 一月十七日黎明，中方編隊由湛江港出發，沿雷州半島西側南下，航渡約二百七十海里後駛抵西沙永興島外海。十八日清晨，兩艘三百三十二型登陸運輸艦在艦隊掩護下進入島礁近海，登陸艇分批把部隊送上琛航島與廣益島；南越守島分隊與海上支援被隔斷，在外海登陸艇無法接應的情況下放下武器，島嶼控制權遂轉入中方手中。一月十九日約十時三十分，南越編隊由岘港出發，六二五型登陸艦居中，兩艘護衛艦分列兩翼，PT-76仍留在艦上，準備先恢復島上陣地。中方要求其返航，南越繼續接近；中國雷達發現目標後，兩艘零五一型驅逐艦提供炮火掩護，四艘零六二型導彈艇在前方及兩翼展開，利用二十五公里級反艦飛彈射程與高速艇位控制射擊諸元。交火中，中方戰史記載反艦彈命中HQ-01，零五一型艦的炮火及隨後到位的殲-8攻擊又使HQ-02受創起火、通訊與航行能力下降。HQ-07仍與受傷艦艇保持接觸，未被擊沉。南越武裝A-1嘗試攔截殲-8，但沒有形成可核實的決定性空戰結果。失去艦隊協同及島上奪回機會後，南越各舰約十七時轉向，沿海峽方向撤退；中方留在作戰海域警戒，沒有把戰鬥延伸至南越沿岸。
dossier.tacticsEn: Before dawn on 17 January, the Chinese formation departed Zhanjiang, sailed south along the western side of the Leizhou Peninsula, and covered roughly 270 nautical miles before reaching the waters off Yongxing Island in the Paracels. Early on 18 January, the two Type 332 landing transports entered the island waters under fleet cover, and landing craft landed the troops in successive groups on Duncan and Robert Islands. The South Vietnamese garrison was cut off from maritime reinforcement and, unable to receive its landing craft offshore, laid down its arms, transferring control of the islands to China. At about 10:30 on 19 January, the South Vietnamese group sailed from Đà Nẵng with the Type 625 landing ship in the center, a frigate on each side, and the PT-76 tanks still embarked for a renewed occupation. China demanded that it turn back, but it continued to approach. After Chinese radar detected the group, the two Type 051 destroyers provided gun cover while the four Type 062 missile boats deployed forward and on the flanks, using their high speed and the approximately 25-kilometer missile range to control the firing geometry. During the exchange, Chinese operational accounts record an anti-ship missile strike on HQ-01, while gunfire from the Type 051 ships and a subsequent J-8 attack damaged HQ-02, set it on fire, and degraded its communications and ability to maneuver. HQ-07 remained in contact with the damaged ships and was not sunk. Armed South Vietnamese A-1 aircraft attempted to intercept the J-8s but produced no verifiable decisive aerial result. With fleet coordination and the opportunity to retake the islands lost, the South Vietnamese ships turned toward Đà Nẵng at approximately 17:00. China remained on station for a period without extending the fight toward the South Vietnamese coast.
dossier.data: 可核對的時間軸以一月十七日清晨從湛江啟航、十八日上午登陸、十九日上午南越由岘港出航、十九日下午交火及當日黃昏前撤退為主幹。湛江至琛航島約二百七十海里，岘港至主要交戰海域約一百八十至二百海里；公開海圖多把最初雷達接觸寫在約十至十二海里，其後南越編隊繼續逼近至反艦飛彈與艦炮的有效射擊範圍。零五一型的一百毫米炮最大射程約二十二公里，五十七毫米炮約十四公里；HY-2反艦飛彈射程約二十五公里、作戰部約半噸，因此攻擊是在近海而非目視距離內完成。中國與南越戰史分別使用北京時間和當地作戰時間，部分小時可能相差一小時，故不應把每個公開時刻視為絕對精確。各方也沒有留下可交叉核實的完整齊射彈數，本文不虛構裝彈總量或發射輪次。
dossier.dataEn: The verifiable chronology is built around the departure from Zhanjiang before dawn on 17 January, the landings on the morning of 18 January, the South Vietnamese departure from Đà Nẵng on the morning of 19 January, the naval engagement that afternoon, and the withdrawal before dusk that day. Zhanjiang lies about 270 nautical miles from Duncan Island, while Đà Nẵng is roughly 180 to 200 nautical miles from the principal engagement area. Published charts commonly place the initial radar contact at approximately 10 to 12 nautical miles, after which the South Vietnamese formation closed inside the effective range of the missiles and naval guns. The Type 051’s 100-millimeter gun had a maximum range of about 22 kilometers and its 57-millimeter gun about 14 kilometers. The HY-2 missile had an approximate range of 25 kilometers and a half-ton warhead, allowing the attack to be conducted within the near approaches rather than at visual range. Chinese and South Vietnamese accounts used Beijing time and local operational time, respectively, so some hourly timestamps may differ by one hour. The published record also lacks a complete, cross-verifiable count of ammunition loaded or salvoes fired, and no total magazine count or firing cycle is therefore invented here.
dossier.cause: 西沙爭端的背景可追溯至一九五六年中國宣布西沙屬於南海諸島，以及一九五八年中國政府公布領海基線之後；南越則在法國逐步撤出南海後強化對西沙中南部島礁的實際控制，並在琛航、廣益等地維持駐防。一九七三年，南越又在其所主張的南海區域向法國、美國石油企業授出石油勘探權，勘探區與中國所主張的西沙海域重疊，北京因此把南越的島上駐軍、巡邏和能源活動視為對中國島礁控制與區域航路的直接挑戰。直接-trigger則是一九七四年一月南越在永興島周邊加強巡邏、嘗試向島上輸送人員及登陸車，中南雙方船艇近距離接觸與警告逐日增加。中方這次行動的軍事目標限於奪取南越在永興島外圍的前進島嶼、切斷補給並建立海上控制，沒有徵集民間船隻，也沒有把行動擴展為登陸南越本土。
dossier.causeEn: The dispute over the Paracels had developed against the background of China’s declaration in 1956 that the islands belonged to the South China Sea Islands and its publication of territorial-sea baselines in 1958. As France withdrew from the region, South Vietnam strengthened its effective control over the central and southern Paracels, maintaining outposts that included Duncan and Robert. In 1973, South Vietnam also granted offshore petroleum exploration rights to French and American companies in areas claimed by China, including zones overlapping the Paracels. Beijing consequently regarded the South Vietnamese garrison, patrols, and energy activity as a direct challenge to Chinese control of the islands and regional sea lanes. The immediate trigger was the South Vietnamese increase in patrols around Yongxing Island during January 1974 and attempted reinforcement of the forward islands. Close encounters and warnings between Chinese and South Vietnamese craft intensified until the confrontation became unavoidable. The immediate Chinese military objective was limited to taking the South Vietnamese outposts outside Yongxing, severing their reinforcement route, and establishing maritime control; it did not extend to a landing on South Vietnam’s mainland.
dossier.impact: 戰役後十二天，越南共和國與中華人民共和國於一月三十一日建立外交關係，並與中華民國斷交；這使南越在國際上的外交位置與美越關係同時受到震動。中國則證明南海艦隊能把驅逐艦、導彈艇、登陸運輸艦與航空兵投入同一項離岸作戰，重視反艦飛彈與艦載或艦隊航空兵的協同經驗，南越之後也把西沙方向視為實際失去控制，而把主要海上警戒轉向 Spratlys。美國沒有以同盟條約為由動用第七艦隊，顯示其防衛承諾存在實際政治邊界。不過，交戰只改變了西沙的實際控制，沒有由國際法庭或共同協議解決主權爭議，雙方後來仍分別維持對西沙的不同主張。
dossier.impactEn: Twelve days after the battle, the Republic of Vietnam established diplomatic relations with the People’s Republic of China on 31 January and severed relations with the Republic of China. South Vietnam’s international position and its relationship with the United States were both affected. China demonstrated that the South Sea Fleet could combine destroyers, missile boats, landing transports, and aircraft in a single operation far from its mainland, reinforcing the importance attached to coordinated anti-ship missile and naval aviation operations. South Vietnam subsequently treated its loss of effective control in the Paracels as settled in practice and concentrated much of its maritime surveillance on the Spratlys. The United States did not invoke its alliance commitments to bring the Seventh Fleet into the fighting, showing the practical political limits of those commitments. The engagement nevertheless changed only actual control in the Paracels; it did not resolve sovereignty through an international court or a joint agreement, and the two sides continued to maintain different claims.
dossier.result: 一月十八日午後，中方已控制琛航島與廣益島，南越原有守島部隊被解除武裝並作為俘虜拘押；一月十九日的反制編隊未能登陸，兩輛PT-6也沒有上岸。HQ-01遭到反艦彈與其他火力重創，HQ-02受炮火及空襲後失去繼續作戰與航行的能力，但仍得到拖帶或打撈，沒有大型南越軍艦被確認永久沉沒。關於雙方死亡、受傷總數及空戰損失，中、南越與美國資料互有差異，現有公開紀錄只能確認有人死亡受傷及上述艦體損傷，不能負責任地列出單一精確數字。俘虜其後經外交安排返回。中方保住了登陸作戰成果，此後沒有人再以南海艦隊奪回這兩座島嶼。
dossier.resultEn: By the afternoon of 18 January, Chinese forces held Duncan and Robert Islands, and the South Vietnamese garrison had been disarmed and held as prisoners of war. The South Vietnamese counterforce failed to land on 19 January, and neither PT-76 tank reached shore. HQ-01 sustained major damage from an anti-ship missile and other weapons, while HQ-02 was rendered ineffective and unable to continue the engagement after gunfire and air attack, although it was taken under tow or salvage and no major South Vietnamese ship is confirmed to have been permanently sunk. Chinese, South Vietnamese, and American records differ over total dead, wounded, and aircraft losses. The surviving public record establishes that people were killed or wounded and confirms the vessel damage described above, but it does not support a responsibly stated single casualty total. The prisoners were subsequently repatriated through diplomatic arrangements. China retained the results of its amphibious operation, and no later South Sea Fleet operation recovered those two islands.

battle.name: 安哥拉內戰
battle.brief: 安哥拉內戰自1975年獨立前後爆發，安哥拉人民解放運動MPLA、右翼全國解放陣線UNITA與民族解放陣線FNLA為爭取國家政權而交戰。這場內戰與非洲冷戰代理人戰高度重疊，MPLA曾獲得的蘇制裝備包括1974年列裝的AK-74突擊步槍。

kit.name: 卡拉什尼科夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-74是蘇軍摩托化步兵師步兵連的制式突擊步槍，配置於基層步兵班，負責近距離一般火力，是連隊地面進攻中的主要步兵武器。

dossier.countries: 1975年的安哥拉並非單一政府與叛軍交火，而是葡萄牙殖民政府迅速退場後，三支獨立組織共同爭奪國家權力的斷裂局面。MPLA以北部、東部林區與城市聯絡網為根基，11月11日宣告成立安哥拉人民共和國；FNLA依托剛果民主共和國（時稱薩伊）的邊境後勤，沿北部通道向羅安達與洛比托一帶施壓；UNITA則由尚比亞進入庫安戈班古、Bié及Huambo高原，保有長距離機動空間。葡萄牙在1月底撤出羅安達，卻留下武器、營區和分散據點。古巴與蘇聯支持MPLA，美國及薩伊支持FNLA，中國主要經尚比亞援助UNITA，南非更以Savannah行動直接進入南部戰線。
dossier.countriesEn: Angola in 1975 was not a single government fighting an insurgency; it was a fragmented struggle for state power that began as Portugal's colonial government withdrew rapidly. The MPLA was rooted in contact networks across the northern and eastern forest zones and cities, and it declared the People's Republic of Angola on 11 November. The FNLA relied on border logistics in what was then Zaire, now the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and pressed down northern routes toward Luanda and Lobito. UNITA entered Cuando Cubango, Bié, and the Huambo highlands from Zambia, preserving long-range mobility. Portugal withdrew from Luanda by the end of January but left weapons, barracks, and dispersed posts behind. Cuba and the Soviet Union supported the MPLA; the United States and Zaire supported the FNLA; China aided UNITA mainly through Zambia; and South Africa entered the southern front directly under Operation Savannah.
dossier.people: 1975年的指揮問題，必須同時寫入三組織最高領袖與前線指揮。主持MPLA的阿戈什蒂紐·內圖把政治領導、軍隊整編與羅安達控制集中在中央；FNLA領袖霍爾登·羅伯托常駐剛果，跨越邊界調度資源，容易令前線與本部脫節；UNITA領袖喬納斯·薩文比則把中部高原作為作戰主體，以流動游擊對抗占據主要城市的MPLA。FNLA北部指揮官丹尼爾·奇佩恩達在1975年3月脫離該組織並率部加入MPLA，北線因此出現成建制轉投。葡方總理馬里奧·索雷斯與外長維托里諾·戈爾什維斯參與1月15日Alvor談判，但協議無法確保三支武裝共享指揮、糧餉和武器。菲德爾·卡斯楚在內圖請求後決定部署Carlota；首批古巴部隊先守住羅安達並打通中南部走廊，並非立即替MPLA控制全部國土。
dossier.peopleEn: Command during 1975 cannot be explained solely through the three top leaders; front-line commanders were equally important. Agostinho Neto, who headed the MPLA, centralized political leadership, military integration, and control of Luanda. FNLA leader Holden Roberto was often based in Congo and directed resources across the border, which could weaken the connection between the headquarters and forward commands. UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi made the central highlands the main theatre of operations, using mobile guerrilla warfare against an MPLA that occupied the principal cities. Daniel Chipenda, a senior FNLA commander in the north, left the organization with his troops in March 1975 and joined the MPLA, producing an organized transfer across the northern front. Portuguese prime minister Mário Soares and foreign minister Vítorino Gonçalves participated in the Alvor talks on 15 January, but the agreement could not ensure shared command, pay, and weapons among the three armed formations. Fidel Castro decided to deploy Operation Carlota after Neto's request. The initial Cuban mission was to hold Luanda and open a central-southern corridor, not to impose immediate MPLA control over the entire country.
dossier.kits: 1975年的作戰裝備橫跨葡萄牙、美國、中國、古巴與蘇聯供應鏈，不能用同一套武器描述三方。葡軍撤走後，HK G3步槍、FN FAL步槍、勃朗寧High Power手槍、7.62×51毫米北約彈及12.7毫米重機槍彈留在前葡軍庫房；MPLA使用的AK-47、PKM、RPG-7、SKS與82毫米迫擊砲則主要依賴7.62×39毫米彈。美國援助FNLA的M1卡賓槍和FNLA-4四輪驅動車，在北線快速機動中相當醒目；UNITA則使用中國援助的56式步槍、四輪驅動車和迫擊砲。古巴援軍可見T-34/85坦克、PT-76輕型坦克、BRDM-1裝甲車及ZU-23-2雙聯高射砲；南非Savannah部隊投入Eland-7裝甲車、Saracen裝甲運兵車與Alvis 6×6卡車。這些型號在1975年以前均已列裝，.30-06與上述數種步槍彈藥的供應是否同步，反而直接影響長距離作戰。
dossier.kitsEn: The equipment employed in 1975 came through Portuguese, American, Chinese, Cuban, and Soviet supply chains, so the three Angolan movements cannot be described with a single common inventory. After the Portuguese departure, former Portuguese depots contained HK G3 rifles, FN FAL rifles, Browning High Power pistols, 7.62×51 mm NATO ammunition, and 12.7 mm machine-gun ammunition. MPLA forces used AK-47 rifles, PKM machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, SKS rifles, and 82 mm mortars, principally with 7.62×39 mm ammunition. American aid gave the FNLA M1 carbines and FNLA-4 four-wheel-drive trucks, which were conspicuous during rapid operations in the north. UNITA used Chinese-supplied Type 56 rifles, four-wheel-drive vehicles, and mortars. Cuban forces brought T-34/85 tanks, PT-76 light tanks, BRDM-1 armored vehicles, and ZU-23-2 twin anti-aircraft guns. South African forces under Savannah employed Eland-7 armored cars, Saracen armored personnel carriers, and Alvis 6×6 trucks. All these models had entered service by 1975, and the availability of .30-06 and the different rifle-ammunition types directly affected the reach of sustained operations.
dossier.tactics: 戰法在葡殖民階段與1975年明顯不同。1961至1974年，MPLA及其他民族主義武裝以小隊伏擊道路與鐵路、襲擊稅站和孤立哨所，葡軍則依靠公路網、堡壘、空中與砲火支援及集中部隊封鎖。Alvor失效後，FNLA企圖以薩伊運來的卡車和機動步兵沿北部公路逼近羅安達，再威脅洛比托至內陸的Benguela鐵路；UNITA避開正面攻城，以Huambo、Bié和庫安戈班古為基地，襲擊MPLA側翼與交通線。古巴部隊在羅安達港集中後，以坦克支援步兵，優先打通Luanda—Malanje—Huambo公路與Lobito—Catumbela—Cubal—Caluquembe鐵路周邊；南非部隊則由納米比亞邊境推進，以Calulo為支撐，朝Cuito Cuanavale方向建立南線縱深。無論卡車縱隊或裝甲車團，都受道路承重、燃料、輪胎、備件、無線電中繼與故障回收限制；砲兵彈藥若不能同車隊抵達，前線火力便會在補給間隙迅速耗盡。
dossier.tacticsEn: Tactics during the colonial phase differed markedly from those of 1975. From 1961 to 1974, the MPLA and other nationalist organizations used small ambush teams against roads and railways, attacked tax posts, and isolated Portuguese sentries. The Portuguese relied on road networks, fortified positions, air and artillery support, and concentrated troop deployments. After Alvor became ineffective, the FNLA attempted to use trucks and motorized infantry brought through Zaire to advance along northern roads toward Luanda and threaten the Benguela Railway between Lobito and the interior. UNITA avoided frontal assaults on major cities and used Huambo, Bié, and Cuando Cubango as bases from which to strike MPLA flanks and transport routes. Cuban forces concentrated at Luanda harbor and used their tanks to support infantry, prioritizing the Luanda–Malanje–Huambo road and the Lobito–Catumbela–Cubal–Caluquembe railway corridor. South African troops advanced from the Namibian border, used Calulo as a support point, and built depth toward Cuito Cuanavale. Truck columns and armored formations were constrained by road bearing, fuel, tires, spare parts, radio relay, and recovery requirements. If artillery ammunition did not move with the column, forward firepower could be exhausted during the interval between resupply.
dossier.data: 按日期核對，1961年2月4日北起義與羅安達監獄突擊拉開獨立戰爭；FNLA在1961年成立，UNITA在1966年成立，兩者與MPLA的分裂不是1975年才出現。1974年4月25日葡萄牙康乃馨革命後，里斯本接受撤出殖民戰爭。1975年1月15日簽署的Alvor Agreement原設計三支武裝各六千人、合共一萬八千人的統合部隊與政治過渡，但1月27日葡萄牙最後部隊撤出羅安達後，紙面統合很快瓦解。2至3月奇佩恩達脫離FNLA，北線出現整批轉投；4至8月，MPLA在Lunda Norte、Malanje及Lobito—Catumbela—Cubal—Caluquembe沿線反覆爭奪，FNLA由薩伊邊境施壓，UNITA從尚比亞進入內陸，兩組織有時協同、有時也爭奪據點。9至10月南非越過納米比亞邊境並展開Savannah；11月11日MPLA宣告建國，11月中旬首批古巴部隊抵達，11月19日Carlota正式展開。12月MPLA與古巴部隊鞏固羅安達並把FNLA逐離首都接近區；UNITA仍在內陸保持野戰力量，Alvor所訂選舉未舉行。
dossier.dataEn: The chronology begins on 4 February 1961, when the northern uprising and the attack on the Luanda prison opened the independence war. The FNLA was formed in 1961 and UNITA in 1966, so the divisions with the MPLA did not first appear in 1975. After Portugal's Carnation Revolution on 25 April 1974, Lisbon accepted an end to the colonial war. The Alvor Agreement, signed on 15 January 1975, envisioned an integrated force of 6,000 men from each movement, for a total of 18,000, together with a political transition. After the last Portuguese troops left Luanda on 27 January, however, the paper integration rapidly broke down. Chipenda left the FNLA between February and March, taking an organized body of troops with him. From April through August, the MPLA repeatedly contested Lunda Norte, Malanje, and the Lobito–Catumbela–Cubal–Caluquembe corridor, while the FNLA pressed from the Zaire frontier and UNITA entered the interior from Zambia. The FNLA and UNITA sometimes coordinated but also competed for positions. South African forces crossed the Namibian border and expanded Operation Savannah between September and October. The MPLA declared independence on 11 November; the first Cuban troops arrived in mid-November; and Carlota formally began on 19 November. During December, MPLA and Cuban forces consolidated Luanda and drove the FNLA away from the approaches to the capital. UNITA retained field forces in the interior, and the elections prescribed by Alvor were never held.
dossier.cause: 1975年內戰的直接起點，是葡萄牙在殖民戰爭尚未結束時突然失去戰鬥意願，政治權力卻沒有交到任何單一安哥拉組織手中。Alvor把選舉、軍隊整編、總統過渡與葡軍撤退寫在同一框架內，卻低估三方彼此的不信任：MPLA要求中央國家機關，FNLA要求北部影響力與軍事配給，UNITA拒絕把游擊隊伍交給一個自己不控制的統合司令部。紙面一萬八千人的規模也無法消化各地既有武裝與據點。外部援助早於葡萄牙退場便已存在；撤軍後，美國、薩伊、古巴、蘇聯、中國與南非分別強化各自支持的陣線，使原本可由葡軍集中反制的戰線變成長期代理衝突。道路、海港與Benguela鐵路決定部隊能否持續作戰，因此控制補給軸線與占據城市同樣成為爭奪中心。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate cause of the 1975 civil war was Portugal's sudden loss of willingness to continue the colonial war while political authority was transferred to none of the Angolan organizations. Alvor placed elections, military integration, a presidential transition, and Portuguese withdrawal within a single framework, but it underestimated the distrust among the three parties. The MPLA sought control of the central state institutions; the FNLA demanded influence and military allocations in the north; UNITA refused to place its guerrilla forces under an integrated command it would not control. The planned force of 18,000 men could not absorb the established formations and positions already held in different regions. Foreign assistance existed before Portugal withdrew, but afterward support from the United States, Zaire, Cuba, the Soviet Union, China, and South Africa reinforced separate aligned forces. Fronts that Portugal could previously contain with concentrated counterinsurgency forces became a prolonged proxy conflict. Roads, ports, and the Benguela Railway determined whether troops could remain supplied, making control of transport corridors as important as control of cities.
dossier.impact: 1975年最重要的結構性影響，是MPLA從一個戰區力量變成掌握國家首都、行政機構與外交身分的一方。羅安達一旦失守，MPLA的北部補給與外部援助管道便會同時中斷；保住羅安達及Lobito鐵路關鍵段，則讓MPLA能持續把外來武器轉成前沿戰力。古巴以Carlota直接出兵，南非以Savannah直接出兵，使安哥拉不再只是三個本地組織的競爭，而成為古巴、蘇聯、美國、南非、薩伊及尚比亞政策交錯的戰場。這種介入也把1975年的兵運推到機械化階段：裝甲車需要長距離公路縱隊，步兵需要集中火力與定點補給，後勤線一旦遭切斷，進攻速度便迅速下降。外交承認、港口使用與軍事物資流向從此高度連動，促使之後數年的內戰維持高強度，而1975年形成的對外連結並未因任何一次進攻而消失。
dossier.impactEn: The most important structural consequence of 1975 was the MPLA's transformation from a regional movement into the force controlling the national capital, administrative institutions, and diplomatic identity. Losing Luanda would have cut both MPLA northern supply routes and its external aid channels. Holding Luanda and critical sections of the Lobito railway allowed the MPLA to convert foreign weapons into combat power at the front. Cuba entered directly through Carlota, while South Africa entered through Savannah. Angola was therefore no longer a contest confined to three local organizations; it became a theatre where Cuban, Soviet, American, South African, Zairian, and Zambian policies intersected. This intervention also pushed 1975 logistics toward a mechanized scale. Armored formations required long road columns, infantry required concentrated firepower and fixed supply points, and an interrupted logistics route could rapidly reduce the speed of advance. Diplomatic recognition, access to ports, and weapons flows became closely connected, helping sustain the high intensity of the conflict in subsequent years. The external links established in 1975 did not disappear after any single offensive.
dossier.result: 就1975年度戰役而言，葡萄牙在羅安達的實際殖民控制已告終結，MPLA保住首都、國家機關與沿海若干關鍵補給點，並以11月11日建國宣言取得國家代表性。FNLA在北線的攻勢受挫，被迫退向北部及邊緣地帶；UNITA沒有被消滅，仍在中部與南部內陸維持成建制力量。古巴Carlota與南非Savannah也從緊急或有限介入，轉為長期軍事存在的開端。因此，1975的勝負不是整場內戰的和平終點：MPLA取得的是執政與持續作戰能力，FNLA和UNITA仍有再戰餘力。整場安哥拉內戰直到2002年4月4日Luena備忘錄達成政治與軍事安排，才進入最終終局。
dossier.resultEn: For the 1975 campaign, Portugal's effective colonial control of Luanda had ended. The MPLA retained the capital, the state institutions, and several critical coastal supply points, and its declaration on 11 November gave it national representation. The FNLA's northern offensive was checked and its forces withdrew toward peripheral and northern areas. UNITA was not eliminated and continued to maintain organized forces in the central and southern interior. Cuban Operation Carlota and South African Operation Savannah also developed from urgent or limited interventions into the beginning of lasting military involvement. The outcome of 1975 was therefore not a peaceful conclusion to the entire civil war. The MPLA gained the ability to govern and continue fighting, while the FNLA and UNITA retained the capacity to resume operations. The full Angolan Civil War reached its final settlement only on 4 April 2002, when the Luena Memorandum established a political and military arrangement.

battle.name: 烏干達-坦桑尼亞戰爭
battle.brief: 烏干達-坦桑尼亞戰爭是中文維基戰爭列表所列的1978年衝突，烏干達越境進入坦桑尼亞卡蓋拉地區，雙方在邊境據點及道路交戰。坦桑尼亞地面力量使用中國Type 59中型坦克，此型車於1959年已在中國人民解放軍服役，屬裝甲部隊作戰裝備。

kit.name: 59式中型坦克
kit.history: 中國人民解放軍機械化步兵師與裝甲師的主力中型坦克，承擔機動作戰、火力支援及反裝甲任務，並作為友好國家裝甲部隊的制式裝備。

dossier.countries: 這場戰爭的地理主軸，是維多利亞湖東岸的卡蓋拉河邊境，以及由坦桑尼亞西北部通往烏干達西南部的走廊。姆萬扎、穆圖庫拉、布科巴、魯昆吉里、姆巴拉拉、卡巴萊、堡壘門、恩特貝與坎帕拉，構成戰役由西向東推進的 主要道路與補給節點。交戰雙方一方是由姆萬扎及布科巴方向展開作戰的坦桑尼亞人民國防軍，另一方是最初越過卡蓋拉河進入坦桑尼亞、其後依托烏干達西部城鎮防守的烏干達軍隊。贊比亞不是主要陸戰交戰方，但提供空軍與政治支援，使坦方能從西側牽制烏軍。坎帕拉雖距邊境較遠，卻因它是烏軍西部戰區的後方中樞而成為雙方必爭之地。
dossier.countriesEn: The geographical axis of the war ran along the Kagera River border beside Lake Victoria and along the corridor leading from northwestern Tanzania into southwestern Uganda. Mwanza, Mutukula, Bukoba, Rukungiri, Mbarara, Kabale, Fort Portal, Entebbe, and Kampala formed the principal road and supply nodes of an operation generally advancing from west to east. One belligerent was the Tanzanian People's Defence Force, operating from the Mwanza and Bukoba directions. The other was the Ugandan army, which initially crossed the Kagera River into Tanzania and later defended positions around the western towns of Uganda. Zambia was not a principal ground belligerent, but it provided air support and political backing, allowing Tanzanian forces to apply pressure from the western side. Although Kampala lay some distance beyond the frontier, it was the logistical center behind the Ugandan western operations and therefore became indispensable to both sides.
dossier.people: 艾達·艾敏既是烏干達總統，也是武裝力量最高指揮者；他已自任陸軍元帥，直接決定向鄰國用兵及集中西部兵力。坦桑尼亞總統朱利葉斯·克洛維爾·尼埃雷把迫使艾敏下台列為政治目標，不過坦方戰地最高指揮通常被戰史列為約瑟夫·基戈尼亞將軍，他負責協調最初攻勢與後續縱隊。烏方第四師指揮沙班·奧皮約少將負責西部主要戰區，但随着部隊離逃、指揮關係鬆散，其協調能力迅速下降。贊比亞總統肯尼思·卡翁達批准跨境航空支援，與坦方形成作戰配合。艾敏出走後，流亡政治領袖優素福·盧萊及戈德貝拉·姆旺加先後成為新政權核心；鐵托則在戰役末期收留艾敏。這些政治人物介入的是國家決策與戰後安排，真正執行 Tactical 指揮者則是雙方陸軍指揮官。
dossier.peopleEn: Idi Amin was both president of Uganda and commander in chief of its armed forces. Having proclaimed himself field marshal, he personally decided to use force against a neighboring state and to concentrate Uganda's western forces. Tanzanian president Julius Klover Nyerere made the removal of Amin a political objective, although General Joseph Kigonya is generally identified in campaign histories as the principal Tanzanian field commander responsible for coordinating the initial attack and the later columns. Major General Shaban Opiyo commanded Uganda's Fourth Division in the main western theater, but his ability to coordinate declined rapidly as units deserted and command relations loosened. Zambian president Kenneth Kaunda authorized cross-border air support in cooperation with Tanzania. After Amin left Uganda, the exiled political leaders Yusuf Lule and Godbera Mwanga successively became central to the new government, while Tito provided refuge to Amin near the end of the episode. These political figures shaped state decisions and the postwar settlement; actual tactical command remained in the hands of the armies' professional commanders.
dossier.kits: 截至1978年，坦方確有中國製Type 59主戰戰車，其主砲為100公釐，另有12.7公釐機槍；烏方西部序列則可見蘇聯製T-34-85及T-54、T-55戰車，分別使用85公釐與115公釐砲彈。坦方122公厘Type 204榴砲及烏方122公厘D-30式榴砲都是當時已列裝的火砲體系，82公厘迫擊砲、PKM通用機槍、AK-47或AKM步槍、RPG-7火箭筒及DShK重機槍則構成兩軍基層火力。開戰初期有坦方福加CM.11輕型噴氣機執行低空近距支援的記錄，贊比亞MiG-21則負責較高空的攻擊與掩護，但各機出擊架次及命中效果並不完整。彈藥消耗方面可確認口徑和供應來源，卻沒有可靠資料可列出各型剩餘量。Type 59所需柴油、100公厘砲彈、122公厘砲彈及備件，均須經公路與轉運維持，不能只按戰車出動數推算實際作戰週轉。
dossier.kitsEn: By 1978, Tanzania genuinely fielded Chinese Type 59 main battle tanks with a 100 mm gun and a 12.7 mm machine gun, while photographs and records of the Ugandan western order of battle show Soviet T-34-85, T-54, and T-55 tanks using 85 mm and 115 mm ammunition. Tanzania's 122 mm Type 204 howitzers and Uganda's 122 mm D-30 howitzers belonged to artillery systems already in service at the time. An 82 mm mortar, PKM general-purpose machine gun, AK-47 or AKM rifle, RPG-7 launcher, and DShK heavy machine gun formed the basic infantry firepower of both armies. Records place Tanzanian Fouga CM.11 jet aircraft in low-level close-support work during the opening phase, while Zambian MiG-21s provided higher-altitude attack and cover, although the sortie counts and effects were not fully documented. Calibers and supply origins can be established with confidence, but reliable figures for remaining ammunition stocks are unavailable. Diesel fuel, 100 mm tank rounds, 122 mm projectiles, and spare parts for the Type 59 had to be sustained by road and transfer services; operational turnover cannot be calculated merely from the number of tanks dispatched.
dossier.tactics: 1978年10月30日夜至31日，駐紮烏干達西南邊境的部隊越過卡蓋拉河，攻取穆圖庫拉附近據點，並沿公路向姆萬扎方向探進；坦方地方邊防營先以觀察哨、封鎖路口及分散撤退阻止其擴張，再集中砲兵與戰車反擊。11月1日至3日，穆圖庫拉一帶反覆易手，最後由坦方控制邊境據點，烏方退回河對岸。進入11月後，戰線沿卡蓋拉河固定下來，雙方以河川渡口、公路側翼、砲兵陣地和巡邏隊反覆交戰，坦方則從姆萬扎及布科巴方向補充師級部隊。1979年2月22日前後，坦軍以多點渡河及步兵密集突擊突破邊防，中央縱隊經魯昆吉里向姆巴拉拉推進，另一縱隊經卡巴萊、堡壘門方向切斷烏軍後路；以基桑加支隊為核心的機動分隊則繞開部分受阻路段，迅速向恩特貝及坎帕拉西側推進。烏軍在姆巴拉拉失守後失去成建制防守節點，坦軍因道路泥濘、燃料與後方縱隊距離而不能全速追擊。4月底，坦軍已進入坎帕拉外圍；艾敏於4月13日先赴利比亞，5月4日短暫返國後再次離開。5月3日，坦軍進入坎帕拉，但納基武布、金亞、穆科諾及坎帕拉周邊仍有烏方據點作戰。坦方進行有限的城市清剿後，於6月初開始分批撤退，戰役沒有演變成長期軍事占領。
dossier.tacticsEn: On the night of 30 October and during 31 October 1978, Uganda's western border force crossed the Kagera River, seized positions around Mutukula, and pushed along the road toward Mwanza. Tanzanian local defense battalions initially delayed the advance with observation posts, blocked junctions, and dispersed withdrawals before concentrating artillery and tanks for a counterattack. Mutukula changed hands repeatedly from 1 to 3 November, after which Tanzania held the frontier positions and Uganda withdrew across the river. During November the front stabilized along the Kagera, with both sides fighting over crossings, road flanks, gun positions, and patrols while Tanzania reinforced the western theater from Mwanza and Bukoba. Around 22 February 1979, Tanzanian forces broke through by crossing at several points and concentrating infantry for repeated attacks. The central column advanced through Rukungiri toward Mbarara, while another force pressed through Kabale and Fort Portal to threaten Uganda's rear routes. A mobile group centered on the Kisanga Brigade bypassed blocked sections and moved rapidly toward Entebbe and western Kampala. After Mbarara fell, the Ugandan army lost its principal coherent defense node, but Tanzanian pursuit was limited by mud, fuel supply, and the distance behind the leading columns. By late April the Tanzanian force was outside Kampala. Amin left for Libya on 13 April and briefly returned on 4 May before departing again. Tanzanian troops entered Kampala on 3 May, although Ugandan positions around Nakivubo, Jinja, Mukono, and the metropolitan perimeter continued to resist. After limited clearing operations, Tanzania began a phased withdrawal in early June rather than converting the campaign into a prolonged military occupation.
dossier.data: 可核對的時間節點如下：10月30日至31日是烏方越境與坦方反攻的起點，11月1日至3日為穆圖庫拉戰鬥，11月至翌年2月主要是卡蓋拉河沿線的消耗戰，2月22日前後展開總攻，2月底至3月上旬姆巴拉拉控制權轉移，4月13日艾敏首次離境，4月底坦軍威脅坎帕拉西側，5月3日坦軍進入首都，5月至6月初則處理納基武布、金亞及坎帕拉外圍的零散抵抗。公開作戰序列常列坦方第二十三、第二十五、第二十六步兵師等部，以及後來集中使用的基桑加支隊；烏方則以第四師、第九師和第十一旅等部為主。不同戰史因增援、臨時編組及指揮隸屬變動，對兵力和營級配置並不一致。坦方初期投入數千人的邊防攻勢，攻入烏境後常被概括為一萬至兩萬兵力；烏方西部可用兵力則多被估在數千至一萬餘之間。物資由達累斯薩拉姆經公路送到姆萬扎，再以卡車、渡船及河上轉運接上布科巴與前線。兩軍傷亡總數沒有完整且一致的原始統計，本實錄因此不列出任何精確死亡、重傷或失聯人數。
dossier.dataEn: The verifiable chronology is as follows: 30 to 31 October marked the Ugandan crossing and Tanzanian counterattack; 1 to 3 November saw the fighting for Mutukula; November through February consisted mainly of attritional combat along the Kagera; a general offensive opened around 22 February; control of Mbarara shifted between late February and early March; Amin first left the country on 13 April; Tanzanian forces threatened western Kampala by late April; Tanzanian troops entered the capital on 3 May; and isolated resistance around Nakivubo, Jinja, and the metropolitan perimeter continued through May and early June. Published orders of battle commonly identify Tanzanian 23rd, 25th, and 26th Infantry Divisions and other formations, together with the later concentration of the Kisanga Brigade. Uganda's western force was built around the Fourth and Ninth Divisions and the Eleventh Brigade, among others. Histories differ over strength and battalion-level assignments because of reinforcements, temporary groupings, and changes in command. The initial Tanzanian border assault involved several thousand troops, while forces committed before the advance on Kampala are commonly summarized as between 10,000 and 20,000; available Ugandan western strength is usually estimated from several thousand to somewhat over 10,000. Supplies moved by road from Dar es Salaam to Mwanza, then by truck, ferry, and river transfer toward Bukoba and the front. No complete, consistent original totals exist for killed, wounded, or missing on either side, so this account quotes no exact casualty figure.
dossier.cause: 衝突根源不是單一邊界測量錯誤，而是邊界問題、艾敏政權與尼埃雷的敵對，以及雙方軍事互信崩潰的累積結果。卡蓋拉河部分河段與附近島嶼在殖民時期留下的界線並不完全清楚，河道變化和兩國實際控制也曾造成爭議。1971年艾敏掌權後，支持烏干達流亡政治及武裝力量的尼埃雷與艾敏逐漸決裂；艾敏方面指控坦桑尼亞庇護反對者，坦方則要求停止跨境支持與邊境軍事挑釁。1978年，烏軍駐防分散、士氣不穩和指揮問題已使艾敏急於用一次邊境行動扭轉局勢，遂批准向坦方進攻。坦桑尼亞則把這次進攻視為無法再容忍的威脅，並把迫使艾敏下台列為公開目標。贊比亞的加入不是新產生的基本原因，而是區域國家共同支持反艾敏行動的結果。
dossier.causeEn: The conflict did not arise from one isolated surveying error. It was the accumulated result of a frontier dispute, the enmity between Amin's government and Nyerere, and the collapse of military trust between the two states. Sections of the Kagera River and nearby islands had inherited ambiguous colonial boundary arrangements, while changes in the rivercourse and actual control had created further friction. After Amin came to power in 1971, his relationship with Nyerere deteriorated because Nyerere supported Ugandan exiled political and armed groups. Amin's side accused Tanzania of sheltering opponents, while Tanzania demanded an end to cross-border support and military provocation. By 1978, poor deployment, declining cohesion, and command problems made Amin anxious to reverse his position through a limited border operation, leading him to approve the attack into Tanzania. Tanzania treated the move as an intolerable threat and openly made the removal of Amin a political objective. Zambia's involvement was not the original cause but the result of a regional alignment supporting the action against Amin.
dossier.impact: 最直接的軍事影響，是烏干達西部野戰部隊失去完整作戰能力。第四師及第九師等部在邊境退卻、指揮崩解與部隊轉向之後，無法重新組成有效防線，首都與西部後方因此直接暴露於坦軍推進之下。艾敏政府的政治控制也在戰爭最後階段解體，坦軍進入坎帕拉後，支持流亡政治組合的新政府逐步接替舊政權。這場勝利提高了坦桑尼亞在維多利亞湖區的軍事投射能力，也顯示贊比亞能以航空支援介入鄰國衝突；但坦方沒有合併烏干達或永久控制卡蓋拉河，也沒有以戰爭正式解決全部邊界問題。烏干達軍隊雖遭重創，新政府後來仍須整编、補充裝備並處理不同軍事派系，顯示推翻艾敏不等於軍隊問題立即消失。兩國因此獲得共同的安全經驗，卻未因此建立能自動防止下一次邊境摩擦的機制。
dossier.impactEn: The most direct military effect was the loss of coherent combat power by Uganda's western field forces. After the withdrawal from the frontier, the breakdown of command, and growing desertions, formations such as the Fourth and Ninth Divisions could no longer reconstruct an effective defensive line, leaving the capital and western rear areas exposed to Tanzanian advance. Amin's political control also disintegrated during the final phase. After Tanzanian forces entered Kampala, a new government supported by exiled political factions progressively replaced the old regime. The campaign increased Tanzania's ability to project military power around the Lake Victoria region and demonstrated that Zambia could intervene in a neighboring conflict through air support. Tanzania nevertheless did not annex Uganda, establish permanent control of the Kagera River, or formally settle every boundary issue through force. Although the Ugandan army was badly weakened, the new government still had to reorganize formations, replace equipment, and manage competing military factions. The fall of Amin therefore did not instantly solve the armed forces' institutional problems. The two states gained a shared security experience, but that experience did not create a mechanism capable of automatically preventing another frontier dispute.
dossier.result: 戰術上，坦桑尼亞在穆圖庫拉、姆巴拉拉及通往坎帕拉的西部走廊取得主動權，最終迫使烏方主力放棄完整陣地；五月三日進入坎帕拉後，又逐步處理納基武布與周邊據點。政治上，艾敏第一次出國後雖短暫返回，五月初卻永久失去國內控制權，優素福·盧萊及戈德貝拉·姆旺加先後進入新政權。坦方沒有另建長期占领政府，也沒有吞併烏干達國土；六月三日戰役通常被視為結束日期之後，部隊分批撤出，至六月上旬才完成主要離境行動。卡蓋拉河沿線的實際控制大致回復戰前狀態，邊界爭議則沒有因這次戰爭而全部解決。因此，結果是坦桑尼亞完成有限政治與軍事目標、烏干達舊政府垮台，而坦軍最終退出，而不是一方永久消滅另一方軍隊或取得永久領土。
dossier.resultEn: Tactically, Tanzania gained the initiative at Mutukula and Mbarara and along the western corridor to Kampala, eventually forcing the principal Ugandan formations to give up coherent positions. After entering Kampala on 3 May, Tanzanian forces progressively reduced the remaining positions at Nakivubo and around the metropolitan area. Politically, although Amin briefly returned after leaving the country for the first time, he permanently lost domestic control in early May. Yusuf Lule and Godbera Mwanga subsequently entered the new government. Tanzania did not establish a prolonged occupation government or annex Ugandan territory. After 3 June, conventionally treated as the end of the war, its forces withdrew in phases, with the principal departure completed during early June. Actual control along the Kagera broadly returned to the prewar pattern, and the war did not fully resolve every boundary dispute. The result was therefore a limited Tanzanian political and military objective achieved, the collapse of Amin's government, and a Tanzanian withdrawal, rather than the permanent destruction of one army or the acquisition of lasting territory.

battle.name: 中越戰爭
battle.brief: 中越戰爭於一九七九年二月爆發，中國人民解放軍與越南人民軍在中國與越南邊境地區交戰。人民空軍投入殲-6戰鬥機執行制空、攔截與空域防衛任務；此型機早於本輪衝突列裝，並在交戰期間實際參與邊境空防作戰，是人民空軍作戰體系中承擔攔截任務的早期噴氣式戰鬥機。

kit.name: 殲-6戰鬥機
kit.history: 殲-6是人民空軍早期的主力制空戰鬥機，主要承擔高空攔截與空域防衛任務，並與其他戰鬥機共同構成邊境方向的空中防線。

dossier.countries: 中越戰爭的交戰國是中華人民共和國與越南社會主義共和國。1979年2月17日開始的攻勢並非沿一條連續戰線展開：中國在廣西軍區方向由南寧指向諒山、高平及邊境要地，在雲南軍區方向由河口、紅河兩側的老街與西北山地指向萊州方向。中國以軍、集團軍、師及直屬支援部隊分路作戰；越南則以北部的諒山、高平主要作戰區和南部的老街方向互相連通，以河內為縱深，調集步兵師、邊防部隊與預備隊。蘇聯是越南的主要武器供應方，但地面戰的實際交戰者仍是中國與越南軍隊。
dossier.countriesEn: The belligerents in the Sino-Vietnamese War were the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The offensive launched on 17 February 1979 did not unfold along one continuous front. In the Guangxi Military Region, Chinese forces advanced from Nanning toward Lạng Sơn, Cao Bằng, and other border strongpoints. In the Yunnan Military Region, they moved from Hekou, from the Lao Cai area and the northwestern highlands on both sides of the Red River, toward the L.ai Châu area. China committed armies, army groups, divisions, and directly attached support units on separate axes. Vietnam connected the principal northern theaters at Lạng Sơn and Cao Bằng with the southern axis around Lào Cai, used Hà Nội as its strategic depth, and committed infantry divisions, border troops, and reserve formations. The Soviet Union was Vietnam's principal supplier of weapons, but the actual ground combatants were the forces of China and Vietnam.
dossier.people: 關鍵決策與指揮分屬不同層級。中共中央政治局核心鄧小平主持作出並推動出兵決定，具體作戰由解放軍總參謀部、廣西軍區和雲南軍區組織。廣西方向由徐世友任軍區司令員、楊得志任政委，五十五軍集團系統內的四十一軍等部擔負高平、諒山方向的主要攻擊；雲南方向由熊克武任司令員、張愛萍任政委，十四軍集團統籌，三十九軍等部隊投入紅河與老街方向。越南方面，由總參謀長文進勇統籌全國防務調度，黎仲謙、黃文祿等指揮官參與前線兵力和火力運用，並把四十三步兵師部署於諒山，與北部邊防部隊及後續調來的師、旅共同構成縱深。中越兩軍的指揮差異，在很大程度上表現為中國集中兵員與重火器速攻，越南則強調固定陣地、縱深預備隊和戰術反擊。
dossier.peopleEn: The decisive political decisions and operational command operated at different levels. Deng Xiaoping, the central figure of the Politburo, chaired and drove the decision to launch the campaign, while field operations were organized by the PLA General Staff and the Guangxi and Yunnan military regions. In Guangxi, Xu Shiyou was military-region commander and Yang Dezhi was political commissar. Formations under the 55th Army Group, including the 41st Army, carried the principal attacks toward Cao Bằng and Lạng Sơn. In Yunnan, Xiong Kewu was commander and Zhang Aiping was political commissar; the 14th Army Group coordinated operations, with the 39th Army and other formations committed around the Red River and Lào Cai. On the Vietnamese side, Chief of the General Staff Văn Tiến Dũng directed nationwide military movements, while commanders such as Lê Trọng Tấn and Hoàng Văn Lương helped manage frontline troops and fire support. The 43rd Infantry Division was deployed at Lạng Sơn and formed part of a depth structure that also included northern border troops and divisions and brigades brought forward from elsewhere. The contrast between the commands appeared chiefly in Chinese concentration of manpower and heavy firepower for rapid attacks and Vietnamese reliance on fortified positions, operational reserves, and tactical counterattacks.
dossier.kits: 裝備上的核心差距是中國的集中火力與越南的防禦工具。中國步兵大量使用56式自動步槍，標準小口徑彈藥為7.62×39毫米，並配備82毫米迫擊炮；炮兵大量使用63式130毫米野戰砲或榴彈砲，坦克支援主要依靠59式坦克，後方還有汽車、拖車、搶修車和通信車。越南步兵常見AK-47自動步槍、PKM通用機槍及RPG-7火箭筒，反坦克和封鎖道路的任務多由步兵、炮兵及工兵協同完成；炮兵使用蘇制D-30 122毫米野戰砲、M-46 130毫米榴彈砲，裝甲力量包括T-54坦克、PT-76兩棲坦克及BTR-50裝甲輸送車。空軍方面，中國可投入J-6戰鬥機和A-5攻擊機，越南則使用MiG-21與Su-7執行攔截或對地攻擊。7.62毫米步槍彈、迫擊炮彈、122與130毫米炮彈均需由後方運至前線。道路狹窄使雙方都必須設立分段前進彈藥庫，以車輛运送燃油，再以軍隊和畜力向山地搬運；因此，任何深入數十公里的部隊都會拉長補給線，坦克也不能脫離工兵整理的道路或橋梁。
dossier.kitsEn: The principal equipment contrast was China's concentration of firepower against Vietnam's defensive tools. Chinese infantry extensively used the Type 56 assault rifle firing 7.62×39 mm ammunition and employed 82 mm mortars. Their artillery included large numbers of Type 63 130 mm field guns or howitzers, while armored support centered on Type 59 tanks; trucks, trailers, recovery vehicles, and communications vehicles supported these formations. Vietnamese infantry commonly carried AK-47 assault rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, and RPG-7 rocket launchers, with antiarmor and road-blocking tasks conducted jointly by infantry, artillery, and engineers. Vietnamese artillery included Soviet D-30 122 mm field guns and M-46 130 mm howitzers, while armored forces fielded T-54 tanks, PT-76 amphibious tanks, and BTR-50 armored personnel carriers. In the air, China could employ J-6 fighters and A-5 attack aircraft, while Vietnam used MiG-21 and Su-7 fighters for interception or ground attack. Rifle ammunition, mortar bombs, and 122 mm and 130 mm artillery shells all had to be carried forward from the rear. Because the roads were narrow, both sides established supply points in stages, moved fuel by truck, and relied on troops and animal transport to carry supplies into the mountains. Any formation advancing dozens of kilometers lengthened its supply route, and tanks could not leave roads and bridges cleared by engineers.
dossier.tactics: 2月17日凌晨，中國各路先以130毫米砲、迫擊炮及部分航空兵力壓制越軍陣地，再由工兵處理路障，步兵以班、排為單位沿山脊、林地和溪谷分進，奪取能觀察射界及控制道路的高地；坦克則在步兵之間沿主要道路推進。北線四十一軍等部在Bô Cô河多處架橋渡河，於2月18日進入並控制高平，後續部隊再向諒山方向展開；南線三十九軍等部則在Manhao及鄰近渡口渡過紅河，以59式坦克和步兵共同向寶獵方向推進。越南沒有始終維持一條平直防線，而是把陣地配置在山脊、路口和城鎮外围，以交叉砲火及反坦克小組封鎖道路；諒山的四十三步兵師利用既有陣地阻止中國部隊繼續越過南部高地。越南預備隊和邊防部隊曾對戰線兩翼實施夜間反擊，老街與寶獵方向也出現反覆爭奪，砲兵則打擊對方集結地、彈藥庫和道路樞紐。到2月下旬，中國攻勢普遍縮短，部队轉為控制已奪高地並保護縱深補給線；越南則一面鞏固諒山等關鍵地區，一面準備在中國撤軍時追擊和收復失地。
dossier.tacticsEn: In the early hours of 17 February, Chinese formations opened with 130 mm artillery, mortars, and air support to suppress Vietnamese positions. Engineers then cleared obstacles, while infantry squads and platoons advanced in separated groups along ridges, wooded slopes, and streams to seize high ground that provided observation and controlled roads. Tanks moved along the main routes between the infantry. In the north, the 41st Army and other formations bridged several points across the Bô Cô River, entered and controlled Cao Bằng on 18 February, and then expanded toward Lạng Sơn. In the south, the 39th Army and other units crossed the Red River at Manhao and nearby crossing points, using Type 59 tanks and infantry together as they advanced toward Bảo Lộc. Vietnam did not maintain one straight defensive line throughout. It placed positions on ridges, at road junctions, and around the approaches to towns, using intersecting artillery fire and antiarmor teams to close routes. The 43rd Infantry Division at Lạng Sơn used prepared positions to stop Chinese forces from advancing beyond the southern heights. Vietnamese reserves and border troops conducted nighttime counterattacks against the flanks, while fighting repeatedly shifted around Lào Cai and Bảo Lộc. Artillery struck opposing assembly areas, ammunition depots, and road hubs. By late February, Chinese attacks generally shortened, and their units shifted toward holding captured heights and protecting longitudinal supply routes. Vietnam consolidated positions around Lạng Sơn and other key areas while preparing to pursue and recover lost ground during the Chinese withdrawal.
dossier.data: 時間上，邊境射擊在1979年1月已持續發生；北京於2月16日發出最後外交照會，攻勢在2月17日展開，3月5日宣布撤軍，至3月16日全部離開越南境內，因此涵蓋二十八個日曆日。常見兵力資料把中國投入概括為約二十二萬名作戰及支援人員、十二個師和約五百門火砲；越方常見估計則為三萬至五萬名投入作戰的正規軍，另有邊防、警衛及後續部隊。邊境戰線約五百公里，但多數師的實際推進只有一至數十公里，攻擊重點集中在少數口岸、道路樞紐和山脊。傷亡資料受陣亡確認、受傷治療、失聯追補及統計時點影響，中方公開數字與越方宣稱差異很大；較可靠的概括只是雙方都有數千至數萬量級的死亡，因此不採用任何單一精確總數。
dossier.dataEn: Border exchanges had already been occurring during January 1979. Beijing issued its final diplomatic note on 16 February, the offensive began on 17 February, withdrawal was announced on 5 March, and the last Chinese troops left Vietnamese territory on 16 March, producing a campaign spanning twenty-eight calendar days. Frequently cited strength estimates summarize the Chinese commitment as approximately 220,000 combat and support personnel from twelve divisions, together with about 500 artillery pieces. Common Vietnamese estimates place the number of regular troops committed at between 30,000 and 50,000, in addition to border, guard, and follow-on formations. The border theater extended for roughly 500 kilometers, but most divisions advanced only between one and several tens of kilometers. Fighting concentrated on a limited number of crossings, road junctions, and ridges. Casualty figures vary because of differences in confirmation of deaths, treatment of wounded, recovery of the missing, and the date of each count. Chinese public figures and Vietnamese claims differ substantially, so the defensible generalization is that both sides suffered deaths numbering in the thousands to tens of thousands. No single precise total is therefore adopted.
dossier.cause: 戰爭不是由單一事件引發，而是長期邊界爭端、軍事姿態與1978年後區域變化累積而成。中越邊境若干地段一直存在界碑位置、巡邏範圍及武裝力量部署的爭議，1978至1979年間的交火又使彼此都提高戒備。1978年越南出兵柬埔寨、推翻赤柬並在北部邊境擴軍；北京擔心蘇聯武器與蘇越軍事合作會使雲南和廣西方向受包圍，同時把越軍進入邊境地帶及零星襲擾視為直接威脅。越南則認為中國在邊境大規模集兵、進行炮擊與前沿部署，自身只是在保衛受到接觸的陣地。1979年1月雙方砲戰升級，2月7日前後天保等中國邊防點遭攻擊或射擊，成為近距離衝突的導火線之一。2月16日北京發出最後照會，翌日凌晨中國軍隊展開攻勢。中方把目的限定在邊境防衛與懲罰越方邊境行動，越方則把全軍迎戰描述抵抗入侵；兩種官方敘事不同，但直接成因而確是邊境火力、陣地與部隊控制權的即時衝突。
dossier.causeEn: The war was not triggered by a single incident. It resulted from the accumulation of long-running border disputes, military postures, and regional changes after 1978. Several stretches of the Sino-Vietnamese frontier had long involved disputes over boundary-marker positions, patrol zones, and armed deployments, and fighting during 1978 and 1979 increased mutual readiness. In 1978, Vietnam entered Cambodia, overthrew the Khmer Rouge, and expanded its northern border presence. Beijing feared that Soviet weapons and the expanding Soviet-Vietnamese military relationship would encircle Yunnan and Guangxi, while also treating Vietnamese movements into the border zone and isolated attacks as direct threats. Vietnam, conversely, regarded the Chinese troop concentration, artillery exchanges, and forward deployments as offensive preparations and considered that its forces were defending positions that had been contacted. Artillery exchanges intensified in January 1979, and attacks or firing against Chinese border posts including Tianbao around 7 February became an immediate trigger for close combat. Beijing issued a final note on 16 February, and Chinese forces attacked in the following predawn hours. China defined its aims as border defense and punishment for Vietnamese border actions, while Vietnam described its nationwide response as resistance to invasion. The official narratives differed, but the immediate cause was an actual contest over border fire, positions, and control of ground in the frontier zone.
dossier.impact: 戰爭的實際影響首先出現在戰役保障與部隊運用。中國一度奪取多個邊境城鎮和交通節點，使越南後方的道路、橋梁、指揮所、彈藥庫與油料庫直接受到威脅；越南則被迫把後調師團投入高平、諒山和寶獵方向，以砲兵反擊及陣地戰消耗進攻部隊。山地作戰也暴露了進攻方後勤限制：道路越往縱深越窄，橋梁、燃料、通信、傷員後送與戰場修理越難同步，坦克前進必須依賴步兵和工兵開路。這次經驗促使中國檢討山地協同、通信及後勤指揮，並在往後years加強立體化與現代化作戰準備；越南則更重視預備隊保存、反裝甲射擊和由固定陣地轉向機動反擊。戰略上，越南在諒山方向阻止了中國繼續深入，中國仍以壓倒性砲兵火力奪取並暫時控制若干邊境要地。地區層面上，河內進一步依賴蘇聯軍援，中國加強西南邊防與對蘇越軍事格局的因應；中越交火在停火後仍多次發生，兩國直到1991年才正式恢復外交關係。
dossier.impactEn: The war's practical effects appeared first in operational support and force employment. China temporarily seized several border towns and transport nodes, placing Vietnamese roads, bridges, command posts, ammunition depots, and fuel stores directly at risk. Vietnam was compelled to commit divisions from the interior to the Cao Bằng, Lạng Sơn, and Bảo Lộc sectors, using artillery counterfire and positional combat to wear down attacking formations. Mountain operations also exposed the attacker's logistical constraints. Roads narrowed with every increment of depth, making bridges, fuel, communications, casualty evacuation, and field repair increasingly difficult to synchronize. Tanks could advance only where infantry and engineers had opened a usable route. The experience led China to examine combined operations in mountains, communications, and logistics, while reinforcing later modernization and more integrated operational preparations. Vietnam placed greater emphasis on preserving reserves, antiarmor fire, and mobile counterattacks rather than relying solely on static positions. Strategically, Vietnam prevented further Chinese penetration at Lạng Sơn, while China used its superior artillery to seize and temporarily hold several border objectives. At the regional level, Hanoi relied more heavily on Soviet military support, and China strengthened its southwestern defenses and response to the Soviet-Vietnamese military balance. Border exchanges recurred after the fighting stopped, and the two countries did not formally restore diplomatic relations until 1991.
dossier.result: 攻勢初期，中國在北線於2月18日控制高平，南線同日進入老街與寶獵，取得坦克可用的道路和數處重要高地；在諒山方向，中國部隊推進到Mộc Thạnh及城郊外圍，卻未能佔領市區，越南第四十三步兵師及其增援仍守住該方向。寶獵等地的越南守軍曾發動側擊和夜襲，一度奪回部分陣地；中國 troops則在二月下旬停止多數縱深推進，轉為鞏固已控制地區，以縮短補給線。雙方沒有達成決定性的政治交換：中國能迅速奪取孤立邊境據點，卻未建立廣泛而持續的佔領體系；越南未能阻止所有越境攻勢，但保存了諒山等關鍵城鎮，並以縱深預備隊和反擊迫使進攻停止。3月5日北京宣布撤軍後，中國部隊按作戰梯隊撤出越南，後方由擔任警戒的部隊掩護；越南軍隊在中國後撤過程中追擊並重新控制被放棄的城鎮。3月16日最後一批中國軍隊離開，雙方大致回到攻勢前的邊境部署。中國完成了暫時奪取邊境目標後再撤出的有限軍事行動，越南則阻止了對河內方向構成持續威脅的深入佔領；沒有形成永久性領土變更，也沒有隨之簽訂解決邊界的條約。
dossier.resultEn: Early in the offensive, Chinese forces controlled Cao Bằng in the northern sector on 18 February. In the south, they entered Lào Cai and Bảo Lộc the same day, gaining roads suitable for tanks and several important heights. In the direction of Lạng Sơn, Chinese troops reached Mộc Thạnh and the outer approaches to the city but did not occupy the urban center, which remained in the hands of the Vietnamese 43rd Infantry Division and its reinforcements. Vietnamese defenders around Bảo Lộc launched flank attacks and nighttime counterattacks and temporarily recovered some positions. By late February, China had ended most of its deeper advances and shifted to consolidating controlled areas so that supply routes could be shortened. The two sides reached no decisive political settlement. China could seize isolated border positions rapidly but did not establish a broad and durable occupation. Vietnam could not prevent every cross-border attack, but it preserved key towns such as Lạng Sơn and used strategic reserves and counterattacks to force the offensive to stop. After Beijing announced withdrawal on 5 March, Chinese formations departed Vietnam in operational echelons while rear units provided covering protection. Vietnamese forces followed during the withdrawal and regained cities that Chinese troops abandoned. On 16 March, the last Chinese troops departed, and both sides returned broadly to the frontier deployment that had existed before the offensive. China had carried out a limited operation that temporarily seized border objectives before withdrawing, while Vietnam had prevented a sustained occupation threatening Hà Nội. No permanent territorial alteration resulted, and no border treaty followed the fighting.

battle.name: 蘇聯入侵阿富汗
battle.brief: 蘇聯入侵阿富汗衝突始於一九七九年十二月，蘇聯軍隊進入阿富汗後，與反抗蘇聯介入的游擊力量持續交戰。蘇聯陸軍使用T-62主力坦克，參與突破、機動與火力支援；此型號於一九六一年列裝並投入戰役。

kit.name: T-62主戰坦克
kit.history: T-62是蘇聯陸軍裝甲部隊的主戰坦克，部署於坦克部隊，負責正面突破、機動作戰與近距離火力支援，並配合步兵作戰。

dossier.countries: 1979年12月24日直接交戰的兩個國家是蘇聯與阿富汗民主共和國；蘇聯的烏茲別克斯坦、土庫曼斯坦與塔吉克斯坦不是中立第三國，而是北方後勤及出兵體系。捷爾梅茲是第108摩托化步兵師的駐地，也是主要鐵路與機場樞紐。該師先頭部隊由海拉坦渡過阿姆河，沿海拉坦至伊什卡什姆公路轉入阿什卡什姆，再接上巴格蘭與薩朗公路。庫什卡、杜尚別及塔什干方向的公路網，支援第180、第122與第201摩托化步兵師等單位進入西部、北部與東南部。蘇軍在阿富汗的主要空中支點包括捷爾梅茲、喀夫爾尼薩、巴格蘭、喀布爾、賈拉勒阿巴德、坎大哈、希南丹和法拉，但各地兵力和任務一直變動。巴基斯坦不是1979年進攻中的直接交戰者，卻是邊境通行與外部支援通道；美國經巴基斯坦向抗蘇武裝提供武器，中國向喀布爾政府供應軍火。這使喀布爾、法拉、坎大哈、賈拉勒阿巴德、海拉坦及通往巴基斯坦邊境的道路，構成持續九年的主要戰區。
dossier.countriesEn: The two direct belligerents on 24 December 1979 were the Soviet Union and the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan. The Soviet Uzbek, Turkmen, and Tajik republics were not neutral third countries; they formed the northern logistics and deployment system. Termez, home of the 108th Motor Rifle Division, was the principal railhead and aviation hub. Its leading echelon crossed the Amu Darya at Hairatan, followed the Hairatan-to-Ishkashim road, turned toward Ishkashim, and connected with the routes to Bagram and the Salang Highway. The road networks centered on Kushka, Dushanbe, and Tashkent supported the movement of formations including the 180th, 122d, and 201st Motor Rifle Divisions into western, northern, and southeastern Afghanistan. Major Soviet air bases and staging points included Termez, Kafarnisa, Bagram, Kabul, Jalalabad, Kandahar, Shindand, and Farah, although deployments and missions changed continually. Pakistan was not a direct belligerent in the initial attack, but it provided a border corridor through which outside assistance entered. The United States supplied weapons to forces opposing the Soviet-backed government through Pakistan, while China supplied arms to the Kabul government. Kabul, Farah, Kandahar, Jalalabad, Hairatan, and the approaches to Pakistan consequently formed the principal operating geography of a war lasting nine years.
dossier.people: 政治與最高指揮層面，蘇共中央書記安德羅波夫主張採取直接干預，國防部長德米特里·烏斯季諾夫及蘇聯最高軍事指揮部負責批准兵力、武器與空運安排，克里姆林宮和國安委員會則在莫斯科與中亞之間協調決定。地面首波攻勢由第108摩托化步兵師先頭部隊、蘇軍空降兵及克里姆林宮軍事情報局所屬特遣隊共同執行。阿富汗方面，哈菲佐拉·阿明在1979年4月推翻努爾穆罕默德·塔拉基後掌權；他與宮廷人員在12月24日至27日的喀布爾戰鬥中死亡，蘇聯支持的巴巴拉克·卡爾邁勒於月底接掌政府。喀布爾失守後，阿富汗國防部的指揮關係仍不斷重組，各師對中央命令的服從程度也不一致。另一端的武裝力量分屬不同組織，軍閥古爾布丁·赫克馬亞爾控制伊斯蘭國，賽義夫領導伊斯蘭統一派，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·馬蘇德則長期指揮伊斯蘭大會派。各支武裝依靠自己的情報網、資金與邊境補給活動，前線指揮員經常必須依據當地路況自行決定襲擊、撤退或守點，不能把整個 opposition 視為接受單一命令的軍隊。
dossier.peopleEn: At the political and supreme-command level, CPSU leader Yuri Andropov pressed for direct intervention. Defense Minister Dmitry Ustinov and the Soviet high command authorized the deployment of troops, weapons, and airlift, while the Kremlin and security council coordinated decisions between Moscow and Soviet Central Asia. The opening ground effort was shared by leading elements of the 108th Motor Rifle Division, Soviet airborne troops, and a special detachment associated with the KGB Main Military Intelligence Directorate. In Afghanistan, Hafizullah Amin had seized power in April 1979 by overthrowing Nur Muhammad Taraki. He and members of his staff died during the fighting in Kabul from 24 to 27 December, after which the Soviet-backed Babrak Karmal assumed the government at the end of the month. After Kabul fell, command relationships inside the Afghan Defense Ministry continued to be rearranged, and divisions differed markedly in their obedience to central orders. The armed organizations confronting the government were separate. Gulbuddin Hekmatyar led Hizb-e Islami Gulbuddin, Sayyaf headed Ittihad-i Islami, and Ahmad Shah Massoud commanded Jamiat-e Islami. These organizations relied on their own intelligence networks, funding, and border supply arrangements. Front commanders frequently had to decide attacks, withdrawals, and base defense from local conditions, and the opposition could not be treated as an army operating under a single chain of command.
dossier.kits: 雙方使用的裝備都真實存在，而且型號在1979年底以前已經列裝；並非每一個型號同時出現在每一支部隊。蘇軍坦克主力包括T-62與T-64A，後續調入的裝甲部隊也可見T-72； infantry 防護依靠BMP-1步兵戰鬥車、BTR-60與BTR-70裝甲運兵車、BTR-80以及BRDM-2輪式裝甲車。阿富汗軍仍保有T-34-85、T-54、T-55和PT-76等坦克，因此正面反坦克火力與機載反坦克武器同樣常見。步兵輕武器包括AK-47、AKM、AK-74、PKM、RPG-7及KPV重機槍，對應的7.62×39毫米、7.62×54毫米、5.45×39毫米和14.5毫米彈藥會隨基層作戰與後勤車隊一起流動。炮兵使用D-30式122毫米榴彈炮、M-46式152毫米榴彈炮及BM-21火箭炮，射擊需要大量炮彈、火箭彈、火藥包、瞄具備件和炮管維修器材。空中武器包括蘇軍MiG-21bis、MiG-23、Mi-8與Mi-24直升機，以及阿軍MiG-21MF、Su-20；An-24、An-2和Il-76負責把輪式車輛、燃料與炮兵裝置送入中轉站。Ural-375D、ZIL-131與KAZ-608等卡車承擔日常運輸。輪胎、底盤、履帶和發動機備件的消耗速度，往往決定一支部隊能連續作戰多久。
dossier.kitsEn: All the equipment mentioned was real and had entered service before the end of 1979, although no single formation carried every model at the same time. Soviet armored strength centered on the T-62 and T-64A, with T-72 tanks appearing in armored units brought into the theater later. Infantry protection came from BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 and BTR-70 armored personnel carriers, the BTR-80, and BRDM-2 wheeled armored vehicles. Afghan forces retained the T-34-85, T-54, T-55, and PT-76, so direct tank engagements were only one part of the anti-armor problem. Infantry weapons included the AK-47, AKM, AK-74, PKM, RPG-7, and KPV machine gun, with 7.62×39 mm, 7.62×54 mm, 5.45×39 mm, and 14.5 mm ammunition moving with combat units and logistics convoys. Artillery included the D-30 122 mm howitzer, M-46 152 mm howitzer, and BM-21 rocket launcher. Their support requirements extended to artillery ammunition, rockets, propellant charges, sighting equipment, spare parts, and gun-tube maintenance. Air operations involved Soviet MiG-21bis and MiG-23 aircraft, Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters, and Afghan MiG-21MF and Su-20 aircraft. An-24, An-2, and Il-76 transports moved trucks, fuel, and artillery equipment into intermediate depots. Ural-375D, ZIL-131, and KAZ-608 trucks carried routine supplies. Tire, chassis, track, and engine consumption often determined how long a unit could remain in continuous combat.
dossier.tactics: 12月24日凌晨，蘇軍先以空降兵控制巴格蘭機場和跑道，再由特遣隊進入喀布爾，奪取通訊、指揮及廣播節點；第108師先頭部隊則從捷爾梅茲方向渡河，沿公路向巴格蘭推進。天亮後，坦克和裝甲運兵車隊進入喀布爾，與國王宮、行政區及中央電台周圍的阿軍守軍交火。阿明政府失去城外公路與機場控制後，宮區及市中心仍在相互射擊，但通信中斷使各單位難以維持統一指揮。主要蘇軍縱隊在27日前後退出喀布爾市中心，留下空降兵、警衛部隊和巴格蘭基地，公開干預因此沒有立即變成全國占領。1980年以後，戰爭轉變為基地防衛與道路控制之爭。蘇軍把團與營集中於巴格蘭、喀布爾、薩朗公路沿線、賈拉勒阿巴德、坎大哈及其他交通樞紐，以D-30、M-46、BM-21和Mi-24支援車隊反擊或清除據點。抗蘇武裝則利用山區、岔路、友軍火力支援範圍和夜間行動，在道路狹窄處發動伏擊，破壞道路，切斷遠距離據點，並以小型突擊隊、火箭筒、地雷及路邊炸藥消耗巡邏與補給車隊。這種作戰沒有使任何一方永久控制國土；政府軍仍占據主要城市和幹線，抗蘇武裝則控制廣大鄉間與部分山區。1987年5月的Magistral行動出動政府軍與蘇軍，試圖奪回薩朗公路及若干被封鎖節點，仍顯示遠距離機動必須依靠護衛、炮兵與空軍協同。
dossier.tacticsEn: Early on 24 December, Soviet airborne troops seized Bagram airfield and its runway, while special detachments entered Kabul and took communications, command, and broadcasting installations. Leading elements of the 108th Division crossed the river from Termez and advanced toward Bagram by road. After daylight, tanks and armored personnel carriers entered Kabul and fought Afghan guards around the royal palace, government district, and central broadcasting station. With the roads outside Kabul and the airfields no longer secure, fighting continued in the palace area and central city, but disrupted communications made unified command increasingly difficult. The main Soviet columns withdrew from central Kabul around 27 December, leaving airborne troops, guards, and the Bagram base behind; the intervention did not immediately become an occupation of the entire country. From 1980 onward, the war became a contest over base defense and lines of movement. Soviet regiments and battalions concentrated around Bagram, Kabul, the Salang Highway, Jalalabad, Kandahar, and other transport nodes, using D-30 and M-46 artillery, BM-21 rockets, and Mi-24 helicopters against convoys and strongpoints. Opposition forces used mountains, secondary roads, the limited reach of friendly fire support, and night movement to ambush narrow approaches, damage roads, cut distant bases, and wear patrol and supply columns with small assault teams, rocket launchers, mines, and roadside explosive devices. Neither side gained permanent control of the country. Government forces held major cities and trunk routes, while opposition organizations controlled extensive rural and mountain areas. The Magistral operation of May 1987 mobilized Afghan and Soviet troops to recover sections of the Salang Highway and other blocked nodes, again demonstrating that long-distance movement required escorts, artillery, and air-ground coordination.
dossier.data: 可核對的時間與編制顯示，1979年首波攻勢主要是第108摩托化步兵師的先頭部隊、空降兵和特遣隊，而不是已經完成部署的整個蘇軍集群。蘇聯於1980年5月成立駐阿富汗第40軍；到1980年代中期，其核心地面編制通常列有第25、第108、第122、第180及第201摩托化步兵師，另有空降兵、航空兵、炮兵、獨立營團與後勤單位。師級單位不是全程同時到位，有的分批進入，有的輪換，有的任務轉向防守其他國家，因此不能把某一年的師數直接當成每天都在戰場上的總兵力。公開資料對蘇軍兵力估算差距很大，但大多落在八萬至十二萬之間；較常見的計算把作戰、支援、空運與後勤人員一併計入。單兵輪換多約十二至十八個月。捷爾梅茲至喀布爾的補給路線超過一千公里，炮彈、柴油、輪式車、履帶備件和食品都依賴鐵路、公路與空運銜接。戰爭從1979年12月24日延續至1989年2月9日：1980年5月建立第40軍，1988年4月14日簽訂日內瓦協議，1988年5月15日開始撤退，1989年2月9日完成最後撤離。蘇軍死亡、失踪、受傷及因傷退役的人數，在不同官方與私人資料中採用不同口徑，不能把其中任何一個估算冒充完整精確總數。
dossier.dataEn: The verifiable chronology and order of battle show that the opening attack mainly involved leading elements of the 108th Motor Rifle Division, airborne troops, and special detachments, not a fully deployed Soviet army group. The Soviet Union formed the 40th Army in Afghanistan in May 1980. By the middle of the decade, its core ground order of battle commonly included the 25th, 108th, 122d, 180th, and 201st Motor Rifle Divisions, together with airborne, aviation, artillery, independent brigade, and logistics units. These divisions were not all present simultaneously. Some entered in stages, some rotated, and some shifted to missions outside Afghanistan, so a division total from one year cannot be treated as the number physically present every day. Public estimates of Soviet strength vary, but most fall within a range of 80,000 to 120,000, with calculations differing over whether combat, support, airlift, and rear-service personnel were included. Individual rotations commonly lasted about twelve to eighteen months. The supply route from Termez to Kabul exceeded 1,000 kilometers, and artillery ammunition, diesel, wheeled vehicles, track spares, and food depended on the connection between rail, road, and air transport. The war ran from 24 December 1979 to 9 February 1989: the 40th Army was formed in May 1980, the Geneva agreement was signed on 14 April 1988, withdrawal began on 15 May 1988, and the final departure was completed on 9 February 1989. Published Soviet deaths, missing personnel, wounded, and medical discharges used different definitions. No single estimate should therefore be presented as a complete exact total.
dossier.cause: 直接干預的背景至少包括四個相互連接的層次。1978年4月28日的Saur革命終結達烏德汗政府，建立普什基姆派掌權的政府；1979年4月，哈菲佐拉·阿明又推翻塔拉基，使喀布爾與蘇聯原有的安全及經濟關係迅速惡化。美國情報機構與巴基斯坦方面從1979年開始更系統地支持反政府武裝，阿明政府則尋求美國及其他國家援助，這使莫斯科擔心阿富汗進入更明確的反蘇陣營。地理上，蘇聯在阿富汗南部直接面對巴基斯坦；若喀布爾與華盛頓靠近，蘇聯顧慮中亞南部邊防、與巴基斯坦的競爭以及通往印度洋的外交選項受到限制。這些是安全評估，不等同於阿富汗全軍已準備進攻蘇聯。12月中旬，阿明政府所屬部隊與蘇聯邊軍發生武裝衝突，莫斯科又取得一封據稱由阿明提出的求援信，公開以此作為出兵理由；後來證實該信並非阿明發出，邊境衝突則被蘇聯當成立即干預的觸發事件。12月14日蘇共中央作出出兵決定，12月24日部隊便開始進攻。官方藉口、邊境風險判斷與中亞戰略考量因而疊加在同一項決定之中。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate intervention rested on several connected developments. The Saur Revolution of 28 April 1978 ended the Daoud government and brought the Pul-e Pakhmak faction to power. In April 1979, Hafizullah Amin overthrew Taraki, rapidly worsening Kabul's previous security and economic relationship with Moscow. Beginning in 1979, American intelligence agencies and Pakistani intermediaries were supporting anti-government armed groups more systematically, while Amin sought assistance from the United States and other countries. Moscow consequently feared a more explicitly anti-Soviet alignment in Kabul. Geographically, the Soviet Union faced Pakistan immediately to the south of Afghanistan. A government in Kabul moving closer to Washington raised Soviet concerns about the security of its southern Central Asian frontier, competition with Pakistan, and access to diplomatic options in the Indian Ocean direction. These were strategic assessments and did not mean that the entire Afghan army was preparing to invade the USSR. In mid-December, Afghan forces and Soviet border troops exchanged fire, and Moscow obtained an alleged request for assistance attributed to Amin. The public justification was based on the border clash and this request, but the letter was later shown not to have come from Amin, while the incident provided the immediate occasion for Soviet action. The CPSU Central Committee approved intervention on 14 December, and forces began attacking on 24 December. The official trigger, border-risk assessment, and Central Asian strategic calculation therefore converged in the same decision.
dossier.impact: 戰爭首先改變的是軍隊與地理空間的關係，而不是首都控制本身。抗蘇武裝在1979年以前已經存在，蘇聯介入未能消滅這股力量，反而使喀布爾政府更加依賴蘇聯炮兵、空中支援、固定基地與北方後勤網。政府軍雖守住多數城市，蘇軍卻很難長期清除鄉間及山區；道路、橋梁、燃料庫與營區因游擊、伏擊、地雷和路邊炸藥承受持續損耗，裝甲車即使沒有被擊毀，也可能因輪胎、底盤、履帶和發動機故障而退出戰鬥。蘇軍的因應方式是集中守備、加強車隊護衛、反覆清理道路、調動Mi-24與Mi-8、以及在據點外建立射擊陣地。這些措施縮短了可供游擊活動的道路，卻也要求更多部隊、燃料、維修與輪替人員。巴基斯坦邊境在軍事上成為外部援助與反蘇武裝補給的樞紐；蘇聯則依靠中國供應和自身空運維持喀布爾。對蘇聯軍事研究而言，阿富汗提供了山地作戰、車隊防衛和空地協同的實例，迫使指揮部門思考如何限制裝甲部隊分散及輪替風險。1988年撤軍開始後，政府軍雖仍保有蘇制武器，卻失去原有後勤與航空支援，阿富汗國防體系難以取代蘇聯網絡。這種 military imbalance 最終在1992年與政府崩解及武裝派系奪取喀布爾同時顯現。
dossier.impactEn: The first major effect was to change the relationship between armies and geography, not merely the control of the capital. Armed opposition already existed before 1979, and Soviet intervention failed to eliminate it. The Kabul government became more dependent on Soviet artillery, air support, fixed bases, and northern logistics. Government forces held most major cities, but Soviet troops could not permanently clear the countryside and mountains. Roads, bridges, fuel depots, and camps suffered repeated damage from ambushes, mines, and roadside explosive devices. Armored vehicles could leave combat through tire, suspension, track, or engine failures even when they were not destroyed. Soviet responses included concentration on base defense, stronger convoy escort, repeated route clearance, Mi-24 and Mi-8 employment, and prepared fire positions outside fortified areas. These measures restricted ground available to guerrilla operations but required more troops, fuel, maintenance, and rotation. Pakistan's border zone became a military hub for external assistance and opposition supply, while the Soviet Union maintained Kabul through Chinese supplies and its own airlift. Within Soviet military analysis, Afghanistan became a practical case study of mountain operations, convoy defense, and air-ground coordination, forcing commanders to manage the risks created by dispersed armored formations and frequent rotations. After withdrawal began in 1988, Afghan government forces still held Soviet-pattern equipment but lost the established logistics and aviation network, and the defense system could not readily replace the Soviet organization. That military imbalance became visible when the government collapsed and armed factions took Kabul in 1992.
dossier.result: 1988年4月14日的日內瓦協議由美國與蘇聯擔任保證人，阿富汗與巴基斯坦接受其安排；協議要求蘇軍分階段撤出，並由美蘇停止對交戰方提供軍火，阿富汗不得容許外國部隊利用其領土進攻蘇聯或巴基斯坦。蘇聯原定按照協議安排分批撤軍，後來決定加速完成。1988年5月15日，第一批車隊開始離開南部據點；南部部隊經坎大哈、斯平博爾達克及土庫曼方向撤出，北部部隊則由喀布爾和巴格蘭經普勒胡姆里、海拉坦返回捷爾梅茲。裝甲車由道路運回，輪式車裝上火車或大批車隊返國，剩餘火炮與彈藥重新盤點，一部分留給阿富汗政府軍，其餘裝備撤回或處理。撤退期間，喀布爾與各地蘇軍基地逐步縮成駐軍點，但抗蘇武裝也沒有在1988年控制首都。1989年2月9日，最後的蘇軍部隊在海拉坦渡過阿姆河，歷時九年的蘇聯直接軍事介入結束。蘇聯是以完成撤軍而非被逐出巴格蘭或喀布爾的方式結束行動；其近十年建立的喀布爾政府則在失去蘇軍保障後維持到1992年，隨後因國防軍分裂及武裝派系進攻而垮台。整個過程顯示，1979年的首波攻勢能迅速改變首都，但長期控制仍取決於能否持續保護道路、城市與後勤節點。
dossier.resultEn: The Geneva agreement of 14 April 1988 was guaranteed by the United States and the Soviet Union and accepted by Afghanistan and Pakistan. It required phased Soviet withdrawal, a halt in American and Soviet military support for the belligerents, and an Afghan commitment not to permit foreign troops to use Afghan territory against the USSR or Pakistan. The Soviet Union initially intended to follow the staged timetable but then accelerated the withdrawal. The first convoys departed southern positions on 15 May 1988. Southern formations withdrew through Kandahar, Spin Boldak, and the Turkmen direction, while northern formations moved from Kabul and Bagram through Pul-e-Khumri and Hairatan to Termez. Armored vehicles returned by road, wheeled vehicles traveled by rail or in large organized convoys, and remaining artillery and ammunition were inventoried. Some equipment passed to Afghan government forces, while the rest returned to the Soviet Union or was otherwise processed. Soviet bases around Kabul and other cities contracted to smaller detachments during the withdrawal, but opposition forces did not enter the capital in 1988. On 9 February 1989, the last Soviet troops crossed the Amu Darya at Hairatan, ending nine years of direct Soviet military intervention. The Soviet departure was completed through an international withdrawal rather than a forced retreat from Bagram or Kabul. The Soviet-supported Kabul government survived the loss of Soviet troops until 1992, when divisions of the Afghan armed forces and attacks by armed factions brought the government down. The full sequence shows that the opening attack could change control of the capital quickly, but lasting control depended on the ability to protect roads, cities, and logistics nodes.

battle.name: 黎巴嫩戰爭
battle.theater: 黎巴嫩南部與黎以邊境地帶
battle.brief: 維基戰爭列表所列的二〇〇六年黎巴嫩戰爭，是以色列與黎巴嫩真主黨武裝之間的衝突。戰事包括邊境交火、火箭攻擊與地面進攻；以色列地面部隊進入黎巴嫩南部，Merkava III主戰坦克作為裝甲主力，執行突破、警戒及伴隨火力支援任務。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦三型主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦三型是以色列陸軍的主戰坦克，負責裝甲正面作戰、突破與護衛，並與步兵及支援車輛協同行動。

dossier.countries: 2006年7月19日至8月11日，黎巴嫩戰爭的主要交戰者是以色列與真主黨。地面戰集中於黎巴嫩南部藍線以北的邊境地帶、利塔尼河附近，以及貝魯特外圍的固定目標；以軍在7月下旬還對黎巴嫩沿岸實施海上封鎖。黎巴嫩軍與內部安全部隊沒有以主力身份加入對以色列的地面進攻，美國、法國等則提供空中支援、海上護航與外交協調。聯合國觀察力量在停火前後維持有限存在。7月11日安理會第1696號決議要求停止攻擊、撤出黎境並處理兩名被扣以軍士兵；7月19日以色列開始「夏季雨水」行動，7月21日真主黨宣布「真實承諾」行動，8月4日再發動「支援抵抗」攻勢。8月10日第1701號決議通過，8月11日凌晨主要炮火停止。國家、交戰組織、黎巴嫩政府力量與聯合國角色，不能混寫成單一國家戰爭。
dossier.countriesEn: From 19 July to 11 August 2006, the main belligerents in the Lebanon War were Israel and Hezbollah. Ground fighting was concentrated in the border belt north of the Blue Line in southern Lebanon, around the Litani River, and against fixed targets on the outskirts of Beirut; Israel also enforced a naval blockade off the Lebanese coast from late July. The Lebanese Armed Forces and Internal Security Forces did not join a major Israeli ground offensive, while the United States, France, and other states provided air support, maritime cover, and diplomatic coordination. United Nations observers maintained a limited presence around the ceasefire. Resolution 1696, adopted on 11 July, called for attacks to stop, a withdrawal, and the return of two detained Israeli soldiers. Israel began Operation Summer Rains on 19 July; Hezbollah announced Operation True Promise on 21 July and launched Operation Supporting the Resistance on 4 August. Resolution 1701 was adopted on 10 August, and the main artillery fire ceased in the early hours of 11 August. The state, armed organization, Lebanese government forces, and United Nations roles must not be merged into a single state-to-state war.
dossier.people: 以色列方面的核心決策者是總理埃胡德·奧爾默特，他主持戰時內閣與外交協調；國防部長阿米爾·佩雷茨在7月31日辭職，軍方則由國防軍總參謀長丹·哈魯茨、北部司令部司令班尼·甘茨、地面部隊司令伊斯雷爾·塔爾，以及空軍司令阿莫斯·亞德林共同負責作戰。北部司令部處理黎南戰區，地面部隊處理道路、步兵與裝甲協同，空軍負責制空、偵察和對地打擊。真主黨方面，賽義德·哈桑·納斯魯拉是政治與公開領導人，伊馬德·卡西姆是軍事領導人，奈姆·哈卡拉則屬於前線作戰指揮體系；7月25日，负责軍事事務的高級官員阿布·阿里·穆斯塔法在以軍空襲中死亡。納斯魯拉在戰役中發表講話，維持了真主黨的政治宣傳，但公開資料沒有提供完整、可核驗的全戰區指揮鏈與完整兵力表。
dossier.peopleEn: On the Israeli side, Prime Minister Ehud Olmert chaired the wartime cabinet and diplomatic coordination. Defense Minister Amir Peretz resigned on 31 July, while Chief of Staff Dan Halutz, Northern Command commander Benny Gantz, Ground Forces commander Israel Tal, and Air Force commander Amos Yadlin directed military operations. Northern Command handled the southern Lebanon theater, the Ground Forces coordinated infantry and armor movement, and the Air Force handled air superiority, reconnaissance, and strikes. On the Hezbollah side, Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah was the political and public leader, Imad Qassem was a military leader, and Naim Khakhal belonged to the frontline operational command. Abu Ali Mustafa, a senior official responsible for military affairs, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on 25 July. Nasrallah delivered major public statements during the campaign, but the available information does not provide a complete, verifiable theater-wide chain of command or a full verified order of battle.
dossier.kits: 以色列在2006年使用的裝備包括F-16I與F-15I戰鬥機、AH-64D攻擊直升機，以及IAI Eitan和RQ-2 Pioneer無人偵察機。地面作戰主要使用Merkava Mk IV主戰坦克、M60A1與M60A3坦克、Namer履帶式裝甲車、Tzukit輪式裝甲車與Achbarit裝甲運兵車；部分Merkava Mk IV配有Trophy主動防護系統。炮兵包括M109A2自走式155公厘榴彈砲、PzH 2000自走式榴彈砲、M270多管火箭系統，以及M252 81公厘迫擊砲。真主黨可使用的重武器包括BM-21卡秋莎122公厘火箭砲、9K51系列無後坐力砲、9K14「女武神」反裝甲飛彈、SPG-9線導反裝甲飛彈與RPG-7系列火箭筒；其地面部隊也使用T-54、T-55與M60系列坦克，以及AK-47、AKM、PKM等輕武器。上述型號在2006年以前均已有服役紀錄，或已在2006年戰役中列裝。
dossier.kitsEn: The Israeli equipment used in 2006 included F-16I and F-15I fighters, AH-64D attack helicopters, and IAI Eitan and RQ-2 Pioneer reconnaissance UAVs. Ground operations relied on Merkava Mk IV main battle tanks, M60A1 and M60A3 tanks, Namer tracked armored vehicles, Tzukit wheeled armored vehicles, and Achbarit armored personnel carriers; some Merkava Mk IVs carried the Trophy active-protection system. Artillery included the M109A2 155 mm self-propelled howitzer, PzH 2000 self-propelled howitzer, M270 multiple-rocket launcher, and M252 81 mm mortar. Hezbollah heavy weapons included the BM-21 Katyusha 122 mm rocket launcher, 9K51-series recoilless rifles, 9K14 Valkyrie anti-tank missiles, SPG-9 wire-guided anti-tank missiles, and RPG-7-series launchers. Its forces also used T-54, T-55, and M60-series tanks, together with AK-47, AKM, PKM, and other light weapons. All of these systems had entered service before 2006 or were fielded by 2006.
dossier.tactics: 以色列先以空中、海上和炮兵建立火力密度，目標包括邊境反裝甲陣地、火箭發射點、雷達、通信節點與指揮所。7月19日至月底，F-16I與F-15I反覆進入黎境，無人機提供目標校正；固定目標遭擊後，以軍再以AH-64D、M109A2與PzH 2000覆蓋殘存陣地。7月下旬至8月初，地面部隊由步兵、坦克、工兵和工程車協同，從邊境東側、南部丘陵道路及沿海公路幾個方向推進，先清除道路、障礙與可疑陣地，再轉移炮兵和後勤。8月4日，真主黨以步兵、迫擊砲和反裝甲小組打擊以軍在馬龍拉斯及邊境走廊的據點，並向縱深射擊火箭；以軍則用Merkava、Tzukit與裝甲支援車封住道路、射擊通道和撤退線。真主黨把兵力分散在地下室、隧道、反斜面陣地與不同發射點，短時間射擊後轉移器材，避免多個發射器同時暴露。以軍後來把地面部署推向利塔尼河附近，但沒有控制整個黎巴嫩。
dossier.tacticsEn: Israel first built firepower density through air, naval, and artillery operations. Targets included border anti-tank positions, rocket launchers, radar, communications nodes, and command posts. From 19 July through the end of the month, F-16I and F-15I aircraft repeatedly entered Lebanese airspace, with UAVs correcting target coordinates. After fixed targets were struck, AH-64D helicopters, M109A2 howitzers, and PzH 2000 howitzers covered surviving positions. From late July into early August, infantry, tanks, engineers, and armored engineering vehicles advanced along several axes, including the eastern border approaches, southern hill roads, and the coastal road. They first cleared roads, obstacles, and suspected positions, then moved artillery and logistics forward.
