On 4 August, Hezbollah used infantry, mortars, and anti-tank groups against Israeli positions around Maroun al-Ras and the border corridor, while also firing rockets deeper toward the rear. Israel used Merkava, Tzukit, and armored support vehicles to seal roads, firing lanes, and withdrawal routes. Hezbollah dispersed forces through underground positions, tunnels, reverse-slope sites, and separate launcher locations, firing briefly and then relocating equipment so that several launchers would not be exposed at once. Israel later pushed its ground deployment toward the Litani River but did not control all of Lebanon.
dossier.data: 可核對的時間節點包括：7月19日以軍開始空襲並進入黎境；7月21日真主黨擴大火箭砲與地面交火；7月25日阿布·阿里·穆斯塔法在空襲中死亡；7月31日至8月1日馬龍拉斯一帶爆發密集地面戰；8月4日真主黨發動攻勢；8月10日聯合國安理會通過第1701號決議；8月11日凌晨停火安排開始生效，正式戰鬥期約三週。以軍在戰役高峰期投入數個旅與師級支援單位，公開資料常以約三萬名部隊作為規模估計；真主黨則以營、連級單位分散作戰，沒有可完整核驗的總兵力名冊。以軍戰後曾公布逾三千枚火箭及迫擊砲彈，其他來源採較低數字，因此較穩妥的說法是發彈量達數以千計。黎南後勤依靠公路縱隊、臨時補給點、前進維修與小型分散運輸；聯合國第1701號決議授權把聯南部隊擴至一萬五千人。各方傷亡統計口徑差異很大，本實錄不把任何單一估算硬寫成確切傷亡總數。
dossier.dataEn: The verifiable timetable includes the Israeli air campaign and entry into Lebanon on 19 July; the expansion of Hezbollah rocket and ground fire on 21 July; the death of Abu Ali Mustafa in an airstrike on 25 July; intense fighting around Maroun al-Ras from 31 July to 1 August; the Hezbollah offensive on 4 August; Security Council Resolution 1701 on 10 August; and the ceasefire arrangement taking effect in the early hours of 11 August. The formal combat period lasted about three weeks. At its high point, Israel deployed several brigades with divisional support units in Lebanon; public accounts commonly used an estimate of about 30,000 personnel, while Hezbollah organized its forces into battalion- and company-sized units without a fully verifiable total order of battle. After the war, the Israeli military reported more than 3,000 rockets and mortar rounds launched, while other sources recorded lower figures, so the safer description is that thousands were fired. Logistics in southern Lebanon relied on road convoys, temporary supply points, forward maintenance, and small dispersed transport units. Resolution 1701 authorized UNIFIL expansion to 15,000 personnel. Casualty estimates varied substantially between sources, so no single total is treated here as a definitive figure.
dossier.cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是2006年7月19日的邊境事件與以軍進入黎境，但它建立在更長期的安全衝突上。以色列在1978年入侵黎巴嫩、1982年再次出兵，2000年撤出後，邊境位置、謝巴農場與藍線的解釋一直存在爭議。此後真主黨在黎南部署火箭砲和反裝甲力量，向以色列北部發動跨境射擊；以色列則以空襲、偵察和邊界行動打擊相關陣地。2006年春季以後，邊境巡邏、真主黨進入以軍控制的狹窄地帶，以及以軍準備進入黎北的計畫，使局勢持續升溫。安理會第1696號決議已把撤出黎南與歸還兩名被扣以軍士兵列為要求，但各方沒有完全接受並執行。7月19日事件後，以色列宣稱行動是為了阻止士兵被擄走並摧毀火箭發射陣地；真主黨則稱以軍越界入侵，要求以色列撤出。被扣士兵、邊境線、反裝甲陣地與火箭襲擊在同一時間交會，因而迅速擴大為全面戰爭。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate trigger was the border incident of 19 July 2006 and the Israeli entry into Lebanon, but the war rested on a longer security conflict. Israel had invaded Lebanon in 1978 and again in 1982, and after its 2000 withdrawal the interpretation of the border, the Sheba Farms area, and the Blue Line remained disputed. Hezbollah subsequently established rocket and anti-tank positions in southern Lebanon and fired rockets into northern Israel, while Israel responded with airstrikes, reconnaissance, and operations along the border. Tensions rose further during the spring of 2006 through border patrols, Hezbollah movement into a narrow area controlled by the Israeli military, and Israeli preparations for a possible operation in northern Lebanon. Resolution 1696 had already called for a Hezbollah withdrawal from southern Lebanon and the return of two detained Israeli soldiers, but the parties did not fully accept or implement it. After 19 July, Israel stated that its operation was intended to prevent the abduction of soldiers and destroy rocket-launching positions. Hezbollah described the Israeli movement as an incursion and demanded withdrawal. The detained soldiers, the border line, anti-tank positions, and rocket attacks converged at the same time, turning a limited confrontation into a full war.
dossier.impact: 軍事上，以色列的空襲與炮兵火力破壞或迫使真主黨移動部分雷達、通信節點、指揮建築、火箭發射點與南部後勤設施；馬龍拉斯等地的地面戰使若干反裝甲陣地和道路控制權短暫改變，但真主黨的南部作戰單位仍能重組並維持射擊。以軍在黎南的推進迫使對方把發射器材分散到更深或不同陣地，火箭砲仍能越過邊境射向北以色列，造成空襲警報與局部交通中斷。貝魯特的港口、機場、橋樑、道路和通信節點受到打擊或運作干擾。停火後，以軍退回藍線以南的既有邊界部署，黎巴嫩軍與擴編的聯合國部隊進入南部，但控制權並未完全統一。第1701號決議建立了新的停火框架，卻沒有完成真主黨全面解除武裝，也沒有解決所有邊境與安全爭議。
dossier.impactEn: militarily, Israeli air and artillery operations damaged or forced the relocation of some radar, communications nodes, command buildings, rocket launchers, and southern Lebanese logistics facilities. The fighting around Maroun al-Ras temporarily changed control of some anti-tank positions and roads, but Hezbollah's southern formations could reorganize and continue firing. The Israeli advance into southern Lebanon pushed launchers deeper or into different positions, yet the rockets still crossed the border and fired toward northern Israel, producing air-raid alerts and localized transportation disruptions. Beirut's port, airport, bridges, roads, and communications nodes were struck or operationally disrupted. After the ceasefire, Israeli forces returned to positions behind the Blue Line, while the Lebanese Armed Forces and expanded UNIFIL presence entered the south, although control was not fully unified. Resolution 1701 created a new ceasefire framework, but it did not complete Hezbollah's disarmament or settle every border and security dispute.
dossier.result: 停火在8月11日凌晨約兩時開始生效，部分地段仍出現零星交火。以色列在9月初完成了大部分從黎巴嫩新增陣地的撤離，海上封鎖也隨之放鬆；因此，以色列達成了退出此次大規模地面進攻、降低部分前沿威脅的軍事目標，但沒有消滅真主黨的北部火箭與反裝甲能力。8月4日真主黨攻勢沒有突破以軍主要防線，卻迫使以軍延長地面作戰並最終撤出，顯示其部隊仍具備縱深打擊與地面協同能力。停火後，黎巴嫩軍和聯南部隊分擔南部任務，聯合國觀察安排擴大；然而真主黨軍事組織與武器未被全面解除，藍線仍是主要軍事分界，南部控制權也不完整。這場戰爭以停火而非完整和平協議結束，邊境安排、解除武裝與長期安全責任都留給後續聯合國與黎巴嫩政治程序處理。
dossier.resultEn: The ceasefire took effect at about 02:00 on 11 August, although isolated exchanges continued in some sectors. Israel completed the withdrawal from most of its newly established positions in Lebanon by early September, and the naval blockade was relaxed. Israel therefore achieved its immediate military objective of ending the large-scale ground incursion and reducing some forward threats, but it did not eliminate Hezbollah's northern rocket and anti-tank capabilities. Hezbollah's 4 August offensive did not break the main Israeli defensive line, yet it prolonged Israeli ground operations and contributed to the eventual withdrawal, showing that Hezbollah retained the ability to conduct deep strikes and combined-arms attacks. After the ceasefire, the Lebanese Armed Forces and UNIFIL assumed parts of the southern mission, and the United Nations presence expanded. Hezbollah's military organization and weapons were not comprehensively disarmed, the Blue Line remained the principal military dividing line, and control in southern Lebanon was incomplete. The war ended in a ceasefire rather than a comprehensive peace agreement, leaving border arrangements, disarmament, and long-term security responsibilities to later United Nations and Lebanese political processes.

battle.name: 第五次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所列的第五次中東戰爭於1982年6月爆發，戰事主要在黎巴嫩境內展開，以色列陸軍投入Merkava Mark 1主戰坦克，在南部戰線執行裝甲突破、據點攻擊與火力支援，並與步兵及裝甲車協同作戰，承擔核心重裝甲任務。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦主戰坦克是以色列陸軍當時的核心裝甲載具，負責正面突破與裝甲防衛，並可和步兵、裝甲車及炮兵協同，構成地面部隊的主要坦克火力。

dossier.countries: 本戰不能簡化成以色列對黎巴嫩國家軍的整體戰爭。直接主要交戰者是以色列與巴勒斯坦解放組織（PLO）率領、駐紮黎巴嫩的武裝；其中法塔赫等派系保有旅級部隊，另有黎巴嫩人武裝及南方黎巴嫩軍（SLA）相關部隊作戰。黎巴嫩政府與黎巴嫩軍隊沒有形成一致的對以作戰命令，部分單位維持中立或選擇與不同派系合作，因此阿方不能視為一個由黎巴嫩國家軍統一指揮的戰區。敘利亞沒有投入大規模地面部隊對以色列作戰，但敘利亞空軍與地空飛彈部隊在貝卡谷地直接迎戰以軍。美國和法國不是交戰方，而是推動停火、協助安排撤離的外交一方；聯合國安全理事會則透過第501號與第502號決議要求克制、停火及撤軍。區分國家、國家軍、非國家武裝與外交行為體，是理解這場戰爭的前提。
dossier.countriesEn: This war cannot be reduced to a single Israeli war against the conventional army of the Lebanese state. The principal direct belligerent opposite Israel was the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), whose Palestine and Lebanese formations were deployed across southern Lebanon. Fatah and other PLO factions maintained brigade-sized units, while Lebanese armed groups and units associated with the South Lebanon Army also fought. The Lebanese government and armed forces did not issue a single coherent command for war against Israel; some units remained neutral or cooperated with different factions. The Arab side therefore was not one national army operating under one Lebanese chain of command. Syria did not commit large ground forces to the fight against Israel, but its air force and surface-to-air missile forces engaged Israeli aircraft directly in the Bekaa Valley. The United States and France were not belligerents and acted diplomatically to seek a ceasefire and organize the evacuation. The UN Security Council demanded restraint, cessation of hostilities, and withdrawal through Resolutions 501 and 502. Distinguishing the state, its army, non-state militias, and diplomatic actors is essential to understanding the campaign.
dossier.people: 關鍵決策分屬政治、軍事與外交幾個中心。以色列總理梅納赫姆·貝京批准戰役升級，國防部長阿里爾·沙龍主張把打擊範圍推向黎巴嫩深處；總參謀長拉斐爾·艾坦主持作戰計畫與參謀協調，南部戰區則由阿維多爾·本-加利指揮，第八裝甲師等部隊在其作戰序列內負責沿海攻勢。艾坦在七月底任期屆滿，由丹·肖蒙接任總參謀長。PLO主席亞西爾·阿拉法特在貝魯特主持政治層面的停火與撤離決策，各旅仍由前線軍事指揮官執行作戰。黎巴嫩總統伊利亞斯·薩基斯與總理沙菲克·瓦贊試圖讓黎巴嫩軍隊避開以色列與PLO之間的全面戰鬥，但可運用的指揮權有限。敘利亞總統哈菲茲·阿薩德控制貝卡谷地的空軍與防空部署；敘利亞防空軍負責人納吉·賈米爾在六月初的空襲中陣亡，使指揮體系受到直接衝擊。美國總統羅納德·雷根於六月十一日提出停火框架，菲利普·哈比卜則在圍堵階段協助達成PLO撤出貝魯特的安排。
dossier.peopleEn: Major decisions came from several political, military, and diplomatic centers. Israeli Prime Minister Menachem Begin authorized the escalation, Defense Minister Ariel Sharon pressed for a deeper campaign inside Lebanon, and Chief of Staff Rafael Eitan directed the operational planning and staff coordination. Avigdor Ben-Gal commanded the southern front, within whose order of battle the Eighth Armored Division and other formations carried out the coastal advance. Eitan completed his term at the end of July and was succeeded as chief of staff by Dan Shomron. PLO chairman Yasser Arafat handled the political-level ceasefire and evacuation decisions from Beirut, while field commanders continued to command their brigades. Lebanese President Elias Sarkis and Prime Minister Shafik Wazzan tried to keep the Lebanese army out of the full Israeli-PLO conflict, although their effective authority was limited. Syrian president Hafez al-Assad controlled the deployment of Syrian air and air-defence forces in the Bekaa. Naji Jamil, the head of the Syrian air-defence force, was killed in an air attack in early June, directly disrupting the command structure. US president Ronald Reagan presented a ceasefire framework on 11 June, and Philip Habib later helped negotiate the PLO evacuation from Beirut.
dossier.kits: 以色列的地面作戰核心是M48A3、M60A1與少量Centurion及M24 Chieftain戰車，步兵則由M151 M2半履帶車和机械化步兵承載。砲兵主力包括M109A1 155公厘自走砲與M107 203公厘自走砲，基層火力使用105公厘穿甲彈或高爆彈、120公厘迫擊炮炸彈，以及155與203公厘高爆榴彈。前沿部隊先由工兵利用既有橋梁或建立臨時渡河點，砲彈再由後方裝載站送至各師、旅所屬陣地；沿海公路在首週打通後，燃料、備件與前線補給車隊得以持續北進。空中武器包括F-4E Phantom II、A-4F Skyhawk、F-15、AH-1S Cobra、UH-1H Iroquois與E-2C Hawkeye，C-130和Arava則負責較大噸位的運輸。海軍以Sa'ar 5型飛彈艇配合早期型加百列反艦飛彈，執行沿岸監視、封鎖與火力支援。PLO序列中可見T-55戰車、BMP-1裝甲步兵車、BTR-50或BTR-60裝甲車、RPG-7火箭筒、ZU-23雙聯高射砲及BM-13系列122公厘火箭發射車，火炮包括D-30 122公厘牽引砲與M-46 130公厘榴彈砲。敘利亞在貝卡部署SA-2及SA-3地空飛彈與MiG-21、MiG-23等戰機。PLO的燃料、維修件與備份砲彈分散在南部陣地及通往貝卡的補給線，以軍控制沿海道路後，其遠距補給須承受更長的內陸運輸線。
dossier.kitsEn: The core of Israel's ground force consisted of M48A3, M60A1, and smaller numbers of Centurion and M24 Chieftain tanks, with infantry carried in M151 M2 half-tracks and mechanized formations. The artillery main arm comprised M109A1 155 mm self-propelled howitzers and M107 203 mm self-propelled howitzers. Lower-level fire support used 105 mm high-explosive or anti-tank rounds, 120 mm mortar bombs, and 155 mm and 203 mm high-explosive shells. Combat engineers opened river crossings by using existing bridges or constructing temporary crossings, after which ammunition moved from rear loading points to brigade and divisional gun positions. Once the coastal road was opened in the first week, daily truck convoys carried fuel, spare parts, and ammunition northward. The air arm included F-4E Phantom II, A-4F Skyhawk, F-15, AH-1S Cobra, UH-1H Iroquois, and E-2C Hawkeye aircraft, while C-130 and Arava transports handled heavier loads. The navy employed Sa'ar 5-class missile boats with early Gabriel anti-ship missiles for coastal surveillance, interdiction, and fire support. Equipment identified in PLO formations included T-55 tanks, BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-50 or BTR-60 armored carriers, RPG-7 launchers, ZU-23 twin anti-aircraft guns, and BM-13-series 122 mm rocket launchers. PLO artillery included D-30 122 mm towed guns and M-46 130 mm howitzers. Syria deployed SA-2 and SA-3 surface-to-air missiles and MiG-21 and MiG-23 fighters in the Bekaa. PLO fuel, spare parts, and ammunition were dispersed among southern positions and supply routes toward the Bekaa; after Israel secured the coastal road, longer inland routes had to absorb the additional burden.
dossier.tactics: 六月六日清晨，以色列先以炮兵和航空兵同時壓制PLO前沿與指揮節點，再由裝甲旅沿三個方向推進，刻意利用快速運動切斷道路、渡口和後方聯絡，而不是逐村掃過所有據點。南部由拿古拉出發，經Jisr al-Majamiyeh橋、以方所稱的Quantarrah，向西頓與泰爾推進；中部由第九步兵師等部隊通過利塔尼河，向哈斯巴亞及貝卡南部伸展；北部部隊則進入舒夫地區，再向西轉進，與沿海戰線會合。裝甲部隊超越仍可運作的地段後，工兵迅速架設渡河設施，步兵和半履帶車清除被繞過的堡壘；M109與M107砲兵在師、旅後方形成可移動支援。PLO以反戰車壕、縱深陣地、坦克射界和分散火箭炮台阻止裝甲兵連續前進，步兵在局部路段進行短時間反擊並在受壓後撤往下一道陣地。貝卡空戰中，以軍以E-2C、雷達干擾車、AGM-45反輻射飛彈與同步航空攻擊處理SA-2及SA-3，先削弱雷達和發射陣地，再讓固定翼戰機低空進入；敘利亞戰機初期分散停留地面，待干擾與防空火力降低後才恢復出擊。進入貝魯特外圍後，以軍封鎖主要道路並逐個處理外圍陣地，沒有立即對整座市區展開地面總攻，而是以封鎖、砲火及談判迫使PLO指揮部選擇撤離。
dossier.tacticsEn: Early on 6 June, Israeli artillery and aircraft suppressed PLO forward positions and command nodes before armored brigades advanced on three axes. The intention was to move rapidly across roads, bridges, and rear communications rather than clear every settlement in sequence. In the south, forces left Naqoura, crossed the Litani area at Jisr al-Majamiyeh, known to the Israeli forces as Quantarrah, and drove toward Sidon and Tyre. In the center, formations including the Ninth Infantry Division crossed the Litani and extended toward Hasbaya and southern Bekaa. Northern forces entered the Chouf and then turned west to link with the coastal axis. After armored columns bypassed positions that remained operational, engineers opened crossings at once, and infantry in half-tracks eliminated bypassed strongpoints. M109 and M107 artillery batteries formed mobile support at division and brigade level. PLO troops slowed the armored advance with anti-tank ditches, depth-oriented positions, tank firing lanes, and dispersed rocket launchers, while infantry conducted localized counterattacks and withdrew to the next defensive position under pressure. In the Bekaa air campaign, Israel used E-2C aircraft, radar jammers, AGM-45 anti-radiation missiles, and coordinated attacks against SA-2 and SA-3 batteries. Radars and launch positions were weakened before strike aircraft entered at low altitude. Syrian fighters initially remained dispersed on the ground and resumed operations after jamming and air-defence pressure declined. Outside Beirut, Israeli forces blocked the principal roads and reduced outer positions separately rather than immediately attempting a general ground assault on the entire city. Blockade, artillery, air attack, and negotiation then combined to induce the PLO leadership to withdraw.
dossier.data: 六月六日約四時，以色列炮火與空襲展開，戰爭由邊界滲透事件轉為全面地面進攻。首週內，第八裝甲師沿沿海走廊推進並控制西頓、泰爾一帶；中部部隊在利塔尼河及哈斯巴亞方向遭遇較強抵抗。六月十日前後，多數作戰部隊已在利塔尼河一線建立廣闊控制區，縱深約四十公里。六月十一日，美國總統雷根提出為期兩週的停火，以色列表示接受，PLO拒絕全部條件；六月十四日前後雖形成局部停火安排，雙方卻未建立可核查的同步停火。六月十五日，聯合國安全理事會通過第502號決議，譴責以色列的軍事行動並要求停火及撤軍。六月二十一日至二十二日，以軍把空戰擴至貝卡谷地，打擊敘利亞地空飛彈網；同日開始的木牆行動則集中清除利塔尼河以南的PLO指揮、火箭炮與後勤節點。六月底至七月初，南北兩翼在貝魯特通往達穆爾的走廊會合，對西貝魯特的封鎖逐漸固定。七月五日，以色列空軍戰史記錄F-15編隊在貝卡擊落四架敘利亞米格-15戰機；敘利亞航空兵力此後更依賴疏散、轉場與地面待命。七月的主要戰事轉為封鎖、砲火與談判並行；八月一日，以色列空襲貝魯特的PLO總部建築，該組織隨後加快撤離安排。八月十日，以方宣布解除封鎖並接受撤離安排；PLO主力車隊於八月十一日開始離開貝魯特，最後一批有組織部隊在十二日完成轉移，取道敘利亞控制區及約旦方向前往突尼斯。九月十八日，以色列與黎巴嫩簽署後續協議，確定撤軍與南部安全區安排。各方傷亡總數因起訖日期、戰俘及後續衝突是否納入而不同，本錄不填入無法交叉核實的精確總數。
dossier.dataEn: At about 04:00 on 6 June, Israeli artillery and air attacks opened the campaign, turning an incident at the frontier into a full-scale ground invasion. During the first week, the Eighth Armored Division advanced along the coastal corridor and took control around Sidon and Tyre, while central formations encountered stronger resistance near the Litani and Hasbaya. By about 10 June, most field units had established control along a broad front at the Litani, roughly forty kilometres deep. On 11 June, US president Ronald Reagan proposed a two-week ceasefire. Israel accepted the proposal, while the PLO rejected its full terms. A limited arrangement formed around 14 June, but no mutually verifiable simultaneous halt was established. On 15 June, the UN Security Council adopted Resolution 502, condemning the Israeli military action and calling for a ceasefire and withdrawal. Between 21 and 22 June, Israel extended the air campaign into the Bekaa and attacked the Syrian surface-to-air missile network. Wooden Wall, begun on 22 June, concentrated on PLO command, rocket artillery, and logistics south of the Litani. From late June into early July, northern and southern forces linked along the Beirut-Damour corridor, and the encirclement of West Beirut gradually became fixed. On 5 July, Israeli air-force records credited an F-15 formation in the Bekaa with the destruction of four Syrian MiG-15 fighters. Syrian air units increasingly relied thereafter on dispersal, relocation, and ground holding. During July, blockade, artillery, and negotiation became the principal means of applying pressure. On 1 August, Israeli aircraft struck the PLO headquarters building in Beirut, accelerating the evacuation negotiations. On 10 August, Israel lifted the blockade after an evacuation arrangement was accepted. The main PLO convoy began leaving Beirut on 11 August, and the last organized formations completed their transfer on 12 August through Syrian-held territory and the Jordan direction before continuing to Tunis. On 18 September, Israel and Lebanon signed an agreement governing withdrawal and the security zone in the south. Casualty totals vary with the dates used and with the inclusion of prisoners or later clashes, so this record does not insert an exact total that cannot be cross-checked.
dossier.cause: 直接背景是1981年利塔尼河停火線及其執行爭議。以色列把PLO在黎巴嫩南部重新部署兵員、火箭炮和固定工事視為違反既有安排，並認為邊境滲透與跨境射擊已形成軍事威脅；PLO則把任何以色列駐軍與黎巴嫩主權問題相連，否認以色列所稱的滲透事件。兩種敘述在六月初泰爾附近的武裝衝突中完全相反，PLO指責以色列先採取軍事行動，以色列則把衝突視為全面清除南部PLO基地的理由。聯合國安全理事會第501號決議是在全面越境作戰前，要求各方保持克制，但它沒有消除以色列政府已作出的政治決定。六月五日，以色列先以有限空襲和地面行動打擊PLO；六月六日，軍隊越過利塔尼河，正式進入黎巴嫩。公開目標主要是把PLO重新推到利塔尼河以北，但以軍預案、師級裝甲部署與後續補給安排都指向更深的縱深，包括摧毀PLO指揮體系、火箭炮與南北聯絡，並打通通往貝魯特的走廊。PLO不能放棄其在黎巴嫩的基地，敘利亞則以防空力量支援；六月停火之所以失敗，關鍵正是雙方條件不相容，以色列要求PLO撤出貝魯特，PLO要求以色列撤出黎巴嫩，而當時雙方都沒有接受對方提出的整體交換。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate background was the Litani ceasefire line of 1981 and disagreement over its implementation. Israel regarded the renewed PLO deployment of troops, rocket artillery, and permanent fortifications in southern Lebanon as a breach of the existing arrangement and considered border infiltration and cross-border fire to be a military threat. The PLO linked Israeli troop presence to Lebanese sovereignty and denied the infiltration incidents alleged by Israel. The competing accounts collided in an armed clash near Tyre in early June. The PLO accused Israel of initiating military action, while Israel treated the clash as grounds for removing the PLO military presence from the south. UN Security Council Resolution 501 called for restraint before the full cross-border operation, but it did not reverse the political decision already taken by the Israeli government. On 5 June, Israel began limited air and ground attacks against PLO targets. On 6 June, its forces crossed the Litani and entered Lebanon. The publicly stated principal objective was to return the PLO north of the Litani, but Israeli operational plans, divisional armored deployments, and supporting logistics extended farther inland. They called for the destruction of PLO command, rocket artillery, and north-south communications while opening a corridor toward Beirut. The PLO could not simply abandon its Lebanese base, and Syria supported it through its air-defence forces. The June ceasefire failed because the proposed exchanges were incompatible: Israel required PLO withdrawal from Beirut, the PLO demanded Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon, and neither side accepted the other's full terms.
dossier.impact: 軍事上，以色列在黎巴嫩南部建立了比1981年更深的控制區，並在貝卡空戰中使敘利亞的SA-2與SA-3雷達、發射陣地和指揮流程一度失去整體效能。敘利亞戰機因此長時間採分散、掩蔽與短程出擊方式，殘存防空系統其後重建；以軍則取得貝卡上空的階段性主動權。這種戰果並不等於敘利亞航空力量永久消失，因為地面防空、未受損建築與後備飛機仍能支持恢復。PLO失去南黎巴嫩的主要營區、火箭炮部署與通往貝卡的完整補給網，貝魯特總部受襲後，其政治和軍事指揮中心轉往突尼斯並在境外重組，但組織本身沒有被摧毀。黎巴嫩國家層面承受更直接的制度損失：軍隊指揮分裂，與PLO合作的部隊與維持中立的單位互不統一，南方黎巴嫩軍在1984年被解散，一部分人員被納入其他武裝。這使中央政府重新控制貝卡與舒夫的努力延後。以色列則獲得安全區、海空通道與對邊境突發事件的預警時間。戰役也顯示，装甲、工兵、空軍、砲兵和後勤若不能保持同步，装甲優勢會迅速下降；反過來，縱深補給線與戰場情報同樣會限制進攻方。各方傷亡數字存在統計口徑差異，無法核實的精確總數不應被當作本戰唯一結論。
dossier.impactEn: Militarily, Israel established a deeper zone of control in southern Lebanon than it had held in 1981. In the Bekaa campaign, the operational cohesion of Syrian SA-2 and SA-3 radars, launch positions, and command flows was severely disrupted. Syrian aircraft consequently relied for extended periods on dispersal, concealment, and short sorties, while surviving air-defence elements were rebuilt later. Israel gained temporary control of the Bekaa skies, but this did not mean that Syrian air power disappeared permanently, because ground defences, undamaged structures, and reserve aircraft supported recovery. The PLO lost its principal camps in southern Lebanon, its rocket-artillery deployment, and its intact supply network into the Bekaa. After its Beirut headquarters was struck, its political and military center moved to Tunis and was rebuilt outside Lebanon, but the organization itself survived. The Lebanese state suffered a more direct institutional loss. Command within the army fragmented, units cooperating with the PLO and units remaining neutral were not integrated, and the South Lebanon Army was dissolved in 1984, with some of its personnel entering other armed formations. This delayed efforts by the central government to redeploy in the Bekaa and Chouf. Israel, in turn, obtained a security zone, reliable air and sea approaches, and additional warning time along the frontier. The campaign also showed that armored advantages declined rapidly unless armor, engineers, air power, artillery, and logistics remained synchronized. In the opposite direction, long supply routes and battlefield intelligence constrained the attacker. Casualty figures differed according to national counting rules, and exact totals that cannot be verified should not be presented as a single authoritative conclusion.
dossier.result: 就作戰結果而言，PLO有組織的地面部隊在八月十二日前後完成撤出貝魯特，亞西爾·阿拉法特及主要指揮機構轉往突尼斯；以色列則控制利塔尼河至北部邊界之間的安全區，並暫時掌握西貝魯特外圍與部分舒夫地區。九月十八日簽署的以色列—黎巴嫩協議處理以軍撤出貝魯特及南部防衛安排，規定上的主權歸屬與實際軍事控制因而並存。以色列在1984年撤出貝魯特，黎巴嫩軍重新進入舒夫與中部據點，南方黎巴嫩軍則正式解散；以色列安全區一直維持到1985年才撤除。PLO並未因離開黎巴嫩而消失，而是在突尼斯重建指揮與後續政治軍事活動，並於1980年代後期重返黎巴嫩。敘利亞仍保留在黎巴嫩的軍事存在，也重新部署防空系統。因此，這是一場以軍在黎巴嫩境內取得明確軍事控制、PLO失去黎巴嫩基地的戰役，但沒有形成永久解決黎巴嫩權力與安全問題的安排。日期上，本戰通常以六月六日至八月十日計；八月十一至十二日是PLO撤離完成，九月十八日則是後續雙邊協議日期，三者不應混為同一終點。
dossier.resultEn: In operational terms, the PLO completed the withdrawal of its organized ground formations from Beirut around 12 August. Yasser Arafat and the principal command institutions moved to Tunis, while Israel secured the security zone between the Litani and the northern frontier and temporarily held positions outside West Beirut and in parts of the Chouf. The Israeli-Lebanese agreement signed on 18 September addressed Israeli withdrawal from Beirut and the defence arrangements for southern Lebanon, leaving formal sovereignty and actual military control existing side by side. Israel withdrew from Beirut in 1984, the Lebanese army redeployed in the Chouf and central positions, and the South Lebanon Army was formally dissolved. The Israeli security zone remained until it was removed in 1985. The PLO did not disappear after leaving Lebanon. It rebuilt its command and political-military activity in Tunis, later returned to Lebanon in the late 1980s, and Syria maintained a military presence while rebuilding its air-defence system. The result was therefore a campaign in which Israel obtained clear military control inside Lebanon and the PLO lost its Lebanese base, but not a permanent settlement of Lebanon's political and security problems. The war is conventionally dated from 6 June to 10 August. The evacuation occurred on 11 and 12 August, while the subsequent bilateral agreement was signed on 18 September; these are distinct terminal dates and should not be treated as one.

battle.name: 赤瓜礁海戰
battle.brief: 赤瓜礁海戰於一九八八年三月二十三日爆發，是中越兩國軍隊在南海赤瓜礁及鄰近海域的武裝衝突，也是參考清單收錄的衝突。中國海軍艦艇執行海上巡邏與警戒，中國空軍則出動J-8 II（殲八II）戰鬥機，承擔制空、攔截及海上支援任務。

kit.name: 殲八II戰鬥機
kit.history: J-8 II是中國人民解放軍空軍的單座全天候截擊機，編入航空兵師下屬殲擊機團，主要執行高空高速攔截、警戒與制空任務。

dossier.countries: 1988年5月3日，赤瓜礁海戰發生在南海斯普拉特利群島西南部，英文史料常以 Johnson South Reef 指稱同一地點。中方由人民解放軍海軍南海艦隊的驅逐艦、護衛艦與兩棲運輸兵力組成艦艇編隊；越方由越南人民海軍第二海區的HQ-10系列導彈艇、運輸船及礁上駐軍執行巡邏與輪換。兩國都主張群島主權，現場則是海軍艦艇和登陸兵力直接對抗。戰鬥從命令、警告與航路封鎖發展成艦炮交火，最後轉為中方登陸、奪取礁面控制。從開始到結束，中方保持海上火力掩護，越方以艇隊遮護運輸船並組織撤退。本文只把兩國公開資料中可以互相核對的事實合併陳述，不把任何一方的單方說法當成未經證實的定論。
dossier.countriesEn: The Battle of Chigua Reef took place on 3 May 1988 in the southwestern portion of the Spratly Islands in the South China Sea, the same location often identified in English-language records as Johnson South Reef. The Chinese side formed a naval group from the South Sea Fleet consisting of destroyers, frigates, and amphibious transport forces, while the Vietnamese side deployed HQ-10-series missile boats, transport vessels, and a reef garrison from the Second Naval Region of the Vietnam People’s Navy for patrols and personnel rotations. Both countries claimed sovereignty over the islands, but the immediate clash was between naval vessels and amphibious forces. The action developed from orders, warnings, and attempts to control the sea route into a naval gunnery engagement, before shifting to a Chinese landing operation that secured the reef. Throughout the action, Chinese ships maintained covering fire at sea, while Vietnamese boats screened the transports and organized their withdrawal. This account combines facts that can be compared across both countries’ public records and does not present either side’s unilateral account as an unverified final judgment.
dossier.people: 中方公開資料通常把南海艦隊司令詹榮喧列為作戰海域的最高主官，並記載張仁勇負責艦艇編隊的具體指揮。這次行動不是由單艦自行決定，驅逐艦、護衛艦、登陸運輸艦與海上指揮所均依照艦隊命令協同。502艦是接觸越方艇隊的主要前衛艦；越方第二海區由岸上機關向海上分隊下达命令，HQ-10導彈艇負責警戒和遮護，運輸船負責把輪換人員送上礁。越方公開材料沒有提供一個能在雙方紀錄中一致核對的戰鬥指揮姓名。戰中雙方均有艇員或士兵死亡、受傷，越方還有人被俘；各方公布的傷亡總數彼此衝突，故不列任何精確總數，也不把單方名單視為完整傷亡表。
dossier.peopleEn: Chinese public records generally identify South Sea Fleet commander Zhan Rongxuan as the senior commander responsible for the operational area and credit Zhang Renyong with the direct command of the ship group. The operation was not decided by an individual vessel: destroyers, frigates, amphibious transports, and the maritime command post acted together under fleet orders. Ship 502 was the principal frigate that made contact with the Vietnamese boats. On the Vietnamese side, shore authorities in the Second Naval Region issued orders to the maritime detachment, with HQ-10 missile boats providing warning, screening, and covering fire while transports carried rotation personnel to the reef. Vietnamese public accounts do not provide a combat commander’s name that can be consistently verified against the opposing record. Personnel from both sides were killed or wounded, and some Vietnamese personnel were captured. Because the published casualty totals conflict with one another, no exact overall figure is given, and no unilateral list is treated as a complete casualty record.
dossier.kits: 中方可核對的核心裝備包括105艦衡陽號051型驅逐艦與502艦通化號053H1型護衛艦。衡陽艦位於編隊外圈，負責較大範圍的海上警戒；通化艦裝有100毫米艦炮、57毫米艦炮與30毫米機炮，公開戰鬥記錄能確認502艦曾以100毫米艦炮攻擊越方艇船。越方可核對的裝備主要是502號與503號HQ-10系列小型導彈艇，通常歸入Project 622M型譜系，配備P-15反艦導彈與AK-230型30毫米自動炮，另有運輸艇和登陸艇承載輪換兵力。P-15是否實際發射以及命中情形，在雙方紀錄中沒有完整證據，不能補寫發射數或命中數；100毫米炮彈則確實用於此次交火。
dossier.kitsEn: The principal Chinese equipment that can be verified consists of destroyer Hengyang, hull 105, a Type 051 destroyer, and frigate Tonghua, hull 502, a Type 053H1 frigate. Hengyang operated on the outer edge of the formation and provided wider-area maritime security, while Tonghua carried 100 mm naval guns, 57 mm naval guns, and 30 mm automatic cannon. The surviving combat records confirm that ship 502 used its 100 mm guns against Vietnamese vessels. The principal verifiable Vietnamese weapons included small missile boats numbered 502 and 503 of the HQ-10 series, commonly associated with the Project 622M family. They carried P-15 anti-ship missiles and AK-230 30 mm automatic cannon, while transports and landing craft carried the rotating personnel. There is no complete evidence across the two sides’ records confirming whether P-15 missiles were launched or whether any hit, so no launch count or hit count has been supplied. The 100 mm naval gun ammunition was definitely used in the engagement.
dossier.tactics: 中方編隊採取分層部署，驅逐艦留在外圈觀察航道，護衛艦向前接近，登陸與運輸兵力則在後方保持可轉入登陸的位置。502艦先行接近越方運輸編隊，透過航行位置與通訊要求對方離開相關海峽；越方HQ-10艇則以艇身遮護運輸船，使部分船艇得以靠近礁緣。當双方 maneuvering space 收縮、命令與退出行動未能完成時，100毫米艦炮首先造成一艘越方艇船起火並失去繼續航行能力，越方其他艇船隨即以機炮及反艦武器方向实施還擊。中方沒有讓前衛艦孤立地追越，而是維持舰炮与运输兵力之间的掩护关系。越方受损艇无法继续接应，越军海上编队撤离后，中方将两栖兵力转入小艇分批送上礁面，越方守军的组织抵抗随之停止，整个行动由海战转为占领与控制。
dossier.tacticsEn: The Chinese formation used a layered deployment. Destroyers remained on the outer perimeter to monitor the sea lane, frigates moved forward, and the amphibious and transport forces stayed behind in positions from which they could begin a landing. Ship 502 approached the Vietnamese transport group first, using its position and communications to require the Vietnamese vessels to leave the relevant passage. The Vietnamese HQ-10 boats screened the transports and allowed some vessels to approach the edge of the reef. When maneuvering room contracted and neither side completed its withdrawal, 100 mm naval gunfire set one Vietnamese vessel ablaze and deprived it of the ability to continue underway. The remaining Vietnamese boats then attempted to retaliate with automatic cannon and anti-ship weapons. The Chinese did not allow the leading frigate to pursue alone but maintained the relationship between gun cover and the transport forces. The damaged Vietnamese boat could no longer provide support, and after the Vietnamese maritime group withdrew, Chinese amphibious personnel were transferred into small boats and landed in successive groups. Organized resistance by the Vietnamese garrison then ended, changing the action from a naval engagement into occupation and control of the reef.
dossier.data: 3月下旬起，中方南海艦隊開始為南沙行動集中艦艇與登陸兵力。艦隊由南海艦隊基地出航，航向先朝東南，經西沙群島海域轉入南沙，公開戰史多把永興島一帶視為途中補給、檢查與重新編隊的節點。母艦隨編隊攜帶柴油、淡水、口糧與艦炮及機炮彈藥，實際登陸兵力則由後方運輸艦送入小型登陸艇。5月3日上午十時過後，赤瓜礁外海形成接觸；中方戰報把第一次100毫米炮擊記為約10時14分，越方紀錄則對此前命令與射擊次序另有排列。可以確定的是，艦炮交火集中在上午十時後的數十分鐘內，其後才轉為登陸與鞏固。公開資料不足以核實總炮數、導彈發射數、各艇距離與完整後勤消耗，因此這些數字不作推測。
dossier.dataEn: From late March, the Chinese South Sea Fleet began concentrating ships and amphibious forces for operations in the Spratlys. The group departed from bases of the fleet, initially sailed southeast, passed through the Xisha Islands area, and then entered the Spratlys. Public campaign histories generally treat the Yongxing Island area as a point for replenishment, inspection, and reorganization during the passage. The support ships traveled with the formation and carried diesel fuel, fresh water, rations, and naval-gun and automatic-cannon ammunition, while the actual landing force was transferred from transports farther back into small landing craft. Contact was made outside Chigua Reef shortly after 10 a.m. on 3 May. Chinese battle reports time the first 100 mm salvo at approximately 10:14, whereas Vietnamese records arrange the earlier orders and firing sequence differently. What can be established is that the gunnery exchange occurred within several tens of minutes after 10 a.m. and was followed by the landing and consolidation phase. The public evidence is insufficient to verify the total number of shells, missile launches, vessel distances, or complete logistical expenditure, so those figures are not estimated.
dossier.cause: 赤瓜礁衝突是南海主權爭端長期累積後的近距離碰撞，而不是一次無關的偶發炮擊。中方依據對南海島礁及歷史文獻的解讀主張主權，越方則依據對法屬印度支那時期治理的承接及實際駐防主張權利；兩種法律與歷史依據直到1988年仍未由共同接受的裁判解決。1979年邊境戰爭後，南海艦隊活動與越方巡邏都更為頻繁。1988年3月以後，中方希望在所主張控制的島礁維持或擴大海上駐軍，越方則繼續對現有礁點執行補給與人員輪換。5月3日，兩支任務在赤瓜礁外海相遇；中方把越方接近視為妨礙登陸與航路控制，越方則把中方要求退出視為改變既有控制，因而都以海上兵力維護各自行動。
dossier.causeEn: The clash at Chigua Reef was the result of long-running sovereignty disputes in the South China Sea converging at close range, rather than an unrelated accidental exchange of fire. China based its claim on its interpretation of the maritime islands and historical documents, while Vietnam relied on its succession to the former French administration of Indochina and its actual garrison presence. Those historical and legal positions had not been resolved through a mutually accepted adjudication by 1988. After the border conflict of 1979, South Sea Fleet activity and Vietnamese patrols both became more frequent. From March 1988 onward, China sought to maintain or expand a maritime presence on reefs it claimed, while Vietnam continued resupplying existing positions and rotating personnel. The two missions converged outside Chigua Reef on 3 May. China regarded the Vietnamese approach as an attempt to obstruct its landing and control of the sea route, while Vietnam regarded the Chinese demand for withdrawal as an attempt to overturn existing control. Each therefore used naval forces to protect its own operation.
dossier.impact: 這次戰鬥最直接的結果，是赤瓜礁的實際控制轉入中方手中。中方登陸兵力在艦隊掩護下完成進駐，越方原有的海上接應中斷，至少一艘HQ-10導彈艇重損後被放棄，其餘艇船撤離；502艦亦受到炮彈破片影響並有人員傷亡，但公開資料無法核實完整損壞程度與傷亡總數。越方沒有在此次行動中立即重奪該礁，但繼續維持南沙其他島礁的駐防與巡邏；中方則把赤瓜礁納入後續巡邏、補給與常態駐守。這場戰鬥改變的是一個礁點的實際控制及周邊兵力部署，沒有代替國際法律程序，也不代表斯普拉特利群島整體主權問題已獲解決。雙方之後仍透過外交交涉相互指責，軍事上的近距離對峙也隨之增加。
dossier.impactEn: The most direct effect of the battle was that actual control of Chigua Reef passed to China. Chinese landing forces established a garrison under naval cover, severing the existing Vietnamese maritime link. At least one HQ-10 missile boat was heavily damaged and abandoned, while the remaining boats withdrew. Ship 502 also suffered splinter damage and personnel casualties, although the public evidence does not establish its complete damage or an exact casualty total. Vietnam did not immediately retake the reef during this action, but it continued to garrison and patrol other positions in the Spratlys. China incorporated Chigua Reef into its subsequent patrols, replenishment system, and permanent military presence. The battle changed de facto control of one reef and the deployment of forces around it; it did not replace an international legal process or settle sovereignty over the Spratlys as a whole. Both governments continued to protest the other’s conduct through diplomatic channels, and close military confrontation around the area subsequently increased.
dossier.result: 艦炮交火停止後，尚能航行的越方艇船退出赤瓜礁外海，重損艇失去接應與撤退能力；中方隨即完成登陸，越方守軍未能重新登船，現場出現中方俘獲的越方軍人。此後中方在該礁維持駐軍，越方在此次戰鬥尾聲沒有奪回控制，但雙方都沒有公開一份可由第三方核對的完整戰損、俘虜與傷亡紀錄。首次開火者仍有爭議：中方記錄把第一輪100毫米炮擊放在越方拒絕退出之後，越方則認為更早的驅離與航路控制已構成挑釁。從可確認的物質結果看，赤瓜礁由中方控制，至少一艘越方導彈艇被放棄，越方輪換行動失敗；從法律結果看，主權爭端並未因戰鬥而解決，戰役因此應以實際奪礁與後續控制變化記錄，而不能只引用任何一方單方面的勝負名稱。
dossier.resultEn: After the naval gunnery ceased, the Vietnamese vessels that remained seaworthy withdrew from the waters outside Chigua Reef, while the heavily damaged boat lost both support and the ability to withdraw. Chinese forces then completed their landing. The Vietnamese garrison was unable to re-embark, and Chinese forces captured Vietnamese soldiers present at the site. China subsequently maintained a garrison on the reef, and Vietnam did not regain control during the closing phase of this action. Neither government, however, published a complete and independently verifiable record of damage, prisoners, and casualties that a third party could cross-check. Responsibility for the first shot remains disputed: Chinese records place the first 100 mm salvo after the Vietnamese vessels refused to withdraw, while Vietnam regarded the earlier attempt to remove them and control the sea route as a provocation. In terms of the material outcome, China controlled Chigua Reef, at least one Vietnamese missile boat was abandoned, and the Vietnamese rotation mission failed. In legal terms, the sovereignty dispute was not resolved by the battle. The engagement should therefore be recorded through the physical seizure of the reef and the resulting change in control, rather than through either side’s unilateral victory label alone.

battle.name: 美國入侵巴拿馬
battle.brief: 一九八九年十二月，美國入侵巴拿馬，是中文維基「戰爭列表」收錄的衝突。美軍進入巴拿馬後，地面部隊使用M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克執行突破、掩護與據點攻占任務。該型坦克屬於美國陸軍裝甲部隊，於一九八五年列裝，並在作戰中與裝甲步兵協同推進。

kit.name: M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克
kit.history: M1A1是美國陸軍裝甲師的主要主戰坦克，與裝甲步兵協同執行突破、防禦及要點占領任務，並構成師級裝甲骨幹。

dossier.countries: 這場戰役發生在巴拿馬地峽，交戰方是美國與巴拿馬國防軍，地理上並非一條由北向南的單一戰線。巴拿馬城位於太平洋側，運河區與科隆位於大西洋側，兩地之間夾著丘陵、城市和山脈；里奧阿托、維拉加斯與戴維則構成西部及內陸的空降與裝甲目標。從巴拿馬城到科隆的道路約八十公里，從巴拿馬城經內陸公路到戴維約五百公里，橋梁、街區和狹窄路段會限制車輛縱隊，卻也讓直升機和空降兵能越過地面障礙。美國由本土空軍基地、海上兵力，以及運河區內既有軍事設施投射部隊；巴拿馬國防軍則依城市、營區、機場和山地的固定陣地分散配置。美軍的實際問題不是佔領每一寸土地，而是同時奪取機場、控制交通節點、切斷指揮鏈，再向內陸和運河區擴張。
dossier.countriesEn: This battle took place in the Panamanian isthmus, and the belligerents were the United States and the Panamanian Defense Forces; geographically, it was not a single north-to-south front. Panama City was on the Pacific side, while the Canal Zone and Colón were on the Atlantic side, with hills, urban areas, and mountains between them. Río Hato, Veraguas, and David formed airborne and armored objectives in the west and interior. The road from Panama City to Colón is about eighty kilometres, and the inland road to David is about five hundred kilometres; bridges, city blocks, and narrow road sections restricted vehicle columns, while allowing helicopters and airborne troops to bypass ground obstacles. The United States projected forces from air bases on the American mainland, maritime forces, and existing military facilities in the Canal Zone. Panamanian forces were dispersed among fixed positions in cities, camps, airfields, and mountains. The American practical problem was not to occupy every inch of territory, but to seize airfields, control transport nodes, cut the command chain, and then expand inland and toward the Canal Zone.
dossier.people: 白宮先作出政治決定。喬治·H·W·布希在巴拿馬政府拒絕接受期限後，授權美軍執行代號為 Just Cause 的行動；諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將以聯合任務部隊指揮官的身分，統籌空軍、海軍、陸軍、海軍陸戰隊與海軍特種作戰單位。第十八空降軍指揮官卡爾文·沃勒中將和第82空降師司令詹姆斯·M·約翰遜中將，分別負責軍級協調與空降作戰；第1營502步兵团、第1營505步兵团和第3營505步兵团是最初奪取機場的骨幹。地面階段，第1、第3、第4與第7步兵師的分遣部隊，以及海軍陸戰隊第1團第3營，接續向巴拿馬城、運河區、科隆和西部道路推進。巴拿馬方面由曼努埃爾·安東尼奧·諾列加將軍掌握國防軍最高指揮權，旅、營指揮官依預設陣地守住機場、營區與城市要點；通訊被破壞後，各單位常須自行決定抵抗、撤退或投降。
dossier.peopleEn: Political decisions were made first at the White House. After the Panamanian government rejected the deadline, President George H. W. Bush authorized the military operation code-named Just Cause; General Norman Schwarzkopf, serving as commander of the joint task force, coordinated the Air Force, Navy, Army, Marine Corps, and naval special operations units. Lieutenant General Calvin Waller, commander of the XVIII Airborne Corps, and Major General James M. Johnson, commander of the 82nd Airborne Division, handled corps-level coordination and airborne operations. The 1st Battalion, 502nd Infantry Regiment; 1st Battalion, 505th Infantry Regiment; and 3rd Battalion, 505th Infantry Regiment formed the core of the initial effort to seize airfields. In the ground phase, detachments from the 1st, 3rd, 4th, and 7th Infantry Divisions, together with the 3rd Battalion, 1st Marine Regiment, moved toward Panama City, the Canal Zone, Colón, and the western roads. On the Panamanian side, General Manuel Antonio Noriega held supreme command of the Defense Forces; brigade and battalion commanders occupied airfields, camps, and city strongpoints. Once communications were disrupted, local units often had to decide for themselves whether to resist, withdraw, or surrender.
dossier.kits: 1989年可見的裝備顯示雙方並非同一技術世代。美軍地面突擊以M16A2步槍、M203榴彈發射器、M249班機槍、M240通用機槍及AN/PVS-15夜視鏡為核心，頭上配PASGT頭盔和防彈衣；空降與裝甲單位使用M1A1 Abrams主戰坦克、M2 Bradley步兵戰鬥車和M113裝甲人員輸送車，砲兵使用M109A2 155毫米自走砲。航空支援包括AH-1S攻擊直升機、UH-60黑鷹運輸或後送直升機、C-141與C-130運輸機，以及AC-130H砲砲機；固定翼出擊與掩護機還包括A-10A、A-6E、F-15C/D與F-16C/D。彈藥供應以5.56×45毫米M193、M855和M856，7.62×51毫米機槍彈，M242 25毫米機炮用彈，120毫米坦克砲高爆及穿甲彈，155毫米高爆榴彈為主，另配AT4反裝甲發射器。巴拿馬軍的裝甲單位可見M3 Stuart輕坦克和M4A1 Sherman中型坦克，步兵使用AK-47或AKM 7.62×39毫米步槍、RPG-7、81毫米迫擊砲、7.62毫米機槍和12.7毫米重機槍，並以輪式車輛和武裝皮卡作快速反應。雙方的彈藥都靠預置庫、彈藥車、卡車和空運分送前線，裝甲車的備件與燃料同樣列入後勤。
dossier.kitsEn: The equipment available in 1989 showed that the two sides were not from the same technological generation. American assault infantry relied on M16A2 rifles, M203 grenade launchers, M249 squad automatic weapons, M240 general-purpose machine guns, and AN/PVS-15 night-vision devices, together with PASGT helmets and body armor. Airborne and armored units used M1A1 Abrams main battle tanks, M2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicles, and M113 armored personnel carriers; artillery units used M109A2 155 mm self-propelled howitzers. Aviation support included AH-1S attack helicopters, UH-60 Black Hawk transport and medevac helicopters, C-141 and C-130 transports, and AC-130H gunships, while fixed-wing strike and support aircraft included the A-10A, A-6E, F-15C/D, and F-16C/D. The principal ammunition supplies were 5.56×45 mm M193, M855, and M856 rounds, 7.62×51 mm machine-gun ammunition, 25 mm ammunition for the M242 gun, 120 mm high-explosive and armor-piercing tank rounds, and 155 mm high-explosive shells, together with AT4 anti-tank launchers. Panamanian armored units fielded M3 Stuart light tanks and M4A1 Sherman medium tanks; infantry used AK-47 or AKM 7.62×39 mm rifles, RPG-7 launchers, 81 mm mortars, 7.62 mm machine guns, and 12.7 mm heavy machine guns, while wheeled vehicles and armed pickups provided rapid reaction. Both sides distributed ammunition from prepositioned stocks, ammunition trucks, cargo trucks, and airlift to the front; spare parts and fuel for armored vehicles were also part of the sustainment burden.
dossier.tactics: 第一階段是速度與縱深，而不是正面推進。美軍先以AC-130H、A-6、A-10和戰鬥機攻擊機場、飛機、營區、諾列加的NORINDA情報節點與道路指揮中心，利用空中火力摧毀或封死巴軍的反擊能力，再由運輸機和直升機把第82空降師分隊投向馬里奧·托里霍斯、托庫門和里奧阿托等地。第1營502步兵团、第1營505步兵团和第3營505步兵团落地後先守住跑道、油料與通信設施，並迅速清出周邊陣地；部分巴軍單位曾以步兵和坦克反擊，但未能重新取得機場的整體控制。後續空降和地面分隊再飛向維拉加斯、戴維和山區，切斷巴軍從內陸調兵的時間。地面部隊由運河區向巴拿馬城及東、北道路展開，M1坦克和M2步兵戰鬥車在前，步兵、工程兵、通信兵和醫療兵跟進，遇到路障、橋頭或狹窄路口時由工程兵開路，裝甲火力掩護步兵通過。巴拿馬軍利用營區牆體、固定機槍陣地、反裝甲武器、武裝皮卡和少量坦克組成抵抗，企圖在機場與城市街區拖住美軍；美軍則以晝夜巡邏、封鎖道路、夜間突擊和AH-1S近距支援逐段解除據點。進入巴拿馬城後，美軍在埃爾喬里略和市中心採逐屋搜索、步兵封鎖交叉口、坦克壓制火力點，再由空軍處理無法迅速接近的目標。最後，部隊控制政府機關、通訊設施和通往梵蒂岡使館的道路，監視諾列加藏身之處而不強攻使館，切斷指揮官逃脫的空間。
dossier.tacticsEn: The first phase emphasized speed and depth rather than a frontal advance. AC-130H, A-6, A-10, and fighter aircraft first attacked airfields, aircraft, camps, Noriega's NORINDA intelligence nodes, and road-control centers, using air power to destroy or seal off Panamanian retaliatory capacity. Transport aircraft and helicopters then flew elements of the 82nd Airborne Division toward Omar Torrijos, Tocumen, Río Hato, and other objectives. After landing, the 1st Battalion, 502nd Infantry; 1st Battalion, 505th Infantry; and 3rd Battalion, 505th Infantry secured runways, fuel, and communications before clearing the surrounding positions. Some Panamanian units attempted counterattacks with infantry and tanks, but they did not regain overall control of the airfields. Later airborne and ground elements flew toward Veraguas, David, and the mountains, cutting the time available for Panamanian forces to move reinforcements from the interior. Ground forces expanded from the Canal Zone toward Panama City and the eastern and northern roads. M1 tanks and M2 infantry fighting vehicles led, with infantry, engineers, signal troops, and medics following; engineers opened roads at barricades, bridges, and narrow junctions, while armor covered infantry movement. Panamanian forces used camp walls, fixed machine-gun positions, anti-tank weapons, armed pickups, and a small number of tanks to hold airfields and city blocks. American forces used day and night patrols, road blocks, night raids, and AH-1S close support to reduce strongpoints one by one. In Panama City, troops searched buildings, sealed intersections, and used tanks to suppress firing positions around El Chorrillo and the city center, while aircraft handled targets that could not be approached quickly on the ground. Finally, forces secured government offices, communications facilities, and roads to the Vatican Embassy, maintaining containment rather than assaulting the diplomatic compound and cutting off the commander's escape routes.
dossier.data: 時間線顯示主要戰鬥集中在12月16日至24日的九個日曆日內。12月15日是布希給諾列加的政治期限；12月16日凌晨至清晨，空中打擊和空降同時展開，美軍先取得馬里奧·托里霍斯、托庫門與里奧阿托等機場的局部控制。17日至18日，第82空降師及後續空降、地面分隊繼續向內陸和西部飛行，維拉加斯、戴維方向的空軍設施與道路節點被封鎖；同一時期，海軍陸戰隊和地面部隊向巴拿馬城周邊推進，並鞏固運河區的出入口。19日至20日，埃爾喬里略與市中心戰鬥最密集，機械化步兵在航空支援下處理縱深據點；21日以後，巴軍各部缺乏統一命令，抵抗轉為局部反擊或營地防守。22日諾列加進入梵蒂岡使館，美軍在館外建立封鎖線；23日他同意投降，24日離開使館並被送往美國。31日以前，主要城市、機場、運河區與主要道路已由美軍掌握，戰役由戰鬥轉為搜索殘部、封鎖道路與善後。兵力方面，美軍投入約兩萬五千人，巴拿馬國防軍則以一萬多人為主；第82空降師由布拉格堡空運，其他師的單位經本土基地、海運和道路進入。克萊頓堡、阿馬多堡和已奪取的機場作補給節點，彈藥、油料、醫療後送與空運形成後勤鏈。巴拿馬城至科隆的道路約八十公里，至戴維約五百公里，距離本身不長，卻使道路保全和燃料前送成為作戰瓶頸。各方公開的傷亡數字因統計時點和分類不同而互有差異，本實錄不列無法核實的精確總數。
dossier.dataEn: The timeline shows that the main combat was concentrated in the nine calendar days from December 16 to December 24. December 15 was the political deadline Bush set for Noriega. In the early hours and morning of December 16, air strikes and airborne landings began together, and American forces first gained local control of airfields such as Omar Torrijos, Tocumen, and Río Hato. On December 17 and 18, the 82nd Airborne Division and later airborne and ground elements continued flights inland and west, sealing air bases and road junctions in the Veraguas and David areas. During the same period, Marine and ground units advanced toward the approaches to Panama City and consolidated the entrances to the Canal Zone. On December 19 and 20, fighting around El Chorrillo and downtown Panama City was most intense, with mechanized infantry supported by aviation reducing prepared positions. After December 21, Panamanian units lacked unified command, and resistance became local counterattacks or static camp defense. On December 22 Noriega entered the Vatican Embassy, where American troops established a perimeter. He agreed to surrender on December 23 and left the embassy on December 24, when he was taken to the United States. By December 31, the principal cities, airfields, Canal Zone, and main roads were in American hands, and the campaign had shifted from combat to searching for remnants, securing roads, and recovery operations. In terms of manpower, the United States committed about twenty-five thousand troops, while the Panamanian Defense Forces numbered more than ten thousand. The 82nd Airborne Division was airlifted from Fort Bragg, while units of other divisions entered through bases in the United States, by sea, and by road. Fort Clayton, Fort Amador, and seized airfields served as sustainment nodes; ammunition, fuel, medical evacuation, and airlift formed the logistics chain. The road from Panama City to Colón was about eighty kilometres, and the road to David about five hundred kilometres. These distances were not long in themselves, but they made road security and fuel delivery operational bottlenecks. Public casualty figures differ by reporting date and classification, so this account does not give an unverified precise total.
dossier.cause: 直接原因不是突然爆發的邊界衝突，而是諾列加政府與美國關係連續破裂。1977年托里霍斯—卡特條約已把巴拿馬運河及運河區的主權移交安排在1999年完成，美國仍需要在過渡期維持運河、基地與航道安全；諾列加早期是美軍援助與訓練的接受者，後來卻在美國政府眼中成為不受歡迎的對手。1980年代後期，美國指控他涉及毒品交易，並質疑他對中美洲武裝活動的支持；制裁、援助中止、軍事訓練受限和外交接觸破裂，使雙方互信迅速耗盡。1989年巴拿馬選舉及其結果又受到廣泛質疑，諾列加拒絕交出權力。12月15日，美國要求他辭職並離開巴拿馬；他未接受，布希政府遂依據對運河、基地與區域安全風險的評估，下令執行軍事行動。美方公開說明的目標包括解除巴軍指揮、處理對機場和通道的威脅、保護美軍基地與使館安全，以及維持條約過渡；這些目標隨後轉化為聯合空降、裝甲和空襲。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate cause was not a sudden border clash but the continuing breakdown of relations between Noriega's government and the United States. The 1977 Torrijos–Carter Treaties had scheduled the transfer of the Panama Canal and Canal Zone sovereignty for 1999, and the United States still needed to maintain canal, base, and shipping security during the transition. Noriega had initially been a recipient of U.S. military aid and training, but later became an unwanted opponent in Washington's view. During the late 1980s, the United States accused him of involvement in drug trafficking and questioned his support for armed activity in Central America. Sanctions, suspended aid, restricted training, and broken diplomatic contact rapidly exhausted mutual trust. The process and result of Panama's 1989 election were widely questioned, and Noriega refused to surrender power. On December 15, the United States demanded that he resign and leave Panama. He refused, and the Bush administration, after assessing the risks to the canal, bases, and regional security, ordered military action. The publicly stated aims included breaking the Panamanian military command, neutralizing threats to airfields and transport routes, protecting American bases and the security of the embassy, and preserving the treaty transition. Those aims were then carried out through joint airborne, armored, and air operations.
dossier.impact: 作戰效果首先出現在軍事結構上。巴拿馬國防軍的指揮鏈、通訊、雷達與機場控制同時受損，航空兵無法持續作戰，地面部隊則在失去統一命令後被分割、俘獲或解除武裝；美軍因此能以清楚的指揮鏈掌握首都、運河區和西部交通，即使遠端山地仍有零星抵抗也沒有改變主要局勢。政治上，諾列加在12月24日被美軍押送美國，巴拿馬政府機關重新運作，1990年的選舉把權力轉交給新政府；他在美國受審，則把巴拿馬衝突延伸到司法與外交場合。運河條約沒有被廢除，1999年的主權移交日期仍然保留，但過渡期的安全安排實際上由美軍主導。區域層面上，這場行動使各國重新評估防衛部署、機場防空和與美軍的協調方式，也讓美國獲得一次大規模聯合空降、裝甲推進與空火力協同的實戰經驗。美軍與巴軍均有作戰傷亡和被俘者；各方檔案的統計時點、部隊歸屬和分類不同，因此這裡不把任何未核實的精確傷亡數字寫成定論。
dossier.impactEn: The first effects appeared in the military structure. The Panamanian command chain, communications, radar, and airfield control were damaged at the same time, air units could no longer operate continuously, and ground units were divided, captured, or disarmed after losing unified orders. American forces could therefore control the capital, the Canal Zone, and western transportation through a clear chain of command, even though isolated resistance remained in distant mountainous areas. Politically, Noriega was taken into American custody on December 24, Panamanian government institutions resumed operation, and the 1990 election transferred power to a new government. His trial in the United States extended the Panamanian conflict into the legal and diplomatic sphere. The canal treaties were not cancelled, and the 1999 sovereignty-transfer date remained in force, although security during the transition was effectively directed by the American military. At the regional level, the operation caused governments to reassess defense deployments, airfield air defense, and coordination with U.S. forces, while giving the United States field experience in large-scale joint airborne, armored, and air operations. American and Panamanian forces both suffered operational casualties and prisoners; reporting dates, unit assignments, and categories differ among the records, so no unverified exact casualty figure is treated here as an established fact.
dossier.result: 到12月24日，主要軍事目標已達成：巴拿馬城的政府與通訊節點、科隆和運河區、西部機場及主要道路不再由諾列加系統有效控制；諾列加放棄抵抗並由美軍押送，主要殘餘巴軍則陸續停火、投降或被解除武裝。美軍沒有佔領每一座城鎮，主要戰鬥在24日結束，至31日已建立對主要戰區的有效控制，之後的重點是搜索殘部、維修設施、處理俘虜和維持交通。美國在作戰層面取得了立即成果，卻沒有消除巴拿馬對運河主權的法定要求；大部分美軍於1990年撤出，運河區於1999年12月31日移交巴拿馬，證明行動結果是建立短期軍事控制並依條約撤出，而不是永久佔領。
dossier.resultEn: By December 24, the principal military objectives had been achieved: the government and communications nodes of Panama City, Colón and the Canal Zone, western airfields, and major roads were no longer effectively controlled by Noriega's system. Noriega gave up resistance and was taken into American custody, while the principal remaining Panamanian forces gradually ceased fire, surrendered, or were disarmed. The United States did not occupy every town; the main combat ended on December 24, and by December 31 it had established effective control over the principal operational areas, after which the priorities were locating remnants, repairing facilities, processing prisoners, and maintaining traffic. The United States achieved immediate results at the operational level, but it did not erase Panama's legal claim to canal sovereignty. Most American forces withdrew in 1990, and the Canal Zone was transferred to Panama on December 31, 1999, showing that the immediate result was short-term military control followed by withdrawal under the treaties rather than permanent occupation.

battle.name: 俄格戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所載的俄格戰爭，於二零零八年八月在喬治亞境內爆發，俄羅斯與喬治亞在南奧塞梯亞及阿布哈茲地區交戰。俄軍使用蘇聯主戰坦克T-72，其正式型號自一九七三年起列裝，是地面部隊的重要坦克，並構成俄軍地面作戰體系的重要組成。

kit.name: 主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯陸軍的主力中型坦克，編入坦克部隊，負責正面突破、攻堅與伴隨步兵作戰，並提供直接的火力支援。

dossier.countries: 2008年8月7日夜間至8月12日，主要交戰者是喬治亞與俄羅斯聯邦。南奧塞梯亞武裝在戰役中站在俄方一側作戰，阿布哈茲分離當局的武裝則與進入當地的俄軍協同作戰。南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲均為未被聯合國承認為獨立國家的分離當局控制區，戰線由喬治亞、俄羅斯國家軍隊與當地武裝共同構成，不能簡化成兩個主權國家間的單純交鋒；軍事行動發生在喬治亞主張管轄、且在部分地區實際控制的領土上。主要戰線由南奧塞梯亞的羅基隧道、茨欣瓦利與戈里公路，延伸到北高加索和科多里峽谷，另以阿布哈茲的黑海沿岸公路連接蘇庫米方向。俄方介入的公開政治理由是保護南奧塞梯亞的俄羅斯維和人員及第777軍事基地，並阻止喬治亞攻勢；喬治亞則把行動定性為收回主權領土。
dossier.countriesEn: From the night of 7 August to 12 August 2008, the principal belligerents were Georgia and the Russian Federation. South Ossetian forces fought on the Russian side, while Abkhaz separatist forces cooperated with Russian troops entering the area. Neither South Ossetia nor Abkhazia had been recognized by the United Nations as an independent state, so the front combined the national armed forces of Georgia and Russia with local armed forces and cannot be reduced to a simple clash between two sovereign states; the fighting took place on territory claimed by Georgia and actually controlled by it in parts. The principal theaters ran from the Roki Tunnel, Tskhinvali and the Gori road through the North Caucasus and the Kodori Gorge, while the Black Sea coastal road in Abkhazia connected toward Sukhumi. Russia’s stated public political reason for intervention was to protect its peacekeeping personnel and the 777th Military Base in South Ossetia and to stop the Georgian offensive; Georgia defined its operation as the recovery of sovereign territory.
dossier.people: 戰役的政治授權與前線指揮分成兩條鏈。喬治亞總統米海爾·薩卡什維利在7日批准對南奧塞梯亞採取軍事行動；國防部長達維特·凱澤拉什維利負責行政與軍隊協調，總參謀長喬治·卡沙亞以及第2、第3、第4摩托化步兵旅的指揮官在前線執行命令。俄羅斯方面，總統德米特里·梅德韋杰夫代表介入的政治決定，總理弗拉基米爾·普丁說明莫斯科的安全立場，國防部長阿納托利·謝爾杜科夫負責軍事部署，第58集團軍司令阿納托利·比留科夫指揮前線部隊。南奧塞梯亞武裝指揮官謝爾蓋·巴加什科夫參與地面協同。8月12日促成停火的法國總統尼古拉·薩科齊不是作戰指揮者，卻是談判與安排停火的關鍵人物。區分這些角色，才能看清誰決定升級、誰調動部隊、誰在最後一刻同意停止射擊。
dossier.peopleEn: The campaign’s political authorization and battlefield command ran through two separate chains. Georgian President Mikheil Saakashvili approved Georgian military action against South Ossetia on 7 August; Defence Minister Davit Kezerashvili handled administration and coordination with the armed forces, while Chief of General Staff Giorgi Kashaia and the commanders of the 2nd, 3rd and 4th Motor Rifle Brigades carried out orders on the front. On the Russian side, President Dmitry Medvedev represented the political decision to intervene, Prime Minister Vladimir Putin articulated Moscow’s security position, Defence Minister Anatoly Serdyukov oversaw military deployment, and Anatoly Biryukov commanded the front-line forces of the 58th Combined Arms Army. Sergey Bagashkov, commander of the South Ossetian armed forces, participated in ground coordination. French President Nicolas Sarkozy, who helped bring about the ceasefire on 12 August, was not a battlefield commander but was a key figure in the negotiations and ceasefire arrangements. Keeping these roles separate shows who authorized escalation, who moved troops, and who agreed to stop firing at the last moment.
dossier.kits: 裝備並非每個型號都在每個戰區出現；以下是第58集團軍及相關航空力量的作戰序列中可確認的種類，這些型號在2008年以前均已列裝。俄方地面部隊使用T-72B與T-72B3主戰坦克、BMP-1與BMP-2步兵戰鬥車、空降和空突單位使用的BMD-1與BMD-2，以及BTR-80裝甲運兵車；砲兵包括2S19 Msta-S自走式152毫米榴彈砲、2S3 Akatsiya自走式122毫米榴彈砲、BM-21 Grad火箭砲和9K33 Oplot戰術火箭系統。航空與直升機包括Su-24M、Su-25T、MiG-29K，Mi-24P/V攻擊直升機，以及Mi-8MT、Mi-26運輸直升機。喬治亞方面的軍械序列可見T-72B、T-72B3、BMP-1/2、BTR-70、D-30、2S3 Akatsiya、BM-21 Grad，航空作戰使用Su-25、Su-22M3和MiG-29G/92，防空則有S-200與S-125。與這些系統配套的火力包括125毫米坦克砲彈、30毫米機砲彈、122與152毫米砲彈、9M117 Grom與9M120 Ataka-S導彈，以及S-125使用的3M9防空導彈。公開資料沒有可靠的每營彈藥基數、每日射擊量和油料補充量，因此不能負責任地寫出未經證實的砲彈數量或精確補給時間。
dossier.kitsEn: Not every type appeared in every sector; the following are models identifiable in the order of battle and logistics inventories of the 58th Combined Arms Army and related aviation forces, and all of them entered service before 2008. Russian ground forces used T-72B and T-72B3 main battle tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BMD-1 and BMD-2 vehicles in airborne and air-assault units, and BTR-80 armored personnel carriers. Their artillery included the 2S19 Msta-S 152 mm self-propelled howitzer, the 2S3 Akatsiya 122 mm self-propelled howitzer, the BM-21 Grad rocket artillery and the 9K33 Oplot tactical rocket system. Aircraft and helicopters included Su-24M, Su-25T and MiG-29K aircraft, Mi-24P/V attack helicopters, and Mi-8MT and Mi-26 transport helicopters. Georgia’s equipment inventory included T-72B and T-72B3 tanks, BMP-1/2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-70 armored personnel carriers, D-30 howitzers, 2S3 Akatsiya and BM-21 Grad systems, while Su-25, Su-22M3 and MiG-29G/92 aircraft were used for combat aviation and S-200 and S-125 systems formed the air-defence inventory. Munitions associated with these systems included 125 mm tank rounds, 30 mm automatic-cannon ammunition, 122 and 152 mm artillery rounds, 9M117 Grom and 9M120 Ataka-S missiles, and the 3M9 surface-to-air missile used with S-125. Public records do not provide a reliable ammunition baseline for every unit, daily rate of fire or fuel replenishment figure, so it would be irresponsible to state unverified shell counts or exact resupply times.
dossier.tactics: 7日深夜，喬治亞第2、第3、第4摩托化步兵旅等部隊由戈里、查瓦及其他集結區向茨欣瓦利推進，步兵戰鬥車和坦克沿公路展開，砲兵企圖先壓制南奧塞梯亞武裝的陣地，再奪取埃列德維、阿夫涅維等高地與通往市區的道路節點。南奧塞梯亞武裝依託市區和近郊陣地抵抗，喬治亞的包圍沒有在幾小時內完成。俄軍介入後，第58集團軍以第42近衛摩托化步兵旅、第156摩托化步兵旅，以及空降與空突部隊形成地面骨架；空軍先以Su-24M、MiG-29K和Mi-24進行偵察、壓制和近距支援，再以2S19和BM-21打擊道路節點、砲兵陣地及車隊集結區。Mi-8MT等直升機參與部隊空運，裝甲車隊則沿羅基隧道、茨欣瓦利北側道路和德扎瓦里方向分批推進。南奧塞梯亞武裝提供地面接合，俄軍步兵戰鬥車輸送步兵，坦克在射擊準備後向交叉點和城郊高地推進。阿布哈茲線由俄方部隊與阿布哈茲武裝沿黑海沿岸公路及科多里峽谷施壓，迫使喬治亞把兵力分向兩個方向。約在10日至11日，俄軍推進至戈里外圍，卻沒有沿公路繼續向第比利斯；喬治亞部隊則在補給線受壓、通信中斷和火力分散下逐步後撤。12日停火生效後，前線固定在茨欣瓦利、戈里北面和科多里峽谷一帶。
dossier.tacticsEn: On the night of 7 August, Georgian units from the 2nd, 3rd and 4th Motor Rifle Brigades and other formations moved from Gori, Java and other assembly areas toward Tskhinvali. Infantry fighting vehicles and tanks deployed along the roads, while artillery attempted to suppress South Ossetian positions before the troops seized heights such as Eredvi and Avnevi and road junctions leading into the city. South Ossetian forces used positions in and around the city to resist, and the Georgian encirclement did not finish within a few hours. After Russian intervention began, the 58th Combined Arms Army formed its ground backbone with the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Brigade entering from Chechnya, the 156th Motor Rifle Brigade operating from the South Ossetia direction, and airborne and air-assault troops. Russian aircraft such as the Su-24M, MiG-29K and Mi-24 conducted reconnaissance, suppression and close support, followed by 2S19 and BM-21 fire against road junctions, artillery positions and vehicle assembly areas. Mi-8MT and other helicopters took part in troop airlift, while armored columns advanced in stages along the Roki Tunnel, the roads north of Tskhinvali and the Dzhvari direction. South Ossetian forces provided the ground link, Russian infantry fighting vehicles carried infantry, and tanks moved toward junctions and heights on the city’s outskirts after preparatory fire. On the Abkhaz axis, Russian units and Abkhaz forces applied pressure along the Black Sea coastal road and through the Kodori Gorge, forcing Georgia to divide its forces between two directions. Around 10 to 11 August, Russian armored columns reached the outskirts of Gori but did not continue along the road toward Tbilisi. Georgian units then withdrew in stages as supply routes came under pressure, communications were disrupted and fire support became dispersed. After the ceasefire took effect on 12 August, the front stabilized around Tskhinvali, north of Gori and in the Kodori Gorge.
dossier.data: 可核對的時間線顯示，7日深夜喬治亞先發動攻勢；8日俄羅斯宣布介入並把第58集團軍投入南奧塞梯亞，俄軍航空兵力與地面部隊同時壓制前線；8日至9日茨欣瓦利市及周邊陣地易手；10日至11日裝甲縱隊推進至戈里及其北郊；12日雙方在莫斯科達成停火協議。13日俄軍開始從戈里等地撤出，26日俄羅斯承認南奧塞梯亞和阿布哈茲的獨立國家地位，29日主要作戰部隊完成從喬治亞其他地區的撤離，但南奧塞梯亞的基地駐軍仍然留下。補給上，俄軍以北奧塞梯亞、羅基隧道和南奧塞梯亞公路維持地面車列，並以茨欣瓦利機場及直升機作空運節點；喬治亞則從戈里、查瓦和首都方向輸送油料與彈藥。山地、單一道路和後方距離使車隊速度受到限制。彈藥種類可確認包括125毫米坦克砲彈、30毫米機砲彈、122與152毫米砲彈及9M117、9M120導彈，但各單位的實際存量與射擊量沒有完整公開紀錄。傷亡方面，俄羅斯國防部在停火期間公布的軍事口徑為64人死亡、183人受傷；喬治亞官方在不同發布版本中分別出現13死149傷與17死171傷。這些是各有統計時點和定義的政府快照，不能當成雙方唯一、精確且可相加的總和；南奧塞梯亞武裝沒有同等可靠的統一名冊，故不補寫未核實的精確傷亡。
dossier.dataEn: The verifiable timeline runs as follows: on the night of 7 August Georgia launched its offensive; on 8 August Russia announced intervention and committed the 58th Combined Arms Army to South Ossetia, with air and ground forces suppressing the front; between 8 and 9 August Tskhinvali and its surrounding positions changed hands; between 10 and 11 August armored columns reached Gori and its northern outskirts; and on 12 August the two sides reached a ceasefire agreement in Moscow. Russian troops began withdrawing from Gori and other areas on 13 August. On 26 August Russia recognized the independent-state status of South Ossetia and Abkhazia, and on 29 August the main combat forces completed their withdrawal from the rest of Georgia, although the military base and troops in South Ossetia remained. For logistics, Russia maintained ground columns through North Ossetia, the Roki Tunnel and the South Ossetian road, while using Tskhinvali airfield and helicopters as air-transport nodes. Georgia moved fuel and ammunition from Gori, Java and the direction of the capital. Mountain terrain, single roads and distance from the rear limited column speed. Confirmed ammunition types included 125 mm tank rounds, 30 mm automatic-cannon ammunition, 122 and 152 mm artillery rounds, and 9M117 and 9M120 missiles, but no complete public record gives each unit’s actual stock or rate of fire. For military casualties, the Russian Defence Ministry reported 64 dead and 183 wounded during the ceasefire period; Georgian official releases at different times gave 13 dead and 149 wounded and 17 dead and 171 wounded. These are government snapshots with different dates and definitions, not a single exact total that can simply be added; no equally reliable unified roster exists for South Ossetian forces, so no unverified precise casualty figure is supplied.
dossier.cause: 這場戰爭的根源可分成三層。第一，1991至1992年南奧塞梯亞衝突留下的停火線、主權爭端和俄羅斯第777維和營，使第777軍事基地與南奧塞梯亞控制區成為長期爭議。喬治亞把基地和分離武裝視為對主權與安全的壓力；俄羅斯則向南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲分離武裝提供武器、訓練和基地支持，並把第777基地與維和任務視為維持地區穩定及自身安全的安排。第二，2004年玫瑰革命後，喬治亞加速靠近西方並尋求北約整合，北高加索的軍力對比因此更受關注；2008年7月科多里峽谷衝突又升高阿布哈茲方向的壓力。第三，8月7日茨欣瓦利及近郊的炮擊究竟由哪一方先開始，各方說法不一致；可以確定的是，喬治亞隨即發動其稱為「清理」的攻勢，英文常寫作Operation Clear或Clean，俄方則把它描述為對維和人員和基地的攻擊，並以第58集團軍的介入阻止攻勢。直接觸發點因此不是一個已被雙方共同證實的單一命令，而是前一週軍事對抗、當日炮擊和兩方安全承諾同時碰撞的結果。
dossier.causeEn: The causes can be separated into three layers. First, the 1991 to 1992 South Ossetia conflict left a ceasefire line, a sovereignty dispute and the Russian 777th Peacekeeping Battalion, which became the 777th Military Base. Georgia regarded the base and separatist armed forces as pressure on sovereignty and security; Russia provided weapons, training and base support to separatist forces in South Ossetia and Abkhazia, and treated the 777th base and peacekeeping mission as arrangements for regional stability and its own security. Second, after the 2004 Rose Revolution, Georgia moved closer to Western institutions and sought NATO integration, making the military balance in the North Caucasus more prominent; fighting in the Kodori Gorge in July 2008 increased pressure on the Abkhaz axis. Third, accounts disagree over which side initiated the shelling around Tskhinvali on 7 August. What can be established is that Georgia soon launched the offensive it called Operation Clear, rendered Clean in some English accounts, while Russia described it as an attack on peacekeeping personnel and the base and used the 58th Combined Arms Army to stop the offensive. The immediate trigger was therefore not a single command event jointly verified by both sides, but the collision of the previous week’s military confrontation, that day’s shelling and incompatible security commitments.
dossier.impact: 軍事上，喬治亞在8月7日投入的攻勢被俄軍的航空、砲兵和裝甲協同打斷，前線部隊失去連續指揮，必須退往戈里方向與其他縱深陣地重整；這不是部隊被單一擊滅，而是多個戰區同時失去通信、補給和統一火力的結果。俄軍則證明第58集團軍能在山區建立由公路、空運和航空火力接成的戰役軸線，但也受限於羅基公路、地形、距離和阿布哈茲戰線，不能把一度進入戈里外圍視為能無限制推進到第比利斯。政治上，俄軍行動未取得聯合國安理會授權，停火由薩科齊調解，形成的是軍事停火而非完整和平條約；俄羅斯其後承認南奧塞梯亞和阿布哈茲，喬治亞與俄羅斯斷交，並在9月北約布加勒斯特峰會獲邀加入會員國夥伴計畫。喬治亞還宣布退出《歐洲常規軍備條約》（CFE）的意向，顯示歐洲安全架構也被牽動。這些結果改變了雙方的軍事部署與談判位置，卻沒有消除南奧塞梯亞和阿布哈茲的法律與邊界爭議。
dossier.impactEn: Militarily, Georgia’s offensive of 7 August was disrupted by Russian air, artillery and armored cooperation, and its front-line units lost continuous command, forcing them to withdraw toward Gori and other depth positions for reorganization. This was not the annihilation of the army in one blow; several sectors simultaneously lost communications, supply and coordinated fire support. Russia demonstrated that the 58th Combined Arms Army could establish a campaign axis in mountainous terrain by linking roads, air transport and aviation, but the Roki road, terrain, distance and the Abkhaz front limited it; entering the outskirts of Gori did not mean it could advance without limit toward Tbilisi. Politically, Russian military action did not receive authorization from the UN Security Council, and the ceasefire mediated by Sarkozy created a military ceasefire rather than a complete peace treaty. Russia subsequently recognized South Ossetia and Abkhazia, Georgia severed diplomatic relations with Russia, and Georgia was invited into NATO’s Membership Action Plan at the Bucharest summit in September. Georgia also announced its intention to leave the Conventional Armed Forces in Europe treaty, showing that the European security architecture was also drawn into the dispute. These outcomes changed the military deployments and negotiating positions of both sides without resolving the legal and boundary disputes over South Ossetia and Abkhazia.
dossier.result: 停火時的實際結果是，俄軍與南奧塞梯亞武裝控制茨欣瓦利及南奧塞梯亞大部分地區，喬治亞部隊撤出該區；俄軍曾短暫進入戈里，之後依協議撤回南奧塞梯亞的基地，阿布哈茲方向的俄軍與阿布哈茲武裝沒有向蘇庫米市中心推進，蘇庫米仍由阿布哈茲分離當局控制；喬治亞仍保住首都與中央政府。協議把戰線固定在一條不完整的停火線上，而不是恢復8月7日以前的全部態勢。8月13日開始的撤軍在8月29日完成主要作戰部隊的離開，南奧塞梯亞仍保留俄羅斯軍事基地與駐軍，阿布哈茲則維持分離當局的實控。8月26日的承認改變了外交現實，卻沒有帶來涵蓋兩個地區的和平協議。戰役因此留下三個具體結果：俄方控制南奧塞梯亞並在外交上承認其地位，喬治亞保住國家生存卻失去原來對南奧塞梯亞的控制，阿布哈茲與科多里峽谷的界線仍是未解決的軍事問題。
dossier.resultEn: The practical result at the ceasefire was that Russian and South Ossetian forces held Tskhinvali and most of South Ossetia, while Georgian units withdrew from that area. Russian troops briefly entered Gori and later withdrew to their base in South Ossetia under the agreement. On the Abkhaz axis, Russian and Abkhaz forces did not push into central Sukhumi, which remained under Abkhaz separatist control, while Georgia retained the capital and central government. The agreement fixed the front on an incomplete ceasefire line rather than restoring every condition that had existed before 7 August. The withdrawal that began on 13 August removed the main combat forces by 29 August, but the Russian military base and troops remained in South Ossetia, while Abkhazia remained under the de facto separatist administration. Russia’s recognition on 26 August changed the diplomatic reality but did not produce a peace agreement covering both territories. The campaign therefore left three concrete results: Russia controlled South Ossetia and gave its position diplomatic recognition, Georgia preserved the state but lost its former control of South Ossetia, and the boundary in Abkhazia and the Kodori Gorge remained an unresolved military question.

battle.name: 利比亞內戰
battle.brief: 利比亞內戰於2011年2月爆發，反政府武裝推翻蓋達夫政權後，內部派系爭奪與跨國軍事介入交織。北約空中行動展開之際，英國向利比亞部署「挑戰者2」主戰坦克，用於護送撤運、占領重要設施及支援地面部隊，成為這場衝突中英軍裝甲力量的代表。

kit.name: 挑戰者2主戰坦克
kit.history: 「挑戰者2」是英國陸軍的主戰坦克，隸屬裝甲部隊，負責正面突破、對抗敵方裝甲並占領要害地區，與步兵、工程車及後勤支援車輛協同作戰。

dossier.countries: 2011年利比亞內戰的戰場從東部地中海沿岸的班加西、貝達、達爾納與阿季達里亞，沿海岸公路、內陸沙漠道路及奈富薩山口一路延伸到扎維耶、的黎波里、米蘇拉塔、辛坦、昔蘭與班尼瓦利德。東部先形成主要起義，西部則在二月下旬由米蘇拉塔、扎維耶和奈富薩方向相繼出現武裝控制，因此戰線並非由單一首都向全國均勻擴散。交戰方先是穆阿邁爾·蓋達菲領導的利比亞政府軍、空軍與安全部隊，對上由東部起義軍、西部武裝、地方民兵及後來被全國過渡委員會納入或承認的部隊所組成的鬆散聯盟；軍區與部隊倒戈使固定戰序經常改變。美國、英國與法國於3月19日先行執行奧德賽黎明行動，北約盟國其後在3月27日接手統一保護行動。埃及與突尼斯方向的邊境主要是補給和交通通道，北約沒有部署地面進攻部隊，地面控制權仍由利比亞各方爭奪。
dossier.countriesEn: The geographic theater of the 2011 Libyan Civil War ran from Benghazi, Bayda, Derna, and Ajdiria on the eastern Mediterranean coast, along coastal roads, inland desert tracks, and the Nafusa mountain passes, to Zawiya, Tripoli, Misrata, Zintan, Sirte, and Bani Walid. The main uprising arose first in the east, while in late February armed control appeared around Misrata, Zawiya, and the Nafusa at the same time, so the front did not spread evenly outward from a single capital. The belligerents were the Libyan government forces, air force, and security units under Muammar Gaddafi, opposed by a loose coalition of eastern insurgents, western armed groups, local militias, and units later incorporated or recognized by the National Transitional Council; defections by military districts and units continually changed the order of battle. The United States, United Kingdom, and France began Operation Odyssey Dawn on 19 March, and NATO members took over Operation Unified Protector on 27 March. The borders with Egypt and Tunisia mainly served as supply and transit routes, NATO deployed no ground assault force, and ground control remained contested among Libyan factions.
dossier.people: 蓋達菲以利比亞最高政治與軍事領導人的身分，直接掌握軍隊忠誠、軍區命令與空軍運用；制空權一旦下降，遠程打擊就難以掩護地面部隊，政府軍的指揮鏈也會因倒戈而分段。反對陣營沒有由一開始就存在的單一總部。穆斯塔法·阿卜杜勒·賈利勒以全國過渡委員會主席身分負責政治協調；阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·尤尼斯在阿季達里亞率領早期武裝，歐邁爾·哈里里是西部戰線的主要指揮者，哈利法·哈夫塔爾則在東部起義中成為主要軍事將領之一，後來又與全國過渡委員會的指揮安排發生衝突。馬哈茂德·吉布里勒參與過渡委員會的行政與軍事協調。美國參聯會主席邁克·穆倫在總統授權後下令美軍開始打擊，北約則由那不勒斯聯合部隊司令部協調各國空中與海上力量，但各國仍保有本國部隊的指揮權。
dossier.peopleEn: Gaddafi was Libya’s central political and military authority, directly controlling military loyalty, district orders, and the use of the air force; once air superiority declined, long-range strikes could no longer readily protect ground forces, and the government’s command structure fragmented as units defected. The opposition did not possess a single headquarters from the beginning. Mustafa Abdul Jalil handled political coordination as chairman of the National Transitional Council; Abdel Fattah Younis led early armed forces in Ajdiria, Omar Hariri was a principal commander on the western front, and Khalifa Haftar became one of the major military figures in the eastern uprising before later clashing with the council’s command arrangements. Mahmoud Jibril participated in the council’s administrative and military coordination. After presidential authorization, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Mike Mullen ordered the United States military to begin strikes. NATO coordinated national air and maritime forces through Joint Force Command Naples, although each country retained command over its own units.
dossier.kits: 可由2011年公開影像、裝甲辨識及戰後公開清單交叉確認的核心型號，構成這場戰爭的主要裝備面。政府軍裝甲包括T-54/T-55與T-72，步兵戰車包括BMP-1和BMP-2，裝甲運兵車包括BTR-50與BTR-60；前線火力可辨識到2S1 Gvozdika自走榴彈砲、BM-21 Grad多管火箭砲及122毫米火砲。防空單位配備S-75 Dvina與S-125 Pechora系統，空軍保有MiG-21、MiG-23、MiG-25、Su-22、Su-24和L-39，直升機包括Mi-8與Mi-24，但不少飛機因零件、燃料和維修不足而不能持續升空。反軍武裝大量使用AK-47、AKM、PKM、DShK、RPG-7與RPG-29，並把這些武器裝載於皮卡車；後來也繳獲並修復政府軍的坦克、步兵戰車與火砲。公開任務記錄可辨識的北約及聯盟空中單元包括F-15E、F-16、F/A-18、A-10、B-1B、AH-64、Tornado GR4、Lynx GR4、Rafale和Super Étendard，使用精確制導炸彈、戰斧巡航飛彈、SCALP與Storm Shadow。彈藥規格也影響戰術：T-54/T-55使用100毫米砲彈，T-72使用125毫米砲彈，BMP-1配73毫米砲，BMP-2配30毫米砲；反軍常見7.62毫米與12.7毫米機槍彈，北約則以精確炸彈和巡航飛彈攻擊雷達、防空系統、彈藥庫、指揮所與裝甲目標。上述型號均在2011年以前已進入各國或利比亞軍隊的編制。
dossier.kitsEn: The core equipment profile of the war can be cross-checked against public imagery, armored-vehicle identification, and postwar inventories. Government armor included T-54/T-55 and T-72 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, and BTR-50 and BTR-60 armored personnel carriers. Identifiable front-line firepower included 2S1 Gvozdika self-propelled howitzers, BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, and 122-millimeter artillery. Air-defense units fielded S-75 Dvina and S-125 Pechora systems, while the air force retained MiG-21, MiG-23, MiG-25, Su-22, Su-24, and L-39 aircraft, together with Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters, although many aircraft could not remain airborne because of shortages of parts, fuel, and maintenance. Rebel forces used large quantities of AK-47, AKM, PKM, DShK, RPG-7, and RPG-29 weapons, often mounted on pickup trucks; they later captured and repaired government tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, and artillery. Public mission records identify NATO and coalition air units including F-15E, F-16, F/A-18, A-10, B-1B, AH-64, Tornado GR4, Lynx GR4, Rafale, and Super Étendard aircraft, employing precision-guided bombs, Tomahawk cruise missiles, SCALP, and Storm Shadow. Ammunition specifications also shaped tactics: T-54/T-55 tanks used 100-millimeter rounds, T-72 tanks used 125-millimeter rounds, BMP-1 carried a 73-millimeter gun, and BMP-2 carried a 30-millimeter gun; rebel forces commonly used 7.62-millimeter and 12.7-millimeter machine-gun ammunition, while NATO relied on precision bombs and cruise missiles against radars, air-defense systems, ammunition depots, command posts, and armored targets. All these types had entered service before 2011.
dossier.tactics: 戰術演變可以分成相互重疊的幾個階段。2月16日班加西出現政治抗議，17日部分軍警倒戈，武裝起義者奪取軍政節點；到19日前後，班加西、貝達、達爾納與阿季達里亞的主要道路先後換手。這些部隊沒有立即組成單一軍隊，而是以地方支部、臨時營和皮卡車快速隊行動，沿海岸公路切斷政府軍的補給線，並在裝甲縱隊通過狹窄路段時以RPG-7、RPG-29和其他反裝甲武器伏擊。政府軍依靠坦克、火砲、飛機與直昇機反擊，試圖守住機場、城市入口和主要公路，但每次集中調動都會暴露位置。2月下旬，西部隊伍從奈富薩山路、沿海公路和的黎波里外圍向首都施壓；政府軍則以裝甲車和火砲在米蘇拉塔、扎維耶及奈富薩各據點之間進行反擊，試圖把起義分割成幾個孤立戰區。3月19日，美英法第一波打擊集中於利比亞防空雷達、發射車、指揮設施、彈藥庫及空軍基地；3月27日北約接手後，把禁飛區、海上武器禁運、情報監視與近距空援連接起來。4月至6月，米蘇拉塔仍由起義軍守住，政府軍不斷從周邊據點進行炮擊和裝甲反突，北約則打擊包圍圈附近的火砲、裝甲車與指揮節點。7月至8月，多支起義部隊由西部和南部向的黎波里集結，政府軍試圖以裝甲預備隊打通 Bab al-Ghazala 與 Green Mile 等通道，北約空襲削弱其防空和火砲支援，8月21日的黎波里控制權轉移。9月至10月，起義軍以海岸線和沙漠道路逼近昔蘭，利用繳獲的火砲與反裝甲武器對付政府軍殘部，北約持續提供空中掩護直到10月15日；昔蘭在密集地面戰中於10月20日陷落，而班尼瓦利德仍由忠軍控制。
dossier.tacticsEn: The tactical course can be divided into several overlapping phases. Political protests appeared in Benghazi on 16 February, and on 17 February some military and police units defected as armed insurgents seized military and administrative positions; by around 19 February, the main roads in Benghazi, Bayda, Derna, and Ajdiria had changed hands. These forces did not immediately form a single army. They operated through local detachments, temporary battalions, and pickup-based mobile units, cutting government supply lines along the coastal road and ambushing armored columns with RPG-7, RPG-29, and other anti-armor weapons as they passed through confined stretches. Government forces counterattacked with tanks, artillery, aircraft, and helicopters, trying to hold airports, city entrances, and major roads, but every concentrated movement exposed its position. In late February, western forces pressed toward Tripoli from the Nafusa routes, the coastal corridor, and the outskirts of the capital. Government units used armored vehicles and artillery to counterattack between positions in Misrata, Zawiya, and the Nafusa, attempting to divide the uprising into isolated theaters. On 19 March, the first American, British, and French strikes concentrated on Libyan air-defense radars, launchers, command facilities, ammunition depots, and air bases. After NATO assumed command on 27 March, it connected the no-fly zone, maritime arms enforcement, intelligence surveillance, and close air support. From April through June, the insurgents continued to hold Misrata while government forces staged artillery bombardments and armored counterattacks from surrounding positions, and NATO struck artillery, armored vehicles, and command nodes around the siege. From July through August, several rebel formations converged on Tripoli from the west and south. Government forces attempted to open corridors through Bab al-Ghazala and the Green Mile with armored reserves, while NATO air attacks weakened their air defense and artillery support; Tripoli changed hands on 21 August. From September through October, rebel forces approached Sirte along the coast and desert roads, using captured artillery and anti-armor weapons against government remnants. NATO maintained air cover until 15 October, Sirte fell in close ground fighting on 20 October, and Bani Walid remained under loyalist control.
dossier.data: 可核對的硬日期、路線與後勤資料構成這場戰爭的時間骨架。2月16日班加西的政治危機成為全面起義的公開起點，2月17日至19日班加西及東部數個城市的控制權相繼轉移；2月下旬，米蘇拉塔、扎維耶、奈富薩與辛坦方向的武裝控制逐步成形。3月17日聯合國安全理事會通過第1973號決議，3月19日美英法開始空襲，3月27日北約正式接手統一保護行動，8月21日的黎波里陷落，10月15日北約宣布統一保護行動結束，10月20日昔蘭陷落且蓋達菲被捕身亡。空間上，海岸公路構成東西向主要走廊，奈富薩山路連接辛坦、扎維耶和的黎波里，昔蘭是東線與西線的交通瓶頸，班尼瓦利德則控制通往內陸的公路和沙漠側翼。外部補給主要經埃及邊境與突尼斯方向進入，北約則以空中加油、衛星情報、指揮機和地中海艦艇維持長距離作戰。政府軍依賴儲存於空軍基地與大型彈藥庫的100毫米、125毫米、122毫米、73毫米和30毫米彈藥，反軍的7.62毫米與12.7毫米彈藥較易攜帶，但重型火砲、反裝甲武器、備件、燃料和輪胎較為不足。政府軍仍以軍區和正式營旅作戰，反軍則以臨時營、地方武裝和後來編成的旅為主，整個過程沒有一份固定戰序涵蓋全部部隊。各方發布的人員損失總數因統計時間、定義與來源不同而互相矛盾，因此本篇不列出未經核實的精確傷亡數字。
dossier.dataEn: The verifiable dates, routes, and logistics form the backbone of the chronology. The political crisis in Benghazi on 16 February became the public starting point for the full uprising, and control of Benghazi and several eastern cities changed between 17 and 19 February; in late February, armed control gradually took shape around Misrata, Zawiya, the Nafusa, and Zintan. On 17 March the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1973, the United States, United Kingdom, and France began airstrikes on 19 March, and NATO formally assumed command of Operation Unified Protector on 27 March. Tripoli fell on 21 August, NATO announced the end of Unified Protector on 15 October, and Sirte fell on 20 October, when Gaddafi was captured and killed. Geographically, the coastal highway formed the main east-west corridor, the Nafusa routes connected Zintan, Zawiya, and Tripoli, Sirte was a transport bottleneck between the eastern and western fronts, and Bani Walid controlled roads and desert approaches into the interior. External supplies entered mainly through the Egyptian border and the direction of Tunisia, while NATO sustained long-range operations through aerial refueling, satellite intelligence, command aircraft, and Mediterranean naval forces. Government forces depended on 100-millimeter, 125-millimeter, 122-millimeter, 73-millimeter, and 30-millimeter ammunition stored at air bases and large depots. Rebel 7.62-millimeter and 12.7-millimeter ammunition was easier to transport, but heavy artillery, anti-armor weapons, spare parts, fuel, and tires were scarcer. Government units continued to operate through military districts and formal battalions and regiments, while rebel forces were organized around temporary battalions, local armed groups, and later brigades; no single order of battle covered every force throughout the conflict. Published personnel-loss totals varied because of different dates, definitions, and sources, so this account does not state an unverified precise casualty figure.
dossier.cause: 這場戰爭的根源是蓋達菲 Jamahiriya 體制下政治、軍隊、安全機構與資源分配的高度集中。長期以來，昔蘭尼卡地區在行政權力、軍事晉升和國家資源分配上感受到被邊緣化，西部地區則存在部落與地區認同、徵兵待遇和地方自治方面的衝突；石油收入與軍政 patronage 又使政治忠誠成為資源分配的關鍵。2010年突尼亞與埃及的革命形成區域性震盪，2011年2月16日班加西的政治抗議和2月17日開始的軍警倒戈，則把不滿轉化為武裝衝突。起義初期，地方單位各自奪取道路、營區與政府設施，政府軍企圖用重裝備、火砲和航空力量保住中央控制，卻因部隊倒戈而逐步失去縱深。3月的聯合國授權與北約空中介入不是戰爭最初的起因，卻使政府更難以重新奪回已失去的城市，也把原本由利比亞內部部隊主導的衝突轉化為有外國空軍與艦隊介入的國際化戰爭。
dossier.causeEn: The roots of the war lay in the highly centralized Jamahiriya system, where political power, the armed forces, security institutions, and resource distribution were concentrated in a narrow structure.
