The Cyrenaica region had long felt excluded from administrative authority, military promotion, and national resources, while western areas experienced conflicts involving tribal and regional identities, conscription treatment, and local autonomy. Oil revenues and military-political patronage made political loyalty a key to access and command. The revolutions in Tunisia and Egypt in 2010 created a regional shock, while the political protests in Benghazi on 16 February 2011 and the military and police defections that began on 17 February converted discontent into armed conflict. At first, local units seized roads, barracks, and government facilities on their own, while the government tried to preserve central control with heavy weapons, artillery, and aviation but lost depth as more units defected. The United Nations authorization and NATO air intervention in March were not the original causes of the conflict, yet they made it much harder for the government to retake cities that had already been lost and turned a conflict led by Libyan internal units into an internationalized war involving foreign aircraft and naval forces.
dossier.impact: 最直接的軍事影響，是蓋達菲政府的中央指揮體系在戰役後期失去連續性，空軍無法有效爭奪制空權，防空系統、火砲陣地和彈藥庫在反軍逼近時相繼失能或被摧毀。大批政府軍坦克、步兵戰車、火砲、防空設備和小型武器落入起義軍手中，使原本缺乏重裝備的地方武裝迅速獲得機動作戰能力，也讓不同反軍派系在短期內擁有各自的裝甲與防空火力。北約則以空中優勢、禁飛區、海上武器禁運和精確打擊展示了沒有地面進攻部隊的遠程干預模式，同時保留了由利比亞地面部隊決定城市控制權的格局。政治上，蓋達菲政權失去國家權力，全國過渡委員會成為大部分城市和行政資源的事實上的中央權力核心，但軍隊並未整合成單一國家軍隊，東部、西部和不同武裝派系反而形成新的競爭力量。國際上，第1973號決議、北約統一保護行動與區域國家的補給和安全安排，改變了阿拉伯之春期間外部介入的邊界；利比亞軍庫與武裝化力量流向不同政治派系，也成為2011年之後安全與政治危機的軍事基礎。
dossier.impactEn: The most direct military effect was the loss of continuity in the central command system of the Gaddafi government during the later stages of the war. The air force could no longer contest air superiority effectively, and air-defense systems, artillery positions, and ammunition depots were disabled or destroyed as rebel forces approached. Large quantities of government tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, artillery, air-defense equipment, and small arms fell into rebel hands, allowing poorly equipped local forces to acquire mobile combat capability quickly and giving different rebel factions their own armor and air defenses. NATO demonstrated a form of long-range intervention based on air superiority, a no-fly zone, maritime arms enforcement, and precision strikes without a ground assault force, while leaving control of cities to Libyan ground forces. Politically, the Gaddafi regime lost state power and the National Transitional Council became the de facto central authority over most cities and administrative resources, but the military was not consolidated into a single national army; eastern, western, and factional forces instead became competing armed actors. Internationally, Resolution 1973, Operation Unified Protector, and regional supply and security arrangements changed the boundaries of external involvement during the Arab uprisings. The dispersal of Libyan weapons and armed forces among rival political groups also supplied the military foundation for the security and political crises that followed 2011.
dossier.result: 結局可以分成戰役層次與國家層次。戰役層次上，反軍由東部起義開始，經米蘇拉塔、扎維耶、奈富薩與昔蘭等戰線推進，最終迫使政府軍放棄主要城市；的黎波里在8月21日失守，昔蘭在10月20日失守，蓋達菲當日被捕身亡。北約在10月15日結束統一保護行動，而地面攻勢仍延續到10月20日，這說明空戰任務的結束時間與地面政治決定的時間並不相同。國家層次上，蓋達菲政府及其中央軍事指揮系統實際上瓦解，全國過渡委員會接管首都和大部分行政資源，成為新的過渡權力核心；但這不是所有忠軍立即投降或全國完成解除武裝。班尼瓦利德到2011年底仍由忠軍控制，部分部隊和大量裝備則分散到不同武裝派系手中。因此，2011年的結果是政府軍在主要戰線上的戰略失敗與蓋達菲政權垮台，而不是全國各地同時建立穩定、統一且完成解除武裝的秩序；後續的政治分裂和軍事競爭，正是從這個未完全平復的結果延伸而來。本篇不提供各方互相矛盾的精確傷亡總數。
dossier.resultEn: The outcome can be divided into a campaign level and a state level. At the campaign level, the rebellion began in the east, advanced through fronts including Misrata, Zawiya, the Nafusa, and Sirte, and eventually forced government forces to abandon the major cities. Tripoli fell on 21 August, Sirte fell on 20 October, and Gaddafi was captured and killed that day. NATO ended Operation Unified Protector on 15 October, while the ground offensive continued until 20 October, showing that the end of the air mission and the decisive ground political outcome did not occur on the same day. At the state level, the Gaddafi government and its central military command structure effectively collapsed. The National Transitional Council took control of the capital and most administrative resources and became the new transitional authority, but this did not mean that every loyalist force immediately surrendered or that the country was fully disarmed. Bani Walid remained under loyalist control at the end of 2011, while scattered units and large quantities of equipment passed into the hands of different armed factions. The result was therefore the strategic defeat of government forces on the principal fronts and the fall of the Gaddafi regime, not the simultaneous establishment of a stable, unified, fully disarmed order across the country; later political fragmentation and military competition developed directly from this incompletely settled outcome. This account does not provide the conflicting precise casualty totals issued by the different sides.

battle.name: 頓巴斯戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所列的頓巴斯戰爭，是二〇一四年起發生於烏克蘭東部、以頓巴斯地區為核心的武裝衝突。俄羅斯與烏克蘭雙方均使用T-72主戰坦克，投入地面警戒、推進與火力支援，坦克仍是裝甲部隊的重要作戰載具。

kit.name: T-72主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯陸軍的主戰坦克，位於裝甲部隊的作戰核心，負責正面突破、反裝甲與佔領重要地形，並協同步兵作戰。

dossier.countries: 本篇把「頓巴斯戰爭（2014）」界定為二月底至十二月底的一段完整年度戰役：克里米亞局勢與烏克蘭政治危機屬於前提，四月起頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克地區形成公開戰線，敘事截至二零一四年十二月三十一日。主要交戰方是烏克蘭政府一方，包括武裝部隊、國民兵特種部隊、烏克蘭安全機關作戰單位及陸續接受整編的志願營；另一方是自稱頓涅茨克人民共和國及盧甘斯克人民共和國的分離武裝。俄羅斯聯邦自戰役初期便以邊境供應、武器及跨境支援參與，二〇一四年八月以後更有無法與當地民兵明確分辨的俄軍建制部隊進入頓巴斯，因此不能把後段戰事單純寫成烏克蘭政府與地方武裝的交火。這不是烏克蘭與俄羅斯正式宣告的國家間戰爭，烏克蘭始終未宣布進入全面戰爭狀態，但俄軍直接介入與跨境交火已使戰役具有國際軍事衝突的性質。主要戰區包括斯洛維揚斯克、克拉馬托爾斯克、阿里季夫斯克周邊，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩市外圍，伊洛瓦伊斯克及通往俄羅斯邊境的三角形地區，以及仍受烏方控制、後來卻未經正式劃界的德巴爾切韋走廊。
dossier.countriesEn: This account defines the 2014 Donbas War as one complete annual campaign whose political prelude began in late February, whose open fighting in Donetsk and Luhansk was established from April, and which ends on December 31, 2014. The principal belligerent was the Ukrainian government side, comprising the armed forces, special National Guard formations, operational units of the Ukrainian security service, and volunteer battalions that were progressively brought under formal military control. The other principal belligerent was the armed formations associated with the self-proclaimed Donetsk People’s Republic and Luhansk People’s Republic. The Russian Federation was involved from the early phase through border delivery, weapons, and other cross-border support, and from August 2014 regular Russian formations entered Donbas in numbers that could not reliably be treated as separate from local armed units. The later phase therefore cannot be described solely as fighting between the Ukrainian government and local militia. This was not a formally declared interstate war between Ukraine and Russia, and Ukraine did not declare a full state of war, although direct Russian military involvement and cross-border fire gave the campaign the character of an international armed conflict. The main theaters included the approaches to Sloviansk, Kramatorsk, and Artemivsk; the outskirts of Donetsk and Luhansk; Ilovaisk and the border triangle leading to Russia; and the Debaltseve corridor, then held by Ukraine but not finally delimited.
dossier.people: 二月政治危機首先改變了烏克蘭的指揮高層。維克托·亞努科維奇於二月二十八日辭去總統職務並前往俄羅斯，議長亞歷山大·圖爾丘诺夫依憲政程序出任代理總統；七日正式就任的波羅申科於五月二十五日當選總統。同月二十五日，烏方第34獨立山地旅在頓涅茨克機場行動中奪回舊航站樓，但同日選舉使軍事升級與政治合法性問題更難分開。烏克蘭於五月十六日成立反恐怖主義作戰司令部，由總統、國防部與總參謀部共同負責政治和軍事協調；總參謀部早期作戰策劃涉及維克托·穆內奇，後來安納托利·庫爾海一度代行職務，尤里·別列日尼等參與作戰協調與談判。國防部長更替、南部軍區指揮權及地方部隊之間缺乏統一作業，也影響前線決策。頓涅茨克方面，伊戈爾·斯特列爾科夫，即後來所稱的格拉西姆，曾於四月至五月宣稱掌握民兵作戰領導；亞歷山大·博羅戴在盧甘斯克早期政治軍事結構中代表一個主要派系。七月末至八月，亞歷山大·扎哈爾琴科成為頓涅茨克共和國核心領導人，後任政府總理；伊霍爾·普洛特尼茨基則在盧甘斯克共和國擔任議長及政府領導人。當地營級指揮官仍掌握實際地面行動。八月以後，俄軍編制部隊歸入南方軍區及第八合成陸軍集團的指揮體系，參與邊境作戰。歐洲安全與合作組織特派監督團只負責觀察、核對裝備及核查停火線，沒有戰場指揮權。
dossier.peopleEn: The political crisis of February first changed Ukraine’s senior leadership. Viktor Yanukovych resigned on February 28 and went to Russia, after which parliamentary speaker Yulia Tymoshenko’s successor, Oleksandr Turchynov, became acting president under the constitutional procedure. Petro Poroshenko formally took office on March 7 and was elected president on May 25. On the same day, the Ukrainian 34th Separate Mountain Brigade seized the old terminal at Donetsk Airport during the airport action, although the election made military escalation harder to separate from questions of political legitimacy. Ukraine established the Anti-Terrorist Operation on May 16, with the president, Ministry of Defence, and General Staff sharing political and operational responsibility. Early planning involved General Staff chief Viktor Muzych, followed later by Anatolii Kulhy in an acting capacity, while Yurii Berezhnyi and others participated in operational coordination and negotiations. Changes of defence minister, the allocation of authority within the Southern Military District, and the absence of a single operating method among field formations all affected decisions on the front. In the Donetsk area, Igor Strelkov, later known as Gerasim, claimed leadership of the militia’s military operations between April and May. Alexander Borodai represented one of the principal political-military groupings in early Luhansk. From late July into August, Alexander Zakharchenko became the central leader of the Donetsk Republic and later served as its prime minister, while Ihor Plotnitsky headed the Luhansk Republic’s council and government. Battalion and local commanders nevertheless retained practical control over ground operations. From August, identifiable Russian formations came under the Southern Military District and the 8th Combined Arms Army structure for operations near the border. The OSCE Special Monitoring Mission observed the fighting, verified equipment, and monitored the ceasefire lines, but did not command any force in the field.
dossier.kits: 二零一四年烏軍作戰序列沿用蘇聯及獨立後烏克蘭的裝備體系，並非所有單位同時配齊相同裝備。第93、第128等機械化或山地旅主要使用T-64B、T-64BV，後來亦有T-72系列裝甲車；步兵搭配BMP-1、BMP-2與BTR-80。第24機械旅及部分志願營多依賴BMP裝甲運兵車、BTR系列車輛、卡車和牽引式迫擊砲，火力則由營、旅屬砲兵分隊支援。烏方火炮包括D-30一五二毫米榴彈砲、二A36「金屬座」一五二毫米榴彈砲、二S一九「暴風雪」自行榴彈砲及BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭砲；這些火力用於射擊城鎮外圍、山地陣地和邊境交通線。空軍及航空兵使用過Su-24、Su-25及Mi-8MT，但可用架數有限，而且制空權並未形成。早期分離武裝常見AK-47、AK-74M及AKM步槍，配RPG-7V與RPG-16；烏方情報及國際報告亦記錄FGM-148「標槍」反裝甲飛彈和FGM-22「毒刺」便携防空系統進入烏方武裝。俄軍成建制部隊加入後，T-72B、T-72B3、BMP-1、BMP-2、BTR-80、卡車及火炮的供應與地方武裝原有武器混在一起，地方部隊也大量使用GAZ-66、KAMAZ-4310等車輛運送人員和彈藥。前線日常消耗包括五點四五毫米及七點六二毫米步槍彈藥、一二〇毫米迫擊砲彈，以及一二二與一五二毫米砲彈。烏方較長的補給鏈由第聶伯羅、第羅茲諾維茨克等地經鐵路或公路送往波羅斯克、阿里季夫斯克方向；裝甲車出戰後若缺乏拖救、油料與備件，很容易因故障失去戰鬥價值。分離武裝起初多依賴當地軍械庫和短程車隊，後期則使用俄羅斯邊境供應節點。
dossier.kitsEn: The Ukrainian order of battle in 2014 continued to rely on Soviet and post-Soviet equipment, and different formations were not equipped identically. The 93rd, 128th, and other mechanized or mountain brigades principally used T-64B and T-64BV tanks, with T-72-series vehicles appearing later; their infantry used BMP-1, BMP-2, and BTR-80 armored vehicles. The 24th Mechanized Brigade and several volunteer battalions depended heavily on BMP transports, BTR-series vehicles, trucks, and towed mortars, with artillery support provided by battalion- and brigade-level batteries. Ukrainian artillery included D-30 122 mm howitzers, 2A36 Giatsint 152 mm howitzers, 2S19 Msta-S self-propelled howitzers, and BM-21 Grad multiple-rocket launchers. These systems were used against urban outskirts, fortified heights, and border transport routes. The air force and aviation assets included Su-24, Su-25, and Mi-8MT aircraft, although the number of serviceable aircraft remained limited and air superiority was never established. Early separatist formations commonly used AK-47, AK-74M, and AKM rifles with RPG-7V and RPG-16 launchers. Ukrainian intelligence and international reporting also documented FGM-148 Javelin anti-tank missiles and FGM-22 Stinger man-portable air-defense systems entering Ukrainian formations. After regular Russian forces entered, their equipment, including T-72B and T-72B3 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-80 armored personnel carriers, trucks, and artillery, became mixed with weapons already held by local units. Local forces also relied heavily on GAZ-66 and KAMAZ-4310 trucks for troop and ammunition movement. Routine front-line consumption included 5.45 mm and 7.62 mm rifle ammunition, 120 mm mortar rounds, and 122 mm and 152 mm artillery shells. Ukraine’s longer supply chain ran by road and rail from Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia toward Pokrovsk and the Artemivsk axis. Once armor went forward, loss of recovery vehicles, fuel, and spare parts could quickly disable otherwise intact vehicles. Separatist units initially depended on local weapons depots and short convoy routes, but later used supply nodes inside Russia to sustain operations.
dossier.tactics: 三月初，烏軍沿頓涅茨克西部主要道路進入城區，至三月中旬宣布控制中央部分地區；然而分離武裝仍掌握南部、東部街區及若干通往郊外的高地。烏軍沒有建立連續外廓，也沒有清除市內分散據點，分離武裝隨後重新進入中央地帶。魯甘斯克方向的初期推進同樣形成街區與郊外互不相連的據點。三月進展因此只是重新部署兵力，而不是完成城市控制。四月十二日，烏方安全部隊由機場、鐵路車站及西側道路進入斯洛維揚斯克，奪取市政機關並設置封鎖線；武裝部隊則退往城市東北部及郊外高地。五月十一日至十二日，烏軍由北面攻擊卡爾什托夫和奧澤爾納，但步兵分批投入，砲兵觀察與後續補給未完全跟上，攻擊未能形成對山地的持續控制。五月二十五日，第34獨立山地旅配合空中火力奪回頓涅茨克機場舊航站樓；新航站樓及跑道兩端仍由分離武裝控制，機場始終不是單一完整陣地。六月二十八日，烏方在頓涅茨克外圍及魯甘斯克方向發動大規模進攻，試圖沿高速公路和鄉間道路壓縮分離武裝陣地，但這種多方向同時推進再次造成裝甲分散。七月初，烏方放棄斯洛維揚斯克以南至阿里季夫斯克的一段突出陣地，撤退到較短的北部防線；縱使因此損失部分車輛，卻避免戰車部隊在市區和郊區之間被逐個分割。七月五日，新航站樓亦落入分離武裝手中。七月十八日，烏方嘗試由諾沃盧漢斯克方向進入斯捷爾諾別舍韋，切斷通往俄羅斯邊境的走廊，但攻擊沒有守住。八月，烏方把第93機械旅裝甲營及志願部隊配置在Pivdenne、雷諾車站和塞列布良卡方向，嘗試沿鐵路側翼接近頓涅茨克機場；另一支力量由阿夫季夫卡外側壓向西頓涅茨克村鎮。這些正面攻擊受到機場、採石場、村落和峽谷地形限制。八月二十五日，亞佐夫營及其他武裝進入頓涅茨克市中心，奪取體育場和火車站，但後方補給線穿過受火力控制的郊區，無法長期維持市內控制。伊洛瓦伊斯克戰役最為關鍵：八月二十四日，多支機械化、摩托化及志願部隊向邊境三角形地帶推進，俄軍成建制部隊從側翼及後方打擊，烏軍指揮部隨即停止進攻並逐步撤回；至八月底至九月初，伊洛瓦伊斯克及通往斯捷爾諾別舍韋的南部走廊轉由分離武裝控制。八月二十九日，烏軍短暫進入盧甘斯克市中心，卻未肅清外圍據點，數日內即遭反擊退出。九月五日明斯克協議後，前線仍有一段進攻與反進攻，但雙方主要轉為鞏固陣地、砲火準備和偵察；至十二月底，沒有再出現佔領整座城市的大型攻勢，零星砲擊和陣地爭奪則持續。
dossier.tacticsEn: In early March, Ukrainian forces entered Donetsk along the principal roads from the west and announced control of parts of the central city by mid-March. Separatist forces nevertheless retained southern and eastern districts and several positions on the heights outside the city. Ukraine had not established a continuous perimeter or eliminated the dispersed positions within town, and separatists subsequently returned to the central districts. The early drive in Luhansk produced the same pattern of disconnected positions in the city and on its outskirts. The March advance therefore amounted to the redeployment of forces rather than consolidated city control. On April 12, Ukrainian security units entered Sloviansk through the airport, railway station, and roads from the west, taking administrative buildings and establishing a cordon. Armed forces withdrew to elevated ground and the northeastern edge of the city. From May 11 to 12, Ukrainian troops attacked Karshtof and Ozerna from the north, but infantry entered in fragmented groups and artillery observation and resupply did not keep pace, preventing sustained control of the heights. On May 25, the 34th Separate Mountain Brigade, supported by aviation, retook the old terminal at Donetsk Airport. The new terminal and both ends of the runway remained in separatist hands, so the airport never became a single coherent position. On June 28, Ukraine launched major attacks around Donetsk and in the Luhansk direction, attempting to compress separatist positions along highways and rural roads, but simultaneous advances in several directions again dispersed the armor. In early July, Ukraine abandoned the salient from south of Sloviansk toward Artemivsk and withdrew to a shorter northern line. This withdrawal cost vehicles but prevented individual tank units from being isolated between urban and suburban areas. The separatists also took the new terminal on July 5. On July 18, Ukraine attempted to enter Starobesheve from the Novoluhanske direction to cut the road to the Russian border, but did not retain the ground gained. In August, Ukraine positioned the armored battalion of the 93rd Mechanized Brigade and volunteer formations around Pivdenne, the Renault railway station, and Serebryanka, attempting to approach Donetsk Airport along the railway flank. Another force pressed from the outskirts of Avdiivka toward western Donetsk settlements. Frontal movement was restricted by the airport, quarries, villages, and valleys. On August 25, Azov and other armed units entered central Donetsk and took the stadium and railway station, but their supply routes crossed an outskirts under fire and could not sustain continuous municipal control. The decisive operation was Ilovaisk. On August 24, mechanized, motorized, and volunteer formations advanced toward the border triangle. Regular Russian formations struck their flanks and rear, the Ukrainian command stopped the advance, and the forces withdrew in stages. By late August and early September, Ilovaisk and the southern corridor toward Starobesheve were under separatist control. On August 29, Ukrainian troops briefly entered central Luhansk but failed to clear the surrounding positions and were forced out after counterattacks. Following the Minsk agreement on September 5, attacks and counterattacks continued for a period, but both sides increasingly emphasized fortification, artillery preparation, and reconnaissance. By the end of December no large offensive had retaken an entire city, although isolated bombardments and local struggles for positions continued.
dossier.data: 可核實的時間與空間資料顯示，這是一場沿約四百公里頓涅茨克至俄羅斯邊境正面展開的多戰區戰役，而不是單一城鎮攻防。歐洲安全與合作組織五月二十一日在斯洛維揚斯克一帶估計分離武裝約一千至二千人；這是地區性快照，不能當作頓巴斯全線總兵力。烏軍一個機械旅的和平時期行政編制通常約三千至四千五百人，山地旅約二千至三千人，但作戰單位實際人數、分散程度及缺額各不相同。二A36的最大射程約四十公里，二S一九約七十公里，BM-21以標準火箭射程約四十公里；實際射擊距離會受高程、觀察、彈種及天候影響。斯洛維揚斯克至頓涅茨克相距約一百公里，烏軍從阿里季夫斯克向頓涅茨克南部作戰時須維持更長補給線。明斯克文件在九月五日簽署，九月十九日又達成涵蓋分界線的補充停火安排，十月九日至十日進行大規模換俘。雙方同年公布的總傷亡數字互相矛盾，部分數字涵蓋作戰命令或失聯者，不能視為核實死亡總數，因此本篇不列任何全戰役精確傷亡或裝甲損失總數；同樣不把任何單方部隊公報數字當成完整戰果。
dossier.dataEn: Verifiable dates and distances show that this was a multi-theater campaign extending along roughly 400 kilometers of approaches between Donetsk and the Russian border, rather than a single urban battle. An OSCE report of May 21 estimated approximately 1,000 to 2,000 separatist fighters around Sloviansk. That was a local snapshot, not a total for the entire Donbas front. A Ukrainian mechanized brigade normally had an administrative establishment of roughly 3,000 to 4,500 personnel, while a mountain brigade had approximately 2,000 to 3,000, although actual combat strengths, dispersion, and vacancies differed. The 2A36 has a maximum range of about 40 kilometers, the 2S19 about 70 kilometers, and standard BM-21 rockets approximately 40 kilometers, with actual engagement distances affected by elevation, observation, ammunition type, and weather. Sloviansk lies about 100 kilometers from Donetsk, so Ukrainian operations from Artemivsk toward southern Donetsk required a substantially longer supply chain. The Minsk document was signed on September 5, a further ceasefire arrangement covering the line of contact followed on September 19, and a large prisoner exchange took place on October 9 and 10. The total casualty figures published by the two sides that year conflict, and some include personnel issued to operational units or reported missing rather than verified dead. Accordingly, this account gives no purported exact total for deaths, casualties, or armored losses, and does not treat any unilateral unit report as a complete battlefield result.
dossier.cause: 這場戰爭沒有能用一句口號解釋的單一原因。二月烏克蘭政治危機以亞努科維奇去職及權力轉移告終，俄軍同時控制克里米亞，烏克蘭東部的國家主權、邊境防衛與地方分離勢力之間的平衡因而被打破。頓巴斯地區長期存在語言、歷史認同、地方自治及國家權力分配爭議，但這些政治與社會背景不能自動說明戰爭為何在二〇一四年爆發。直接原因是一系列具體軍事事件：地方分離武裝佔領政府機關、武警設施及軍事據點，宣布成立兩個共和國；烏克蘭派遣部隊意圖恢復原有邊界與中央控制；俄羅斯則以武器供應、跨境部隊及邊境火力支援維持武裝存在。莫斯科把部分行動描述為保護烏克蘭境內俄語居民及阻止軍事衝突擴張，但俄軍直接進入頓巴斯後，其行動已超出秘密提供武器或非正式武裝顧問的範圍。烏方並非單純等待談判，其部隊也採取了封鎖城鎮、奪回機場及向邊境推進的軍事行動；地方武裝同樣藉攻擊邊境與交通線，迫使烏軍分散。九月明斯克安排試圖以停火、談判及未完成的地方政治改革降低軍事強度，但未解決跨境部隊合法性、武器撤除、邊界控制及地方權力分配等核心爭議。
dossier.causeEn: The war cannot be explained by a single slogan or one event. Ukraine’s political crisis ended with the removal of Yanukovych and a transfer of power while Russian forces controlled Crimea, destroying the existing balance among Ukrainian sovereignty, border defense, and separatist forces in the east. Donbas had long-standing disputes over language, historical identity, local autonomy, and the distribution of state authority, but those political and social conditions did not by themselves explain why war began in 2014. The immediate causes were concrete military developments: local separatists seized administrative buildings, internal-security facilities, and military sites and proclaimed two republics; Ukraine deployed forces to restore its existing borders and central control; and Russia supplied weapons, cross-border formations, and border-based fire support to preserve the armed presence. Moscow described parts of its action as protection of Russian-speaking inhabitants of Ukraine and as prevention of further escalation, but after regular Russian troops entered Donbas, Russian activity went beyond the provision of weapons or advisers to informal local forces. Ukraine was not merely waiting for negotiations. Its forces blockaded towns, attacked the airport, and advanced toward the border, while separatists attacked border and transport routes in ways that forced Ukrainian units to disperse. The September Minsk arrangements attempted to reduce military intensity through ceasefires, negotiations, and incomplete provisions for local political reform. They did not resolve the core disputes over the legal status of cross-border forces, withdrawal of weapons, control of borders, or the distribution of local political authority.
dossier.impact: 軍事影響首先出現在控制區，而不在一場可以明確判定勝方的城市決戰。烏方在斯洛維揚斯克、克拉馬托爾斯克、阿里季夫斯克、 Druzhkivka 及科斯季揚蒂夫斯克等北部城鎮保持控制，卻未能重新建立對頓涅茨克和盧甘斯克兩市的完整外廓。分離武裝則在頓涅茨克南部的邊境三角形建立縱深，並保有兩市中心、頓涅茨克機場區及魯甘斯克大片區域。這使最初被烏方視為短程平亂的行動逐漸轉化為持續數月的地面戰。烏克蘭把國民兵、志願營、邊境部隊與常備旅納入同一作戰體系，總參謀部與地方指揮部的協調、戰車回收、彈藥前送及工程保障成為比單個營能否奪取街區更關鍵的問題。俄羅斯則把原本臨近邊界的南方軍區部隊、第8合成陸軍集團及後方補給節點連成較穩定的支援結構，使地方武裝能獲得成建制裝甲與砲火，而不是只依賴小型突擊隊。雙方都更重視分散陣地、偽裝、機動砲兵、反裝甲伏擊、空中觀察及戰術偵察；但密集砲火和反砲火未能解決後勤及戰術指揮問題。戰役造成大量裝甲車、步兵車、迫擊砲與火炮損失，沒有一方的宣稱能提供可靠的總數。純軍事而言，二〇一四年最重要的制度結果是烏克蘭建立反恐怖主義作戰架構，俄羅斯把邊境部隊與地方武裝作戰合併編排，而前線也由鬆散零星戰鬥逐漸凝固成一條仍可再發動攻勢的分界線。
dossier.impactEn: The principal military effects were changes in territory rather than the outcome of a single urban battle. Ukraine retained Sloviansk, Kramatorsk, Artemivsk, Druzhkivka, Kostiantynivka, and other northern towns, but failed to establish a continuous perimeter around Donetsk or Luhansk. Separatist forces obtained depth in the southern Donetsk border triangle and retained the centers of both cities, the Donetsk Airport area, and substantial parts of Luhansk. An operation initially treated as a short internal-security campaign consequently developed into months of conventional ground warfare. Ukraine incorporated National Guard formations, volunteer battalions, border troops, and regular brigades into a common operational structure, exposing the importance of command coordination, armored-vehicle recovery, ammunition distribution, and engineering support. Russia connected formations of the Southern Military District, the 8th Combined Arms Army, and rear-area supply nodes to the front, allowing local forces to receive brigade-sized armor and artillery support rather than relying only on small raiding teams. Both sides placed greater emphasis on dispersed positions, concealment, mobile artillery, anti-ambush measures, aerial observation, and tactical reconnaissance. Heavy bombardment and counterbattery action did not solve the underlying logistical and command problems. Large numbers of tanks, armored personnel carriers, mortars, and artillery pieces were lost on both sides, but neither side’s claim can be treated as a reliable total. In strictly military terms, the most important institutional results of 2014 were Ukraine’s creation of an Anti-Terrorist Operation structure and Russia’s integration of border formations with operations conducted by local armed units. The front hardened into a ceasefire line that could support renewed offensives.
dossier.result: 截至二零一四年十二月三十一日，烏克蘭保住了斯洛維揚斯克至魯甘斯克北部的大部分鐵路與公路走廊，也繼續控制阿里季夫斯克、克拉馬托爾斯克、斯洛維揚斯克、北部魯甘斯克若干據點及德巴爾切韋；它仍未能奪回頓涅茨克和盧甘斯克市中心，也失去伊洛瓦伊斯克至俄羅斯邊境的主要突出地帶。頓涅茨克人民共和國控制頓涅茨克市、機場、頓涅茨克南部及邊境三角形，盧甘斯克人民共和國控制盧甘斯克市及省內大片西部、東部區域。雙方實際分界線呈多段折線，並非一條連續而清楚的陣地；德巴爾切韋突出部尤其沒有達成正式劃界。九月五日明斯克協議、九月十九日補充停火和十月大規模換俘，使大規模正面進攻明顯減少，但協議沒有一致落實的撤軍、全面非軍事化或可靠監察方案。十二月的零星砲擊和陣地行動仍在繼續，因此不能把年終狀態稱為永久和平。二〇一四年的戰役結果是雙方都保住部分目標、失去部分目標，並留下德巴爾切韋等仍可爭奪的地帶；它既不是烏方收復兩個州，也不是分離武裝推翻烏克蘭政府。戰爭未在十二月結束，後續戰鬥已超出本篇界定的年度範圍。
dossier.resultEn: By December 31, 2014, Ukraine had preserved much of the railway and road corridor through Sloviansk and northern Luhansk and continued to hold Artemivsk, Kramatorsk, several positions in northern Luhansk, and Debaltseve. It had not retaken the centers of Donetsk or Luhansk and had lost the principal salient around Ilovaisk leading toward the Russian border. The Donetsk Republic controlled Donetsk city, the airport, southern Donetsk, and the border triangle, while the Luhansk Republic held Luhansk city and substantial western and eastern portions of the oblast. The actual line of contact consisted of several angular sectors rather than one continuous and clearly defined front, and the Debaltseve salient was never formally delimited. The Minsk agreement of September 5, the additional ceasefire arrangements of September 19, and the large prisoner exchange in October reduced major conventional offensives, but no settlement with consistently implemented withdrawal, comprehensive demilitarization, or reliable verification was completed. Sporadic artillery fire and local positional fighting continued in December, so the year-end position cannot be described as a permanent peace. The military result of 2014 was that both sides retained some objectives, lost others, and left areas such as Debaltseve open to further contest. It was neither a Ukrainian recapture of the two oblasts nor a separatist overthrow of the Ukrainian government. The fighting did not end in December, and subsequent combat falls outside the annual scope of this account.

battle.name: 納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫戰爭
battle.brief: 納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫戰爭始於2020年2月，是亞美尼亞與亞塞拜然圍繞納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫及周邊地區的武裝衝突。亞塞拜然調動BM-21「Grad」多管火箭炮參戰，該型號於1967年列裝，以車載發射系統提供遠距火箭火力，是此次地面作戰中可辨識的蘇聯時期裝備。

kit.name: BM-21「Grad」多管火箭炮
kit.history: BM-21「Grad」是蘇聯陸軍炮兵體系中的122毫米多管火箭炮，負責提供較炮兵射程更遠的火箭火力，並與自行加榴炮共同構成縱深打擊能力。

dossier.countries: 2020年納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫戰役的一方是亞塞拜然及其武裝部隊，另一方是亞美尼亞武裝力量與亞爾斯赫克國防軍。亞塞拜然由賈姆賈、托武茲等西部師區，以及與亞爾斯赫克相接的北部、東部和南部方向部署，攻勢跨越約三百公里的接觸線。亞美尼亞本土軍與亞爾斯赫克部隊依托山脊、峽谷、疊堡、反坦克壕和縱深陣地作戰。俄羅斯在開火時不是參戰國，先以調解者身分斡旋，停火後又依協議向亞爾斯赫克及拉欖走廊一線派遣維和部隊；土耳其沒有地面參戰，但在戰前與戰時向亞塞拜然提供TB2無人機。亞爾斯赫克的代表不是亞美尼亞首都當局，而是其總統與國防部長，因此10月26日安排是三方都能執行的停火文件，而不是單純的兩國交換聲明。多數接觸面地形破碎，一處缺口可能牽動後方道路，但能否持續推進仍取決於山區通行、守軍封閉缺口的能力和後備部隊抵達速度。
dossier.countriesEn: The belligerent on one side in the 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh War was Azerbaijan and its armed forces; the other side was the Armed Forces of Armenia and the Artsakh Defense Army. Azerbaijan deployed from western districts such as Ganja and Tovuz and from northern, eastern, and southern sectors adjoining Artsakh, with its offensive spanning a contact line of roughly 300 kilometres. Armenian and Artsakh forces fought from ridgelines, valleys, overlapping strongpoints, anti-tank ditches, and in-depth positions in the mountains. Russia was not a belligerent when the shooting began; it first acted as mediator and later deployed peacekeepers to Artsakh and the Lachin corridor area under the agreement. Turkey did not enter the ground war, but supplied TB2 drones to Azerbaijan before and during the fighting. Artsakh was represented not by Armenia's government in Yerevan but by its own president and defense minister, so the arrangement of October 26 was a three-party enforceable ceasefire document rather than a simple bilateral statement. Most sectors of contact were physically fragmented, and one breach could affect roads behind the front, but actual progress depended on mountain access, the defenders' ability to close gaps, and the speed with which reserves could arrive.
dossier.people: 伊利亞姆·阿利耶夫以亞塞拜然總統與最高統帥身分發動攻勢，9月27日公開宣布全面進攻，10月8日宣布單方面停火以赴莫斯科會談，10月18日再要求亞方全面撤出特定區域，10月20日前後接受暫停交火的政治框架。國防部長扎基爾·胡塞因諾夫把政治決策轉成軍令，並代表亞塞拜然簽署10月26日文件；總參謀長魯斯坦·奧魯若夫與陸軍司令伊斯梅爾·穆薩耶夫分別統籌參謀作業和地面突擊。亞美尼亞總理尼科爾·帕希尼揚掌握談判立場，國防部長阿爾茨倫·薩爾基揚與總參謀長阿肖特·馬努基揚負責亞美尼亞本土軍。亞爾斯赫克總統薩姆維爾·沙赫拉馬尼揚與國防部長賈米爾·拜拉馬揚決定亞爾斯赫克防軍的撤出與停火，亞爾森·哈魯秋尼揚則參與前線軍事指揮。公開可核對的資料大多停留在軍團、旅和防區層級，因此不把無法確認的個人戰功或臨時指揮 命令寫成事實。亞美尼亞本土軍與亞爾斯赫克防軍分屬不同指揮系統，撤軍、後備部隊和火力協調必須經過額外層級，這也是缺口擴大後難以立即堵住的原因之一。
dossier.peopleEn: President and commander-in-chief Ilham Aliyev initiated the offensive, publicly announcing a broad attack on September 27, a unilateral cessation intended to facilitate talks in Moscow on October 8, and renewed demands for Armenian withdrawal from specified districts on October 18, before accepting the political framework for a temporary halt around October 20. Defense Minister Zakir Huseynov converted political decisions into operational orders and signed the October 26 document for Azerbaijan. Chief of the General Staff Rustam Orujov and Ground Forces commander Ismayil Musayev directed staff operations and the ground offensive respectively. Armenian prime minister Nikol Pashinyan set the negotiating position, while defense minister Artsrun Sargsyan and Chief of the General Staff Ashot Manukyan oversaw the Armenian armed forces. Artsakh president Samvel Shahramanyan and defense minister Jamil Bayramyan decided on the withdrawal and ceasefire of the Artsakh Defense Army, with Arsen Harutyunyan participating in front-line military command. Publicly verifiable information is concentrated at corps, brigade, and sector level, so unconfirmed individual exploits or improvised commands are not treated as facts. The Armenian armed forces and the Artsakh Defense Army belonged to separate command systems, making the coordination of withdrawals, reserves, and fires require additional levels. That structure was one reason gaps could widen after they appeared before they could be sealed.
dossier.kits: 公開影像與官方裝備資料顯示，亞塞拜然在2020年可投入的裝甲包括蘇聯製T-72B主戰坦克、土耳其製M60T3主戰坦克、M113T裝甲運兵車及BMP系列裝甲車；亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克則以T-72B、BMP-2、BMP-3和BTR系列裝甲車構成主要地面突擊與防禦力量。雙方可辨識的代表性火力包括152毫米2S19 Msta-S與2S22 DANA自行榴彈炮、122毫米BM-21 Grad火箭炮，以及部分單位的BM-27 Uragan 300毫米火箭炮，實際使用仍受彈藥存量、射程和射界限制。亞塞拜然部署有S-300PT、S-300V與9K33 Osa防空系統，亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克可見S-300Ts、S-300V、9K37 Buk-M1與9K33 Osa。這些飛彈系統主要提供防區和後方掩護，不能單憑配備表推算實際攔截戰果。土耳其於2020年交付亞塞拜然的Bayraktar TB2可攜帶MAM-L導引炸藥，用於偵察及攻擊暴露的砲位、通訊與車隊；亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克大量使用的Lancet-3巡飛彈則以小型防護據點和移動中的裝甲目標為主。這些型號在2020年以前均已列裝。考量雷區與反坦克壕，装甲車輛通常只沿已勘察的短距離道路轉移，油料與散熱／戰備物資留在後方，長時間停留的砲兵和後勤單位因而更容易受到無人機觀察與反砲兵火力的威脅。
dossier.kitsEn: Public imagery and official inventories show that Azerbaijan could field Soviet T-72B main battle tanks, Turkish M60T3 main battle tanks, Turkish M113T armoured personnel carriers, and BMP-series vehicles. Armenia and Artsakh relied mainly on T-72B tanks, BMP-2 and BMP-3 infantry fighting vehicles, and BTR-series vehicles for assault and defence. Representative fires identifiable on both sides included 152 mm 2S19 Msta-S and 2S22 DANA self-propelled howitzers, 122 mm BM-21 Grad launchers, and, in some units, BM-27 Uragan 300 mm rocket launchers; their actual use remained constrained by ammunition stocks, range, and firing sectors. Azerbaijan operated S-300PT, S-300V, and 9K33 Osa air-defence systems, while Armenia and Artsakh fielded S-300Ts, S-300V, 9K37 Buk-M1, and 9K33 Osa systems. These missile systems principally protected sectors and rear areas, and their presence alone does not establish interception results. Turkey delivered Bayraktar TB2 drones to Azerbaijan in 2020; the aircraft could carry MAM-L guided munitions and were used for reconnaissance and strikes against exposed artillery, communications, and vehicle columns. Lancet-3 loitering munitions used by Armenia and Artsakh were particularly effective against small protected positions and moving armoured targets. Every model named here had entered service before the end of 2020. Because of minefields and anti-tank ditches, armoured vehicles usually moved only along surveyed routes over short distances, while fuel and sustainment stocks remained farther to the rear. Artillery and logistics units that stayed in one place for long periods were therefore more exposed to drone observation and counter-battery fire.
dossier.tactics: 9月27日天亮前，亞塞拜然在托武茲、巴爾達、哈德魯特、菲祖利與卡拉巴赫東側等多個地段實施砲火準備，TB2觀察、無人機偵察和地面突擊相互銜接。雙方對哪一方首先開火的說法不一，可以確認的是亞方隨即由多個方向展開進攻。巴爾達方向承受最早的主要突破壓力，亞塞拜然的砲兵先打擊塹壕、疊堡和周邊高地，T-72B、M60T3與裝甲運兵車再以短距離移動配合步兵接近，至9月28日，巴爾達市中心及附近主要陣地已由亞塞拜然控制。9月29日至30日，亞塞拜然把攻勢擴展為三條主要軸線：西北面指向卡爾巴賈爾與拉欖，南面壓向哈德魯特與菲祖利，東面則向馬爾塔克爾特及卡拉巴赫縱深推進。亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克以T-72B和BMP系列裝甲車在部分地段反擊，並利用後方砲兵支援受威脅陣地，但多個突破口同時出現，守軍無法在一夜之間全部封閉。地理定位影片可確認TB2曾攻擊或偵察多個砲位、通訊節點和車隊，卻不足以支持雙方公布的每一筆裝備損失。10月1日至4日，亞塞拜然把已突破地區當成後續出發點，反覆以短距離炮擊、固定陣地和裝甲輸送隊交替推進，並控制通往馬爾塔克爾特的部分道路。亞美尼亞投入預備兵力試圖恢復縱深道路，阿格達姆與哈德魯特方向的防線因連續遷移而拉長；卡拉巴赫方向的守軍則退守較高陣地，繼續以反坦克壕、地雷和相互支援的火力點遲滯裝甲車。10月4日以後，亞塞拜然再次發動廣泛攻勢，一面向卡爾巴賈爾施壓，一面在阿格達姆以南及舒沙周圍縮短控制區，另一面鞏固通往馬爾塔克爾特方向的突破口。10月5日至7日的主要特徵不是單純坦克正面衝撞，而是攻方奪取路口和高地、守方逐點後撤、再由步兵與工兵清理狹窄通道的連續作戰。10月8日18時，亞塞拜然宣布暫停攻擊，莫斯科會談於9日舉行；由於沒有形成可核驗的撤軍與安全安排，交火在10日恢復。10月15日再度會談，10月18日至20日仍有最後一輪多軸進攻及短暫停火。10月20日以後，零星砲火與談判交替進行，軍事位置沒有立即回到9月27日狀態。10月26日各方簽署停火文件後，主要砲火停止，山區陣地、撤軍路線和戰俘交換才依協議進入實際執行階段。
dossier.tacticsEn: Before dawn on September 27, Azerbaijan conducted artillery preparation across the Tovuz, Barda, Hadrut, Fizuli, and eastern Qarabağ sectors, with TB2 observation, drone reconnaissance, and ground assaults closely linked. The sides disagreed over who had fired first, but it is clear that Azerbaijan then advanced along several axes. The Barda front bore the first major breach. Azerbaijani artillery struck trench lines, overlapping strongpoints, and surrounding heights; T-72B and M60T3 tanks and armoured personnel carriers then advanced in short movements behind infantry. By September 28, Barda's centre and most nearby positions were under Azerbaijani control. From September 29 to 30, Azerbaijan expanded the offensive into three principal axes: toward Kalbajar and Lachin in the northwest, toward Hadrut and Fizuli in the south, and toward Martakert and the interior of Qarabağ in the east. Armenian and Artsakh forces counterattacked with T-72B tanks and BMP-series vehicles in several sectors and supported threatened positions with rearward artillery, but simultaneous openings could not all be sealed in a single night. Geolocated footage confirmed that TB2 aircraft observed or struck multiple artillery positions, communications nodes, and vehicle columns, although it could not validate every equipment-loss claim announced by either side. From October 1 to 4, Azerbaijan used captured ground as the starting point for subsequent attacks, alternating short artillery bursts, fixed-position assaults, and armoured transport movements while taking control of sections of the road to Martakert. Armenia committed reserves to restore routes into the interior, and the defensive line around Aghdam and Hadrut stretched through repeated relocations. In the Qarabağ sector, defenders withdrew to higher ground and continued to delay armour with anti-tank ditches, mines, and mutually supporting firing positions. After October 4, Azerbaijan launched another broad offensive, pressing toward Kalbajar, shortening its control around Aghdam in the south and Shusha, and consolidating penetrations toward Martakert. From October 5 to 7, the pattern was less a single frontal tank charge than a sequence in which attackers seized junctions and heights, defenders withdrew position by position, and infantry and engineers then cleared narrow routes. At 18:00 on October 8, Azerbaijan announced a pause, followed by talks in Moscow on October 9. Fighting resumed on October 10 because no verifiable withdrawal and security arrangement had been completed. Further talks took place on October 15, and another series of attacks and temporary halts occurred from October 18 to 20. Sporadic fire and negotiations alternated after October 20, and the military positions did not immediately return to those of September 27. The ceasefire document signed on October 26 ended the main artillery conflict, after which positions, withdrawal routes, and exchanges of prisoners entered the implementation stage.
dossier.data: 主要戰鬥從2020年9月27日延續至10月26日，按日曆日計算約三十日；部分文獻把停火後的俘虜交換、屍體搜尋與協議執行期一併計算，因而稱為四十四日戰爭。這項名稱反映不同計日方式，不代表另有一場戰役。接觸線全長約三百公里，但有效突破集中於巴爾達、阿格達姆、菲祖利、哈德魯特、卡爾巴賈爾、拉欖及馬爾塔克爾特等方向。9月28日前後巴爾達的控制權改變可由衛星影像與戰報互相印證；10月初通往馬爾塔克爾特的道路曾中斷，舒沙與馬爾塔克爾特周邊據點也陸續易手，但不同據點並非同一日失守。亞塞拜然官方使用的軍人傷亡數字為2,894人死亡、9,557人受傷；亞美尼亞在停火前曾公布989名軍人死亡、超過2,000人受傷，亞爾斯赫克防軍另以自身指揮鏈發布軍人數字。各方統計時間、納入範圍和更新方式不同，無法可靠相加，也沒有國際共同核驗的總表，因此本紀錄不把失蹤直接算作死亡，也不替任何一方推算精確總和。裝備方面可以確認若干陣地和車輛被放棄或摧毀，但公開影像不足以建立完整的逐件損失表。
dossier.dataEn: The principal combat phase lasted from September 27 to October 26, 2020, or about thirty calendar days. Some accounts also count the post-ceasefire exchanges of prisoners, recovery of remains, and implementation of agreements, and therefore call it a forty-four-day war. That name reflects different counting conventions rather than the existence of another campaign. The contact line was about 300 kilometres long, but effective penetrations were concentrated around Barda, Aghdam, Fizuli, Hadrut, Kalbajar, Lachin, and Martakert. Changes in control around Barda by September 28 can be cross-checked through satellite imagery and operational reporting. In early October, the road toward Martakert was interrupted, while positions around Shusha and Martakert changed hands successively rather than on a single day. The official Azerbaijani military casualty figures were 2,894 dead and 9,557 wounded. Before the ceasefire, Armenia reported 989 military personnel dead and more than 2,000 wounded, while Artsakh authorities issued separate military figures through their own chain of command. The sides used different reporting dates, inclusion rules, and updates, so the totals cannot be reliably added, and there is no internationally verified common table. Missing personnel are therefore not automatically counted as dead, and no definitive combined total is inferred. Open-source evidence confirms that some positions and vehicles were abandoned or destroyed, but it is insufficient for a complete item-by-item loss list.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的遠因是亞塞拜然、亞美尼亞及亞爾斯赫克之間從未解決的主權、邊界與安全安排問題。1988年至1994年的戰爭結束後，雙方接受停火，卻沒有達成永久政治協議。1994年停火後，亞美尼亞部隊仍控制阿格達姆、薩爾桑格與貝爾達申等亞塞拜然西部區域，這些突出部被亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克視為保護本國及亞爾斯赫克的安全屏障，亞塞拜然則堅持不得接受這種現狀。歐安組織明斯克小組長期談判未能確定最終地位，接觸線上的砲火、小規模滲透和违及停火的事件則持續發生。2020年7月24日至26日，托武茲方向再度發生戰鬥，雙方各自指責對方先攻擊並違反停火，事件加深國內政治壓力，也讓外交談判更難維持現狀。外部援助改變了雙方對風險的計算：亞塞拜然獲得土耳其無人機及較強的遠程火力，亞美尼亞則依靠俄羅斯基地與軍事支持維持北部邊境安全。8月至9月的接觸線談判未產生可核驗的撤軍方案。從公開聲明和部署可見，亞塞拜然認為有限攻勢可在國際介入前奪取特定區域，亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克則把同一批陣地視為不可退讓的縱深，雙方對戰役代價與勝負門檻的估算因而朝相反方向移動。
dossier.causeEn: The deeper causes were unresolved questions of sovereignty, borders, and security among Azerbaijan, Armenia, and Artsakh. The 1988-1994 war ended with an accepted ceasefire but no final political settlement. After the 1994 ceasefire, Armenian forces continued to hold areas in western Azerbaijan, including the salient around Aghdam, Sarsang, and Berdashen. Armenia and Artsakh regarded positions of this kind as security barriers for Armenia and Artsakh, while Azerbaijan rejected the post-war arrangement. The OSCE Minsk Group never settled the final status issue, while artillery fire, small infiltrations, and ceasefire violations continued along the contact line. Fighting in the Tovuz direction on July 24-26, 2020, brought mutual accusations of first attack and ceasefire violations, increased domestic political pressure, and made diplomatic management of the existing situation more difficult. External assistance altered each side's calculation of risk. Azerbaijan obtained Turkish drones and stronger long-range firepower, while Armenia relied on the Russian base and Russian military support for the security of its northern border. Contact-line talks in August and September produced no verifiable withdrawal plan. Public statements and deployments indicated that Azerbaijan believed a limited offensive could seize selected districts before international mediation froze the front. Armenia and Artsakh treated the same positions as non-negotiable depth. Their estimates of acceptable cost and the threshold for victory consequently moved in opposite directions.
dossier.impact: 軍事上，亞爾斯赫克的防禦縱深在短時間內縮短。阿格達姆、巴爾達、卡拉巴赫西部與馬爾塔克爾特周邊的大量陣地由亞塞拜然取得，亞美尼亞被迫從部分西部突出部撤出原有部隊，斯捷潘內克特與卡爾巴賈爾周邊的直接威脅因而出現，但亞塞拜然在2020年並未占領斯捷潘內克特，也未完整控制卡爾巴賈爾。外交上，俄羅斯由中立調解者轉為停火見證者與安全安排參與者，依協議最多派遣1,960名維和人員，前往亞爾斯赫克及拉欖走廊一帶；土耳其的無人機供應和監測角色也更為公開，但土耳其仍未成為地面交戰方。此次行動顯示，無人機觀察、砲兵隱蔽、通訊中斷、後備部隊反應時間與外線公路安全會直接影響山區防線，命中數輛坦克並不能單獨決定陣地得失。停火協議沒有處理亞爾斯赫克的最終地位，部分撤軍地點和交接程序又以停火時實際位置為基礎，這些未決問題在其後仍造成軍事接觸與再交火風險。
dossier.impactEn: Militarily, Artsakh's defensive depth was compressed in a short period. Azerbaijan gained extensive positions around Aghdam, Barda, western Qarabağ, and Martakert, forcing Armenia to withdraw forces from parts of its western salient. A direct threat to Stepanakert and the Kalbajar area emerged, although Azerbaijan did not capture Stepanakert or take complete control of Kalbajar in 2020. Diplomatically, Russia moved from neutral mediator to witness and security participant, with authority to deploy up to 1,960 peacekeepers to Artsakh and the Lachin corridor area under the agreement. Turkey's drone deliveries and monitoring role became more visible, but Turkey still did not become a ground belligerent. The campaign showed that drone observation, artillery concealment, communications disruption, reserve reaction time, and the security of roads behind the front directly affected a mountain defence. Destroying several tanks by itself could not determine control of positions. The ceasefire did not settle Artsakh's final status, and some withdrawal areas and handover procedures were based on the actual positions on the day fighting stopped. Those unresolved questions remained sources of military contact and renewed violence afterward.
dossier.result: 10月26日，扎基爾·胡塞因諾夫代表亞塞拜然、阿爾茨倫·薩爾基揚代表亞美尼亞、賈米爾·拜拉馬揚代表亞爾斯赫克，在俄羅斯外長謝爾蓋·拉夫羅夫見證下於莫斯科簽署停火安排。文件要求亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克部隊在十天期限內撤出卡爾巴賈爾、拉欖、庫巴德利、阿格達姆、傑布賴伊勒、菲祖利、贊吉蘭等劃定區域，以及賈姆賈附近的指定交接點；亞塞拜疆則保留戰前已控制及戰爭中取得的區域。交換俘虜與遺體、搜尋遺體、排雷、監察交接和防止違反停火成為主要執行事項。協議同時安排最多1,960名俄羅斯維和人員進入亞爾斯赫克及拉欖走廊相關地區，協助觀察停火與撤離線。領土結果是亞塞拜然保有巴爾達、阿格達姆以及卡拉巴赫和馬爾塔克爾特大部分已取得區域，但斯捷潘內克特與卡爾巴賈爾市仍在亞爾斯赫克控制之下，拉欖走廊也沒有依這份文件立即開通。這不是永久和平條約，沒有由亞美尼亞正式放棄對邊界或亞爾斯赫克地位的主張；停火後的俘虜交換和掃雷工作仍持續一段時間，但不應把這些執行程序改寫成10月26日後仍有主要戰役。
dossier.resultEn: On October 26, Zakir Huseynov signed for Azerbaijan, Artsrun Sargsyan for Armenia, and Jamil Bayramyan for Artsakh in Moscow, with Russian foreign minister Sergei Lavrov witnessing the arrangement. The document required Armenian and Artsakh forces to withdraw within ten days from designated areas including Kalbajar, Lachin, Qubadli, Aghdam, Jabrayil, Fuzuli, and Zangilan, together with specified handover points near Ganja. Azerbaijan was to retain areas it already controlled before the war and had captured during the fighting. Exchanges of prisoners and remains, recovery operations, mine clearance, monitoring of handovers, and prevention of ceasefire violations became the main implementation tasks. The agreement also provided for up to 1,960 Russian peacekeepers to enter Artsakh and areas related to the Lachin corridor to observe the ceasefire and withdrawal lines. Azerbaijan retained Barda, Aghdam, and most of the areas it had gained in Qarabağ and around Martakert, but Stepanakert and the town of Kalbajar remained under Artsakh control, and the Lachin corridor was not opened immediately under this document. This was not a final peace treaty, and Armenia did not formally relinquish its position on the boundary or the status of Artsakh. Prisoner exchanges and mine-clearance work continued for some time after October 26, but those implementation activities should not be recast as continuing major combat after the ceasefire.

battle.name: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭
battle.brief: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭自2022年2月展開，戰線由北、東、南多個方向推進，地面作戰結合裝甲突擊與遠程火力打擊。俄軍使用T-72B主戰坦克執行地面進攻；此型號於1985年服役，是俄羅斯地面部隊的制式裝備，任務包括突破防線、伴隨步兵推進及提供機動火力支援。

kit.name: 主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72B是俄羅斯地面部隊的主戰坦克，位於裝甲作戰核心，負責突破防線、護送步兵及提供機動火力，並與自走榴彈砲協同作戰。

dossier.countries: 這場2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭的地面交戰，主體是俄羅斯聯邦武裝部隊與烏克蘭武裝部隊；俄方還由頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地方武裝參與作戰。白俄羅斯提供軍用機場、鐵路、公路與住宿基地，但未投入本身的師級地面部隊，因此不列作主要地面交戰者。戰線分成北方、東部與南方：北方集群由白俄羅斯邊境、蘇梅及切爾尼戈夫方向逼近基輔；東部集群由羅斯托夫、沃羅涅日和頓涅茨克向哈爾科夫、伊久姆及庫皮揚斯克施壓；南方集群以俄方控制的克里米亞為基地，攻向赫爾松、扎波羅熱、頓涅茨克南部及亞速海沿岸。北約、歐盟及若干國家提供武器、訓練、情報與財政支持，但沒有以國家身分加入地面戰鬥；摩爾多瓦也未成為主要戰場。
dossier.countriesEn: The principal ground belligerents in Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine were the armed forces of the Russian Federation and Ukraine, with the local forces of Donetsk and Luhansk also participating on the Russian side. Belarus provided military airfields, railways, roads, and accommodation bases, but it did not commit its own army-sized ground formations and is therefore not treated as a principal ground belligerent. The front was divided into northern, eastern, and southern sectors. The northern grouping advanced toward Kyiv from the Belarusian border and through Sumy and Chernihiv. The eastern grouping applied pressure toward Kharkiv, Izium, and Kupyansk from Rostov, Voronezh, and Donetsk. The southern grouping used Russian-controlled Crimea as a base for operations toward Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, southern Donetsk, and the Sea of Azov coast. NATO, the European Union, and several other states supplied weapons, training, intelligence, and financial support without entering ground combat as belligerents. Moldova was not a principal battlefield.
dossier.people: 俄方的政治決策、戰略目標與動員命令由弗拉基米爾·普京主持，安德烈·別伊負責國防部協調，瓦西里·祖利奇及總參謀部處理軍種與後勤問題。地面指揮先後由亞歷山大·多沃爾尼科夫及瓦列里·蘇羅維金負責；蘇羅維金於2022年5月下旬獲得烏克蘭戰區聯合部隊的指揮責任。主要作戰單位包括近衛第1坦克軍、第2、第3、第4、第5、第6、第7及第8合成軍，以及第58、第47、第49、第8和第51軍。烏克蘭方面，澤連斯基負責最高政治與對外協調，瓦列里·扎盧日尼擔任武裝部隊總司令，國防部與總參謀部策劃全國防務；第93、第128、第80、第72、第24及第30机械化旅等部隊在哈爾科夫、頓巴斯和南方戰線輪換作戰。丹尼斯·普希林與列奧尼德·帕謝奇尼克是頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地方政權的政治領袖，葉夫根尼·普里戈津則率領瓦格納組織，該組織在索萊達爾及巴赫穆特方向保持較高作戰自主性，也與俄軍正式指揮系統多次發生摩擦。
dossier.peopleEn: Strategic political decisions, war aims, and mobilization orders in Russia were directed by Vladimir Putin. Andrey Shoigu coordinated the Ministry of Defence, while Valery Gerasimov and the General Staff handled service and logistics matters. Operational land command passed through Alexander Dvornikov and Valery Surovikin, with Surovikin receiving responsibility for the combined force grouping in Ukraine in late May 2022. The principal Russian formations included the 1st Guards Tank Army, the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th Combined Arms Armies, and the 58th, 47th, 49th, 8th, and 51st Armies. In Ukraine, Zelensky directed high-level political and external coordination, while Commander-in-Chief Valery Zaluzhny led the Armed Forces through the Ministry of Defence and General Staff. Separate brigades including the 93rd, 128th, 80th, 72nd, 24th, and 30th Mechanized Brigades rotated through the Kharkiv, Donbas, and southern fronts. Denis Pushilin and Leonid Pasechnik were the political leaders of the Donetsk and Luhansk administrations. Yevgeny Prigozhin commanded the Wagner organization, which retained substantial operational autonomy around Soledar and Bakhmut and repeatedly came into conflict with Russia’s formal command structure.
dossier.kits: 俄軍投入的裝備均在2022年以前列裝，包括T-72B3、T-72B3M、T-90A、BMP-1、BMP-2、BTR-80及BTR-82A。炮兵主力為1989年列裝的2S19、2012年列裝的2S35、2018年列裝的2S34、2S4、9A55Grad、BM-21Grad、9K57BM-27暴風雨及2012年列裝的TOS-1A；常見彈藥包括125公厘穿甲、破甲與制導炮彈，152公厘高爆榴彈，9K55炮彈，9K58 Grad火箭炮彈，以及122與300公厘火箭彈。航空兵力使用MiG-29、MiG-31、Su-27、Su-30SM、Su-35S、Su-24M、Tu-22M3、Tu-95MS、Ka-52及Mi-28N，並使用Kh-101、Kinzhal等已在役的武器。2017年列裝的Lancet與2018年列裝的Orlan-10分別用於攻擊裝甲與戰場監視，R-330Zh及2014年列裝的Pole-21則保護後方指揮所、雷達與彈藥庫。烏克蘭運用T-64BV、T-80UD、T-84U Oplot、BMP-2、BMP-3、BTR-3、BTR-4、2S7、2S9、2018年列裝的2K22及BM-21，並以M777 HSS、1992年列裝的HIMARS、S-300、Buk-M1、Kub-M3、Stinger、Javelin、NLAW及AT4構成火力與防空體系；M777自1988年起服役，Bayraktar TB2則於2014年列裝。雙方都使用前線排障與回收單位處理故障、磨損及繳獲裝備，但能否投入作戰取決於車況、零件、訓練與補給。
dossier.kitsEn: The equipment committed by Russia had all entered service before 2022. It included the T-72B3, T-72B3M, T-90A, BMP-1, BMP-2, BTR-80, and BTR-82A. The principal artillery systems were the 2S19, fielded in 1989; the 2S35, fielded in 2012; the 2S34, fielded in 2018; the 2S4; the 9A55 Grad; the BM-21 Grad; the 9K57 BM-27 Uragan; and the TOS-1A, fielded in 2012. Common ammunition included 125 mm armour-piercing, high-explosive, and guided rounds; 152 mm high-explosive shells; 9K55 rounds for the 2S19; 9K58 Grad rockets for the 9A55 and BM-21; and 122 mm and 300 mm rockets. Russian aviation included MiG-29, MiG-31, Su-27, Su-30SM, Su-35S, Su-24M, Tu-22M3, Tu-95MS, Ka-52, and Mi-28N, together with weapons such as the Kh-101 and Kinzhal. The Lancet, fielded in 2017, and Orlan-10, fielded in 2018, were used for attacks against armored vehicles and battlefield observation. The R-330Zh and Pole-21, fielded in 2014, protected command posts, radar stations, and ammunition depots in the rear area. Ukraine used T-64BV, T-80UD, T-84U Oplot, BMP-2, BMP-3, BTR-3, BTR-4, 2S7, 2S9, 2K22, fielded in 2018, and BM-21, while building firepower and air-defence systems around M777 HSS, HIMARS, fielded in 1992, S-300, Buk-M1, Kub-M3, Stinger, Javelin, NLAW, and AT4. The M777 had entered service in 1988, while Bayraktar TB2 was fielded in 2014. Both sides used frontline recovery and maintenance units to address damage, wear, and captured equipment, but whether such equipment could be employed depended on its condition, spare parts, crew training, and resupply.
dossier.tactics: 2022年2月24日，俄軍同時展開北方、東北部與南方進攻。北方集群從白俄羅斯向基輔、速向切爾尼戈夫與蘇梅推進，傘兵及直升機部隊在霍斯托梅爾、瓦西爾基夫與查伊卡一帶著陸，企圖控制重要機場並切斷基輔方向的道路；北線因道路壅塞、補給拉長、部隊分散及指揮失靈而未能在基輔城下形成持續攻勢。東北部集群由別爾戈羅羅德、沃羅涅日及羅斯托夫方向進攻哈爾科夫與盧甘斯克，但未能完成伊久姆至庫皮揚斯克的鉗形合圍。南方集群從克里米亞越過克里米亞地峽，向赫爾松及扎波羅熱擴張，2月26日控制梅利托波爾、2月底控制別爾迪揚斯克、3月初進入埃涅爾戈達爾，並以長時間圍攻拿下馬里烏波爾及亞速鋼鐵廠一帶。4月18日，俄軍在頓巴斯重啟固定方向攻勢，至5月下旬把主要戰場推向北頓尼茨克與北盧甘斯克，6月底控制北頓尼茨克，7月17日控制萊先昌斯克。9月初，烏克蘭利用俄軍從北方及東北方向抽調部隊造成的空隙，在哈爾科夫州反擊，9月10日奪回利曼，9月中旬進入庫皮揚斯克，但未立即完全控制該市。俄軍9月21日宣布徵召，9月30日簽署部分動員命令，新编成部隊其後被投入庫皮揚斯克及北頓涅茨克方向；多支部隊缺乏完整裝甲、炮兵協同與系統訓練，因此仍高度依賴炮兵、兵役人員與後方射擊支援。Lancet及Orlan-10分別用於反裝甲攻擊和炮兵座標偵察，Kh-101、Kinzhal、無人飛行器與彈道飛彈則打擊鐵路、彈藥庫、機場及指揮節點。到11月底，俄軍放棄部分哈爾科夫突出部與赫爾松西岸，退往較易防守的地帶，並在北頓涅茨克至扎波羅熱方向趕建蘇羅維金防線，但整場戰役仍停留在流動戰與陣地戰交替的階段。
dossier.tacticsEn: On 24 February 2022, Russia launched attacks across the northern, northeastern, and southern sectors. The northern grouping advanced from Belarus toward Kyiv and toward Chernihiv and Sumy. Airborne and helicopter forces landed around Hostomel, Vasylkiv, and Chaika to seize airfields and disrupt roads leading to Kyiv. The northern offensive failed to generate sustained pressure against Kyiv because of road congestion, stretched supply lines, dispersed formations, and command failures. The northeastern grouping attacked Kharkiv and Luhansk from the Belgorod, Voronezh, and Rostov directions but did not close the pincer between Izium and Kupyansk. The southern grouping crossed the Crimean Isthmus from Crimea toward Kherson and Zaporizhzhia. It took Melitopol on 26 February, Berdyansk near the end of February, and Enerhodar in early March, then spent months seizing Mariupol and the Azovstal area. On 18 April, Russia renewed its fixed-axis offensive in Donbas. By late May the principal battles had shifted to Severodonetsk and northern Luhansk; Russia took Severodonetsk by the end of June and Lysychansk on 17 July. In early September, Ukraine exploited the redeployment of Russian formations from the north and northeast by counterattacking in Kharkiv Oblast. Ukrainian forces retook Lyman on 10 September and entered Kupyansk in mid-September without immediately gaining full control of the city. Russia announced conscription on 21 September and signed the partial-mobilization decree on 30 September. The resulting formations were committed to the Kupyansk and northern Donetsk sectors. Many lacked integrated armour, artillery support, and systematic training, so they remained heavily dependent on artillery, conscripted personnel, and rear-area fire support. Lancet and Orlan-10 were used for anti-armour attacks and artillery reconnaissance, while Kh-101, Kinzhal, unmanned aircraft, and ballistic missiles struck railways, ammunition depots, airfields, and command nodes. By late November, Russian forces had relinquished parts of the Kharkiv salient and most of the western bank at Kherson, moved into more defensible positions, and accelerated construction of the Surovikin defensive line from northern Donetsk toward Zaporizhzhia, although the campaign continued to alternate between maneuver warfare and positional operations.
dossier.data: 美國情報總監辦公室在2022年2月18日估算，俄軍在烏克蘭周邊集結超過169,000名人員，較1月30日所評估的約100,000人增加；同一評估列出3,894輛戰鬥車、491套火炮系統、370架固定翼飛機及60架直升機。這是部署估計，不是開戰時完整編制。時間線顯示，2月24日全面進攻開始，2月26日梅利托波爾淪陷，4月18日頓巴斯固定方向攻勢展開，5月下旬北頓尼茨克成為主戰場，7月17日萊先昌斯克失守，9月初烏克蘭在哈爾科夫州反攻，9月10日利曼失而復得，9月17日烏軍宣布進入庫皮揚斯克。赫爾松撤退命令於11月11日發出，俄方在11月20日宣布撤軍完成，烏方則確認西岸主要市區已撤空；9月30日的部分動員令在11月30日以停止徵召的命令作結。12月31日，普京下令從扎波羅熱州部分地區撤軍，但年內沒有獨立核實全部完成。聯合國人权监测團在11月24日核實了一次交換，涉及802名被俘人員及34名受傷軍人。各階段死亡、受傷、失蹤及被俘數字因確認方式、統計時點與分類規則不同，無法可靠拼成單一總數，因此本實錄不採用任何未經核實的精確傷亡總表。
dossier.dataEn: On 18 February 2022, the United States Office of the Director of National Intelligence estimated that Russia had massed more than 169,000 personnel near Ukraine, up from about 100,000 on 30 January. The same assessment listed 3,894 combat vehicles, 491 artillery systems, 370 fixed-wing aircraft, and 60 helicopters. These were deployment estimates rather than a complete wartime order of battle. The chronology records the full-scale invasion on 24 February, the fall of Melitopol on 26 February, the fixed-axis Donbas offensive launched on 18 April, the emergence of Severodonetsk as the main battlefield in late May, the fall of Lysychansk on 17 July, the Ukrainian counteroffensive in Kharkiv Oblast in early September, the recapture of Lyman on 10 September, and Ukraine’s announcement that it had entered Kupyansk on 17 September. The order to withdraw from Kherson was issued on 11 November; Russia announced completion on 20 November, while Ukraine confirmed that the main urban area west of the Dnieper had been vacated. The 30 September partial-mobilization decree was concluded by an order ending conscription on 30 November. On 31 December, Putin ordered the withdrawal of Russian forces from parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, although there was no independent confirmation that this withdrawal had been completed within 2022. On 24 November, the United Nations human-rights monitoring mission verified an exchange involving 802 prisoners of war and 34 wounded service members. Reported deaths, injuries, missing personnel, and prisoners differed across stages because verification methods, reporting dates, and classification rules were not consistent. A single reliable casualty total therefore cannot be assembled, and this record does not use any unverified precision casualty total.
dossier.cause: 直接背景可分成_structural與政治層次。2014年，俄羅斯兼併克里米亞並支持頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地方武裝，烏克蘭的領土完整與邊境安全從此成為長期爭議；2015年的明斯克協議建立了停火框架，但沒有解決實際控制與全面撤軍問題，部分地區仍持續戰鬥。俄羅斯自2021年起在烏克蘭邊境增加兵員，2022年初美國情報機構評估其正在準備大規模攻勢。2月21日至22日，普京承認兩個地方政權並主張其對烏克蘭相關地區的主權，2月23日發表講話並下令展開特別軍事行動，成為全面入侵的政治與軍事觸發點。俄羅斯公開提出的要求包括烏克蘭從頓巴斯全面撤軍、限制北約在烏境內的軍事存在及由北約提供新的安全保證；基輔拒絕以割讓主權、承認佔領或放棄防衛合作來換取停火。烏克蘭自2014年後確實重建軍力，北約也在2019年承諾加入程序，但公開情報並未建立烏克蘭準備立即攻擊俄羅斯或北約基地的可靠時間表。北約國家沒有直接參戰，烏克蘭也沒有被證實在2022年2月先發動全面進攻，因此近因是俄羅斯作出的進攻決定，而不是已發生的北約交戰或烏克蘭先攻。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate background can be divided into structural and political causes. In 2014, Russia annexed Crimea and supported the local forces in Donetsk and Luhansk, making Ukrainian territorial integrity and border security continuing sources of dispute. The 2015 Minsk agreements established a ceasefire framework but did not resolve territorial control or a complete troop withdrawal, and fighting continued in some areas. Russia increased troop numbers along Ukraine’s borders from 2021, and in early 2022 United States intelligence assessed preparations for a large offensive. On 21 and 22 February, Putin recognized the two separatist administrations and asserted sovereignty over the relevant Ukrainian regions; on 23 February he delivered an address and ordered the launch of the special military operation, creating the political and military trigger for the full-scale invasion. Russia publicly demanded a complete Ukrainian withdrawal from Donbas, restrictions on NATO military presence in Ukraine, and new NATO security guarantees. Kyiv rejected a ceasefire based on ceding sovereignty, recognizing occupation, or abandoning defence cooperation. Ukraine had genuinely rebuilt its armed forces since 2014, and NATO had granted an accession roadmap in 2019, but open-source intelligence did not establish a reliable timetable showing that Ukraine planned an immediate attack on Russia or NATO bases. NATO states did not enter the war, and Ukraine was not verified as having launched the full-scale invasion first. The proximate cause was therefore Russia’s decision to attack, rather than an existing NATO war or an established Ukrainian first strike.
dossier.impact: 作戰層面上，北方速戰速決計劃受挫，暴露了俄軍長距離縱隊、燃料供應、指揮通信及後勤規劃的限制；南方戰線較快取得進展，卻沒有消除北頓尼茨克與馬里烏波爾的長期消耗戰。到秋季，主動權主要集中於頓巴斯，俄軍增加炮兵、徵召部隊與遠程打擊，依賴固定火力支援及大量被動承受衝擊的營級進攻。俄羅斯工業動員雖擴大了炮彈與飛彈供應，庫存、炮管壽命和裝備補充仍形成持續負擔；烏克蘭則利用縱深防禦、反炮兵偵察、無人飛行器、M777 HSS、HIMARS、Javelin等武器維持重點方向的反擊能力，外部防空系統也降低了俄軍航空與巡航飛彈的威脅。黑海方面，Moscow號巡洋艦於3月17日被擊沉，烏軍於9月底收復蛇島，克里米亞港口、軍用機場及補給節點持續遭打擊；連接克里米亞與羅斯托夫的克里米亞大橋公路部分於10月19日重新開放，增加了南部運輸選項，但未能取代整個鐵路與公路補給網。瓦格納組織6月23日至24日拒絕俄軍指揮系統並短暫占領總參謀部大樓所在區域，迫使克里姆林宮重新協商其指揮關係，該組織其後返回前線。政治層面上，2月3日聯合國大會第ES-11/1號決議譴責侵略，多數會員國拒絕承認俄羅斯9月兼併四州的法律效果，北約與歐盟則持續提供軍援和制裁。遠程打擊提高了雙方後方成本，但沒有切斷烏克蘭的指揮、替補與城市補給，也沒有迫使基輔接受俄方條件。
dossier.impactEn: Operationally, the collapse of the northern blitzkrieg plan exposed weaknesses in Russian long columns, fuel supply, command communications, and logistics planning. The southern front made faster gains but did not eliminate the attritional fighting in northern Donetsk and Mariupol. By autumn, initiative was concentrated mainly in Donbas, where Russia relied on heavier artillery use, mobilized formations, long-range strikes, and infantry attacks that often absorbed impacts through mass rather than mobility. Russia’s industrial mobilization expanded artillery and missile output, but stocks, barrel life, and equipment replacement remained continuing strains. Ukraine used defense in depth, counter-battery reconnaissance, drones, M777 HSS, HIMARS, Javelin, and other weapons to sustain counterattacks in selected sectors, while imported air-defence systems reduced the threat from Russian aircraft and cruise missiles. In the Black Sea, the cruiser Moskva was sunk on 17 March, Ukraine recaptured Snake Island at the end of September, and military airfields, ports, and supply nodes in Crimea continued to come under attack. The road section of the Crimean Bridge reopened on 19 October, adding a transport option for the southern theater but not replacing the railway and road network. Between 23 and 24 June, Wagner refused the Russian command chain and briefly occupied the area around the General Staff headquarters, forcing the Kremlin to renegotiate its command relationship before Wagner returned to the front. Politically, United Nations General Assembly Resolution ES-11/1 condemned the aggression on 3 March, most member states refused to recognize the legal effect of Russia’s September annexation of four oblasts, and NATO and the European Union continued military support and sanctions. Long-range strikes increased rear-area costs but did not sever Ukrainian command, replacement, and urban supply systems or compel Kyiv to accept Russian conditions.
dossier.result: 截至2022年12月31日，俄羅斯沒有奪取基輔、蘇梅、切爾尼戈夫、哈爾科夫或敖德薩，北方集群未能進入基輔市中心作持續控制，北東部的伊久姆至庫皮揚斯克合圍也沒有形成；南方集群雖取得梅利托波爾、馬里烏波爾、克里米亞及部分扎波羅熱地區，卻未建立跨越烏克蘭全國的連續控制線。烏克蘭仍保有基輔、哈爾科夫、第聶伯羅彼得羅夫斯克、扎波羅熱、敖德薩及尼古拉耶夫等主要城市，也控制赫爾松西岸；俄方則繼續控制克里米亞、亞速海部分海岸，以及盧甘斯克、頓涅茨克、扎波羅熱和哈爾科夫州的部分地區，但沒有控制這四州全部領土。9月撤出哈爾科夫州北部部分突出部、11月撤出赫爾松西岸，是具有明確戰術意義的撤退，卻不等於俄方放棄整場入侵或所有既有控制區。部分動員確實增加了俄軍人手，使部分新編部隊能投入北頓尼茨克、庫皮揚斯克與瓦格納方向作戰，但訓練、裝備、補給及指揮整合不足仍限制整體攻勢。到年底，俄軍在北頓涅茨克至扎波羅熱方向推進蘇羅維金防線，烏軍則以縱深陣地、選擇性反擊和局部奪回赫爾松維持防線。因此，2022年的結果不是任何一方取得完整戰略勝利：俄羅斯擴大了2022年2月24日以後在南部與頓巴斯的控制，卻未完成北方速決及全國控制目標；烏克蘭避免了國家與主要城市失守，卻仍未能收復克里米亞及2014年以來被俄方控制的大部分頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地區。停火、全面撤軍及永久解決領土問題均未達成，軍事衝突在2023年繼續。
dossier.resultEn: By 31 December 2022, Russia had not taken Kyiv, Sumy, Chernihiv, Kharkiv, or Odesa. The northern grouping had not gained sustained control of central Kyiv, and the northeastern pincer between Izium and Kupyansk had not formed. The southern grouping had taken Melitopol, Mariupol, Crimea, and parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, but it had not established continuous control across Ukraine. Ukraine retained Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, Mykolaiv, and the western bank of Kherson. Russian and Russian-aligned forces continued to control Crimea, part of the Sea of Azov coast, and areas of Luhansk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv oblasts, but not the entirety of those four oblasts. The September withdrawal from parts of the northern Kharkiv salient and the November withdrawal from the western bank of Kherson were tactically meaningful retreats, but they did not amount to abandonment of the invasion or every area previously held by Russia. Mobilization did add personnel and allowed newly formed formations to be committed in northern Donetsk, around Kupyansk, and alongside Wagner, but inadequate training, equipment, supply, and command integration continued to constrain Russia’s offensive capability. By the end of the year, Russia was constructing the Surovikin defensive line from northern Donetsk toward Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine maintained a defense in depth, conducted selective counterattacks, and recovered most of Kherson. The result was therefore not a complete strategic victory for either side. Russia enlarged its control in southern Ukraine and Donbas after 24 February but did not achieve its northern rapid-decision goal or nationwide control. Ukraine prevented the loss of the state and its principal cities but did not recover Crimea or most of the Donetsk and Luhansk territory held by Russia since 2014. No ceasefire, complete withdrawal, or permanent territorial settlement had been achieved, and military operations continued into 2023.

battle.name: 以色列—哈馬斯戰爭
battle.brief: 以色列—哈馬斯戰爭自二〇二三年十月起，成為中文維基「戰爭列表」所收錄的當代衝突。戰場中，以軍地面部隊廣泛使用「梅卡瓦四型」主戰坦克，負責裝甲部隊作戰；此型早於本輪衝突已列入以色列陸軍服役。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦四型主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦四型是以色列陸軍裝甲部隊的主力主戰坦克，位於地面作戰體系的裝甲核心，並承擔部隊防護與機動任務。

dossier.countries: 這是一場力量與手段並不對等的跨境戰爭：以色列國家與以色列國防軍是主要交戰方；哈馬斯是控制加薩地帶並實際執行攻勢的武裝組織，不能把哈馬斯寫成國家。除哈馬斯武裝部隊外，巴勒斯坦聖戰組織曾從加薩向以色列境內施射火箭，但地面戰與主要防務由哈馬斯主導。伊朗提供政治、武器與後勤協助，並於2023年10月14日直接發動大規模遠程攻擊；真主黨、胡塞武裝、伊拉克民兵及敘利亞方向武裝分別在北部、東部與西部形成牽制。美國提供防空彈藥補給與海上防衛支援，英國與法國部署防禦性海軍力量；卡塔爾與埃及則在11月推動暫停交戰。
dossier.countriesEn: This was an asymmetric cross-border war. Israel and the Israel Defense Forces were the principal belligerents, while Hamas was the armed organization controlling Gaza and carrying out the offensive; Hamas should not be described as a country. In addition to Hamas forces, Palestinian Islamic Jihad fired rockets from Gaza toward Israel, although Hamas led the ground fighting and principal defensive operations. Iran supplied political, weapons, and logistical support and directly launched a large-scale long-range attack on October 14, 2023. Hezbollah, the Houthi movement, Iraqi militias, and armed groups operating from Syria created pressure on the northern, eastern, and western fronts. The United States provided air-defense ammunition replenishment and maritime defensive support, while the United Kingdom and France deployed naval forces in a defensive posture. Qatar and Egypt promoted a temporary cessation of hostilities in November.
dossier.people: 人物層次必須分清政治責任、總參謀部與戰區指揮。以色列總理本雅明·內塔尼胡主持自10月7日成立的戰時內閣；國防部長約奧夫·加蘭特在10月22日後由伊斯卡·卡茨接替。本尼·甘茨在戰役爆發時任以色列國防軍總參謀長，負責動員與統籌，11月1日卸任後，由原南部戰區司令赫茲·哈勒維接任。加薩方面，哈馬斯政治局主席伊斯梅爾·哈尼亞負責政治領導，最高軍事責任主要歸於穆罕默德·戴夫；聖戰旅參謀長葉海亞·薩拉吉則是公開發動攻勢、承認協調角色的重要人物。公開資料無法完整還原各營、連的即時指揮鏈，因此不能把每支突擊分隊都直接歸入最高指揮人員名下。
dossier.peopleEn: Responsibility must be separated among political leadership, the General Staff, and theater command. Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu chaired the wartime cabinet formed on October 7. Defense minister Yoav Gallant was replaced by Israel Katz after October 22. Benny Gantz served as chief of staff when the war began and directed mobilization and overall coordination before leaving office on November 1, when Herzi Halevi, previously commander of the Southern Front, succeeded him. In Gaza, Hamas Political Bureau chairman Ismail Haniyeh represented the organization's political leadership, while primary military responsibility was associated with Mohammed Deif. Qassam Brigades deputy commander Yehya al-Sarraj publicly acknowledged a coordinating role in launching the offensive. Public sources do not permit a complete reconstruction of every battalion and company's real-time chain of command, so individual assault detachments should not automatically be attributed directly to the highest commanders.
dossier.kits: 截至2023年已投入服役的主要裝備包括Merkava Mk4主戰坦克，該車配有120毫米主砲，部分車輛裝有Trophy主動防護系統；步兵、作戰工程與砲兵部隊使用155毫米自走式或牽引式榴彈砲，以及履帶式裝甲工程車。空中主力包括F-15I與F-16I戰機、AH-64E長臂攻擊直升機，以及IAI Eitan、Heron無人飛行平台。防空體系由Iron Dome使用的Tamir攔截彈、David's Sling使用的Stunner攔截彈和Arrow-3攔截彈構成，反裝甲作戰則可見Spike系列导弹。海軍警戒力量包括Sa'ar 4.5型飛彈艇與Sa'ar 5型護衛艦。哈馬斯一方可由公開資料確認的裝備包括AKM步槍、PKM通用機槍、RPG-7火箭筒、迫擊砲、火箭發射器、反裝甲飛彈、商用無人機及高速海上突擊艇；並非每件武器都有足夠證據判定其確切廠牌與型號尾碼。
dossier.kitsEn: The principal equipment already in service by 2023 included the Merkava Mk4 main battle tank, fitted with a 120 mm main gun and, on some vehicles, the Trophy active protection system. Infantry, combat-engineer, and artillery units used 155 mm self-propelled or towed howitzers and tracked armored engineering vehicles. The air arm centered on F-15I and F-16I fighters, AH-64E attack helicopters, and IAI Eitan and Heron unmanned platforms. The air-defense network relied on Tamir interceptors for Iron Dome, Stunner interceptors for David's Sling, and Arrow-3 interceptors, while Spike-family missiles were available for anti-armor operations. Maritime security and deterrence were supported by Sa'ar 4.5-class missile boats and Sa'ar 5-class corvettes. Publicly documented Hamas equipment included AKM rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, mortars, rocket launchers, anti-tank missiles, commercial drones, and fast assault craft. The available evidence does not establish the exact manufacturer and variant suffix of every weapon.
dossier.tactics: 10月7日清晨，哈馬斯以多方向協同的攻勢開場：地面突擊隊越過加薩與以色列間的邊界，高速海上小艇衝擊近岸防衛，飛行器攻擊與傘具滲入同步進行，部分分隊襲擊以軍據點、砲兵陣地與指揮節點。以軍前沿部隊利用預設陣地阻滯突破，後方則部署防空系統、封閉缺口、投入預備隊，並由戰機與直升機打擊已確認的發射陣地和指揮節點。10月13日，以軍公布Swords of Iron行動；10月14日，第162師由西南側的Kerem Shalom進入加薩，第252師由北側Erez方向投入，第82師、210師與146師依序在北部、中部及南部軸線作戰。步兵、Merkava坦克、砲兵、戰鬥工程車與空中支援協同推進，透過日夜突擊、據點攻堅及地下通道搜索逐步壓縮哈馬斯陣地。10月下旬戰鬥集中於加薩市，10月27日以軍在加薩市北部實施特種部隊突擊。11月1日，以軍官方確認十三名士兵在傑巴利亞一處地下通道中陣亡。進入11月後，主要地面戰重心轉向漢尤尼斯，12月再向拉法東部接近地延伸；月底雖曾短暫停火，但部署方向並未根本逆轉。
dossier.tacticsEn: At dawn on October 7, Hamas opened with a coordinated multidirectional assault. Ground teams crossed the boundary between Gaza and Israel, fast maritime craft attacked the near-shore defense, aircraft attacks and infiltration by parachute systems occurred simultaneously, and some detachments struck Israeli military positions, artillery positions, and command nodes. Israeli forward units used prepared positions to slow penetrations while rear echelons deployed air defenses, closed gaps, committed reserves, and employed fighters and helicopters against confirmed launch sites and command nodes. The IDF announced Operation Swords of Iron on October 13. On October 14, the 162nd Division entered Gaza from the southwest through Kerem Shalom, while the 252nd Division entered along the northern axis near Erez. The 82nd, 210th, and 146th Divisions were committed in turn along northern, central, and southern axes. Infantry, Merkava tanks, artillery, combat engineers, and air support worked together through daylight and night raids, strongpoint attacks, and underground searches to compress Hamas positions. Fighting concentrated on Gaza City in late October, followed by a special-forces raid north of the city on October 27. On November 1, the IDF confirmed that thirteen soldiers had been killed in an underground passage at Jabalia. During November, the principal ground effort shifted toward Khan Younis and in December extended toward approaches to eastern Rafah. A late-month pause did not fundamentally reverse the deployment.
dossier.data: 可核對的硬資料顯示，加薩地帶南北長約四十公里、寬度約六至十二公里，是高度狹長的戰區。以軍官方曾表示已動員接近三十萬預備役人員，但這個數字是官方動員估計，並非經獨立審核的最終人口統計。前線重型裝備主要由埃拉特港送入，再經內蓋夫北部與貝爾謝巴周邊後勤節點，以受護護公路車隊分送至南部、中部與北部戰區。155毫米砲彈、Merkava的120毫米砲彈、Spike反裝甲飛彈及Tamir、Stunner、Arrow系列攔截彈均面臨持續補充需求，美國自10月下旬開始向以色列交付額外防空攔截彈，但各批確切數量沒有完整公開。哈馬斯主要依賴預先儲存的火箭、迫擊砲彈與反裝甲武器，以色列對加薩的邊境、海上與空域管制限制補給，卻沒有可靠資料證明其分散庫存已完全耗盡。11月30日上午8時，埃及、卡塔爾與美國推動的暫停交戰正式生效，12月1日即告破裂。截至12月31日，自10月7日起計已進入第86天；各方沒有可交叉核對的每日完整傷亡總數，因此不引用單一精確總傷亡。
dossier.dataEn: Verifiable hard data show that Gaza is approximately forty kilometers long and between six and twelve kilometers wide, making it a narrow and elongated theater. Israeli officials stated that close to three hundred thousand reservists had been mobilized, but this was an official mobilization estimate rather than an independently audited final figure. Heavy equipment for the forward areas was supplied principally through the port of Eilat and then moved through logistics nodes in northern Negev and the Beersheba area in protected road convoys to the southern, central, and northern sectors. There was continuing demand for 155 mm artillery shells, Merkava 120 mm ammunition, Spike anti-armor missiles, and Tamir, Stunner, and Arrow interceptors. The United States began delivering additional air-defense interceptors to Israel in late October, although complete quantities for each delivery were not released. Hamas relied primarily on prepositioned rockets, mortar ammunition, and anti-armor weapons. Israeli border, maritime, and airspace controls restricted resupply, but no reliable evidence establishes that Hamas's distributed stocks were completely exhausted. A cessation promoted by Egypt, Qatar, and the United States took effect at 8 a.m. on November 30 and broke down on December 1. Counting from October 7, December 31 was day 86. No complete, cross-verifiable daily casualty totals for all parties were available, so no single precise aggregate casualty figure is cited.
dossier.cause: 戰爭的直接誘因是2023年10月7日哈馬斯對以色列發動的跨邊界攻勢，但原因不能只歸於單一事件。2007年哈馬斯取得加薩控制權後，以色列實施嚴格的邊境、海上與空域管制；哈馬斯則以火箭、地下通道及分散式武裝回應，雙方在2014年、2021年與2022年的直接軍事衝突中已多次逼近全面戰爭。2023年7月，加薩與約旦河西岸同步升溫，區域代理人與外部力量也持續活動，使危機累積。哈馬斯公開宣稱10月7日行動旨在突破以色列安全包圍、展示境內火力並迫使解除加薩限制；其最高層是否另有推翻以色列國家體系的目標，仍有爭議，不能當作已證實命令。以色列政府則把公開軍事目標界定為摧毀哈馬斯軍事統治、解除火箭與地下通道威脅，並在加薩建立有效軍事控制；這項政治目標與後來的戰場結果並未自動結合成同一個議題。
dossier.causeEn: The immediate trigger was Hamas's cross-border attack against Israel on October 7, 2023, but the war cannot be explained by a single incident. After Hamas took control of Gaza in 2007, Israel imposed strict border, maritime, and airspace controls. Hamas responded with rockets, tunnels, and dispersed armed formations, and the two sides repeatedly approached renewed general war during direct military confrontations in 2014, 2021, and 2022. Tensions rose simultaneously in Gaza and the West Bank during July 2023, while regional proxies and outside powers remained active, further accumulating pressure. Hamas publicly described the October 7 operation as an effort to breach Israel's security perimeter, demonstrate firepower inside Gaza, and force a lifting of restrictions on Gaza. Whether its leadership intended anything beyond that, including the overthrow of the Israeli state, remains disputed and should not be presented as a proven order. The Israeli government publicly defined its military goals as dismantling Hamas military rule, neutralizing the rocket and tunnel threat, and establishing effective military control in Gaza. Those political goals and subsequent battlefield outcomes did not automatically resolve into the same political conclusion.
dossier.impact: 戰事的直接影響是以色列由邊境防衛與遠程空襲，轉為持續時間長、動員規模大的地面與空中協同戰役；戰車、步兵、砲兵、戰鬥工程和防空彈藥都需要長期補充。哈馬斯的中央指揮與部分地面部隊受到重創，車輛、通信和地下通道遭到破壞，但其火力仍能分散運作，使以軍無法僅靠封鎖一個城市就消除全部抵抗能力。10月14日，伊朗首次從本土直接以無人機、巡飛飛彈與彈道飛彈大規模攻擊以色列，使戰爭由加薩主戰場迅速擴張為多戰區危機。真主黨、胡塞武裝與伊拉克民兵分別開闢火力牽制，美國啟動Sentinel of the Guardians海上行動，派遣航母戰鬥群與防空巡洋艦，DDG-79USS Carney等艦艇執行攔截，英國與法國也部署防禦性海軍力量。區域防空消耗、補給週期與戰區指揮因此成為軍事瓶頸；卡塔爾與埃及的外交穿梭則顯示，軍事暫停與政治安排必須分開處理。
dossier.impactEn: The immediate consequence was Israel's transition from border defense and long-range strikes to a sustained, large-scale combination of ground and air operations. Tanks, infantry, artillery, combat-engineer equipment, and air-defense ammunition all required sustained replenishment. Hamas's central command and parts of its ground organization suffered major losses, and vehicles, communications, and tunnels were damaged, but its firepower continued to operate in dispersed form. Israel therefore could not neutralize the resistance merely by isolating one city. On October 14, Iran directly launched a large-scale attack against Israel from Iranian territory using drones, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles, marking the first such direct Iranian attack on Israel. The war consequently expanded from the Gaza theater into a wider regional crisis. Hezbollah, the Houthi movement, and Iraqi militias opened additional fronts. The United States launched Operation Sentinel of the Guardians, deploying carrier strike groups and air-defense cruisers, while ships such as DDG-79 USS Carney conducted interceptions. The United Kingdom and France also deployed defensive naval forces. Regional air-defense consumption, replenishment cycles, and theater command became major military constraints. Diplomatic shuttle efforts by Qatar and Egypt demonstrated that a temporary military halt and a political settlement had to be handled as separate problems.
dossier.result: 題目以2023標示戰爭，因此完整實錄採2023年10月7日至12月31日；這段時期結束時戰爭本身並未終止。到年底，以色列掌握北部加薩、加薩市數條主要走廊及漢尤尼斯周邊的封鎖與突入陣地，並維持由北向南的推進體系。哈馬斯失去部分中央通信、指揮與地面裝備，但仍可從北部邊緣及分散地下網使用火箭、迫擊砲、狙擊與小規模突擊。以軍公布多項指揮官陣亡及地下設施被毀的成果，但完整的組織損失無法公開獨立核對。11月30日的暫停交戰在12月1日破裂，年末沒有全面停火，也沒有形成政治協議。就2023年的軍事結果而言，以色列重新取得戰略主動權並擴大地面控制，哈馬斯的跨邊界攻勢則被壓制但組織未被消除；因此這不是戰爭的最終結局，而只是第一階段的年度總結。
dossier.resultEn: Because the question identifies the war with 2023, the complete chronicle covers October 7 through December 31, 2023. The war itself had not ended when this period closed. By the end of the year, Israel held positions in northern Gaza, along several principal corridors through Gaza City, and around the encirclement and penetration positions near Khan Younis, while maintaining a north-to-south operational system. Hamas had lost part of its central communications, command network, and ground equipment, but it could still use rockets, mortars, sniper fire, and small assaults from the northern edge and dispersed tunnel network. Israel announced the deaths of multiple commanders and the destruction of underground facilities, but the full organizational losses could not be independently verified in public. The cessation that began on November 30 broke down on December 1. No full ceasefire or political settlement existed by the end of the year. The military result for 2023 was that Israel regained strategic initiative and expanded ground control, while Hamas's cross-border offensive was checked but the organization was not eliminated. The year therefore ended with an interim operational balance rather than a final conclusion to the war.
